chapters.title: Chapter 51: The Dangerous Midterm Exam
paragraphs: Compared to lower-tier Yao Beasts like the Bodhi Precious Snake, Yang Fan felt that he could completely use the living space within his Divine Kingdom to cultivate the Elf Race.
According to the data, wherever the Elf Race existed, the growth rate of plants would increase significantly by 50%.
If the Elf Race could be spread throughout the entire Divine Kingdom, it would at least be comparable to a C-rank Planting Talent.
Currently, Yang Fan had also cultivated quite a few low-tier Yao Beasts in his Divine Kingdom.
He didn’t want these Yao Beasts to bring him much profit, but mainly to stabilize the ecology.
If conditions permitted, Yang Fan would have liked to sell them all.
After all, a lot of Great Rocs had appeared recently to steal his Blood Clotting Flowers.
Once the Ancient Spirit Tree nurtured enough little spirits, Yang Fan could try to clear out the small fry in the Divine Kingdom and restore a clear and bright universe.
After figuring out the function of the Ancient Spirit Tree, Yang Fan began his grand procurement endeavor.
Leaving so many Faith Points in the Divine Kingdom without spending them would incur “divine retribution”.
“Buy 80 adult Taisui first.” With a wave of his hand, Yang Fan directly spent 160 million.
Nowadays, the food in the Divine Kingdom was very abundant.

Not only was there a supply of blood pills from the Hundred Spirits Blood Pool, but those twenty Taisui, under the cutting of the Fully Automatic Concentrator, could produce a large amount of compressed meat every day.
Yang Fan could feel that, given his believers’ current consumption of food, they could at most consume 1/8 of the output, and the food warehouse had already accumulated a lot.
But who asked these foods to have a long enough shelf life.
He who lacks long-term consideration must have near-term worries.
Nowadays, because too many Blood Clotting Flowers were planted, his believer population had not multiplied on a large scale.
Moreover, the stronger the believers’ strength became in the future, the consumption of food would definitely increase exponentially.
Anyway, Faith Points were sufficient, so he would first max out the production capacity of the Fully Automatic Concentrator; inventory could never be too much.
Even if they really couldn’t finish eating, to the point where the Divine Kingdom couldn’t pile it all up, Yang Fan could completely sell it in the Divine Shop.
No matter how one calculated this business, it wouldn’t result in a loss.
Subsequently, Yang Fan purchased another 500 Moon Wells and 500 Sun Springs, reducing his funds by a huge 300 million.
First, it was to increase fixed investments.
After all, sheer luck like today’s couldn’t happen all the time, and high-return investments like Blood Clotting Flowers would end after the College Entrance Examination.
For long-term planning, he had to purchase more fixed assets to increase long-term cash flow.
Second, it was for the growth of the Ancient Spirit Tree.
The richer the aura of life within the Divine Kingdom, the faster the Ancient Spirit Tree would grow.
Since he was prepared to vigorously cultivate the Elf Race, Yang Fan naturally had to consider this when making investments.
Afterwards, Yang Fan purchased another 10,000 Marrow Cleansing Pills.
After this period of development in the Divine Kingdom, apart from those Tier 1 and Tier 2 living beings, the believers who had failed to break through had long since died.
Yang Fan prepared to select another 10,000 Mortals with the best Aptitude to take the Marrow Cleansing Pills, thereby improving the overall Aptitude of the believers.
In the blink of an eye, the over 600 million Faith Points were left with only over 80 million.
With a thought from Yang Fan, all the purchased resources were loaded into the Divine Kingdom.
The Ancient Spirit Tree was placed by Yang Fan in the deepest part of the Divine Kingdom’s forest, and then he used Divine Power to directly carve out a huge open space.
As the Ancient Spirit Tree descended, the towering ancient trees around it seemed to sense something; their branches began to sway, jumping and cheering like people.
Yang Fan could feel that the overall aura of life within his Divine Kingdom had risen by a sliver.
Afterward, he neatly placed the Moon Wells and Sun Springs located in Shenqi City, along with the newly purchased buildings, on both sides of the Ancient Spirit Tree.

A massive aura of life instantly filled the entire forest, and the open space that had just been carved out by Yang Fan with Divine Power was actually growing weeds at a speed visible to the naked eye.
Yang Fan could feel that the Ancient Spirit Tree really liked this kind of environment.
The branches of the ancient tree were currently wrapped in green leaves, and it had already begun to nurture little spirits.
“Divine Master: Yang Fan
Divine Kingdom Area: One million square kilometers
Talent: F-rank Resource Talent (All resources within the Divine Kingdom accelerate growth by 10%)
SSS-Rank Talent: Evolution (Unique talent, can accelerate Divine Kingdom Evolution, hidden.)
Believers: Tier 2 Living Beings (25), Tier 1 Living Beings (644), Mortals (330,000)

Techniques: Five Elements Cultivation Technique, Vajra Indestructible Technique, Federal Body Refinement Technique, Muscle and Tendon Strengthening and Marrow Cleansing Technique, Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array (Minor Achievement)...
Faith Points: 82.67 million (Providing 27.2 Faith Points daily)

Buildings: Moon Well X1000, Sun Spring X1000, Special Life Building Ancient Spirit Tree (Millennial, nurturing little spirits), B-rank Building Hundred Spirits Blood Pool X1 (Soaking 10 Taisui, load rate 100%), Special Building Fully Automatic Concentrator X1 (Cutting plant loaded with 100 Taisui, load rate 100%), C-rank transmission tower X5
Assets: Blood Clotting Flower (X8 million, D-rank Spirit Plant), Taisui X110, Bodhi Precious Snake...”
Relying on the tenfold Evolution Talent, the Moon Wells and Sun Springs he currently possessed could provide a fixed income of 60 million Faith Points every month.
All of this was thanks to the Luo Family’s investment in him, something he wouldn’t even dare to imagine in the past.
Even so, Yang Fan did not become conceited or forget himself.

The massive inflow and outflow of Faith Points during this period made him understand one truth: for the development of the Divine Kingdom, no matter how many Faith Points there were, it would never be enough.
In the following days, Yang Fan’s life began to become regular again.
Attending classes — browsing the Divine Shop and God Forum — attending class reunions.

Ever since he entered the top 100 of the Luo Family in the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle, those Genius classmates had been much more polite to him and frequently invited him when organizing gatherings.
Yang Fan basically attended every time.
Compared to these prodigies born into major families since childhood, Yang Fan indeed lacked a bit in experience and exposure.
Birds of a feather flock together, and people of the same kind group together.
These people’s sharing often allowed Yang Fan to suddenly see the light.
In the past few days, Luo Mingxuan hadn’t spoken in the chat group either, which actually made Yang Fan feel a lot more peaceful.
On this day, Yang Fan came to the Virtual World to attend classes as usual.
Today, Li Qingying’s expression was exceptionally solemn.
“In one month, it will be the midterm exam for the senior grade. The school has already made a decision on the location for this exam.” On the podium, Li Qingying’s tone carried a hint of gravity.
All the students in Class 7, Grade 12 sat up straight and solemn.
This was the midterm exam, and classes would be streamed right after the evaluation ended; its importance was second only to the College Entrance Examination.
“The location chosen for this assessment is the Divine Kingdom of an Alien Demigod, and the opposing deity is not dead.”
The entire Class 7, Grade 12 was exceptionally quiet; you could hear a pin drop.
“Um... Teacher Li, did I hear that right? Are we going to invade the Divine Kingdom of an Alien Demigod?” a classmate in the audience raised a hand to ask.
That tone and demeanor were just short of asking directly whether the school wanted them to go die.
That was a demigod powerhouse; I’m afraid all the Divine Beings in the entire senior grade added together wouldn’t be enough to fill the other party’s teeth gaps.
Once entering the Alien Divine Kingdom, it was equivalent to an invasion.
At that time, the Alien Demigod could also simultaneously lock onto the invader’s Divine Kingdom coordinates.
The opposing party’s believers would dispatch troops to counterattack.
With their current strength, how could they possibly survive?

chapters.title: Chapter 52: Terrifying Rewards
paragraphs: Sensing everyone’s doubts, Li Qingying explained, “The believers of that Alien Demigod have already been weakened quite a bit by the school’s gods. The strongest among them will not exceed a Tier 5 Being, and all students are free to cooperate.”
Hearing this, their expressions did not soften in the slightest.
Even if their strength was weakened by the school’s higher-ups, the opponent was still an Alien Demigod.
The territory of a demigod’s divine kingdom alone spanned tens of millions of square kilometers, and the believer population can be imagined.
The ranked beings among them were definitely not few in number.
If this Alien Demigod no longer held their ground and instead counterattacked their divine kingdoms along the coordinates, it would definitely be a situation of nine deaths and zero life.
The difficulty and risk of this midterm exam were simply too great!
Most of Class 7, Grade 12 came from ordinary families, and ninety percent of them took the logistics route, with the believers in their divine kingdoms being utterly weak.
As the head teacher, Li Qingying could naturally understand these worries.
“This is a decision by the Federal Government. Greenhouses cannot nurture powerhouses. Compared to the dangers of a real Divine Kingdom War, this school exam has already been reduced by a lot.”
“If you are worried about the safety of your own divine kingdom, you can choose to stay in the outer perimeter and let your believers do some gathering work.”

“The main military forces of this Alien Demigod are concentrated in the center of the divine kingdom. Considering that our Human Race’s gods are still around, as long as we do not back him into a corner, he will never launch a large-scale counter-invasion,” Li Qingying comforted.
Hearing this, many students’ complexions looked much better.

Most of them followed the logistics faction, and their believers didn’t have much combat capability to begin with, so naturally they wouldn’t foolishly go to the Divine Kingdom Core area to take risks.
“Since this midterm exam carries a certain degree of mortal danger, the school’s rewards are equally generous.”

“The entire assessment process will be monitored by a high-tier Intelligent Life from start to finish. The Spirit Plants, buildings, corpses of alien believers, and all valuable items obtained within the divine kingdom will be officially recorded. Your final score will be determined based on the amount of your harvest.”
“Not only that, all resources harvested this time can be directly moved back to your own divine kingdom; the school will not confiscate them.”
Hearing this, hope appeared on the faces of many students.
This was an Alien Divine Kingdom where a god was still alive; the treasures inside were bound to be numerous.
Even if it was just the peripheral areas, those low-tier Spirit Plants were still good things for Divine Beings like them.
Li Qingying continued to add, “In addition, the school will grant extra rewards to the top 100 students in the whole school.”

“Rank 10 to 100 will be rewarded with 500 million Faith Points; Rank 4 to 10 will be rewarded with 1 billion Faith Points; 3rd place will be rewarded with 2 billion Faith Points and one Fountain of Life, a special building; 2nd place will be rewarded with 5 billion Faith Points and any building below Grade A from the school’s inventory; 1st place will be rewarded with 10 billion Faith Points and any building below Grade A from the school’s inventory.”
Over 95% of the students in Class 7, Grade 12 did not feel that these rewards had anything to do with them, but this did not stop them from marveling at the school’s lavish expenditure this time.
The special building for 3rd place, the Fountain of Life, although quoted at 1 billion Faith Points in the Divine Shop, had no inventory at all.
It was a strategic resource, and all transactions were private peer-to-peer ones, so its true price definitely exceeded 2 billion.
As for the rewards for 2nd and 1st place, they were even more exaggerated: any building below Grade A from the school’s inventory could be chosen at will.
Yang County No.
1 Middle School was an official institution after all, and all teachers were subject to being transferred to The Frontline to fight against Alien Gods.
The school’s inventory was probably even richer than local snakes like the Luo Family and the Li Family.
Moreover, the value gap of Grade B buildings was extremely large.

Some cheap ones, like the Hundred Spirits Blood Pool, were estimated to be around 1 billion, while some buildings could fundamentally change the Aptitude of believers, or accelerate the development process of the entire divine kingdom, making their value completely inestimable.
Tens of billions or even hundreds of billions were possible.
It wasn’t scary that the school rewarded Grade B buildings; what was scary was that it let you choose them yourself.
This was forcing those monsters in Class 1 to go crazy.
It was not hard to imagine that the competition for the top two spots in this midterm exam would definitely be a fierce battle.
The interests involved were simply too huge—so huge that even gods would be tempted.
The stronger the strength, the more resources one could obtain.
In this midterm exam, 99% of the school’s investment was placed on the top two spots.
Yang Fan was likewise tempted; this was definitely an opportunity to transform into a dragon leaping over the dragon gate.
A moment later, Yang Fan subconsciously shook his head.
His current strength still had far too large a gap compared to monsters heavily invested by families like Luo Bing and Li Tianheng.
What belongs to you cannot be lost; what does not belong to you cannot be taken.
Aiming too high and reaching too far would only add unnecessary trouble.
After announcing the matters regarding the midterm exam, Li Qingying directly dismissed the class.
At the same time, Yang Fan received an invitation from Li Shuhao.
“Brother Yang, bring Zhang Pang along and let’s get together for a bit.”
Yang Fan nodded.
After sending the coordinates to Zhang Pang, he directly tapped the coordinates to leave the classroom.
This time, Li Shuhao did not choose to go to Tianxiang Renjian, but rather to a secluded courtyard where tea and pastries had already been set up.
There were seven people in total, and Yang Fan knew all of them.
Apart from Wang Zhenyu, there were also Wang Mazi, Wei Feng, and Yu Mo.
These three were all Subordinate Gods of Li Shuhao.
The reason Zhang Pang was able to receive an invitation was perhaps also because he was Yang Fan’s Subordinate God.
“Brother Yang, please sit. This is the reception hall of my Li Family; it’s quiet and has good privacy,” Li Shuhao explained.
“I thought it was going to be Tianxiang Renjian again!” Yang Fan joked with a smile.
“If Brother Yang likes it, I’ll treat you later. But after all, we need to discuss serious business today, which is why I chose this place.”
“Forget it, I am a matrilocal son-in-law now, I need to keep myself clean and self-disciplined,” Yang Fan shook his head.

“With the talent you’ve displayed, even the Luo Family has to take you seriously. What’s wrong with going to Tianxiang Renjian? Raising a little mistress wouldn’t be a problem at all,” Li Shuhao rolled his eyes.
Hearing this, Yang Fan merely shook his head, “Stop joking around. Brother Li specially invited us here, so I suppose there must be an important matter.”

Li Shuhao nodded and said seriously, “The location of this midterm exam far exceeds my expectations. If we want to achieve good results, we must venture deep into the hinterland of the Alien Divine Kingdom. Relying solely on the power of one person is utterly impossible, so I want to seek cooperation.”
Before Yang Fan could speak, Li Shuhao first cast his gaze toward Wang Zhenyu.
“Old Wang, let’s cut to the chase. With your strength, it is utterly impossible for you to enter the top 100 of the school. I hope you can help me.”
“Brother Hao, what do you want me to do?” Wang Zhenyu asked in confusion.

“Sell all the resources obtained within the Alien Divine Kingdom to me. I will give you double the price, paid in a lump sum after the exam ends. If I am fortunate enough to enter the school’s top 100, I will supplement you with an extra 20 million,” Li Shuhao stated his conditions.
Wang Zhenyu did not hesitate and directly nodded in agreement, “Alright, I will come find you before the exam ends.”
For Wang Zhenyu, what he needed most were resources.
Being able to sell this harvest to Li Shuhao at twice the price was not a bad choice either.
Yang Fan’s expression was somewhat surprised as he said, “Can it be operated like this?”
“Of course, there is nothing in this world that cannot be traded. As far as the school is concerned, as long as it isn’t something prohibited, you can do it.”

“I’ve checked the records of the midterm exams of Yang County No. 1 Middle School over the years. There have been gang formations, underhanded moves, and even direct robberies of classmates. As the saying goes, ‘what is not explicitly forbidden by law is permitted’—that is precisely how it is.”

“Brother Hao, what do you want me to do?” Wang Zhenyu asked in confusion.
“Sell all the resources obtained within the Alien Divine Kingdom to me.
I will give you double the price, paid in a lump sum after the exam ends.
If I am fortunate enough to enter the school’s top 100, I will supplement you with an extra 20 million,” Li Shuhao stated his conditions.
Wang Zhenyu did not hesitate and directly nodded in agreement, “Alright, I will come find you before the exam ends.”
For Wang Zhenyu, what he needed most were resources.
Being able to sell this harvest to Li Shuhao at twice the price was not a bad choice either.
Yang Fan’s expression was somewhat surprised as he said, “Can it be operated like this?”
“Of course, there is nothing in this world that cannot be traded.
As far as the school is concerned, as long as it isn’t something prohibited, you can do it.”
“I’ve checked the records of the midterm exams of Yang County No.
1 Middle School over the years.
There have been gang formations, underhanded moves, and even direct robberies of classmates.
As the saying goes, ‘what is not explicitly forbidden by law is permitted’—that is precisely how it is.”

chapters.title: Chapter 53: The Population of Believers Surges
paragraphs: Speaking of this, Li Shuhao’s gaze turned a bit solemn.
The school rewards this time are so generous; in the face of immense benefits, everything fails to stand the test of scrutiny.
The assessment within the Alien Divine Kingdom requires one not only to be careful of the Alien God’s believers, but even more cautious of those classmates.
Li Shuhao had a feeling in his heart that this batch of Yang County No.
1 Middle School seemed to be raising Gu; what they wanted was not how high the students’ average strength was, but to nurture one or two monsters.

“Brother Yang, the divine kingdom of a still-living demigod carries unimaginable risks; this is simply the finishing work of reclamation. It is completely fine to understand this as the work of demigod powerhouses, yet I didn’t expect the school to actually send us this time.”
“It really is dangerous.” Yang Fan narrowed his eyes slightly.
Back then, he had witnessed that mountain-sized Goblin, he just didn’t know what kind of believers the demigod participating in this assessment actually had.
“Our cooperation can be a win-win; after all, we are classmates with a higher degree of trust, aren’t we?” Li Shuhao said seriously.
Yang Fan fell into deep thought, also considering the gains and losses.
After a moment, Yang Fan still shook his head and said, “Temporarily, I have no intention of cooperating. Apologies.”
After saying this, Yang Fan turned his head to signal Zhang Pang, then stood up together to exit the Virtual World.
Li Shuhao said one thing very correctly: this midterm exam, besides needing to be careful of the Alien Demigod, also required being careful of classmates.
In the divine kingdom of an Alien Demigod, good things naturally won’t be lacking.
When the time comes, how the spoils of war will be divided, whether someone will stab you in the back, and whether it’s possible they won’t put in real effort—
These are all problems; human hearts are far more complicated than fighting against alien races.
With the SSS-rank Talent, Yang Fan naturally possessed more troop reinforcements than others.
Collaborating with others to explore the divine kingdom had more disadvantages than advantages.
Watching the place where Yang Fan disappeared, Li Shuhao felt a bit regretful, but could also understand in his heart.
Now that the other party belonged to the Luo Family, looking for partners would naturally center around the Luo Family.
Although he and Yang Fan were classmates, in front of such a major event, they naturally had to prioritize personal interests.
Regarding this, Li Shuhao didn’t feel anything was wrong.
On the other side, on the second-floor loft of Mingyue Community, Zhang Pang took off his helmet and began going downstairs to eat.
Zhang Pang didn’t take the midterm exam to heart; anyway, he was now Yang Fan’s Subordinate God, and following the latter was fine.
After entering the Alien Divine Kingdom, he would listen entirely to Yang Fan’s arrangements; as someone in logistics, he didn’t have such heavy pressure.
What Zhang Pang cared about most every day now was the growth situation of the Blood Clotting Flower inside his own divine kingdom; the midterm exam had to take a back seat.
“What a pity, today that nouveau riche dog Li Shuhao didn’t treat guests at Tianxiang Renjian, a wasted trip.” Zhang Pang complained while chowing down his food.
During this period, hitching a ride on Yang Fan’s coattails, he had freeloaded quite a few times.
Yangcheng Villa, Yang Fan put this batch of mature Blood Clotting Flower, Moon Dew, and Sun Essence inventory up for sale online.
“After-tax revenue of 275 million, already deposited into the divine kingdom.”
“Faith Points: 352 million”
This time, Yang Fan only chose to purchase 6 million Blood Clotting Flower seeds because he wanted to clear out all the open spaces around the four major cities.
This midterm exam disrupted Yang Fan’s deployment; he had to begin vigorously developing the population.
To prevent believers from wasting time, Yang Fan directly chose to purchase finished buildings of the Mechanical Divine Kingdom in the Divine Shop.

“F-rank City of Steel: Size range adjustable, maximum 10,000 square kilometers, priced at 2 million. Merchant’s remarks: The surroundings of the city are cast from refined iron, possessing basic defensive capabilities. It is equipped with a large number of residential and office buildings inside, complete with living facilities, and can be put into use directly.”
Yang Fan directly spent 10 million to load five City of Steel into the divine kingdom.
This could be considered the most expensive building among ordinary cities, but given Yang Fan’s current income, he didn’t care about this bit of consumption.
With the City of Steel loaded into the divine kingdom, the living area of the believers expanded tenfold.
Such a massive city only cost 2 million Faith Points; basic materials and ordinary buildings in this era were truly cheap.
Subsequently, Yang Fan descended a Divine Decree.
“My believers, three hundred years from now, there will be a life-or-death battle. During this time, everyone must work hard to Cultivate, teach the younger generation well, and not kill each other.”
“Thank you for the grace of our God, we shall naturally strive our best.”
Having finished all this, Yang Fan bought another 300-year E-rank Breeding Card—fertility increased by 50%, infant mortality decreased by 50%.
Directly loaded it into the divine kingdom.
Three hundred years was enough for Yang Fan to push the believer population of the divine kingdom to its limit.
Under drastic and sweeping reforms, Yang Fan’s divine kingdom believers were developing rapidly.
The first decade produced a total of 600,000 newborns.

Food was abundant, the living environment was opulent, living space was sufficient, coupled with the blessing of the Breeding Card, female believers basically gave birth to two children every three years.
By the third decade, the population inside Yang Fan’s divine kingdom had already surpassed one million.
In the Real World, he still attended classes and studied step by step every day.
Over these past few days, Yang Fan also received invitations from other geniuses.
There were those from the Blacksmith Association, those from Zhongyuan Tower, and of course, even more from those geniuses of the Luo Family.
In just a few days, several teams of people had already been formed across the entire third year of high school.
Some had the organization leader personally issue an invitation to Yang Fan, while others did so through someone else.
Li Shuhao invited Yang Fan again, but this time he represented another Genius of the Li Family.
Yang Fan naturally chose to reject them all.
Those cooperating people either had a massive gap in strength, putting them in a subordinate relationship, or were comparable in strength and wary of each other.
Right now, they looked bustling and grand with great momentum, but when it truly came to allocating resources, it would either be dog-eat-dog or endless haggling.
In this world, there were no true friends to begin with; there were only absolute interests.
Since he had sufficient troop support, why would Yang Fan bother playing mind games with these people?
Moreover, after so long, Yang Fan hadn’t heard of any moves from monster-level Prodigies like Luo Bing and Li Tianheng.

Either they had sufficient confidence in their own strength and didn’t need to cooperate with others, or their social circle was higher, and with Yang Fan’s current status, he wasn’t qualified to understand.
Yang Fan continued living as usual, unaffected by the outside world.

Resources in the divine kingdom were not lacking and could rely on natural Evolution; as for himself, aside from communicating with Genius classmates, he carved out an hour every day to read books in the school library.
Whether it was the development of the Human Race’s divine kingdom or information on Alien Gods, Yang Fan still had too much knowledge that needed to be learned.
As a God, the road ahead was very, very long.
He needed to be down-to-earth, taking it step by step; as long as the direction was right, that was enough.
During this period, Yang Fan harvested another round of Blood Clotting Flower with a net profit of 120 million.
Coupled with the income from Moon Dew and Sun Essence, his Faith Points broke 400 million once again.
“God Lord: Yang Fan
Divine Kingdom Area: One million square kilometers
Talent: F-rank Resource Talent (All resources within the divine kingdom accelerate growth by 10%)
SSS-Rank Talent: Evolution (Unique talent, can accelerate divine kingdom Evolution, hidden.)
Believers: Tier 2 Living Beings (102), Tier 1 Living Beings (3,644), Mortals (2.64 million)
Dependents: little spirits (52)

Techniques: Five Elements Cultivation Technique, Vajra Indestructible Technique, Federal Body Refinement Technique, Muscle and Tendon Strengthening and Marrow Cleansing Technique, Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array (Major Achievement)...
Faith Points: 462 million (provides 80.2 Faith Points daily)

Buildings: Moon Well X1000, Sun Spring X1000, Special Life Building Ancient Spirit Tree (thousand-year-old, nurturing little spirits), B-rank building Hundred Spirits Blood Pool X1 (soaking 10 Taisuis, load rate 100%), Special building Fully Automatic Concentrator X1 (cutting plant loaded with 100 Taisuis, load rate 100%), C-rank transmission tower X5, F-rank City of Steel X5
Assets: Blood Clotting Flower (X6 million, D-rank Spirit Plant), Taisui X110, Bodhi Precious Snake...”

chapters.title: Chapter 54: Purchasing Weapons Before the War
paragraphs: After a month of crazy development, Yang Fan’s total population had broken through 2.5 million.

The population size had already reached this number about 100 years ago in the Divine Kingdom, and afterwards, due to the population density reaching a critical value, it had been fluctuating up and down.
As for the believers’ food, it was still abundant; even with the population exploding, the daily output of the Fully Automatic Concentrator was still far greater than the consumption.
What was even more surprising was the believers’ understanding of the Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array.
After reaching the Great Success stage, the Formation deployed by the gathering of a ten-thousand-strong army was now fully fifty percent stronger than before.
This was Yang Fan’s greatest advantage compared to others.
Having comprehended a Formation to Major Achievement, he was confident that not a single person in the entire third year of high school could accomplish this right now.
In these three months, 90 years had passed in other people’s Divine Kingdoms, but for him, it was a full 900 years.
Over the 900 years, the believers continuously practiced the Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array, summarizing their experiences and passing them on to the next generation.
It was not that his believers had particularly good Comprehension Ability; all of this was ground out by time.
The only thing that made Yang Fan somewhat unsatisfied was that after so long, a Tier 3 living being still hadn’t been born.
You must know that during the exam three months ago, Tier 3 living beings had already appeared in Luo Bing’s Divine Kingdom, and she would only be stronger now.
“Just how many treasures for improving Aptitude did Luo Bing pour into her believers?” Yang Fan felt a sense of emotion in his heart.
You must know that his development time was ten times that of Luo Bing, but even now, he still hadn’t caught up to her from three months ago.
Yang Fan could understand this; the gap in their starting points was too huge.
His true eruption had to be counted from after receiving the Luo Family’s investment, and his development in the first three months had been very slow.
In two more days, he would go to Yang County No.
1 Middle School to participate in the midterm exam.
Before that, Yang Fan prepared to make an all-out sprint in the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle once.
The losses in this midterm exam definitely wouldn’t be small; right now was the time when his Divine Kingdom’s combat power was at its strongest.
Before that, Yang Fan still needed to make a trip to the Luo Family’s stronghold to purchase weapons.
The prices of weapons within the Family were a full fold cheaper than the Divine Shop.
He had learned this from another Luo Family Genius when he attended a gathering some time ago.
The smelting of weapons required many steps.
First, Ore was acquired from the market, and then the Ore was smelted into iron essence through the smelting equipment of the Mechanical Divine Kingdom.
This iron essence was then loaded into the Divine Kingdom for believers to forge, and then placed in batches into the Divine Shop to be sold.
Many merchants doing this type of business did not have the ability to handle a complete system; they could only be responsible for one or multiple links among them.
This brought up a problem: every single link had to go through the Divine Shop, which meant taxes had to be paid once.
Taxes were collected level by level, and exploitation occurred at every layer, until finally, the end consumers bore everything.
This was an indirect tax.

In the year 26748 of the Divine Kingdom, a deity had once raised objections to this, believing that for such goods with complex craftsmanship, the Federal Government should reduce taxes to benefit the people’s livelihood.
According to historical records, it caused quite a commotion back then, with news flying everywhere.

Federal Government councilors even held meetings specifically for this for over ten days, and finally negotiated a result—changing the indirect tax to a value-added tax, allowing merchants to purchase tax-type Intelligent Life to make deductions and tax reductions.
Ordinary Divine Beings were very satisfied with this result.
Although the commodity prices did not drop, the Federal Government was still doing something, and it was said that deductions could be made.
Although they didn’t understand it, it felt like the discount was very large.
Upper-layer deities and lower-layer Divine Beings were both very happy about this.
You protect my cake, and I protect your thoughts.
Everyone had a bright future.
During this period of time, Yang Fan had not touched the funds within his Divine Kingdom precisely to purchase a sufficient amount of weapons.
During the last school exam, he suffered from a lack of weapons.
Even if they were just the most ordinary iron weapons, if the supply had been sufficient at that time, he could have penetrated much deeper.
For Mortals, the gap between wearing armor and fighting bare-handed was more than tenfold.
Arriving at the Luo Family’s stronghold in the Virtual World, Yang Fan found Zhan Yunxiao.
“Greetings, Young Master Yang.” Zhan Yunxiao stood up and saluted.
Yang Fan was long no longer the ordinary second-class Genius when he first entered the Luo Family.
His ranking in the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle had entered the top hundred, and in the future, as long as he did not fall, there was an extremely high probability he would become a deity.
Zhan Yunxiao’s attitude was naturally much more respectful.
Now, if the Family had any welfare policies, he would also send a copy of the document to Yang Fan.
This was the benefit brought by a change in status and position.
People would naturally incline towards benefits and avoid harm; the stronger you showed yourself to be and the greater your potential, the more people would be willing to befriend you.
“Elder Zhan, I want to purchase a large quantity of weapons. I wonder if you have any connections?” Yang Fan asked.
Yang Fan could have asked Luo Chengfeng, but thinking that these were just low-tier weapons, there was no need to trouble his grandfather who was a deity, so he found this nominal guide instead.
“Yes, I have a friend whose Divine Kingdom focuses mainly on smelting weapons. If a Genius like Young Master Yang goes to purchase them, there are even discounts,” Zhan Yunxiao said hurriedly.
“Then I’ll have to trouble you to introduce us.”
“I’ll send him the coordinates right away.” Zhan Yunxiao opened the communication box and said.
Not long after, a pot-bellied, middle-aged big man teleported over to this place.
“Old Zhan, are you sure it’s a big business? You called me over so urgently.”
Although the other party looked like he weighed four or five hundred pounds and his body appeared extremely unhealthy, Yang Fan could sense the pressure emanating from him.
This person, just like Zhan Yunxiao, was a demigod powerhouse.
“Let me introduce you. This is Luo Tietie, possessing D-grade forging Aptitude, and he currently exclusively supplies weapons for the Luo Family.”
“This is Yang Fan, Young Master Yang. You shouldn’t be unfamiliar with him, right!”
Zhan Yunxiao introduced them to each other.

“Oh my goodness, so it’s Young Master Yang! Your name has been loud enough in the Luo Family lately. I heard the Family head even specially approved 500 million in funds for you. How promising and accomplished! My humble name is Luo Tietie, doing a bit of weapon business to make a living. If Young Master Yang doesn’t mind, you can call me Fatty Luo just like Old Zhan.” Luo Tietie’s face was squeezed into a smile.
The other party was so enthusiastic that Yang Fan felt somewhat unaccustomed to it, and hurriedly said, “I want to purchase weapons.”
“How many does Young Master Yang want!”
“20,000 sets of F-grade weapons, and 5 million sets of ordinary iron weapons.”
“Do you have any requirements for the weapons? Sabers, spears, swords, halberds, large hammers, or...”
“Anything is fine, but armor is a must.” Yang Fan thought about it.

“Simple. I’ll give you a discount on the 20,000 sets of F-grade weapons; 160 million will do. As for those 5 million sets of ordinary iron weapons, they cost practically nothing, so I’ll throw them in as a bonus. Let’s add each other as friends, and directly contact me in the future if Young Master Yang has any demands.” Luo Tietie was full of enthusiasm.
Hearing the other party’s quote, Yang Fan was also somewhat surprised in his heart.
This was quite a bit lower than he had estimated.
“Then many thanks. If I have any demands in the future, I will definitely look for you first,” Yang Fan said seriously.
Yang Fan directly transferred 160 million Faith Points, and the other party similarly delivered the goods on the spot.
The transaction completed, Yang Fan exchanged a few polite words and then left the Virtual World.
At this moment in the Luo Family’s stronghold, Zhan Yunxiao asked curiously, “Selling them so cheap, do you still make a profit?”

“Recently, the Family discovered a large-scale Ore vein at a new resource point, and the raw material cost has dropped quite a bit. There is still a profit to be made. Besides, isn’t this our first time doing business? For a Genius like this, once he becomes a demigod or even a deity in the future, won’t his consumption of weapons be an astronomical figure? A person’s vision still needs to be long-term. Having a long-term cooperative partner, even if the profit is thinner, is better than letting these scrap metals gather dust in the Divine Kingdom,” Luo Tietie explained.
“You’re still the one who knows how to do business.”

“You still need to learn how to deal with people. You guy tinkers with those crooked and Evil Path investments inside your Divine Kingdom every day; although the profits are high, the volume is too small.”
“Investment has risks; it’s still better to rely on one’s own believers. No matter how much they are squeezed, they won’t have any complaints.”
“Tch, believers are bound to our lives. The two of us are the same age, yet you look a whole circle older than me,” Luo Tietie couldn’t help reminding him.
“Who told me not to have the surname Luo!” A trace of melancholy flashed in Zhan Yunxiao’s eyes.
How could he not know the disadvantages of squeezing the Divine Kingdom’s resources, but without the Family as a backing, he simply didn’t have the qualifications to take risks and do business.

This brought up a problem: every single link had to go through the Divine Shop, which meant taxes had to be paid once.
Taxes were collected level by level, and exploitation occurred at every layer, until finally, the end consumers bore everything.
This was an indirect tax.

In the year 26748 of the Divine Kingdom, a deity had once raised objections to this, believing that for such goods with complex craftsmanship, the Federal Government should reduce taxes to benefit the people’s livelihood.
According to historical records, it caused quite a commotion back then, with news flying everywhere.

Federal Government councilors even held meetings specifically for this for over ten days, and finally negotiated a result—changing the indirect tax to a value-added tax, allowing merchants to purchase tax-type Intelligent Life to make deductions and tax reductions.
Ordinary Divine Beings were very satisfied with this result.
Although the commodity prices did not drop, the Federal Government was still doing something, and it was said that deductions could be made.
Although they didn’t understand it, it felt like the discount was very large.
Upper-layer deities and lower-layer Divine Beings were both very happy about this.
You protect my cake, and I protect your thoughts.
Everyone had a bright future.
During this period of time, Yang Fan had not touched the funds within his Divine Kingdom precisely to purchase a sufficient amount of weapons.
During the last school exam, he suffered from a lack of weapons.
Even if they were just the most ordinary iron weapons, if the supply had been sufficient at that time, he could have penetrated much deeper.
For Mortals, the gap between wearing armor and fighting bare-handed was more than tenfold.
Arriving at the Luo Family’s stronghold in the Virtual World, Yang Fan found Zhan Yunxiao.
“Greetings, Young Master Yang.” Zhan Yunxiao stood up and saluted.
Yang Fan was long no longer the ordinary second-class Genius when he first entered the Luo Family.
His ranking in the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle had entered the top hundred, and in the future, as long as he did not fall, there was an extremely high probability he would become a deity.
Zhan Yunxiao’s attitude was naturally much more respectful.
Now, if the Family had any welfare policies, he would also send a copy of the document to Yang Fan.
This was the benefit brought by a change in status and position.
People would naturally incline towards benefits and avoid harm; the stronger you showed yourself to be and the greater your potential, the more people would be willing to befriend you.
“Elder Zhan, I want to purchase a large quantity of weapons.
I wonder if you have any connections?” Yang Fan asked.
Yang Fan could have asked Luo Chengfeng, but thinking that these were just low-tier weapons, there was no need to trouble his grandfather who was a deity, so he found this nominal guide instead.
“Yes, I have a friend whose Divine Kingdom focuses mainly on smelting weapons.
If a Genius like Young Master Yang goes to purchase them, there are even discounts,” Zhan Yunxiao said hurriedly.
“Then I’ll have to trouble you to introduce us.”
“I’ll send him the coordinates right away.” Zhan Yunxiao opened the communication box and said.
Not long after, a pot-bellied, middle-aged big man teleported over to this place.
“Old Zhan, are you sure it’s a big business?
You called me over so urgently.”
Although the other party looked like he weighed four or five hundred pounds and his body appeared extremely unhealthy, Yang Fan could sense the pressure emanating from him.
This person, just like Zhan Yunxiao, was a demigod powerhouse.
“Let me introduce you.
This is Luo Tietie, possessing D-grade forging Aptitude, and he currently exclusively supplies weapons for the Luo Family.”
“This is Yang Fan, Young Master Yang.
You shouldn’t be unfamiliar with him, right!”
Zhan Yunxiao introduced them to each other.
“Oh my goodness, so it’s Young Master Yang!
Your name has been loud enough in the Luo Family lately.
I heard the Family head even specially approved 500 million in funds for you.
How promising and accomplished!
My humble name is Luo Tietie, doing a bit of weapon business to make a living.
If Young Master Yang doesn’t mind, you can call me Fatty Luo just like Old Zhan.” Luo Tietie’s face was squeezed into a smile.
The other party was so enthusiastic that Yang Fan felt somewhat unaccustomed to it, and hurriedly said, “I want to purchase weapons.”
“How many does Young Master Yang want!”
“20,000 sets of F-grade weapons, and 5 million sets of ordinary iron weapons.”
“Do you have any requirements for the weapons?
Sabers, spears, swords, halberds, large hammers, or...”
“Anything is fine, but armor is a must.” Yang Fan thought about it.
“Simple.
I’ll give you a discount on the 20,000 sets of F-grade weapons; 160 million will do.
As for those 5 million sets of ordinary iron weapons, they cost practically nothing, so I’ll throw them in as a bonus.
Let’s add each other as friends, and directly contact me in the future if Young Master Yang has any demands.” Luo Tietie was full of enthusiasm.
Hearing the other party’s quote, Yang Fan was also somewhat surprised in his heart.
This was quite a bit lower than he had estimated.
“Then many thanks.
If I have any demands in the future, I will definitely look for you first,” Yang Fan said seriously.
Yang Fan directly transferred 160 million Faith Points, and the other party similarly delivered the goods on the spot.
The transaction completed, Yang Fan exchanged a few polite words and then left the Virtual World.
At this moment in the Luo Family’s stronghold, Zhan Yunxiao asked curiously, “Selling them so cheap, do you still make a profit?”
“Recently, the Family discovered a large-scale Ore vein at a new resource point, and the raw material cost has dropped quite a bit.
There is still a profit to be made.
Besides, isn’t this our first time doing business?
For a Genius like this, once he becomes a demigod or even a deity in the future, won’t his consumption of weapons be an astronomical figure?
A person’s vision still needs to be long-term.
Having a long-term cooperative partner, even if the profit is thinner, is better than letting these scrap metals gather dust in the Divine Kingdom,” Luo Tietie explained.
“You’re still the one who knows how to do business.”
“You still need to learn how to deal with people.
You guy tinkers with those crooked and Evil Path investments inside your Divine Kingdom every day; although the profits are high, the volume is too small.”
“Investment has risks; it’s still better to rely on one’s own believers.
No matter how much they are squeezed, they won’t have any complaints.”
“Tch, believers are bound to our lives.
The two of us are the same age, yet you look a whole circle older than me,” Luo Tietie couldn’t help reminding him.
“Who told me not to have the surname Luo!” A trace of melancholy flashed in Zhan Yunxiao’s eyes.
How could he not know the disadvantages of squeezing the Divine Kingdom’s resources, but without the Family as a backing, he simply didn’t have the qualifications to take risks and do business.

chapters.title: Chapter 55: Luo Family Ranking Enters the Top 50
paragraphs: Returning to reality, after Yang Fan loaded the weapons into the Divine Kingdom, he issued a Divine Decree to gather his ten thousand strongest believers.
Inside the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle space.
“Federal citizen Yang Fan, 830 points, current win rate 94.2%, would you like to start matching.”
“Start.”
“Random scenario generating, volcano, battle begins.”
In less than a minute, the battle ended.
This time the opponents had ten Tier-2 creatures, but throughout the entire battle, Yang Fan’s soldiers lost a total of less than a hundred people.
One reason was that they were now all equipped with a full set of F-grade weapons.
The second was that the Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array at the Great Success stage was simply too powerful.
The entire battle was completely a one-sided crushing defeat.
“Points + 20, current points 850, win rate 94.3%, do you wish to continue matching?”
“Continue.”
Winning ten matches in a row, Yang Fan’s points had already broken a thousand.
At this moment, the opponents Yang Fan faced already included Tier-3 creatures, and the entire team was similarly equipped with a complete set of F-grade weapons.
The leading Tier-3 creature held a long spear and led an army of ten thousand like a sharp spike piercing straight into the throat of the main army.
“Disperse.”
A general shouted, and the front-row soldiers holding shields scattered to both sides, causing that Tier-3 creature to miss its charge completely.
With the first beat courage is mustered, with the second it wanes, and with the third it is exhausted.
The opponent’s Tier-3 creature was just about to turn back when it was surrounded tightly by dozens of Tier-2 creatures.

It had wanted to rely on the physical advantages of a Tier-3 creature to break a gap in the Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array, but under the close coordination of Yang Fan’s army, its own general was instantly besieged.
Like a dragon trapped in shallow waters, after only a few rounds, that Tier-3 creature had its head lopped off.
When cast, the Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array at the Great Success stage had clear rules for advancing and retreating, allowing ten thousand people to act as one.
Clearly, the weapons and strength of both sides were comparable, yet it eliminated an army of ten thousand at the cost of less than five hundred people.
Inside a commercial apartment on a distant planet, a young woman took off her helmet, her face filled with depression.
“Yan’er, what’s wrong? You look so glum.”

“I just participated in the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle and ran into a monster. Clearly his believers’ physical fitness was a lot worse than mine, yet he completely wiped out my army at the cost of just a few hundred people!”
“Oh? Did you run into those Family youths wearing full sets of C-grade weapons?”
“No, his equipment is about the same as mine, but it felt very strange. It felt like I was being led around by the nose by him!”
“Pull up the battle video, and I’ll take a look for you.”
“Others have comprehended the Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array to the Great Success stage, while you haven’t even reached Minor Achievement. It’s normal to be suppressed and beaten.”
“The Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array at the Great Success stage? Why haven’t I encountered it since I started matching?”

“This person either comes from a poor background, taking the logistical Divine Kingdom route where his believers spent a lot of time comprehending the Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array to the Great Success stage, thus having limited future potential; or he’s a Prodigy who awakened his Divine Kingdom not long ago, deduced the Formation through his own Comprehension Ability, and then taught it to his believers, making him a Genius.”
“Then which kind is he?”

“Your mother is just someone who commands believers to farm and sell spiritual rice; do I have the authority to know the specific information of a simulation battle opponent? Rest for a bit and come eat.”
This Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle encompasses the Divine Beings of the entire Human Race, so you can encounter any kind of monster.
If you run into someone rushing points, it’s possible for an army of ten thousand to be instantly killed in just a few breaths, so there’s no need to overthink it.”
“Oh.”
After his points rose to 1000, Yang Fan clearly felt that the opponents’ strength had grown a lot, and the probability of Tier-3 creatures appearing in the enemy camp began to increase.
After a few more matched battles, the opponent Yang Fan encountered even featured one Tier-4 creature and five Tier-3 creatures.
Their overall strength was nearly double that of Yang Fan.
Yang Fan still patiently watched the battle.
By now, his believers’ comprehension of the Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array had already surpassed himself, the deity, so he only needed to watch quietly.
Through these few matches, Yang Fan also gradually understood the power of the Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array at the Great Success stage.
Even if the opponent’s overall strength was stronger than his, it was not entirely impossible to fight back.
Facing Yang Fan’s believers, a single Tier-4 creature from the opponent was enough to match a hundred men by itself.
With a sweep of its spear, the front ranks of the army were directly flicked flying by a dozen people.
The enemy army did not Cultivate the Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array, but rather another Formation focused primarily on offense.
The army was like a venomous sting, all its power converging onto one side, instantly piercing straight to the location of the Formation’s core.
Seeing this scene, Yang Fan’s expression held a bit more surprise.
The Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array was a basic Formation rewarded by the Federal Government to senior high school students.
This Formation was highly inclusive, integrating cultivation, defense, offense, and maneuvering into one.

Since matching in the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle, it wasn’t as if Yang Fan hadn’t encountered other Formations, but the Formation of the person before him was even more terrifying, and judging by its power, it had definitely been comprehended to the Minor Achievement stage.

He had originally thought that relying on the Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array at the Great Success stage, even if his strength was insufficient, he would still have the power to fight; he hadn’t expected the opponent’s overall strength to be this strong.
Soon the grand Formation was broken, and when it came to a clash of hard strength, the opponent wiped out all of Yang Fan’s believers with a loss of about thirty percent.
“Points - 1, current points 1244, win rate 92.5%, do you wish to continue matching.”
The voice of the Intelligent Life sounded at the same time.
“End matching.”
Yang Fan shook his head gently, and his consciousness exited the Virtual World.
After all, the Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array was only an F-grade Formation, and because it was too comprehensive, it instead lacked distinct advantages.
If he encountered a Formation with prominent advantages in a certain aspect, even if the opponent’s comprehension Realm wasn’t as high as his, he would fall into a passive position.
“I still need to buy other Formations; relying solely on the Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array is too monotonous.” Yang Fan analyzed his shortcomings.
Opening his wrist-watch, he checked the Luo Family Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle leaderboard.
“Luo Family Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle Leaderboard.”
1st place, Luo Hen, First-Class Genius, 1950 points, win rate 63.2%.
2nd place, Luo Bing, First-Class Genius, 1650 points, win rate 65.5%.
34th place, Yang Fan, Second-Class Genius, 1244 points, win rate 92.5%.
111th place, Luo Mingxuan, Second-Class Genius, 842 points, win rate 51.2%.
In this Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle, all his believers were equipped with F-grade weapons, pushing their combat power to the absolute extreme, yet he only rushed to 34th place.
It wasn’t just him; everyone else was also progressing, especially Luo Hen, whose points were already close to breaking 2000.
This result was within Yang Fan’s expectations, but it was just a pity that this progress couldn’t win him the Luo Family’s rewards.

The higher the ranking, the more fixed everyone’s positions became, especially in the top one hundred; it was possible that the rankings of the entire senior high school grade wouldn’t change much anymore.
After a Genius inside the Luo Family opened the leaderboard, they suddenly discovered that their ranking had dropped by one place.
At this moment, various Family groups within the Luo Family started chatting about this matter.
“It’s Yang Fan again! He rushed to 34th place this time and squeezed me past 50th place, how miserable.”
“Still not knowing how to work hard, you’re really embarrassing me.”
“Dad, give me some more resources. As your son, I couldn’t even keep my spot in the top 50, so it doesn’t look good on you either!”
“Have you finished digesting the resources I gave you last time? You still have the nerve to ask for more.”

chapters.title: Chapter 56: An Opportunity
paragraphs: 2026 Genius Exchange Group.
“Brother Yang, you’re awesome! Just now, I saw in the Family group that my cousin was squeezed out of the top 50 by you, and he’s currently being reprimanded by the Sixth Elder.”
“Luo Qingyuan, don’t wash our Family’s dirty linen outside. Leave your brother some Face.”
“Sorry, I forgot that my cousin is also in this group. Offense, offense, I’ll go talk in another group.”
“Are you really not considering cooperation? @Yang Fan.”

“There is strength in numbers. After all, they are an Alien Demigod, and the number of the opponent’s believers is definitely not small. If we don’t cooperate, we will easily be encircled and annihilated.”
“Let’s join forces, brother. I’ve already pulled 8 people on my side, and all their Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle points are above 500. @Yang Fan.”
The Genius Exchange Group became lively again, and many people wanted to win over Yang Fan once more.
After all, only when a team’s strength was powerful would they be qualified to advance toward the hinterland of the Divine Kingdom in order to obtain more core resource buildings.
However, at this moment, Yang Fan had no time to look at the group messages because he received a call from Luo Chengfeng.
“How did your strength progress so much? Could it be that you used some method to squeeze the potential of your believers!” An eager voice from Luo Chengfeng came from inside the watch.
“No.”
“What is the strongest strength of your believers right now?”
“Tier 2 living beings.”
“How is that possible? Then how did you get 1,244 points?” On the other end of the phone, Luo Chengfeng was completely dumbfounded, feeling that Yang Fan was joking with him.
“I have comprehended the Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array to the Great Success stage.”

After a moment of silence, Luo Chengfeng’s serious voice came over: “Download all the videos of you participating in the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle today, and then send them to me. Immediately!”
Feeling the other’s serious tone, Yang Fan immediately followed suit.
The Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle protected personal information extremely strictly.
Aside from the participant themselves, even gods had no qualification to view it.
After sending the video over, Luo Chengfeng replied with a single sentence, ‘Wait,’ and there was no further news.
After watching a few battles and confirming that it was the Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array at the Great Success stage, Luo Chengfeng couldn’t help but curse: “I really fucking struck gold!”
Without hesitation, Luo Chengfeng directly entered the Virtual World to request a meeting with the Patriarch Luo Hai.
In the Virtual World, inside the Elder Council Hall of the Luo Family, there were only Luo Hai and Luo Chengfeng at this moment.
The walls of the council hall were projecting the battles from Yang Fan’s simulation battle this time.

“The Patriarch believes it now, right? I was originally worried that he used some method to squeeze the potential of his believers for this midterm exam, which is why I asked about it. I didn’t expect this kid’s Comprehension Ability to be so Heaven-Defying!”
Luo Chengfeng’s tone was excited.
Solely in terms of Comprehension Ability, he felt that no one among the younger generation of the Luo Family could surpass him.

“It’s a bit of a pity. If we had known earlier that he could comprehend a Formation of the Great Success stage before the exam, our Luo Family could have completely provided Medicinal Pills to help him rapidly increase the strength of his believers, and we could also vie for the resources rewarded by First High this time.” Luo Hai sighed.
After all, the strength of Yang Fan’s believers was too weak.
If he possessed a large number of Tier 3 or even Tier 4 living beings, he would definitely be a massive dark horse in this midterm exam.

Luo Chengfeng hurriedly said: “We cannot just look at the present. With Yang Fan’s talent, in the future when he becomes a god, his combat power will definitely far surpass those of the same tier, and he can definitely expand territory for our Luo Family. As a Formation Genius, the Patriarch should understand the huge value within.”
“That is naturally the case. Such a Prodigy, even if he were only my Luo Family’s son-in-law, we would still do our best to nurture him.” Luo Hai nodded and said seriously.
“I wonder if the Patriarch has ever thought about adding another quota for a First-Class Genius?” Luo Chengfeng tentatively asked.

Luo Hai looked at the projected video and finally sighed: “I am willing to give him an Opportunity. If he can enter the top ten in this midterm exam, I will convene the Elder Council and have everyone vote on it.”
“Thank you, Patriarch.”
Luo Chengfeng’s expression was overjoyed.
As long as there was an Opportunity, it would be fine.

The resources invested in a First-Class Genius were too massive; it wasn’t just an investment of Faith Points, and the most precious among them were some special buildings that could not be purchased.
As long as there was a sliver of an Opportunity, Luo Chengfeng would fight for it with all his might for Yang Fan.
“If the Elder Council does not pass it, I will still use the Patriarch’s authority to reward him with a Flesh Sea Blood Pool as a subsidy.”
“Yes.”
After Luo Chengfeng left, Luo Hai considered it over and over again, but still edited a message and sent it out.
A moment later, a cold figure arrived at the conference room.
It was precisely Luo Bing.
“Father, you asked me to come over because...?”
“Watch first.” Luo Hai pointed at the combat video on the projection.
Luo Bing frowned slightly: “The strength is so weak, and comprehending such a low-level Formation as the Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array to the Great Success stage is simply a waste of time.”
Luo Bing didn’t understand what significance it had for her father to make her watch this video.
“He is your classmate, Yang Fan.”
“What?” Luo Bing’s expression finally changed.
The Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array at the Great Success stage was nothing rare, but if the opponent was a senior high school student, it was a different story.
In such a short time, even Luo Bing herself could not do it.
At this moment, Luo Bing’s mind recalled the scene of Awakening that day.
It was clearly only an F-rank talent, yet the area of his divine kingdom possessed one million square kilometers.
This person indeed had something special about him.
“For this midterm exam, with your strength, getting first place is without any difficulty. Help this person during the exam and figure out a way to let him enter the top ten.”
“Why is that?”

“Gods need friends, even friends to whom they can entrust their backs. He is your classmate, and his background is clean enough. He can help you a lot when you reach university.” Luo Hai said with profound eyes.
“Yes, Father.”
Her father was a Tier 3 God after all, so Luo Bing naturally wouldn’t doubt his judgment.
At this moment, Yang Fan was talking with Luo Chengfeng in the Virtual World.

“These are 50,000 sets of F-rank weapons and 10,000 sets of E-rank weapons. I can only give you this much help; any more might affect your evaluation.” Luo Chengfeng took out two cards filled with weapons and handed them to Yang Fan.
“Thank you, Grandpa.” Yang Fan was somewhat surprised in his heart.
The value of these resources was not low; even purchasing them inside the Family would cost two to three billion.
Yang Fan never expected that before the midterm exam, Luo Chengfeng would suddenly give him such a huge investment.

“For this school midterm exam, you must try every means possible to charge into the school’s top ten. If successful, a great Opportunity awaits you.” Luo Chengfeng said with an extremely solemn expression.
Yang Fan nodded, indicating that he understood.
Even if Luo Chengfeng didn’t say it, Yang Fan would still strive to improve his ranking.

Although the overall strength of his believers couldn’t compare to those Family Prodigies, with the 2.5 million population inside his divine kingdom, coupled with his Evolution Talent, he had sufficient troop sources to support him and wasn’t afraid of troop attrition at all.
As for the top ten, Yang Fan still had the ability to contend for it.
Before Yang Fan could exit the Virtual World, he saw another invitation message.
It was precisely Luo Bing.
If it were any other classmate, Yang Fan would be prepared to pretend he didn’t see it, but he wouldn’t dare refuse this big sister’s invitation.
Tapping gently on the coordinates, Yang Fan’s consciousness was directly teleported into a conference room.
“Sister Bing, is there something you need me for?” Yang Fan cupped his fists in salute.
Everyone in the exchange group called Luo Bing that way.

“Me, Luoyue, Luoyang, Li Tianheng, and three other people from the Li Family have formed a seven-person team together, preparing to jointly attack the Divine Kingdom Core of an Alien Demigod in this midterm exam. Do you want to join?” Luo Bing’s voice was very cold, and emotional changes could not be heard.

sentences.text: 2026 Genius Exchange Group.
“Brother Yang, you’re awesome!
Just now, I saw in the Family group that my cousin was squeezed out of the top 50 by you, and he’s currently being reprimanded by the Sixth Elder.”
“Luo Qingyuan, don’t wash our Family’s dirty linen outside.
Leave your brother some Face.”
“Sorry, I forgot that my cousin is also in this group.
Offense, offense, I’ll go talk in another group.”
“Are you really not considering cooperation? @Yang Fan.”
“There is strength in numbers.
After all, they are an Alien Demigod, and the number of the opponent’s believers is definitely not small.
If we don’t cooperate, we will easily be encircled and annihilated.”
“Let’s join forces, brother.
I’ve already pulled 8 people on my side, and all their Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle points are above 500. @Yang Fan.”
The Genius Exchange Group became lively again, and many people wanted to win over Yang Fan once more.
After all, only when a team’s strength was powerful would they be qualified to advance toward the hinterland of the Divine Kingdom in order to obtain more core resource buildings.
However, at this moment, Yang Fan had no time to look at the group messages because he received a call from Luo Chengfeng.
“How did your strength progress so much?
Could it be that you used some method to squeeze the potential of your believers!” An eager voice from Luo Chengfeng came from inside the watch.
“No.”
“What is the strongest strength of your believers right now?”
“Tier 2 living beings.”
“How is that possible?
Then how did you get 1,244 points?” On the other end of the phone, Luo Chengfeng was completely dumbfounded, feeling that Yang Fan was joking with him.
“I have comprehended the Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array to the Great Success stage.”
After a moment of silence, Luo Chengfeng’s serious voice came over: “Download all the videos of you participating in the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle today, and then send them to me.
Immediately!”
Feeling the other’s serious tone, Yang Fan immediately followed suit.
The Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle protected personal information extremely strictly.
Aside from the participant themselves, even gods had no qualification to view it.
After sending the video over, Luo Chengfeng replied with a single sentence, ‘Wait,’ and there was no further news.
After watching a few battles and confirming that it was the Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array at the Great Success stage, Luo Chengfeng couldn’t help but curse: “I really fucking struck gold!”
Without hesitation, Luo Chengfeng directly entered the Virtual World to request a meeting with the Patriarch Luo Hai.
In the Virtual World, inside the Elder Council Hall of the Luo Family, there were only Luo Hai and Luo Chengfeng at this moment.
The walls of the council hall were projecting the battles from Yang Fan’s simulation battle this time.
“The Patriarch believes it now, right?
I was originally worried that he used some method to squeeze the potential of his believers for this midterm exam, which is why I asked about it.
I didn’t expect this kid’s Comprehension Ability to be so Heaven-Defying!”
Luo Chengfeng’s tone was excited.
Solely in terms of Comprehension Ability, he felt that no one among the younger generation of the Luo Family could surpass him.
“It’s a bit of a pity.

If we had known earlier that he could comprehend a Formation of the Great Success stage before the exam, our Luo Family could have completely provided Medicinal Pills to help him rapidly increase the strength of his believers, and we could also vie for the resources rewarded by First High this time.” Luo Hai sighed.
After all, the strength of Yang Fan’s believers was too weak.
If he possessed a large number of Tier 3 or even Tier 4 living beings, he would definitely be a massive dark horse in this midterm exam.
Luo Chengfeng hurriedly said: “We cannot just look at the present.
With Yang Fan’s talent, in the future when he becomes a god, his combat power will definitely far surpass those of the same tier, and he can definitely expand territory for our Luo Family.
As a Formation Genius, the Patriarch should understand the huge value within.”
“That is naturally the case.
Such a Prodigy, even if he were only my Luo Family’s son-in-law, we would still do our best to nurture him.” Luo Hai nodded and said seriously.
“I wonder if the Patriarch has ever thought about adding another quota for a First-Class Genius?” Luo Chengfeng tentatively asked.
Luo Hai looked at the projected video and finally sighed: “I am willing to give him an Opportunity.
If he can enter the top ten in this midterm exam, I will convene the Elder Council and have everyone vote on it.”
“Thank you, Patriarch.”
Luo Chengfeng’s expression was overjoyed.
As long as there was an Opportunity, it would be fine.

The resources invested in a First-Class Genius were too massive; it wasn’t just an investment of Faith Points, and the most precious among them were some special buildings that could not be purchased.
As long as there was a sliver of an Opportunity, Luo Chengfeng would fight for it with all his might for Yang Fan.
“If the Elder Council does not pass it, I will still use the Patriarch’s authority to reward him with a Flesh Sea Blood Pool as a subsidy.”
“Yes.”
After Luo Chengfeng left, Luo Hai considered it over and over again, but still edited a message and sent it out.
A moment later, a cold figure arrived at the conference room.
It was precisely Luo Bing.
“Father, you asked me to come over because...?”
“Watch first.” Luo Hai pointed at the combat video on the projection.
Luo Bing frowned slightly: “The strength is so weak, and comprehending such a low-level Formation as the Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array to the Great Success stage is simply a waste of time.”
Luo Bing didn’t understand what significance it had for her father to make her watch this video.
“He is your classmate, Yang Fan.”
“What?” Luo Bing’s expression finally changed.
The Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array at the Great Success stage was nothing rare, but if the opponent was a senior high school student, it was a different story.
In such a short time, even Luo Bing herself could not do it.
At this moment, Luo Bing’s mind recalled the scene of Awakening that day.
It was clearly only an F-rank talent, yet the area of his divine kingdom possessed one million square kilometers.
This person indeed had something special about him.
“For this midterm exam, with your strength, getting first place is without any difficulty.
Help this person during the exam and figure out a way to let him enter the top ten.”
“Why is that?”
“Gods need friends, even friends to whom they can entrust their backs.
He is your classmate, and his background is clean enough.
He can help you a lot when you reach university.” Luo Hai said with profound eyes.
“Yes, Father.”
Her father was a Tier 3 God after all, so Luo Bing naturally wouldn’t doubt his judgment.
At this moment, Yang Fan was talking with Luo Chengfeng in the Virtual World.
“These are 50,000 sets of F-rank weapons and 10,000 sets of E-rank weapons.
I can only give you this much help; any more might affect your evaluation.” Luo Chengfeng took out two cards filled with weapons and handed them to Yang Fan.
“Thank you, Grandpa.” Yang Fan was somewhat surprised in his heart.
The value of these resources was not low; even purchasing them inside the Family would cost two to three billion.
Yang Fan never expected that before the midterm exam, Luo Chengfeng would suddenly give him such a huge investment.
“For this school midterm exam, you must try every means possible to charge into the school’s top ten.
If successful, a great Opportunity awaits you.” Luo Chengfeng said with an extremely solemn expression.

As for the top ten, Yang Fan still had the ability to contend for it.
