Do you want to join?” Luo Bing’s voice was very cold, and emotional changes could not be heard.

chapters.title: Chapter 57: People Will Really Die
paragraphs: “Um... Is my strength not enough?” Yang Fan asked doubtfully.
He knew all the names Luo Bing mentioned; they were all top figures in the grade.
If they excluded the advantage of troop reinforcements and solely discussed believer strength, Yang Fan certainly didn’t think he could catch the eyes of these geniuses.
Luo Bing said proudly, “If I say you can, you can.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan inevitably felt puzzled inside.
“Why would the other party take care of me? Could it be that this ice block is on such good terms with my Rou’er?”
Yang Fan wasn’t stupid; the other party’s move was clearly meant to pull him up.
90% of a Divine Kingdom’s assets were in the core location.
Following the other party, even if he only got the smallest piece of meat, his ranking in this midterm exam wouldn’t be low.
If he didn’t have the Evolution Talent, Yang Fan would have agreed immediately, but now he preferred to venture out alone.
This was an Alien Demigod’s Divine Kingdom, after all; who knew what good things were inside.
Following these monsters, how could it ever be his turn if they truly encountered high-value buildings?
Yang Fan took a deep breath and said, “Thank you, Sister Bing. I know my strength is insufficient, so I won’t hold you back. Besides, I want to explore the Divine Kingdom by myself.”
“Alright.” Luo Bing nodded and didn’t try to keep him any longer.
Luo Bing’s personality was just like that, aloof and keeping others at a distance.
Even though she wondered why Yang Fan rejected her, she wouldn’t actively ask about it.
Returning to reality, Yang Fan looked at Luo Rou lying on the bed and asked, “Rou’er, are you and Luo Bing very close?”
Luo Rou shook her head.
“Consider us ordinary friends, but ever since my Divine Kingdom was damaged, we haven’t had any interaction.”
“Is that so?” Doubts swirled in Yang Fan’s heart, and he didn’t quite understand the meaning behind Luo Bing’s actions.
Thinking of what Luo Bing said to him, Yang Fan felt much more relaxed inside at this moment.
This move by Luo Bing and Li Tianheng would definitely anger that Alien Demigod.
Heading to the Divine Kingdom Core was equivalent to raiding their old lair.
Even if this demigod went crazy in the end, the main firepower would definitely be concentrated on those seven people.
With people willing to attract the firepower, the risks for everyone else would be much smaller.
For Yang Fan, exam rankings were certainly important, but safety was absolute priority number one.

“With my current strength, hoping for the core assets of a demigod’s Divine Kingdom carries too high a risk. At that time, not only would I have to withstand the pressure of the demigod’s believers, but I would also have to guard against Luo Bing and the others.”
A gentleman does not stand under a dangerous wall.
Eating meat easily leads to overeating to death, so it’s better to choose to drink soup.
The future road is long; let’s walk and see as we go, no need to compete for momentary superiority,” Yang Fan muttered to himself.
On the day of the exam, all senior high school students came to the school playground.
The process was the same as the last exam.
Luo Chengfeng, Li Yuan, Wan Sanqian, Tie Wuqing...
The familiar faces from last time had already taken their seats on the high platform.
Every student’s nutrient pod had long been prepared.
On the high platform, Li Yuan, an Elder of the Li Family, couldn’t help saying, “Elder Luo, you have great luck. I didn’t expect you to pick up a treasure last time.”
Yang County was only so big; Yang Fan’s ranking in the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle had long since spread.
As the admissions Elder of the Li Family, letting a Genius with such a high probability of becoming a god be snatched away by the Luo Family naturally pained his heart.
“After all, I married my granddaughter to him. Elder Li Yuan doesn’t seem to have a granddaughter, hahaha.” Luo Chengfeng laughed triumphantly.
Once others found out that Yang Fan had comprehended the Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array at the Great Success stage, they would probably regret it even more.
Thinking of this, Luo Chengfeng felt even more smug in his heart.
Li Yuan just let out a cold snort at this.
If it were three months ago, based on Yang Fan’s performance, he wouldn’t have married off his granddaughter even if he had one.
After all, he didn’t have a Junior whose Divine Kingdom was damaged.
However, Li Yuan only said these words in his heart.
Everyone was a god; there was no need to poke each other’s sore spots.
Wan Sanqian was full of regret.
He had been the one most optimistic about Yang Fan initially, but alas, it was impossible for him to be a match for the Luo Family.

Dean of Students Yang Wanli suddenly flashed onto the stage, performed a gentleman’s bow to everyone on the high platform, then turned around and said in a high-pitched tone, “Fellow students, this is your second senior high school exam. As for the specific details of the exam, I suppose the head teachers of each class have already explained it clearly, so I won’t elaborate further.”

“Now I want to tell everyone the standard for ending the exam: either someone breaks the Alien Demigod’s Divine Kingdom Core, or the Alien Demigod invades the students’ Divine Kingdoms, resulting in large-scale student deaths. Only then will our school’s teachers forcibly terminate it.”
“As for the assessment time, I can clearly tell you all, there is no time limit. This midterm exam will really kill people.”
Following Yang Wanli’s words, most of the senior students off the stage panicked in disorder.
Breaking the Divine Kingdom Core, doesn’t that mean killing that Alien Demigod?
Can Divine Beings really kill a demigod?
As for the Divine Kingdom being invaded, what a joke, those were a demigod’s believers; would the ones dying be themselves?
Originally, everyone had already done their psychological preparation.
Especially students with weaker strength had long decided that just gathering valuable Spiritual Plants and Spirit Plants at the edge of the Divine Kingdom would be enough.
Now, hearing Yang Wanli’s words, their heartbeats all accelerated.
They felt that this midterm exam was simply a dragon’s pool and tiger’s den.
Under the pressure of Yang Wanli’s terrifying divine aura, not a single student dared to speak up and question him.
“Now, everyone enter the nutrient pods; the coordinates are inside.”
“I hope all students can return alive.” Yang Wanli’s voice suddenly turned eerie, making people feel a chill down their spines.
Under the immense psychological pressure, everyone entered the nutrient pods.
The midterm exam officially began.
“Director Yang, aren’t the requirements for ending this assessment a bit too strict?” Li Yuan asked.
Even if the Alien Demigod had been weakened, wanting to rely on a group of Divine Beings to break his Divine Kingdom Core sounded like a fairy tale no matter how you heard it.
As for large-scale student deaths, that was even more absurd.
This was an exam, not a real Divine Kingdom War; there was no need to pay such a huge price.
Those god-level powerhouses on the high platform all furrowed their brows tightly.

“This is the Principal’s intention, but everyone rest assured, what I just said was mainly to scare these children who haven’t experienced baptism by blood and fire. The Principal has already signed a contract with this Alien Demigod, and the other party will hold back.”
“Then the Divine Kingdom Core?”
“An imitation was made for him,” Yang Wanli laughed and said.
Hearing this, everyone let out a sigh of relief.
If it was only an imitation, this Alien God definitely wouldn’t resist to the death.
Everyone would put on a play: Yang County No.
1 Middle School would cultivate the younger generation through this, and the Alien Demigod would get a chance to survive.
Yang Wanli raised his hand and pointed at the sky’s light screen, saying, “The 2026 Senior Midterm Exam of Yang County officially begins. May all Fellow Daoists witness the ceremony.”
The huge light screen projected onto every student, and everything they could see would be reflected to the outside world.
Unlike the last assessment, this time it was in an Alien Divine Kingdom.

Because the Alien God was still alive, the Human Race’s Intelligent Life could only observe what was happening inside the Divine Kingdom through the students, and had no way to open a global field of view.
All senior high school students descended onto the same open space.
Students who had made arrangements before the exam formed teams respectively and marched towards the depths of the Divine Kingdom.

chapters.title: Chapter 58: Alien Believers
paragraphs: Zhang Pang came to Yang Fan’s side and said, “Brother Yang, what can I do?”
“Your believers don’t have much combat capability, so just operate in the outer periphery and gather some Spirit Plants.” Yang Fan looked around at everything.
The surrounding vegetation was very lush, but the air was permeated with a faint scent of blood and a hint of desolation.
Yang Fan guessed that this should be the reason the school’s deities had invaded, but perhaps for the sake of their examination, it wasn’t destroyed on a large scale.
Zhang Pang nodded and said, “Then when will we meet up so I can hand over the supplies I obtain to you?”
“No need, keep them for yourself to develop your divine kingdom.” Yang Fan said indifferently.
There weren’t many valuable things in the periphery of the divine kingdom.
He was aiming for the top ten in this exam, and Zhang Pang couldn’t help him much.
“Ah? But I am your Subordinate God!”
Zhang Pang couldn’t understand Yang Fan’s approach.
He naturally knew the situation of other Subordinate Gods; in school exams, giving the resources one obtained to the main god was basically an unspoken rule.
Subordinate Gods were essentially a part of the main god, much like the relationship between a headquarters and a subsidiary.
Although they had autonomy, they flew the main god’s banner.
During this time, he had already bathed in Yang Fan’s light quite a bit.
Now he didn’t even need to hand over the resources obtained from the exam; this treatment was simply too good.
If other Subordinate Gods knew about his situation, wouldn’t they die of envy?

“Pay attention to your own safety and try not to go deep. Most of my troops will be committed to this battle, and if your divine kingdom is invaded, I might not have time to send troops.” Yang Fan said with a serious expression.
“Understood, Boss, I guarantee I won’t hold you back.” Zhang Pang hurriedly nodded.
Zhang Pang already had a decision in his heart: if he ran into alien believers, no matter what their strength was, he would run away immediately.
He was still young, and the girls at Tianxiang Renjian were still waiting for him; he cherished his life dearly.
After Yang Fan moved away from his classmates, he immediately summoned the soldiers from his divine kingdom.
A full five hundred thousand: 105 Tier 2 beings, 3,822 Tier 1 beings, and the rest were all Mortals.
Feeling the stern murderous aura around him, Yang Fan understood that the danger level of this place was not low.
Even a lion uses its full strength to catch a rabbit; right now, these 500,000 troops were his core strength.
However, his advantage lay in his Evolution Talent.
The divine kingdom was still continuously training troops, and once losses occurred, more believers would continue to fill the gaps.
Outside, the many deities on the high platform also began to comment.
“Yang Fan looks a bit weak in overall strength. Could it be that the Luo Family is reluctant to invest?” Li Yuan asked with a smile.
Luo Chengfeng snorted coldly, “His strength is not weak at all; at the very least, it’s at the level of the top ten in the grade.”
“Oh? Could it be he has some trump card?” A look of curiosity appeared on Li Yuan’s face.
Luo Chengfeng did not explain this.
Once Yang Fan unleashed the Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array at the Great Success stage, it would definitely shock the other party.
He couldn’t wait to see Li Yuan’s expression after finding out.
“Luo Bing and Li Tianheng’s team is crazy enough, actually heading straight for the Divine Kingdom Core.”
“They are indeed full of confidence. Even though it has been weakened, it is still a demigod after all, and the power in the core area cannot be weak.”
Wan Sanqian suddenly looked curiously at Yang Wanli, “Director Yang, I wonder how much living force this Alien Demigod still has?”
“Over a thousand Tier 5 Beings, over ten thousand Tier 4 beings, over a hundred thousand Tier 3 beings, and tens of millions of ordinary tribes.” Yang Wanli smiled slightly.

“Principal Hong really dares to apply pressure. Coupled with the harsh environment of the divine kingdom itself, these little fellows are going to suffer!” Luo Chengfeng gave a bitter smile, his gaze toward Yang Fan carrying a trace of worry.
If all the believers of this demigod gathered in one place, they could easily wipe out the entire senior grade.
Unlike the divine kingdoms of Divine Beings, a demigod’s divine kingdom had various traps and poisons in addition to believers.
After all, once one becomes a demigod, they must protect their divine kingdom from invasion by others.
Apart from the believers themselves, they also needed defensive structures.
“Brat, you must be careful; don’t capsize in a gutter.” Luo Chengfeng prayed as he looked at Yang Fan’s location.
Inside the Alien Divine Kingdom, Yang Fan continuously pushed forward.
Because of the Intelligent Life, at this moment, besides seeing the physical environment in his eyes, he could also see its value.
“Ordinary trees, 0 points.”
“Ordinary beasts, 0 points.”
“Weeds, 0 points.”
Exploring for over a hundred kilometers straight, Yang Fan had no gains other than acquiring some F-grade Spirit Plants.
“Candidate Name: Yang Fan; Points: 13,200.”
Along the way, Yang Fan also roughly understood the value judgment rules of the Intelligent Life; it was basically linked 1:1 with Faith Points.
However, there was good news: this exam seemed to have an invisible power of rules.
As long as he approached within a hundred meters of a valuable item, he could directly collect it into his divine kingdom without having to arrange soldiers for gathering work.
The efficiency was indeed much higher.
“Wuwuwu.”
Noisy sounds came from the depths of the dense forest, and Yang Fan faintly saw figures shuttling back and forth among the tall trees.
“This is, a demonic monkey?” Yang Fan saw the figure clearly.
The other party was huge in volume, roughly three to four times that of his believers.
“Alien Believer: Demonic Monkey (Ordinary), Corpse Value: 10 Points.” Specific information appeared in the iris of Yang Fan’s eyeball.
There were only a hundred or so demonic monkeys with little intelligence.
Even when looking at his army of 500,000, there was no fear in their eyes.
Coming to the ground, the demonic monkeys wielded iron staves, casting out streaks of afterimages, then stood holding their staves and struck a formation.
Seeing this scene, Yang Fan couldn’t help but say, “They wield their staves pretty well.”
Yang Fan waved his hand, and the vanguard charged forward.
With just a single exchange, this batch of demonic monkeys was killed on the spot.
With a thought, Yang Fan collected these corpses into his own divine kingdom.
Not only for points, but these corpses could also be thrown into the Hundred Spirits Blood Pool to refine blood pills, and the production efficiency was much stronger than Taisui meat.
Make full use of everything; it couldn’t be wasted.
Continuing deeper for about a thousand kilometers, suddenly a miserable scream came from the rear, and a thousand-man army fell into a swamp.
“F-grade Defensive Structure: Swamp (Triggered), 10,000 Points.”
Yang Fan directly collected the swamp structure into his divine kingdom, but those one thousand ordinary soldiers had already suffocated to death.
“How many times has this been? This ghost place is simply fatal!” Yang Fan couldn’t help but complain.
If these defensive traps weren’t triggered, he wouldn’t be able to discover them at all.
Along the way, losses were a few hundred people at least, and thousands at most.
He hadn’t seen many alien believers, but he had already lost nearly ten thousand ordinary soldiers.
Regarding the dangers within the demigod’s divine kingdom, Yang Fan raised his evaluation of them to another height in his heart.
The deeper they went, the more battle traces there were around.
Scorched marks, toxic smoke, sword scars, and mountains split open by a mysterious power.
Even just catching a glimpse of a corner of the battle, Yang Fan could feel the terrifying battle that occurred when the school’s upper echelon attacked this place.

sentences.text: Zhang Pang came to Yang Fan’s side and said, “Brother Yang, what can I do?”
“Your believers don’t have much combat capability, so just operate in the outer periphery and gather some Spirit Plants.” Yang Fan looked around at everything.
The surrounding vegetation was very lush, but the air was permeated with a faint scent of blood and a hint of desolation.
Yang Fan guessed that this should be the reason the school’s deities had invaded, but perhaps for the sake of their examination, it wasn’t destroyed on a large scale.
Zhang Pang nodded and said, “Then when will we meet up so I can hand over the supplies I obtain to you?”
“No need, keep them for yourself to develop your divine kingdom.” Yang Fan said indifferently.
There weren’t many valuable things in the periphery of the divine kingdom.
He was aiming for the top ten in this exam, and Zhang Pang couldn’t help him much.
“Ah?
But I am your Subordinate God!”
Zhang Pang couldn’t understand Yang Fan’s approach.
He naturally knew the situation of other Subordinate Gods; in school exams, giving the resources one obtained to the main god was basically an unspoken rule.
Subordinate Gods were essentially a part of the main god, much like the relationship between a headquarters and a subsidiary.
Although they had autonomy, they flew the main god’s banner.
During this time, he had already bathed in Yang Fan’s light quite a bit.
Now he didn’t even need to hand over the resources obtained from the exam; this treatment was simply too good.
If other Subordinate Gods knew about his situation, wouldn’t they die of envy?
“Pay attention to your own safety and try not to go deep.
Most of my troops will be committed to this battle, and if your divine kingdom is invaded, I might not have time to send troops.” Yang Fan said with a serious expression.
“Understood, Boss, I guarantee I won’t hold you back.” Zhang Pang hurriedly nodded.
Zhang Pang already had a decision in his heart: if he ran into alien believers, no matter what their strength was, he would run away immediately.
He was still young, and the girls at Tianxiang Renjian were still waiting for him; he cherished his life dearly.
After Yang Fan moved away from his classmates, he immediately summoned the soldiers from his divine kingdom.
A full five hundred thousand: 105 Tier 2 beings, 3,822 Tier 1 beings, and the rest were all Mortals.
Feeling the stern murderous aura around him, Yang Fan understood that the danger level of this place was not low.
Even a lion uses its full strength to catch a rabbit; right now, these 500,000 troops were his core strength.

The divine kingdom was still continuously training troops, and once losses occurred, more believers would continue to fill the gaps.
Outside, the many deities on the high platform also began to comment.
“Yang Fan looks a bit weak in overall strength.
Could it be that the Luo Family is reluctant to invest?” Li Yuan asked with a smile.
Luo Chengfeng snorted coldly, “His strength is not weak at all; at the very least, it’s at the level of the top ten in the grade.”
“Oh?
Could it be he has some trump card?” A look of curiosity appeared on Li Yuan’s face.
Luo Chengfeng did not explain this.
Once Yang Fan unleashed the Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array at the Great Success stage, it would definitely shock the other party.
He couldn’t wait to see Li Yuan’s expression after finding out.
“Luo Bing and Li Tianheng’s team is crazy enough, actually heading straight for the Divine Kingdom Core.”
“They are indeed full of confidence.
Even though it has been weakened, it is still a demigod after all, and the power in the core area cannot be weak.”
Wan Sanqian suddenly looked curiously at Yang Wanli, “Director Yang, I wonder how much living force this Alien Demigod still has?”
“Over a thousand Tier 5 Beings, over ten thousand Tier 4 beings, over a hundred thousand Tier 3 beings, and tens of millions of ordinary tribes.” Yang Wanli smiled slightly.
“Principal Hong really dares to apply pressure.
Coupled with the harsh environment of the divine kingdom itself, these little fellows are going to suffer!” Luo Chengfeng gave a bitter smile, his gaze toward Yang Fan carrying a trace of worry.
If all the believers of this demigod gathered in one place, they could easily wipe out the entire senior grade.
Unlike the divine kingdoms of Divine Beings, a demigod’s divine kingdom had various traps and poisons in addition to believers.
After all, once one becomes a demigod, they must protect their divine kingdom from invasion by others.
Apart from the believers themselves, they also needed defensive structures.
“Brat, you must be careful; don’t capsize in a gutter.” Luo Chengfeng prayed as he looked at Yang Fan’s location.

chapters.title: Chapter 59: Huge Harvest Medium Ore Vein
paragraphs: Suddenly, Yang Fan seemed to sense something and directly ordered, “The entire army advances eastward.”
This was the scout method Yang Fan came up with.
Within this Alien Divine Kingdom, he was just like ordinary believers and could only observe with the naked eye.
However, as a deity, he had absolute control over his believers.
As long as he wished, he could even observe the surrounding environment through the eyes of any believer.
Therefore, Yang Fan sent out scouts in groups of a hundred in all directions to explore the path.
A team of scouts had just discovered a demon monkey tribe consisting of at least five thousand demon monkeys.
As the main army arrived, Yang Fan finally saw the full picture.
The monkey troop lived in a valley, picking wild fruits, drawing water with bamboo tubes, with little monkeys playing and big monkeys patrolling.
Just like a Human Race tribe, this was completely a small demon monkey tribe.
“Alien Believer: Demon Monkey General (Tier 3 ranked being), 10,000 Points.”
“Alien Believer: Demon Monkey Soldier (Tier 2 ranked being), 1,000 Points.”
“Alien Believer: Demon Monkey Soldier (Tier 1 ranked being), 100 Points.”
The strength of this group of demon monkeys was not weak; most of them were ranked demon monkeys, and ordinary monkeys were actually in the minority.
Not only that, Yang Fan could see that many demon monkeys were injured, and the air was filled with a bloody smell.
“Are these the remnant soldiers left after being cleaned up by the school’s deity powerhouses?” Yang Fan pondered inwardly.
“Why did they gather here?”
Yang Fan cast his gaze toward a fiery red peach forest behind the demon monkey tribe.
“Ten-thousand-year fire spirit peach tree (C-grade Spirit Plant), 5,000 Points.”
There were at least tens of thousands of trees in the entire peach forest behind, and Yang Fan’s eyes instantly filled with joy.
No wonder these monkey troops gathered here; it turned out to be a treasured land.
“The entire army presses forward, leave none alive.” Yang Fan ordered.
“Kill.”
The sides of this valley were steep, and the middle could only accommodate an army of ten thousand.
It could be considered a place easy to defend and hard to attack.
However, for Yang Fan, this was enough.
With so many C-grade Spirit Plants, even if he had to pile up human lives, he had to snatch them, not to mention that most of these monkeys were injured.
“Humans, despicable!” The Tier 3 demon monkey looked at the human soldiers who suddenly rushed out, its eyes filled with hatred.
It was all because of these aliens that his home was shattered.
“Little monkeys, defend against the enemy for me.”
All the demon monkeys picked up the iron rods in their hands and charged forward wave after wave.
“Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array, myriad spirits as one, myriad spirits as me.”
“Kill for me.”
Even though this place was easy to defend and hard to attack, the state of the demon monkeys was too poor, and they were quickly slaughtered by Yang Fan’s army.
Whether it was the Demon Monkey Soldier or those babbling little monkeys, he did not let any of them go.
Yang Fan waved his big hand and swept the corpses of these alien demon monkeys into his Divine Kingdom.
Those who are not of our race must have different hearts; these demon monkeys were not pets at home, but enemies.
There was not the slightest bit of pity in Yang Fan’s eyes.
After clearing the battlefield, Yang Fan also stored those tens of thousands of fire spirit peach trees into his Divine Kingdom.
This income was as high as 60 million Faith Points.
“Candidate Yang Fan, 73.6 million Points.”
“As expected of a demigod powerhouse’s Divine Kingdom; although dangerous, the opportunities are equally huge!” Yang Fan sighed inwardly.
The deity powerhouses outside looked at Yang Fan’s harvest this time and sighed with some emotion.
“Good luck, to actually run into a peach orchard, and the ones garrisoning it are all remnant soldiers.” Li Yuan couldn’t help saying.
The other powerhouses all nodded in agreement.
With so many C-grade Spirit Plants, before the Divine Kingdom was invaded, the Monkey Soldiers stationed here should have been at least fifty thousand.

If that were really the case, relying on the natural barrier and with the strength of Yang Fan’s army, it would take at least triple the force to capture it, and it would never be as easy as it was now.
Wan Sanqian looked at the light screen and asked with some doubt, “That’s not right. Although these Monkey Soldiers are all injured, most of them are ranked beings. Why are the losses so low?”
Everyone had witnessed Yang Fan’s battle just now; after only a few rounds of fighting, all these demon monkeys were killed.
An army of ten thousand suffered losses of no more than a thousand.
This casualty ratio was simply too good!
Hearing Wan Sanqian’s question, the rest of the people finally reacted, feeling that there indeed seemed to be a problem.
Luo Chengfeng suppressed his smile at this moment, trying his best not to show it.

“The Great Success stage Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array. I didn’t expect Class 7 to produce a Genius. He joined the Luo Family, right? You guys have really struck gold.” Yang Wanli evaluated, his tone carrying quite a bit of appreciation.
Hearing this, everyone wore expressions of sudden realization.
“He comprehended the Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array to Major Achievement? How is this possible?” Li Yuan was shocked.
A Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array at the Great Success stage was not uncommon, but none of those people were high school students.
“My granddaughter’s husband has good Comprehension Ability. Is Elder Li envious?” Luo Chengfeng said proudly.
Li Yuan’s face turned green and red, and he said somewhat unwillingly, “Elder Luo has good fortune, picking up a Genius Junior. There is someone to carry on the torch!”
“Thank you for the praise.” Luo Chengfeng laughed heartily.
Looking at Luo Chengfeng’s proud expression, the rest of the people were both envious and jealous.
Inside the Alien Divine Kingdom, Yang Fan continued to explore deeper, and at a flat spot in the mountain range, he discovered dozens of square warehouses.
“C-grade grain storage warehouse, 100,000 Points.”
Yang Fan opened the warehouse and found all kinds of spirit fruits inside.
“C-grade fire spirit peach, 50 Points.”
“C-grade wood peach, 20 Points.”
“C-grade hundred spirit peach, 5 Points.”
Each warehouse was packed full, and Yang Fan directly packaged them all into his Divine Kingdom.
“Candidate Yang Fan, Points +36 million, current Points 125 million.”
During this period, the harvest had noticeably increased, most likely because he was getting closer and closer to the center of the Divine Kingdom now.
Yang Fan checked his surroundings and found that there were actually monkey tracks, and it seemed they had left not long ago.
“Taking this as the center, send 20 teams of scouts to investigate.”
Receiving the order, 20 squads instantly split off to start exploring.
Yang Fan’s consciousness stayed in the middle of the army, his eyes slightly closed, while his attention followed the perspective of the scouts.
Soon, he found the traces of the monkey troops.
“In the southeast direction, ten thousand elite soldiers set out; the rest of the people rest in place.” Yang Fan issued a Divine Decree.
Arriving at the destination, Yang Fan looked at a mine cave behind the monkey troop, and specific information floated up before his eyes.
“Medium Ore Vein, containing various basic Ores, 500 million Points.”
Seeing this, Yang Fan’s breathing involuntarily grew a bit heavy; there was actually an Ore vein here, and it was even a medium-sized one.
The Divine Kingdom War consumed weapons heavily, while Ore veins could continuously produce various Ores.
For those deities with forging talent, an Ore vein was a money printer.
Therefore, even for a medium Ore vein, its value was comparable to the lowest-valued B-grade building.
Perhaps because the loss of Monkey Soldiers here during the Divine Kingdom War was too severe, the Monkey Soldiers guarding the Ore vein at this moment numbered less than a thousand.
“Quickly resolve this, leave none alive!” Yang Fan ordered.
In less than a quarter of an hour, all the Monkey Soldiers died, and their corpses were collected into Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom.
Arriving at the entrance of the Ore vein, Yang Fan took a deep breath and chanted silently in his heart, “Store.”
The volume of the Ore vein was truly too large, and Yang Fan didn’t know whether that invisible rule would allow him to store it into his Divine Kingdom.
With a loud rumble, the entire mountain range began to shake, and then directly vanished out of thin air before Yang Fan’s eyes.
“It really works! I’ve struck it rich!” Yang Fan could feel that there was an extra medium Ore vein inside his Divine Kingdom.

chapters.title: Chapter 60: Divine Kingdom Core Two Armies Arrayed
paragraphs: Having done all this, Yang Fan led ten thousand elite soldiers to rendezvous with the main army and continued to penetrate deeper.
Advancing all the way, Yang Fan could see several granaries every 5,000 kilometers.
It seemed that this Alien Demigod had built a supply line along the way.
In response, Yang Fan accepted everything as it came.
These items were quite valuable; even if he couldn’t use them himself, he could list them for sale in the Divine Shop after going out.
During this period, Yang Fan encountered another large monkey troop, numbering as many as 30,000, among which the Monkey Soldiers alone reached 5,000.
However, the location where the monkey troop was situated at that time was extremely open.
Yang Fan, who possessed an army of 500,000, directly had the entire army charge and kill, crushing them with ten times the force, and ultimately paid a casualty of fewer than 20,000 people.

Besides the corpses of these demon monkeys, Yang Fan collected all kinds of spiritual fruits, messy iron stick weapons, and even F-grade buildings suitable for monkeys to live in, without missing a single one, all into his own Divine Kingdom.
Walking all the way, Yang Fan had already obtained 1.5 billion points.

“Invading other people’s Divine Kingdoms to acquire resources is really fast; it is simply addictive.” After collecting the C-grade building in front of him into the Divine Kingdom, Yang Fan could not help exclaiming.

Fighting all the way here, Yang Fan’s soldiers had long suffered losses exceeding 200,000, but fortunately, the believers within his Divine Kingdom constantly engaged in Breeding, growing, and troop training.
This allowed his total troop strength within the Alien Divine Kingdom to always remain around 500,000.
The outside world.
Luo Chengfeng had been grinning from ear to ear these past few days, in high spirits.
“My granddaughter’s husband has really good luck; he actually found a supply line, delivering resources right to his doorstep!”
With Yang Fan’s current achievements, aside from Luo Bing’s team heading straight for the Divine Kingdom Core, the scores of other students had been pulled far behind by Yang Fan.
As long as he continued to maintain this, entering the top ten of the grade would be without a doubt.

“The deeper one goes, the more dangerous it is. He hasn’t even encountered the Demon Monkey Army until now, coupled with the fact that this supply line happened to be cleared by the school’s powerhouses, which is why he could have it so easy,” Tie Wuqing said indifferently.
“Although Brother Tie is right, his troop strength can constantly be maintained at 500,000. The foundation of his Divine Kingdom is quite profound,” Wan Sanqian murmured.
“Using a Breeding Card to pull up the population before the exam is also common sense.”

“Fighting until now, even Luo Bing and the others are feeling a lack of follow-up strength, and their total troop strength has dropped by about thirty percent. As for him, he is actually still maintaining the initial quantity.”
“Luck is also a part of strength; who made the route he chose happen to have almost no resistance.”
In the following time, Yang Fan felt that the monkey troops he encountered were getting stronger and stronger, and even Tier 5 demon monkey generals appeared.
Although Yang Fan relied on his numerical advantage to completely annihilate the opponents, his actions became increasingly vigilant.
Every time he advanced 10,000 kilometers, he had to rest for a period and send out scouts to scout in all directions.
First, to prevent running into the Demon Monkey Army, and second, to investigate traps.
When the large army moved out together, once they encountered a D-grade or higher defense trap, it would cause a loss of over ten thousand people.
Although Yang Fan possessed sufficient troop sources thanks to his Evolution Talent, if the damage was too great at one time, his overall strength would decline for a period of time.
Being in the Alien Demigod’s Divine Kingdom, having combat power decline was definitely not a good thing.
Now that the harvest was already not small, fighting steadily and pushing forward slowly was the most correct choice.
“My God, human traces have appeared 1,000 miles to the east!” a scout reported.
The area of the demigod’s Divine Kingdom was too large.
In order to investigate the danger more carefully, Yang Fan went from the initial 100 scout teams to the current 500 teams.
He had indeed allocated nearly one-tenth of his forces to explore the path.

Under this circumstance, Yang Fan didn’t have enough energy to pay attention to the situation of all believers, so he issued an order that if a scout discovered a situation, they should leave one person in place and have the other believers return to report.
Upon receiving the news, Yang Fan immediately had his consciousness connect to the soldier still guarding there, acquiring the opponent’s entire field of vision.
Chill emanated all around, and the entire valley was covered with a layer of thin ice, showing no traces of melting.
“This aura is...? Luo Bing!”
Yang Fan’s heart trembled.
He had felt Luo Bing’s aura before, and the ice layer here was of the same origin as it.
“How could it be frozen? Could it be that Luo Bing already possesses believers in the Qi Refining Realm and can use ice-type spells?” Yang Fan asked doubtfully.

Now it had only been half a year since the Awakening of the Divine Kingdom.
Even if Luo Bing possessed the Ice Spirit Root talent, having believers in the Qi Refining Stage was a bit ridiculously fast.

This was just like the gap between a Mortal and an immortal cultivator.
This was also the reason why during this midterm exam, the school’s divine powerhouses did not allow the Alien Demigods to have believers surpassing Tier 5 Beings.
“It should be other means, special buildings, or ice-attribute weapons.”
Using the believer’s body to check the traces here and determine the direction of the other party’s advance, Yang Fan then descended a Divine Decree to recall all scouts.
“Everyone advance west,” Yang Fan issued an order.
The ice in the valley had just not melted yet, and it was very likely that he was not far from Luo Bing and their position.
Within this Alien Demigod’s Divine Kingdom, besides being careful of alien believers, one needed to be even more careful of their own kind.
Yang Fan’s strength was not weak, but it was absolutely impossible for him to defeat Luo Bing and Li Tianheng, let alone that the other party was a seven-person team.
Change places to search for resources; there was no need to wade into the murky waters of the core area.
If he went over now, he might even become an enemy of Luo Bing and the others.
Divine Kingdom Core.
Huge mountain ranges wound endlessly, and boundless Monkey Soldiers filled every corner of the mountain ranges, divided into three layers from top to bottom.
The first layer at the very bottom consisted of ordinary demon monkeys, numbering as many as one million.
The middle layer consisted of Tier 1 and Tier 2 Monkey Soldiers, numbering over 100,000.
The top layer had over a hundred Tier 5 Beings, over a thousand Tier 4 Beings, and over ten thousand Tier 3 Beings.
After this, various rare buildings were placed.
The Demon Monkey Army was arrayed in strict formation, and their opponents were the Human Race army of Luo Bing, Li Tianheng, and others.

Even though the army composed of the seven people had experienced successive major battles, their total troop strength still remained at four to five million, but in terms of the number of high-tier beings, they were still far inferior to the Demon Monkey Army.
“Sister Bing, Brother Tianheng, this bone is too hard. Can we bite through it?” one of them said with a solemn expression.
Looking at the several B-grade buildings in the center of the Alien Divine Kingdom, Li Tianheng couldn’t help feeling a surge of heat in his heart.
As expected of a demigod powerhouse, there were five B-grade buildings alone, along with those dazzling, endless C-grade, D-grade, and E-grade buildings that stretched as far as the eye could see.
This place definitely accounted for more than ninety percent of the resources of the entire Divine Kingdom.
“Fight!” Li Tianheng said earnestly.

Looking at the milky-white light sphere floating in the center of the Demon Monkey Army, Luo Bing’s eyes were likewise filled with Battle Intent: “The Divine Kingdom Core is right before our eyes, how can we retreat?”

Seeing this, Li Tianheng took a deep breath, looked at his companions, and said in a serious tone: “Before coming, we had already discussed it well: Luo Bing and I will take the top two places, and the remaining resources will be evenly split among you. After the exam ends, I can also acquire the Fountain of Life at five times higher than the market price to make it convenient for you to split the accounts. Does anyone have any objections to this?”
“Let me state in advance that if anyone dares to slack off and not put in effort, they will be offending Luo Bing and me. Think clearly about the consequences.”
As long as they bit off this hard bone, securing the top seven places in the whole school with the acquired resources would be a breeze.
Moreover, the members of this team were all direct descendants of the Luo Family and the Li Family.
Although he didn’t think they dared to play any sneaky tricks with him, it was still better to make things clear before the major battle.

chapters.title: Chapter 61: Wonder Spirit Peach Mountain
paragraphs: “This is only natural. Sister Bing and Brother Tianheng’s strength is obvious to all. No one will have any objections to you two taking the top two spots. As for the rewards for third to seventh place—” he added, “to avoid infighting, we’ll cash them out and split them evenly among ourselves privately.”
“Agreed.”
“I don’t have any problem either.”
“We already discussed this long ago, just do it! Taking down a demigod powerhouse’s Divine Kingdom Core will be enough for me to brag about for a whole year throughout senior year!”
“Alright, then let’s fight! I refuse to believe we can’t chew through a half-crippled demigod powerhouse!” Li Tianheng shouted loudly.
His talent, Mad Blood, instantly activated, directly buffing all Human Race soldiers.
“Kill!”
The great battle was on the verge of breaking out.
In a single exchange, nearly one hundred thousand of those ordinary demon monkeys fell directly.
High up in the sky ten thousand meters above, the demon monkey deity emitting a milky-white glow was watching the fierce battle below, a trace of mockery curving the corners of his mouth.

“Foolish humans, did you really think this deity would put all my belongings in one place? If it weren’t for signing a contract with your Human Race deities, giving me a chance to survive, I would definitely personally command a massive army to slaughter all of you.”

“I’ll just play along with you brats for a little while. Consider these buildings as my payment to buy back my life!” The Demi-god Demon Monkey wore a slightly pained expression; after all, these were all his savings.

“Fortunately, I’m smart and transferred my core assets in advance. In your wildest dreams, you would never expect that the most valuable buildings in my Divine Kingdom are in the exact opposite direction, Hhahaha.”
At this moment, the Demi-god Demon Monkey was also concentrating on commanding the Monkey Soldiers to fight.
It wasn’t that Luo Bing and the others were too strong, but rather that he needed to act his part well.
After all, Human Race deities were still watching this place at this moment.
It wouldn’t do to cripple these Human Race geniuses, and it equally wouldn’t do if it failed to provide a training effect.
For a dignified demigod like him to make a move against a group of Divine Beings, grasping the proper measure of restraint was truly not easy.
This was the final great battle, which also attracted the gaze of many external deities.
“A Tier 5 Being is actually able to cast Spirit Ice Art. Although its power is much weaker, how did she manage to do it?”
“It’s the effect of the special building, Ice God Temple. The Luo Family head truly dotes on his daughter.”

“Li Tianheng’s Mad Blood effect can actually buff so many people. Although it’s only a C-grade talent, the further the Divine Kingdom develops, the greater the role this talent plays. No Wonder the Li family gave him the treatment of a First-Class Genius.”
“This foolish monkey actually dares to hold back; the formation was broken through so quickly.”
During the battle at the Divine Kingdom Core, no matter how far away he was, Yang Fan could still feel the tremors of the mountain range.

“Fighting so fiercely, they’re going all out!” Yang Fan couldn’t see what was specifically happening, but these subtle vibrations that could travel ten thousand li away, along with the increasingly thick scent of blood in the air, were all telling him how tragic the battle was.
“Once the Divine Kingdom Core is breached, the mid-term exam will also end. I must speed up my actions.”
Yang Fan stopped sending out scouts and instead explored with his entire army together.
With younger generation leaders like Luo Bing and Li Tianheng around, Yang Fan didn’t dare to expect too much, but he still hoped to enter the top ten of his grade.
After all, Luo Chengfeng had said that an Opportunity was waiting for him.
Several more months passed inside the Divine Kingdom.
At this moment, Yang Fan was putting twenty granaries into the Divine Kingdom.
Yang Fan stopped in his tracks; he suddenly found the dense forest before him somewhat strange.
Compared to other places, the fallen leaves on the ground here were a full meter higher, and a large number of tree branches had fallen off.
Yang Fan looked up at the slightly barren towering ancient trees, feeling somewhat puzzled in his heart.
“A troop of monkeys passed by? Such a large forest is entirely like this; the number must be at least several hundred thousand!”
“That’s not right. The Divine Kingdom Core area is currently in a fierce battle, how could there still be so many Monkey Soldiers coming here?”
“This should be the scene caused when the school deities subjugated this place.”
Figuring out the crux of the matter, Yang Fan plucked up his courage and continued to explore forward.
Arriving outside a huge valley, Yang Fan looked at the endless demon monkey footprints on the ground, his eyes showing some hesitation.

“These probably, maybe are also footprints left from before. Right now, the Alien Demigod is fighting a defensive battle at the Divine Kingdom Core location, how could they split their forces to come here?”
“There might be treasures left behind from before in this place, I have to go investigate.”
Yang Fan sent a Tier 2 Being who had cultivated Light Body Art to investigate, and his consciousness was similarly attached to the other party.
The soldier’s figure quickly arrived above the valley like a nimble monkey.
Yang Fan cast his gaze toward the valley.
At this moment, he was completely dumbfounded.
“Demon Monkey General (Tier 5 Being), 1 million points.”
“Demon Monkey General (Tier 5 Being), 1 million points.”
“Demon Monkey Soldier...”
The entire valley was filled with ranked demon monkeys, numbering a full million.
“This...” Yang Fan was dumbfounded; he even doubted whether he had read it wrong.
At this moment, the battle at the Divine Kingdom Core location was earth-shattering, how could so many Monkey Soldiers be hidden here?
Were these Monkey Soldiers refusing to obey commands, abandoning the Divine Kingdom Core, and sleeping while waiting for death?
Yang Fan could not understand.
If the Divine Kingdom Core was breached, neither deities nor believers would escape death.
At a moment of life or death, a nearly million-strong army was actually sleeping here.
What were they waiting for?
These were all well-trained demon monkey troops, otherwise, given the monkeys’ mischievous Qi, it would be utterly impossible to remain this quiet.
Yang Fan’s heart had already started to feel afraid.
If his army was discovered by this elite force, it probably wouldn’t even be enough to fill the gaps between their teeth.
Just as Yang Fan was preparing to flee, his gaze caught sight of the buildings placed at the center of the monkey troop.
“B-grade building, Monkey Wine Spring, 2 billion points.”
“B-grade building, Monkey Wine Spring, 2 billion points.”
“B-grade Spirit Plant, Pan Tao Tree, 1 billion points.”
“B-grade Spirit Plant, Pan Tao Tree, 1 billion points.”
“Special building, Enlightenment Stone, 10 billion points.”
“Wonder, Spirit Peach Mountain (Undeployed), 30 billion points.”
Yang Fan only felt his heart pounding fiercely at this moment.
He issued an order, having that believer skilled in Light Body Art carefully return to the army.
At this moment, the outside world had already exploded into an uproar.
“This demon monkey is truly cunning, actually transferring its core assets away!”
“This Alien Demigod is quite wealthy.”
“As expected of Yang County No. 1 Middle School, they actually bear to use so many treasures as rewards for examinees.”
“What a pity, although Luo Bing and Li Tianheng are strong, they attacked the wrong location.”
“When the exam ends, how about we don’t let this Demi-god Demon Monkey go? With so many good things, even I am somewhat tempted.”
Everything Yang Fan saw had long since fallen into everyone’s eyes.
Some sighed, some were angry, and others expressed wanting to seize this demon monkey’s Divine Kingdom Foundation.
Divine Kingdom Wonders were not common; even deities would be tempted.
Hearing everyone’s words, Yang Wanli spoke up: “This demon monkey has made a contract with the principal; it will be released to leave once the exam ends. Everyone, watch your words.”
Hearing this, the crowd’s expressions became sheepish, and they did not dare to say any more.
Contracts also had extremely strong binding force on deities.
With Hong Bing, a Tier 3 God, present, they certainly didn’t dare to harbor crooked thoughts.
At this time, everyone once again cast their gazes toward Yang Fan’s position.
They were also very curious about how Yang Fan would ultimately choose.
Would he be blinded by greed, or recognize reality and immediately flee ten thousand li away?

chapters.title: Chapter 62: Demon Monkey Riot
paragraphs: Luo Chengfeng also grew nervous, praying inwardly, “Little Yang, don’t be foolish. If you touch this thing, that Demi-god Demon Monkey will go crazy.”
This Demi-god Demon Monkey had a cunning nature, holding the mindset of a cunning rabbit having three burrows, and transferred its core assets here.
Had Yang Fan not stumbled upon it by chance, even they would not have known.
If Luo Bing and the others were here, they could naturally give it a fight, but Yang Fan’s strength was too weak.
The troop strength differed by twofold, and the Yao core army had even more large numbers of Tier 4 and Tier 5 Beings holding down the fort.
The combat power was simply not on the same level.
Once discovered by the Demon Monkey Army, total annihilation of the army was a minor matter; if they followed the coordinates to counterattack the Divine Kingdom, it would be too late for regrets.
“What is this kid doing? Isn’t he retreating? Why is he running to the riverside?”
At this moment, within the Alien Divine Kingdom, Yang Fan’s 500,000 troops had retreated to a position a thousand miles away from the valley.
Yang Fan was seen taking out the corpse of an infant demon monkey from his Divine Kingdom.
An adult demon monkey’s body was several times that of a human, while this juvenile demon monkey happened to be similar in size to an adult human.
Yang Fan commanded his believers to carefully skin the juvenile demon monkey starting from its back, trying their best not to damage the integrity of the skin.
After finishing, he had a Tier 2 soldier who knew the Light Body Art crawl inside.
“Once successful, run towards the periphery with all your might.” Yang Fan issued a Divine Decree in advance.
Afterwards, that Tier 2 believer mimicked the movements of a demon monkey and quickly moved toward the valley.
The Demon Monkey Army inside the valley was all asleep, and since Yang Fan was originally a body of consciousness, he could completely borrow his believer’s body to approach that pile of buildings.
Once close, he could utilize the power of rules to collect all these buildings into his Divine Kingdom.
As long as the Divine Kingdom was not destroyed, his consciousness would not be damaged; by then, what died would merely be a Tier 2 believer.
The only thing to worry about was how to escape the hunt of the Alien Demigod afterward.
Yang Fan was very conflicted; such an Opportunity was right before him, and the risks were not small, yet he truly was unwilling to give up.
If he could succeed, he would run straight to the periphery.
When the Demon Monkey Army pursued them, the most dangerous ones wouldn’t be him, but those classmates taking the logistics path.
Hadn’t the school teachers said so?
If Yao Beasts invaded students’ Divine Kingdoms on a large scale, the exam would naturally be terminated.
Those classmates were Yang Fan’s shield; he wanted to gamble, gambling that the school’s deities would intervene.
Yang Fan was not an utterly heinous person, but he definitely didn’t consider himself a good person either.
With heavy profits before him and rules to exploit, why shouldn’t he give it a desperate fight!
Better a Fellow Daoist die than this poor Daoist!
Yang Fan believed and was certain that the school teachers would definitely intervene.
If they didn’t, it was the school being irresponsible, what did that have to do with him?

“It has nothing to do with me, it has nothing to do with me, it has nothing to do with me.” Yang Fan turned his head to look in the direction of the outer perimeter of the Divine Kingdom, repeating it constantly in his heart.
Looking at the scene of someone draped in demon monkey skin and tiptoeing forward.
The deities in the outside world seemed to have guessed something!
Yang Wanli suddenly stood up, his expression shocked as he said, “This kid is going to use the contract rules established between the principal and that demon monkey to directly backdoor their base!”
Cleaning up the battlefield in a Divine Kingdom War was not as simple as this exam; that required relying on a large number of believers to slowly transport things back to one’s own Divine Kingdom.
As long as the distance was sufficient in this exam, one could directly collect the buildings into their own Divine Kingdom.
The reason it could be so simple was entirely because Hong Bing had established a contract with the opposing deity.
Everything within the Divine Kingdom was decided by the deity; to put it bluntly, this was permitted by this Demi-god Demon Monkey itself.
But judging from the current situation, there seemed to be a loophole in this contract, and Yang Wanli even felt that the success rate of Yang Fan’s move was extremely high.
“He is too bold. The very instant he collects these buildings into the Divine Kingdom, he will be discovered, and by then the demon soldiers of the entire Divine Kingdom will hunt him down.”

“Once Yang Fan’s believers in this world are killed off, his consciousness will be pulled back into his own Divine Kingdom, his coordinates exposed, and the opponent will take advantage of the momentum to enter. This is courting death.”
“I actually feel his idea is not bad, and he has a lot of potential. Shouldn’t the school step in to save him?” Wan Sanqian tentatively asked Yang Wanli.
“That’s right, if my grandson-in-law’s Divine Kingdom is invaded, the school should terminate this exam,” Luo Chengfeng said anxiously.
“The principal has been paying attention to this exam all along, he has his own judgment,” Yang Wanli said slowly.
Within the Alien Divine Kingdom, inside the valley, a short and small infant monkey was cautiously crawling forward.
500 meters, 400 meters, 300 meters.
Yang Fan’s believer was already so nervous that he forgot to breathe, fearing he would leak a trace of human Qi.
Just when he was 200 meters away, a Tier 5 demon monkey general opened his eyes, looking at the little monkey by his feet, a flash of doubt flitting across the corner of his eyes.
Being stared at by a Tier 5 Being, Yang Fan’s believer was instantly frightened into not daring to move.
“Charge, even if you die, you must approach within 100 meters.” Yang Fan directly descended a Divine Decree into his Soul.
The deity’s command made him forget about death at this moment.
With all his might, he executed the Light Body Art, standing up on his hind legs, and his entire body flew towards those buildings like an arrow shot from a bow.
“Lawless.” The Tier 5 demon monkey general opened his right hand and directly slapped it towards the believer’s back.
In his eyes, this undeveloped monkey dared to ignore the rules and come here, simply courting death.
With a bang, the terrifying power directly slapped the believer into a puddle of meat paste.
A large number of demon monkeys woke up at this moment because they smelled the scent of alien blood.
Stunned for a moment, all the Tier 5 demon monkey generals stood up simultaneously, their eyes filled with panic.
They discovered that all those precious buildings their deity had arranged for them to protect had completely vanished.
“Ahhh.”
“Awooo.”
“Who did this?”
“Run, sprint towards the outer periphery of the Divine Kingdom with all your might.” Yang Fan issued a Divine Decree.
The scheme had succeeded, but at this moment Yang Fan did not feel joy, because he knew that the true test had just begun.
The Demi-god Demon Monkey, who was acting with Luo Bing and the others, also felt something at this moment.
Its gaze was like torches, and its consciousness instantly covered the entire Divine Kingdom, finding the culprit.
“Courting death.”
The opponent’s eyes were filled with anger and madness, instantly issuing a Divine Decree.
“Kill all of this person’s believers for me, attack his Divine Kingdom, and snatch all my treasures back!”
All the B-rank buildings could be given to these humans, but his Wonder, the Spirit Peach Mountain, absolutely could not be lost.
Without the Spirit Peach Mountain, he would lose the chance to make a comeback; no matter what, he had to take it back.
The pressure on Luo Bing and the others suddenly skyrocketed; they discovered that these demon monkeys had all gone crazy.
“Kill.”
“Humans, step aside for me, or die!”
“Despicable humans, I am going to slaughter all of you.”
Seeming to feel the anger of their deity, all the demon monkeys within the Divine Kingdom began to go crazy.
The battle situation instantly reversed.
Luo Bing and the others, who were about to reach the end, were suddenly forced back, and the demon monkeys charged at their formation desperately.
“Hold your ground, Mad Blood blessing.”
“Freezing a Thousand Miles!”
Luo Bing’s face turned icy cold as she shot out an ice arrow, instantly freezing four Tier 5 demon monkeys.
“Sister Bing, Brother Tianheng, these demon monkeys are not right. It seems they have used Yao Beast secret techniques, and our formation is about to be broken.”
“We must retreat and stabilize the formation. Once the major formation is broken, we will be lambs waiting to be slaughtered.”
“Head down the mountain first.” Li Tianheng’s face was full of reluctance.
Clearly it was just a little bit more, just a little bit more!

chapters.title: Chapter 63: Heavy Losses Encounter
paragraphs: On the other side, Yang Fan’s expression was equally ugly.
These Monkey Soldiers seemed to be able to pinpoint his location, desperately coming from all directions to intercept him.
In a mere single day, Yang Fan had encountered more than ten battles.
Although the strength of the demon monkeys he met was not strong, it delayed a lot of the army’s marching time.
Right now, Yang Fan did not dare to delay for even a moment.
He knew very well in his heart that the million-strong Demon Monkey Army was definitely pursuing him.
“The deity of this divine kingdom is still here, and all my actions are under the other party’s gaze. If this continues, being caught is only a matter of time.”

Yang Fan’s eyes turned fierce, and he gave the order: “Leave 200,000 ordinary soldiers, chop down all the trees in this forest, and pile them together. If the Demon Monkey Army comes, set fire to them at the first instance. Delay them for as long as possible.”
Orders were executed strictly.
As a deity, Yang Fan’s believers would not question his commands in the slightest, even knowing clearly that staying behind meant certain death.

“I must go faster. The other party’s two most important forces are at the Divine Kingdom Core and the valley just now. Although the Monkey Soldiers in other places are not few, they are extremely scattered. If they encounter me, I still have the strength for a fight. As long as we reach the periphery, the pressure will be passed to the school.”
To speed up, Yang Fan even had the soldiers take off their armor and travel light.
He didn’t care even if the marching process suffered greater sacrifices because of this.
As for the buildings and Spirit Plants encountered along the way, Yang Fan ignored them completely.
Luo Bing and Li Tianheng’s team had now plummeted to 2 million.
The Demon Monkey Soldiers in the mountain range desperately charged at their Formation, displaying an attitude of dragging them down together.
“Sister Bing, the enemy deity has made a move. These beasts’ Formation is much stronger than before. We are no match for them.”
“Brother Tianheng, retreat quickly. There aren’t many sources of troops left in my divine kingdom. If this continues, we’ll all fall here.”

“I miscalculated. An Alien Demigod is not something we can provoke right now. After going back, I’m going to make my dad find a way to track down this demigod. Since they had this ability, playing back and forth with us at the beginning—were they just toying with us?”
“Retreat quickly, run towards the periphery, and leave 500,000 people to cover the rear.”
“Luo Mingxuan! You actually abandoned me and ran away alone. Have you no shame? We agreed to advance and retreat together.”
“Brother, I am sorry. I don’t want to die. If I can stay alive, I’ll compensate you for your losses after going out.” Luo Mingxuan apologized while fleeing with his own army.
“What happened? Where did all these demon monkeys come from? Why did they all suddenly pop out?”
“This is the method of an Alien Demigod. The school is fucking heartless—they actually want our lives!”
“When I get out alive, I’ll tell my father to stop donating to Number One High School.”
“Damn it, I haven’t lived enough yet. Sister Ruyan, I’m afraid I won’t be able to come to Cloud and Earth to see you anymore!”
At the outermost periphery of the divine kingdom, a classmate let out a scream.
“Alien believers, it’s demon monkeys! Everyone, run!”
“Brother, don’t panic. I’ll help you. It’s just an ordinary demon monkey. I bought quite a few weapons; one or two hundred believers can definitely take it down.”
Seeing that alien believers had actually appeared here, Zhang Pang hurriedly took a step back, protecting his classmates in front of him.
“Time to slip away, time to slip away. This place is still too dangerous. I am still young and can’t take risks.” Zhang Pang retreated backwards with his believers.
The entire divine kingdom was in complete chaos at this moment.
The demon monkeys killed anyone they saw, and the massive amounts of fresh blood further stimulated the ferocity of these beasts.
Outside, a miserable scream suddenly came from the playground.
A nutrient pod was forced open, and a student evaporated right before everyone’s eyes.
The Divine Kingdom Core was breached by the Yao Beast, and casualties had already appeared among the students.

“Director Yang, if this continues, something big is going to happen. Even if the students of Number One High School take the logistics path, they can still provide quite a bit of assistance to The Frontline in the future. We can’t just waste lives in vain like this.” Luo Chengfeng said in a serious tone.
“This... I can’t make the decision. The principal has always been here. If it truly gets out of control, he will naturally step in.” Yang Wanli’s expression was somewhat ugly.

“It’s all because of your granddaughter’s husband, relying on the power of rules to move away the other party’s Divine Kingdom Core building. With such despicable means, how could this monkey not go crazy?” Li Yuan snorted coldly.
If Yang Fan truly had the strength, it would be fine, but he achieved it through opportunistic means, and now he still wanted the students of the entire senior grade to carry the burden with him.
Such an approach was truly unsightly.

Luo Chengfeng said in an icy tone: “Yang Fan did not violate the school rules. What’s wrong with using some methods? Could it be that when you all launch a Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle against alien races, you still have to send a formal greeting card in advance to tell the other party when I will attack you?”

Seeing that the two of them were about to quarrel, Yang Wanli spoke out to persuade: “Alright, Yang Fan has committed no fault. When it all comes down to it, it’s still our school’s own lack of consideration. To cultivate the students’ combat awareness and avoid letting them waste all their time on gathering resources, the principal added such a clause into the contract.”
In Yang Wanli’s view, Yang Fan’s actions had no problems, it was just that the consequences triggered were somewhat serious.
This monkey seemed to have gone crazy.
If this continued, it would no longer be an assessment, but a massacre.
“Principal, don’t hold such high demands for these students anymore. Hurry up and make a move!” Yang Wanli said in his heart.
Yang Fan had been running wildly inside the divine kingdom for more than a month.
During this period, the interceptions he encountered were no less than a hundred battles, and the total force invested by the other party was as high as 300,000.

Coupled with the various defensive buildings and harsh environments encountered, his losses in this past month were greater than all his previous losses combined, having consumed nearly 700,000 ordinary soldiers.
Now, Yang Fan only had 300,000 elite soldiers left by his side.
Even with the Evolution Talent, he couldn’t withstand such consumption.
“Transfer another 50,000 old people and 50,000 females from the divine kingdom to chop trees and dig trenches for me.” Yang Fan ordered once again.
To block the pursuers, he even abandoned nearly 500,000 female and elderly believers who had no combat effectiveness.
If this continued, he would even have to drag out those children in the divine kingdom who hadn’t grown up yet.
“As expected of an Alien Demigod powerhouse, truly terrifying.” Yang Fan said with an ugly expression.
Along the way, because it had been too smooth, Yang Fan had miscalculated this demigod’s strength.
At this rhythm, he was afraid he wouldn’t be able to run out.
Just at this moment, a small squad of soldiers suddenly came to report.
“My deity, traces of the Human Race have been discovered, right not far ahead.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan’s eyes lit up.
“Catch up to them.” Yang Fan said.
After a day, Yang Fan finally found the team, which was none other than Luo Bing and the others.
At this time, the aura of the other party’s believers was also extremely withered, looking as if they had just experienced a major battle.
However, the number of people was still a massive 2 million, making it undoubtedly the most powerful team in the senior high grade.
“Sister Bing, Brother Tianheng, save me! These monkeys have gone crazy!” Yang Fan’s consciousness shouted loudly.
“Why are you here?” Li Tianheng revealed a look of surprise.
Li Tianheng naturally recognized Yang Fan.
After all, they were group members, and coupled with the other party’s good performance in the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle during this period, he was naturally worth paying attention to.
However, this place still belonged to the scope of the Divine Kingdom Core; he didn’t expect Yang Fan to actually dare to come here to explore.

At this time, the aura of the other party’s believers was also extremely withered, looking as if they had just experienced a major battle.
However, the number of people was still a massive 2 million, making it undoubtedly the most powerful team in the senior high grade.
“Sister Bing, Brother Tianheng, save me!
These monkeys have gone crazy!” Yang Fan’s consciousness shouted loudly.
“Why are you here?” Li Tianheng revealed a look of surprise.
Li Tianheng naturally recognized Yang Fan.
After all, they were group members, and coupled with the other party’s good performance in the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle during this period, he was naturally worth paying attention to.
However, this place still belonged to the scope of the Divine Kingdom Core; he didn’t expect Yang Fan to actually dare to come here to explore.

chapters.title: Chapter 64: Life in This World Relies Entirely on Acting Skills
paragraphs: “I was originally searching for resources on the outer perimeter, but for some reason, the demon monkeys suddenly went crazy a while ago and chased me everywhere. In my panic, I ended up here,” Yang Fan hurriedly explained, his eyes filled with bitterness.

“Brother Tianheng, and Sister Bing, I still have three to four hundred thousand believers here. Although their strength isn’t high, they can help you scout ahead. There are quite a few traps and defensive buildings in this ghost place.” Yang Fan showcased his own value.
Luo Bing nodded and wanted to agree, but the four members of the Li family were unwilling.
How many believers could scouting consume?
There was simply no need for them to bring along a dead weight.
Yang Fan carefully observed the changes in everyone’s expressions.
Before the other party could speak, he immediately took out resources from his Divine Kingdom.
“Fifty Class-C grain storage silos, countless spiritual fruits of various kinds, and one medium-sized mineral vein.”
The huge mineral vein suddenly appeared, shaking the mountain peak.
“This is my biggest harvest of this trip. I hope Brother Tianheng can take this little brother under your wing. This place is too dangerous!” Yang Fan respectfully bowed to Li Tianheng.
Seeing this, everyone’s expressions looked much better.
This was close to one billion points!
They hadn’t expected the person before them to have such a huge harvest.
If he could safely wait until the end of the assessment, relying on the resources here, this person should be able to squeeze into the top ten, right?
“You are a member of the Luo Family, so it’s only right to take you out. There’s no need to be like this,” Luo Bing spoke up.
Hearing these words, the expressions of the four Li family members were clearly displeased.
Although their group had harvested quite a bit, they hadn’t managed to get a single bit of the assets from the Divine Kingdom Core in the end.
Right now, they were all suppressing a fire in their hearts.

“Sister Bing’s words aren’t quite right. Since I’m asking for your protection, how can I not contribute anything? The Divine Kingdom War is too dangerous. After experiencing this, I finally understand that in the future, I must never do things beyond my capabilities.”
“Although I handed over most of my harvest, I learned valuable experience from it.”
“Most importantly, I get to make friends with all of you. In the past, I wouldn’t have even had the chance to try and cozy up to you!”
Yang Fan scratched the back of his head, a hint of shyness appearing on his face.
Seeing this, Li Tianheng hurriedly stepped forward and waved his right hand, storing those resources into his Divine Kingdom.
“Brother Yang, rest assured, I’ll guarantee your safety.”
Seeing that Yang Fan was so tactful, Li Tianheng’s impression of him improved quite a bit.
Wasn’t it completely normal to collect a little protection fee for taking him out of the Divine Kingdom Core area?

“Many thanks, Big Brother Tianheng. If you have any requests in the future, just give this younger brother a word.” Yang Fan stepped forward, looking at Li Tianheng with a face full of gratitude, putting on an appearance of following his every command.
Seeing this scene, the expressions of the three members of the Luo Family were somewhat unsightly, but they didn’t say much more.
After all, this place was fraught with danger, and everyone still needed to cooperate fully.
Outside, Li Yuan, an Elder of the Li family, could no longer control himself.
Li Yuan fiercely slapped the armchair, stood up, and pointed at Luo Chengfeng, cursing, “Is this your granddaughter’s husband? Absolutely shameless to the extreme!”
Li Tianheng and the others didn’t know the real situation.
Right now, they had been sold out by someone and still didn’t realize it.

Although Luo Chengfeng’s expression was somewhat awkward, he still unconvincedly said, “In a situation of life and death, how can anyone still talk about Jianghu morality? Besides, your Li family’s Genius looks quite satisfied with this protection fee!”
“Satisfied your sister, why didn’t he take out that Wonder?” Li Yuan was so angry he spat blood.
Bringing Yang Fan along meant Luo Bing and Li Yuan would have to face the demigod’s full firepower, and those few resources might not even be enough to make up for the losses in the end.
This brat Yang Fan was simply ruthless enough to eat people without spitting out their bones!

“This kid’s heart is a bit too black.” Tie Wuqing was somewhat amused yet exasperated, having already decided in his heart that once he went back, he would make his son Tiefeng stay further away from this classmate.
“Hahaha, I’m almost starting to admire this kid’s shamelessness!” Wan Sanqian burst into belly-laughter.
Clearly his strength wasn’t much, but relying on his acting skills, he had the top and second-ranked students of the grade twirling around his finger.
That could also be considered a kind of ability.
Most of these deities had lived for thousands of years, and seeing such a comical scene happen among the juniors, they couldn’t help but smile faintly as well.
After joining Luo Bing and Li Tianheng’s team, Yang Fan’s pressure was much less.
As for sending believers to scout the path, he had even less complaints and was always taking the lead.
Moreover, because he didn’t fear the loss of believers, the scouting efficiency was much higher, and the group’s departure speed became even faster.
“Damn it, why am I so unlucky these past few days? The number of these demon monkeys has increased by two or three times!”
“It really is strange.”
Seeing everyone’s confusion, Yang Fan hurriedly said, “A month ago, the Yao Beasts here suddenly went crazy. Did you guys seize the core building of this Demi-god Demon Monkey?”
Hearing this, Li Tianheng’s face twitched, and he didn’t reply.
They did try to seize it, but they hadn’t managed to get it.
Everyone’s expressions were low, and they all guessed that they must have been close to success, which was what drove the Alien Demigod crazy.
They didn’t get any goods, but instead brought trouble upon themselves.
It would be embarrassing just to speak of it.
“What now?” one of them asked.
After all, the losses during this period were too great; the ones left were all elites among their believers, which had already sharply decreased by five hundred thousand.
“We’ll go to the outer perimeter to rendezvous with the other classmates. We can only wait for the school teachers to make a move!” Luo Bing sighed.
“Fuck the school teachers! Is this fucking midterm exam? They’re toying with me!”
“Stop complaining and hurry up and leave. I always feel like danger is approaching.” Li Tianheng looked towards the Divine Kingdom Core area, a trace of worry rising in his heart.
“Right, let’s run quickly!” Yang Fan echoed as well.
If they were caught up by that group of Monkey Soldiers in the valley, even Luo Bing and Li Tianheng’s team wouldn’t fare well.
“Big shots of the school, just how much longer are you going to watch the show? Make a move quickly!” Yang Fan prayed endlessly in his heart.
Li Tianheng kept his word.
During this period, aside from having Yang Fan scout the path, the Demon Monkey Soldiers they encountered were all dealt with by the seven of them.
Relying on his rest during this period, Yang Fan gained quite a few more Mortal believers within his Divine Kingdom.
“A little further ahead, and we’ll almost be at the outer perimeter!” Luo Bing let out a light breath, her eyes likewise filled with fatigue at this moment.
Just at this moment, everyone subconsciously turned around.
Billowing thick smoke rose, and towering ancient trees rustled.
Millions of Monkey Soldiers were swarming toward them like ants.
“What the fuck, I didn’t even manage to seize a single Class-B building, yet they chased me all the way here.” Li Tianheng flew into a rage.
“This Alien Demigod is simply a lunatic. Our consumption is too great, don’t go head-to-head, let’s leave quickly.” Another person’s expression was grave.
Right at this moment, a fifth-order general among the monkey horde suddenly let out a heaven-shaking roar.
“Humans, put down the building, and I’ll spare your lives.”

Seeing this, Yang Fan rushed out and pointed his finger at the Demon Monkey Army, saying, “A bunch of beasts, your deities are already prisoners of our Human Race. Instead of obediently offering up the building to beg for mercy, you still dare to bark.”
Looking at the primary culprit before them, the Demon Monkey Army could no longer endure it.
“Kill.”
“Kill all the humans.”
“For the deities, kill all the humans.”
Ceasing dialogue, those demon monkeys rushed straight toward the army like madmen.
Seeing this, Li Tianheng instantly activated his talent “Mad Blood”, a wave of exhilarated power covering all his believers.
“Maintain formation and kill them all for me!”
