chapters.title: Chapter 65: Safe Brother
paragraphs: As the leading figure of the Li Family of this generation, when had Li Tianheng ever suffered such humiliating grievance?
Not a single core building was obtained, and now he was being hunted down by a group of beasts for millions of kilometers.
At this moment, Yang Fan took a step back at the same time and shouted loudly at Li Tianheng: “Big Brother Tianheng, and Sister Bing, these Yao Beasts are too strong, we cannot fight them head-on.”
“I will go ahead to scout the path first, ensuring there won’t be any traps along the way ahead. You guys fight while retreating, safety first.”
“Once we grow stronger in the future, we will kill all these Alien deities together.”
Hearing this, Li Tianheng was stunned on the spot, feeling it made some sense yet feeling something was not quite right.
That’s not right, brother.
Where did that righteous indignation and Aura you had just a moment ago go?
Weren’t you going to fight to the death with the opponent?
How come you ran away first?

“Brother Tianheng, what Yang Fan said is correct. Our Divine Kingdom has consumed too much, and believers have suffered heavy losses; fighting while retreating and waiting for the school’s deities to make a move is the right way.”
“Do not act on impulse, maintain formation, and slowly retreat. With Yang Fan scouting the path ahead, at least we don’t have to worry about traps,” Luo Bing also spoke up.
The gap in strength between the two sides was too vast.
Even with the blessing of Li Tianheng’s Mad Blood talent, they would eventually be defeated given enough time.
Yang Fan once again summoned five hundred thousand believers from his Divine Kingdom.
These people had no armor, no weapons, and some didn’t even have clothes.
Their purpose was to use their lives to investigate and flush out all the poisonous creatures, traps, and defensive buildings in this dense forest.
The Yao Beast army had arrived, and he could not waste any time now.
“Luo Bing, Li Tianheng, you must hold on.” Yang Fan cheered them on in his heart.
The sounds of battle, killing, and miserable screams were endless to the ear.
Trees fell row by row, and the severed limbs of humans and Yao Beasts littered the entire mountain forest.
Luo Bing made a decisive decision, leaving five hundred thousand people behind to cover the rear, while the rest of the believers caught up with Yang Fan’s pace.
Three more days passed before they finally reunited.
Looking at Yang Fan’s many extra believers who weren’t even wearing clothes, a trace of unbearable pity flashed in Li Tianheng’s eyes.

“Brother, I have seen all your contributions. Be careful not to shake the Foundation of your own Divine Kingdom. If the casualties of believers are too severe, it will greatly drag down the development pace of the Divine Kingdom.” Li Tianheng stepped forward and patted Yang Fan’s shoulder, a hint of brotherly affection appearing in his eyes.
A trace of awkwardness flashed in Yang Fan’s eyes, but he concealed the emotion instantly.

“We are almost there. Next, we will go scout the path, you should recall these believers back to your Divine Kingdom. Women and children are the Foundation stones of the future development of the Divine Kingdom, and their casualties cannot be too excessive,” Luo Bing said.
“That’s right, leave the rest to us. If you hadn’t mobilized a large number of believers to scout the path, it would have been impossible for us to arrive here so quickly.”
“I acknowledge you as my brother. Once we get out, I’ll book a private room for you at Tianxiang Renjian.”
“Hahaha, then we male comrades will go together. Sister Bing, do you want a male model? I know a good place.”
“Scram, don’t lower your guard. I feel that this Alien Demigod won’t give up so easily.” Luo Bing’s face darkened.
If it were usual times, she would definitely have taught the other party a lesson.
However, after going through life-and-death experiences during this period of time, their relationship had indeed improved quite a bit.
Yang Fan said with a serious expression: “This is all what I should do. Your believers are stronger in strength than mine, how can they be wasted on such matters? I must never hold the team back!”
Yang Fan’s expression was incomparably sincere.
With a wave of his large hand, hundreds of thousands of believers set off once again.
It was a bit awkward.
If this continued, by the time this assessment ended, he was afraid he would offend quite a few people.
These seven people were all representative figures of the younger generation of the Luo Family and Li Family.
This time, he was afraid he would thoroughly offend these Family prodigies.
Every gain has a loss.
Compared to the harvest, Yang Fan felt that everything was worth it.
“In the future, I’d better speak less in the Genius Exchange Group to avoid being scolded by people!” Yang Fan made a decision in his heart.
The further they went toward the outer perimeter, the weaker the resistance they encountered became.
After all, those Yao monkeys living here were mostly unranked creatures.
Their intelligence was not high, and they could only use their lives to stop Yang Fan and his party.
After another month of sprinting, the group finally arrived at the open space where they had initially entered the Alien Divine Kingdom.
This place was already packed with senior high school students, and the surroundings were surrounded by hundreds of thousands of ordinary Yao monkeys.
This place seemed to have rule restrictions; although those Yao monkeys were baring their fangs and brandishing their claws outside, they couldn’t enter at all.
Those students on the logistics track swallowed their saliva as they looked at the dense, dark mass of Yao monkeys outside, feeling somewhat terrified in their hearts.

“I want to take a leave of absence from Yang County No. 1 Middle School. This mid-term examination is simply too outrageous. Feng Shao, Brother Jun, and Xiaoyuer have all had their Divine Kingdoms breached by this group of beasts, and their lives or deaths are unknown.”
“Our class is the same; two people died just from what I know.”
“When I get out, I’m going to report this to the Federal Government. The school simply doesn’t take the lives of students like us on the logistics track seriously at all.”
Everyone sat on the lawn, their tones filled with complaints.
“Where is that team of Luo Bing and Li Tianheng? Why haven’t they returned yet? Could something have happened to them?”
“That should be impossible. Their strength is definitely enough to venture deep into the hinterlands of the Divine Kingdom.”
“Do you think it could be that Luo Bing and the others robbed this Demigod’s core assets, and thus—?”

“High probability that’s the case, otherwise the other party wouldn’t have gone so crazy. Those stinking monkeys look at me as if they’ve met the enemy who killed their father. It scared the hell out of me.”
At this moment, Li Shuhao had already returned to Class 7’s camp.
Looking into the distance, he also thought with worry in his heart: “Brother Yang, you must be safe and sound!”
Just at this moment, the monkey horde outside was suddenly disrupted by a terrifying force.
“Ice Seal,” Luo Bing uttered softly, and nearly ten thousand ordinary Yao monkeys were directly frozen into ice sculptures.
“Wind-Breaking Slash.” The long saber in the hands of Li Tianheng’s Tier 5 believer swept horizontally, instantly shattering those ice blocks and clearing a path.
Seeing that the Yao monkeys surrounded but did not attack the students in the open space, Luo Bing and the others also knew this place was a safe zone.
After recalling their believers back into their own Divine Kingdoms, they stepped into it.
“Luo Bing and Li Tianheng have returned! Such terrifying strength, were those believers in the Qi Refining Realm just now?”
“It seems they really ventured into the hinterland of this Demigod Divine Kingdom. Truly amazing, I wonder what assets this Alien Demigod actually has!”
Everyone looked at Luo Bing and the others, their faces all showing expressions of envy.
“Brother Yang, why are you here?”
“Brother Li, this examination has truly been heart-pounding!” Yang Fan let out a long breath, feeling a wave of mental exhaustion.

Li Tianheng came over and patted Yang Fan’s shoulder, saying: “Let’s go out and have a drink together. I’ve made up my mind to make friends with you. You helped a lot in being able to return so smoothly this time. However, we have use for those resources. After going out, I will discuss with the others and convert them into Faith Points for you.”
Hearing Li Tianheng’s words, no one else in the team refuted it.
An alliance forged through life and death—how could a few hundred million Faith Points compare to it?

In the future when attending university or even stepping into society, a person like Yang Fan, who could stake his entire Divine Kingdom to help at a critical moment, was truly a friend one could entrust with their back.

“No, this is all what I should do. Without you guys, I might not have been able to come out alive.” Yang Fan hurriedly waved his hand, his expression incomparably serious, as if the other party converting Faith Points for him would mean looking down on him.
“I understand your meaning. Calculating these things between brothers is indeed inappropriate. Remember to look for me if you have any trouble in the future.” Li Tianheng made a promise.

After another month of sprinting, the group finally arrived at the open space where they had initially entered the Alien Divine Kingdom.
This place was already packed with senior high school students, and the surroundings were surrounded by hundreds of thousands of ordinary Yao monkeys.
This place seemed to have rule restrictions; although those Yao monkeys were baring their fangs and brandishing their claws outside, they couldn’t enter at all.
Those students on the logistics track swallowed their saliva as they looked at the dense, dark mass of Yao monkeys outside, feeling somewhat terrified in their hearts.
“I want to take a leave of absence from Yang County No.
1 Middle School.
This mid-term examination is simply too outrageous.
Feng Shao, Brother Jun, and Xiaoyuer have all had their Divine Kingdoms breached by this group of beasts, and their lives or deaths are unknown.”
“Our class is the same; two people died just from what I know.”
“When I get out, I’m going to report this to the Federal Government.
The school simply doesn’t take the lives of students like us on the logistics track seriously at all.”
Everyone sat on the lawn, their tones filled with complaints.
“Where is that team of Luo Bing and Li Tianheng?
Why haven’t they returned yet?
Could something have happened to them?”
“That should be impossible.
Their strength is definitely enough to venture deep into the hinterlands of the Divine Kingdom.”
“Do you think it could be that Luo Bing and the others robbed this Demigod’s core assets, and thus—?”
“High probability that’s the case, otherwise the other party wouldn’t have gone so crazy.
Those stinking monkeys look at me as if they’ve met the enemy who killed their father.
It scared the hell out of me.”
At this moment, Li Shuhao had already returned to Class 7’s camp.
Looking into the distance, he also thought with worry in his heart: “Brother Yang, you must be safe and sound!”
Just at this moment, the monkey horde outside was suddenly disrupted by a terrifying force.
“Ice Seal,” Luo Bing uttered softly, and nearly ten thousand ordinary Yao monkeys were directly frozen into ice sculptures.
“Wind-Breaking Slash.” The long saber in the hands of Li Tianheng’s Tier 5 believer swept horizontally, instantly shattering those ice blocks and clearing a path.
Seeing that the Yao monkeys surrounded but did not attack the students in the open space, Luo Bing and the others also knew this place was a safe zone.
After recalling their believers back into their own Divine Kingdoms, they stepped into it.
“Luo Bing and Li Tianheng have returned!
Such terrifying strength, were those believers in the Qi Refining Realm just now?”
“It seems they really ventured into the hinterland of this Demigod Divine Kingdom.
Truly amazing, I wonder what assets this Alien Demigod actually has!”
Everyone looked at Luo Bing and the others, their faces all showing expressions of envy.
“Brother Yang, why are you here?”
“Brother Li, this examination has truly been heart-pounding!” Yang Fan let out a long breath, feeling a wave of mental exhaustion.
Li Tianheng came over and patted Yang Fan’s shoulder, saying: “Let’s go out and have a drink together.
I’ve made up my mind to make friends with you.
You helped a lot in being able to return so smoothly this time.
However, we have use for those resources.
After going out, I will discuss with the others and convert them into Faith Points for you.”
Hearing Li Tianheng’s words, no one else in the team refuted it.
An alliance forged through life and death—how could a few hundred million Faith Points compare to it?

In the future when attending university or even stepping into society, a person like Yang Fan, who could stake his entire Divine Kingdom to help at a critical moment, was truly a friend one could entrust with their back.
“No, this is all what I should do.

Without you guys, I might not have been able to come out alive.” Yang Fan hurriedly waved his hand, his expression incomparably serious, as if the other party converting Faith Points for him would mean looking down on him.
“I understand your meaning.
Calculating these things between brothers is indeed inappropriate.
Remember to look for me if you have any trouble in the future.” Li Tianheng made a promise.

chapters.title: Chapter 66: Li Tianheng You Fool
paragraphs: Although Yang Fan was an outsider Genius of the Luo Family, the Luo and Li families in Yang County were not enemies.
Just making friends, Li Tianheng only cared about sincerity.
Luo Bing also said to Yang Fan, “If you have any trouble in the future, come straight to me.”
Luo Bing finally understood at this moment why her father had asked her to take care of the other person in this exam.
Her father’s vision was indeed better than hers; such a person was worth deep friendship!
“Brother Yang, we are returning to Class 1, Grade 12’s camp. After we get out, we must hang out more.”
“Don’t forget Tianxiang Renjian; I can even book a presidential suite for you.”
Everyone chimed in one after another, all bidding farewell to Yang Fan.
Seeing this scene, the other students of Grade 12 were completely baffled.
What did Yang Fan do?
How did he become sworn brothers with these monsters at the top of the grade?
Such great networking resources—this kid must have hit the jackpot!

Returning to Class 7, Grade 12, Li Shuhao said with a face full of envy, “Brother Yang, I finally understand why you didn’t accept my invitation—you actually managed to join Brother Tianheng and the others’ team. This younger brother admires you. When you make it big in the future, remember to help me out more.”
“Brother Li, remember to stay away from me in a moment.”
“Why?”
“To avoid collateral damage.”
At this moment, Zhang Pang was like a victorious rooster, standing directly beside Yang Fan with the look of ‘I am the most awesome lackey in Grade 12′.
“Brother Yang, you are awesome. The most correct thing I’ve done in my life is becoming your Subordinate God,” Zhang Pang said in a low voice.
“Stay away from me. If you don’t want to die, keep a low profile lately.”
“Ah? You can’t take off and leave your brother behind! I am your Subordinate God!” Zhang Pang’s expression became somewhat anxious.
“It’s hard to explain clearly. Anyway, it’s best to pretend you don’t know me from now on. It’s for your own good,” Yang Fan said in a serious tone.
The two were best friends.
Looking at Yang Fan’s expression, Zhang Pang knew that things were probably going to blow up.
Out of trust, Zhang Pang sneaked over to the very corner of the class and stopped talking to anyone.
Just at this moment, millions of Yao soldiers appeared in the nearby mountains, swarming toward this place with overwhelming momentum.
“What is the situation? Aren’t we safe once we get here? How are we supposed to get out?!”
“Could it be that the mid-term exam hasn’t ended yet? My consciousness has returned to my Divine Kingdom now, these demonic monsters won’t chase after us here, right?!”
Terrifying Auras radiated from the bodies of those fifth-order demon monkey generals, and many weak students began to tremble.
Thud thud thud thud.
The demon monkeys’ palms slammed frantically, but outside this open space, there seemed to be an invisible air wall, and no matter what, they couldn’t enter even an inch.
A mountain-sized light shadow floated above the sky.
Although it was a conscious entity, its appearance was almost identical to those demon monkeys.
“Alien Demigod!”
An exclamation came from the crowd.
“Human, return my things!” The Demi-god Demon Monkey stared fixedly at the location of Class 7, Grade 12 where Yang Fan was.
Yang Fan directly closed his eyes and put on a terrified appearance.
Things had already reached this point; he didn’t believe that the school’s divine powerhouses wouldn’t know about this matter.
How could meat that had already entered his mouth be spit out?
“Court death!” The demigod phantom above the sky condensed a huge iron rod that was fully a thousand meters long and smashed it directly at everyone.
This was the other party’s Divine Kingdom; with a single thought, all energy could be mobilized.
The huge iron rod fell, emitting a terrifying sonic boom, and even space began to shatter.
The Grade 12 students present were now so frightened that they stood frozen in place, almost forgetting how to breathe.
“You have violated the contract!” A voice came from the Void Realm.
The voice seemed to carry an invisible magic, and that destructive attack vanished into thin air at this moment.
The Demi-god Demon Monkey was full of resentment: “Hong Bing, I only want the ‘Wonder’.”
“The contract is made. I will let you leave, or you can choose to die here.”
The Alien Demigod was full of unwillingness, casting a glance at the location of Class 7, Grade 12, as if wanting to remember Yang Fan forever, before turning around and leaving.
Facing a deity, no matter how unwilling it felt in its heart, there was nothing it could do.
If it continued to persist, its Divine Kingdom Core would be destroyed.
“Mid-term exam ends, consciousness returns.”
As Hong Bing’s voice fell, all the students present felt a huge pulling force, and their consciousness instantly returned to the nutrient pods.
Yang Fan opened the pod door.
Having returned to reality, he felt his body somewhat stiff.
This mid-term exam had lasted a full month.
Yang Wanli stood up, walked to the podium, and said loudly, “Now, announcing the rankings.”
At the same time, the light screen in the sky changed, and the images inside those Divine Kingdoms began to shatter, followed by the appearance of lines of text.
“Mid-term exam rankings:
1st Place, Class 7, Grade 12 Yang Fan, Points: 471.23 billion.
2nd Place, Class 1, Grade 12 Luo Bing, Points: 6.469 billion.
3rd Place, Class 1, Grade 12 Li Tianheng, Points: 6.023 billion.
4th Place...
As the rankings were announced, the entire playground fell dead silent.
To be precise, after seeing the first line of words, they didn’t continue reading downwards.
What is the situation?
First place is Yang Fan?
What on earth did he do?
Did he raid a demigod’s old nest?!
In an instant, a thought appeared in everyone’s mind.
Could it be that this guy drove those Yao Beasts crazy?!
“Impossible? Did an error occur? Why am I only in 3rd place, how could 1st place be Yang Fan?!” Li Tianheng’s expression gradually distorted.
In this mid-term exam, Li Tianheng was determined to get 2nd place, and he had even thought about what building to choose from the school’s warehouse.
As long as he obtained that building, his believers’ development would undergo a qualitative leap, and he would even be qualified to try applying to the two top universities in the Federation.
At this moment, he simply had no way to accept this result.
And why was it Yang Fan?
His brother?
From the hinterland of the Divine Kingdom all the way to the safety zone, the other party had been under his protection!
How could this be?
Completely incomprehensible.
Li Tianheng only felt his worldview beginning to collapse.
“You fool! You were sold out and you didn’t even know it.” Li Yuan couldn’t hold back anymore and directly cursed out loud.
“Sixth Grandfather, I?” Li Tianheng felt baffled.

Li Yuan didn’t want to talk nonsense, looking directly at Yang Wanli and saying, “Director Yang, can you make the mid-term exam recording public? No other reason, just to remind the young people. Sometimes friends can be much more treacherous than enemies.”
While speaking, Li Yuan’s gaze stared straight at Yang Fan.
A First-Order God was actually gnashing his teeth at this moment.
Seeing this scene, all the students of Grade 12 were dumbfounded.
What on earth did Yang Fan do?
A question surfaced in everyone’s heart.
“This...” Yang Wanli hesitated a bit, after all, this was not in line with the regulations.
“Granted!” The voice of Principal Hong Bing came from the sky.
The light screen changed once more, directly dragging the progress bar to the scene where Yang Fan brought his believers outside that valley.
He had his believers crawl into the skins of infant demon monkeys, using the rules to take away buildings worth thirty to forty billion.
Then the Yao Beasts rioted, and Luo Bing, Li Tianheng, and others also failed because of this, being forced to flee in panic.
Afterwards was when Yang Fan ran into Luo Bing and her party.
“Sister Bing, Brother Tianheng, these resources were me...”
Everything that happened inside the Divine Kingdom was clearly recorded by the Intelligent Life.
From how Yang Fan obtained the core building to how he acted weak and played the pity card to use Luo Bing, Li Tianheng, and others to return to the safety zone.
His scheming methods were all High Grade, it’s just that...
Under the gaze of everyone, these plots were played out like a movie, which was simply like subjecting Yang Fan to death by a thousand cuts.

chapters.title: Chapter 67: Played for a Fool
paragraphs: Yang Fan took a deep breath, lowering his head and standing in place without looking at anyone.
As the saying goes, as long as I am not embarrassed, the ones who are embarrassed are others!
“My Brother Yang, no wonder you told me to stay away from you, right? Won’t the two of us become street rats in school from now on!” Zhang Pang’s face turned pale with fright.
His own big brother actually treated the top ten Geniuses of the school like fools!
The problem was that he fucking succeeded!
It was badass alright, but the consequences were very serious.
Which of these people wasn’t powerful with a Heaven-Defying background?
It was hard to imagine how to get through the rest of high school life.

After the playback ended, Li Yuan glared at Li Tianheng and said, “Stupid thing, how could my Li Family give birth to such trash as you, and a First-Class Genius at that? I really want to stuff you back into your mother’s stomach!”
Li Yuan continued to curse, completely disregarding his image as a deity.
There was no help for it; it was simply too humiliating.
Watching his own Genius being sold and still helping the other party count the money, Li Yuan really wanted to find a crack in the ground to crawl into.
Every time Li Tianheng called Yang Fan brothers in the Alien Divine Kingdom, he felt like he was slapping his own face.
Not only Li Tianheng, but Luo Bing and the remaining five members of the team had extremely ugly expressions.
They fancied themselves as leading figures of the younger generation and proud sons of heaven.
What was the result?
They were played like fools!
“Damn it, Yang Fan! Just you wait for me!” The expression of that hot-tempered Genius from the Li Family was twisting.
Right at this moment, Li Tianheng moved.
He didn’t care about the gazes of the crowd and walked straight toward Yang Fan blankly.
Arriving at a position half a meter in front of Yang Fan, the other party stopped.
“Very good, extremely good, I remember you.”
Bang!
Li Tianheng threw a punch instantly, striking straight at Yang Fan’s chest.
After the development of the Divine Kingdom during this period, Yang Fan’s reaction speed was likewise not weak now.
Crossing his hands together, he blocked in front of his chest.
Yang Fan only felt a huge force transmitting from his arms to his whole body, sending his entire person flying backward.
“Such strong power, my right hand is already fractured.” Yang Fan retreated dozens of meters in succession, his face full of solemnity.
With just a single strike, he knew that there was still a huge gap between his Divine Kingdom and the other party’s.
“Enough, this is a school, not a place for private fights.” Yang Wanli stopped him.
“Why aren’t you hurrying back with me, you disgraceful thing.” Li Yuan had arrived beside Li Tianheng at some unknown time, directly grabbing his shoulder and disappearing from this place.
“Yang Fan and Luo Bing stay, the rest can leave. As for the rewards of the top one hundred, the school will send them to your respective Divine Kingdoms.” Yang Wanli waved his hand.
Quite a few students walked past Yang Fan, their eyes containing disdain, admiration, amazement, and even fear.
He didn’t expect Class 7, Grade 12 to have such a ruthless person.
They had to stay away in the future; if they cooperated with this person, they might get eaten until not even bone scum was left.
“You pretend to be a pig to eat the tiger quite well. To think Laozi called you brother for so many days. When we have time, let’s apply for the Divine Kingdom Battlefield and practice.”
“Me too. Even though you are a member of the Luo Family, since you dared to play tricks on me like this, I remember you.”
“Yang... bro...ther, I will well remember your brotherly affection. I hope you won’t regret it in the future.”
When the remaining five members of the team passed by Yang Fan, they all patted his shoulder, but at this moment their eyes no longer held any brotherly affection, instead revealing a hint of danger.
From childhood to adulthood, this was the first time they had suffered such a huge covert loss.
Yang Fan was truly sinister.
Talking about asking for protection was completely treating them as cannon fodder.
If they had chosen to sit on the fence back then and everyone had escaped to the safe zone, they definitely wouldn’t have encountered such huge resistance.
Perhaps this person would have long been killed by the Alien Demigod.
This midterm exam was simply gathering the strength of everyone to achieve just him alone.
Relying on petty cleverness to steal the other party’s nest, and depending on a shameless and limitless way of handling affairs to trick them into helping block the beast tide.
Such an ungrateful and shameless scoundrel was definitely the public enemy of the whole school.
Very soon, there were only Yang Fan and Luo Bing left among the students on the entire playground.
Zhongyuan Tower boss Wan Sanqian hadn’t left yet, instead looking at Yang Fan with great interest.
“Kid, after today, you will be famous in Yang County!” Wan Sanqian laughed and said.
Yang Fan’s skin twitched.
If the benefits weren’t too huge, he wouldn’t want this kind of fame either.

“Don’t care about other people’s evaluations. The higher a person stands, the farther scenery they can see. When you achieve a Breakthrough to a Demigod, others will envy you. When you achieve a Breakthrough to a deity, others will only look up to you. As long as you become strong enough, naturally someone will argue the classics for you.” Wan Sanqian suddenly said.
Hearing this, Yang Fan respectfully bowed and saluted: “Thank you for your guidance, Senior.”
“It’s been a long time since I’ve seen such an interesting junior. It’s just a pity that you’ve already joined the Luo Family, otherwise I might have been able to pass Zhongyuan Tower to you.”
After Wan Sanqian let out a loud laugh, his figure immediately vanished without a trace.
Luo Chengfeng walked down the high platform and slightly cupped his fists, saying, “Director Yang, please wait a moment.”
“No problem.” Yang Wanli said indifferently.
Having obtained consent, Luo Chengfeng immediately came before Yang Fan and Luo Bing.
“Luo Bing, the Patriarch has admonished that the Ice Immortal Palace and the Ice God Temple in the school storehouse complement each other. You must choose it.” Luo Chengfeng said.
Luo Bing let out a cold hum, turned her head, and did not answer.
Because of Yang Fan, at this moment she didn’t even have any favorable impression left for this elder Luo Chengfeng.
Luo Chengfeng shook his head with a bitter smile and turned to look at Yang Fan, his eyes containing too many emotions.
Appreciation, worry, bewilderment, sighing.
He originally hoped that Yang Fan would fight for a top-ten spot in this midterm exam, but he didn’t expect the other party to pull off such a big stunt for himself.
First place in the grade, and by the way, he scammed the entire Grade 12.
Luo Chengfeng was a deity who had lived for a thousand years, after all.
His judgment of right and wrong naturally wouldn’t be as green as these students.
In life-and-death survival, everything could be betrayed, and everything could be utilized.
After all, once one’s Divine Kingdom was destroyed, nothing else would have any meaning.
In his heart, he didn’t think Yang Fan did anything wrong, but the consequences were indeed serious.
His own grandson-in-law was probably going to become a lone ranger in the future!
Offending so many people—not to mention high school, he would probably face gossip even when he reached university.
Whether it was Divine Kingdom investment, Divine Kingdom War, or future pioneering work, teamwork was required.
Luo Chengfeng wasn’t certain right now whether Yang Fan’s action was right or wrong for him.
Right now, Yang Fan’s harvest even made deities somewhat tempted, but looking toward the future, he would probably have to face various pressures all by himself.

Luo Chengfeng took a deep breath and said, “Little Yang, the school’s storehouse originates from a high-tier Mechanical Divine Kingdom civilization and is connected to the Federal Education System. It will automatically help you select the Class B building most suitable for your current development. You just need to choose from them. There is no need to blindly pursue high or low value; what suits your own Divine Kingdom is the most important. Trust in science and technology.”
Yang Fan was not a child of a major Family, and his experience was still shallow.
Luo Chengfeng truly worried that he would solely judge the full value of the buildings based on the height of Faith Points, wasting this Opportunity in vain.
“Understood, thank you Grandpa.” Yang Fan nodded seriously.
“You... sigh, forget it, we’ll talk when we get back.” Luo Chengfeng stopped talking midway.

After the development of the Divine Kingdom during this period, Yang Fan’s reaction speed was likewise not weak now.
Crossing his hands together, he blocked in front of his chest.
Yang Fan only felt a huge force transmitting from his arms to his whole body, sending his entire person flying backward.
“Such strong power, my right hand is already fractured.” Yang Fan retreated dozens of meters in succession, his face full of solemnity.
With just a single strike, he knew that there was still a huge gap between his Divine Kingdom and the other party’s.
“Enough, this is a school, not a place for private fights.” Yang Wanli stopped him.
“Why aren’t you hurrying back with me, you disgraceful thing.” Li Yuan had arrived beside Li Tianheng at some unknown time, directly grabbing his shoulder and disappearing from this place.
“Yang Fan and Luo Bing stay, the rest can leave.
As for the rewards of the top one hundred, the school will send them to your respective Divine Kingdoms.” Yang Wanli waved his hand.
Quite a few students walked past Yang Fan, their eyes containing disdain, admiration, amazement, and even fear.
He didn’t expect Class 7, Grade 12 to have such a ruthless person.
They had to stay away in the future; if they cooperated with this person, they might get eaten until not even bone scum was left.
“You pretend to be a pig to eat the tiger quite well.
To think Laozi called you brother for so many days.
When we have time, let’s apply for the Divine Kingdom Battlefield and practice.”
“Me too.
Even though you are a member of the Luo Family, since you dared to play tricks on me like this, I remember you.”
“Yang... bro...ther, I will well remember your brotherly affection.
I hope you won’t regret it in the future.”
When the remaining five members of the team passed by Yang Fan, they all patted his shoulder, but at this moment their eyes no longer held any brotherly affection, instead revealing a hint of danger.
From childhood to adulthood, this was the first time they had suffered such a huge covert loss.
Yang Fan was truly sinister.
Talking about asking for protection was completely treating them as cannon fodder.
If they had chosen to sit on the fence back then and everyone had escaped to the safe zone, they definitely wouldn’t have encountered such huge resistance.
Perhaps this person would have long been killed by the Alien Demigod.
This midterm exam was simply gathering the strength of everyone to achieve just him alone.
Relying on petty cleverness to steal the other party’s nest, and depending on a shameless and limitless way of handling affairs to trick them into helping block the beast tide.
Such an ungrateful and shameless scoundrel was definitely the public enemy of the whole school.
Very soon, there were only Yang Fan and Luo Bing left among the students on the entire playground.
Zhongyuan Tower boss Wan Sanqian hadn’t left yet, instead looking at Yang Fan with great interest.
“Kid, after today, you will be famous in Yang County!” Wan Sanqian laughed and said.
Yang Fan’s skin twitched.
If the benefits weren’t too huge, he wouldn’t want this kind of fame either.
“Don’t care about other people’s evaluations.
The higher a person stands, the farther scenery they can see.
When you achieve a Breakthrough to a Demigod, others will envy you.
When you achieve a Breakthrough to a deity, others will only look up to you.
As long as you become strong enough, naturally someone will argue the classics for you.” Wan Sanqian suddenly said.
Hearing this, Yang Fan respectfully bowed and saluted: “Thank you for your guidance, Senior.”
“It’s been a long time since I’ve seen such an interesting junior.
It’s just a pity that you’ve already joined the Luo Family, otherwise I might have been able to pass Zhongyuan Tower to you.”
After Wan Sanqian let out a loud laugh, his figure immediately vanished without a trace.
Luo Chengfeng walked down the high platform and slightly cupped his fists, saying, “Director Yang, please wait a moment.”
“No problem.” Yang Wanli said indifferently.
Having obtained consent, Luo Chengfeng immediately came before Yang Fan and Luo Bing.
“Luo Bing, the Patriarch has admonished that the Ice Immortal Palace and the Ice God Temple in the school storehouse complement each other.
You must choose it.” Luo Chengfeng said.
Luo Bing let out a cold hum, turned her head, and did not answer.
Because of Yang Fan, at this moment she didn’t even have any favorable impression left for this elder Luo Chengfeng.
Luo Chengfeng shook his head with a bitter smile and turned to look at Yang Fan, his eyes containing too many emotions.
Appreciation, worry, bewilderment, sighing.
He originally hoped that Yang Fan would fight for a top-ten spot in this midterm exam, but he didn’t expect the other party to pull off such a big stunt for himself.
First place in the grade, and by the way, he scammed the entire Grade 12.
Luo Chengfeng was a deity who had lived for a thousand years, after all.
His judgment of right and wrong naturally wouldn’t be as green as these students.
In life-and-death survival, everything could be betrayed, and everything could be utilized.
After all, once one’s Divine Kingdom was destroyed, nothing else would have any meaning.
In his heart, he didn’t think Yang Fan did anything wrong, but the consequences were indeed serious.
His own grandson-in-law was probably going to become a lone ranger in the future!
Offending so many people—not to mention high school, he would probably face gossip even when he reached university.
Whether it was Divine Kingdom investment, Divine Kingdom War, or future pioneering work, teamwork was required.
Luo Chengfeng wasn’t certain right now whether Yang Fan’s action was right or wrong for him.
Right now, Yang Fan’s harvest even made deities somewhat tempted, but looking toward the future, he would probably have to face various pressures all by himself.
Luo Chengfeng took a deep breath and said, “Little Yang, the school’s storehouse originates from a high-tier Mechanical Divine Kingdom civilization and is connected to the Federal Education System.
It will automatically help you select the Class B building most suitable for your current development.
You just need to choose from them.
There is no need to blindly pursue high or low value; what suits your own Divine Kingdom is the most important.
Trust in science and technology.”
Yang Fan was not a child of a major Family, and his experience was still shallow.
Luo Chengfeng truly worried that he would solely judge the full value of the buildings based on the height of Faith Points, wasting this Opportunity in vain.
“Understood, thank you Grandpa.” Yang Fan nodded seriously.
“You... sigh, forget it, we’ll talk when we get back.” Luo Chengfeng stopped talking midway.

chapters.title: Chapter 68: Penglai Island
paragraphs: After finishing the explanations, Yang Fan and Luo Bing followed Yang Wanli to the school basement.
Silver-white square storage boxes filled the entire basement, and right facing the door was a light blue glass.
Yang Wanli walked up to the glass and placed his right hand on it.
“Identity recognition successful, the cabin door is about to open.” The prompt sound of the Intelligent Life came from all around.
“Little fellows, you may go in.” Yang Wanli said.
Yang Fan only felt a pushing force appear behind him, instantly sending him and Luo Bing into the warehouse.
The interior of the warehouse was a vast expanse of white, with countless cards floating overhead like stars.
Unlike Yang Fan, Luo Bing was already used to this scene and directly said aloud: “Request to select a building.”
“Identity verification successful, Authority B, querying Divine Kingdom Awakening records, querying past performance, starting to retrieve data...”
“Retrieval successful.”
“Recommended buildings are as follows:

Ice Immortal Palace, B-Rank building, worth 800 Divinity Points, increases the Cultivation speed of ice-type Spiritual Root believers by 60%, reduces Spiritual Qi consumption by 30%, calms the mind and concentrates...
Frigid Medicine Garden, B-Rank building, worth 100 Divinity Points, can greatly increase the growth rate of ice-type Spirit Plants...
nine profound ice tower, B-Rank defensive building, worth 30 Divinity Points...
A light screen appeared directly in front of Luo Bing, with cards carrying buildings arranged at the end of the text.
“I choose the Ice Immortal Palace.” Luo Bing did not hesitate.
The card fell into her hands and was instantly stored into her Divine Kingdom.
After finishing her selection, Luo Bing did not leave directly, but instead turned her head to stare closely at Yang Fan.
Being stared at by the other party, Yang Fan said somewhat nervously: “Sister Bing, congratulations.”
“Welcome to Class 1, please guide me well in the future.” Leaving these words behind, Luo Bing turned around and left directly.
Looking at the other party’s back, Yang Fan couldn’t help but shiver; he always felt that the other party’s words implied something, and her tone even carried a trace of anger.
Yang Fan shook his head, cast aside distracting thoughts, and began to follow suit.
“Request to select a building.”
“Identity verification successful, Authority B...”
“Recommended buildings as follows:
immortal nurturing tower, B-Rank building, worth 900 Divinity Points.

The tower has one hundred thousand seats, which can slowly improve the Cultivation Aptitude of believers, increase Cultivation speed by 70%, increase the success rate of Realm Breakthrough by 30%, reduce the Heart Demon breeding rate by 20%...
Blood Sacrifice Heavenly Pool, B-Rank building, worth 400 Divinity Points.
Throwing in the Physical Body of living beings can greatly improve the believers’ Physical Body body-refining Aptitude...
Heaven-Grade Weapon Pavilion, B-Rank building, containing a large mineral vein, worth 200 Divinity Points.
Can automatically forge various weapons, with the highest Rank being C-Rank.
Looking at the dazzling array of B-Rank buildings, Yang Fan couldn’t help but swallow his saliva.
As expected of the school’s Intelligent Life, everything recommended was what he wanted.
Why can he only choose one?
Yang Fan wanted them all!
Just at this moment, that light screen changed and updated with another selection once again.
“Penglai Island, Wonder. Value:??? Function:???”
“A Wonder! This is!” Yang Fan’s eyes revealed shock.
Right now, a Wonder, Spirit Peach Mountain, was placed inside Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom.
Although he didn’t know what Rank of building a Wonder was, the value of Spirit Peach Mountain was the highest among assets within Alien Divine Kingdoms.
Yang Fan furrowed his brows tightly: “Why would a Wonder appear? Could it be that the Intelligent Life considers its value to also belong to a B-Rank building? But why are they all question marks?”
What exact effects Penglai Island had were not specified, which made Yang Fan truly conflicted.
Pursuing the lowest risk, he should naturally choose the immortal nurturing tower, which could greatly improve believers’ Aptitude.
This was the building Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom lacked the most at present.
But had he taken few risks during this period of time?
Since this item appeared in the selection box, it proved that this Penglai Island was likewise suitable for his own Divine Kingdom.
The timid are starved to death, while the bold are stuffed to death.
Yang Fan hesitated no longer and chose “Penglai Island”.
Inside the teaching building, Yang Wanli was holding documents and standing quietly behind Hong Bing.
The warehouse image was being projected on the wall, and Yang Fan’s facial expression changes were clearly visible.

“Principal, isn’t this against the rules? Even among Wonder-class buildings, Penglai Island is a scarce item, and its value is at least 5000 Divinity Points. To give it to a student!” Yang Wanli’s expression showed a trace of heartache.

“Penglai Island has the effect of hiding Divine Kingdom coordinates. This kid has gained too much in this exam, and without much background, he might not necessarily be able to keep this wealth.” Hong Bing looked at Yang Fan in the image with great interest.
“With the Federal Government laws around, as long as he hasn’t graduated, no one dares to harbor any ideas.” Yang Wanli retorted.
“The Human Race wouldn’t dare, but what about the aliens?”
“What does the Principal mean?”

“Rather than worrying about scarcity, worry about inequality. This kid has offended so many people. If anyone among them harbors malicious intentions and finds a way to obtain Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom coordinates before leaking them to the aliens...”
“Impossible, this is the crime of betraying the race, and once discovered, it will implicate the entire Family.” Yang Wanli was greatly shocked, his eyes full of disbelief.
There were naturally borers within the Human Race, and illegal robberies of others’ Divine Kingdom assets were repeatedly banned.
But if it involved aliens, once the incident broke out, it would definitely alarm the Federal Government law enforcement team.
By then, not only himself, but even his Family would be implicated.

“I have spent three thousand years on The Frontline, what kind of things haven’t I seen? There are quite a few such scums in the Human Race.” Hong Bing let out a cold snort, a flash of coldness passing through the depths of his eyes.

“I am very optimistic about this kid, so Penglai Island can be treated as the school’s investment in him. It happens to match the Spirit Peach Mountain he obtained. I hope this child can become a High-tier God in the future and protect our Human Race.”
Hearing this, Yang Wanli couldn’t help asking: “Since the Principal is optimistic about this person, why still pull so much hatred for him?”
Flogging Yang Fan in front of the entire school, Yang Wanli initially thought that his Principal also looked down upon Yang Fan’s handling style.
How did he end up being optimistic about him instead?
“How can young people do without pressure?” Hong Bing’s majestic face actually revealed a trace of a bad smile at this moment.
“Principal, oh Principal, stop using that military set of methods to Cultivate these high school students; our work pressure is already huge!” Yang Wanli inwardly ranted crazily.
Returning to Yangcheng Villa, as soon as he stepped through the door, Yang Fan saw Luo Rou’s pale face that revealed worry.
“Husband, what did you do?”
“What’s wrong?” Yang Fan furrowed his brows slightly.

“I just received many messages, some from your classmates, and some from demigod or even god elders of my Luo Family. They are all asking whether you have any intention to trade the buildings harvested this time.” Luo Rou explained.
Suddenly receiving so many messages, among which there were even powerhouse gods, Luo Rou panicked on the spot, not daring to reply to any messages until this moment.
“Just pretend you didn’t see them.” Yang Fan replied.
Now, no matter what, he had the Luo Family backing him up, and with the Federal Government laws present, he didn’t think those gods would be shameless enough to directly make a move against him.
As for whether to trade, he still had to figure out what exact effects these buildings and Wonders had before making a decision.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan immediately went upstairs and locked the room door, not allowing anyone to disturb him.

chapters.title: Chapter 69: Thank You for My God's Grace
paragraphs: “Grade B building Monkey Wine Spring, worth 2 billion Faith Points (no purchase permission).”
“Depositing spirit fruits can produce Monkey Wine.”

“This wine is mild in nature and contains pure spiritual power. Consuming it can refine the Physical Body, eliminate Impurities, and slightly improve Cultivation Aptitude; at the same time, it can greatly enhance Comprehension Ability in a short period, making it easier for the consumer to comprehend Cultivation Techniques and break through Bottlenecks.”
“With sufficient spirit fruits, the Divine Kingdom can produce 100 bottles of Monkey Wine every thirty years.”
“Monkey Wine: Selling price 1 million Faith Points. (Can be purchased in the Divine Shop).”
“Grade B Spirit Plant Pan Tao Tree, worth 1 billion Faith Points (no purchase permission).”
“It blossoms in three thousand years, bears fruit in three thousand years, and matures in three thousand years.”
“A single mature Pan Tao can extend life by a thousand years.”
“A single Pan Tao is worth 100 million Faith Points (no permission to purchase).”
“Special building Enlightenment Stone (no permission to view specific information).”
“Wonder: Spirit Peach Mountain (no permission to view specific information).”
“Wonder: Penglai Island (no permission to view specific information).”
Looking at the feedback from the Intelligent Life, Yang Fan was instantly stunned.
Given his current situation, he actually had no way to view the specific information.
As a Divine Being, it was understandable that he didn’t have purchase permissions for Grade B buildings, but he should at least be able to see the details of these buildings!
This meant he didn’t even have the qualification to learn knowledge!
“What is going on? These things are placed right here in my Divine Kingdom, could it be that you expect me to figure them out on my own?” Yang Fan muttered complainingly.
“Beep beep beep.”
“With a Tier 3 God acting as a guarantor, Federal citizen Yang Fan’s identity permissions have been increased, and the above information can now be viewed.” The Intelligent Life sent an urgent voice.
Hearing this, Yang Fan’s expression was equally shocked.
“A Tier 3 God is acting as a guarantor for me? Who is it?” Doubts arose in Yang Fan’s heart.
Unable to figure it out, he simply stopped thinking about it; anyway, it was a good thing for him right now.
“Grade B building Monkey Wine Spring, worth 2 billion Faith Points (available for purchase).”
“Grade B Spirit Plant Pan Tao Tree (available for purchase).”
“Special building Enlightenment Stone: A special building nurtured by heaven and earth, containing the aura of Dao rules, extremely rare.”

“Where it exists, it can form an Enlightenment Domain. The range of the Domain is about a hundred kilometers in radius. Living beings within it have clear thoughts, greatly enhanced Comprehension Ability, and Cultivation efficiency increased by 50%.”
“Being in this Domain for a long time not only helps in comprehending Cultivation Techniques and raising Realms, but also accelerates the mastery and deduction of various skills.”
“Worth 10 billion Faith Points (out of stock in the Divine Shop; if you wish to purchase, you can choose to place a pending order, and the Divine Shop will help match the transaction).”
“Good stuff, no Wonder even the Divine Shop is out of stock.” Yang Fan was overjoyed.
Placing this Enlightenment Stone in a gathering place of believers could not only greatly improve Cultivation efficiency, but also help them comprehend various skills.
If anyone’s Divine Kingdom had this treasure, they would definitely keep it for themselves; how could they possibly sell it?
Yang Fan was clear that these tens of billions of Faith Points were not the value of the Enlightenment Stone itself at all.
Much like the starting bid of an auction house, the actual transaction price should be much higher than this.
Yang Fan suppressed the joy in his heart and continued to search for “Wonder Spirit Peach Mountain”.
“Wonder: Spirit Peach Mountain (out of stock in the Divine Shop, transaction matching probability is extremely low, placing a pending order is not recommended as it wastes time).”
“A top-tier resource-type blessed land formed by the convergence of Spiritual Veins and Immortal Qi, its mountain body nurtures spirituality and can continuously grow various spirit fruits.”

“The Spirit Plants in the mountain are luxuriant, mainly spirit peaches alongside hundreds of other fruits. The spirit fruits produced contain pure Spiritual Qi, and long-term consumption can nourish the physique, stabilize Cultivation, and be widely provided as Cultivation resources.”

“The yield is extremely astonishing, enough to support the daily Cultivation and survival needs of hundreds of millions of living beings, and it is an important Foundation for maintaining the operation of the Divine Kingdom.”

“However, this mountain has extremely high environmental requirements and needs a continuous supply of Immortal Qi for nourishment. Once the Immortal Qi is insufficient, the Spirit Plants will rapidly decline, and their yield and quality will drop drastically.”
“[Evaluation]: Extra-large resource point, possessing long-term strategic supply capability.”
Yang Fan was silent, Yang Fan was shocked, Yang Fan was ecstatic.
He finally understood why that Alien Divine Kingdom had so many spirit fruit supply lines, yet so few guarding Monkey Soldiers.
This was simply because there were too many resources, piled up everywhere throughout the Divine Kingdom, without even sending believers to guard them.

With Spirit Peach Mountain around, that Alien Demigod didn’t care about these spirit fruit resources at all, and piling them up everywhere was just so that their believers could eat whenever they wanted.
Yang Fan took a deep breath, and at this moment he actually felt cold sweat breaking out on his forehead.
After understanding the value of the Wonder, Yang Fan felt that this harvest was too huge; no Wonder those gods would pay attention to him.
“Damn it, why must the exam be conducted through live streaming? Could someone be eyeing me?”
“Aside from the Intelligent Life of the Federal Government, no one else should know the coordinates of my Divine Kingdom. However, would the gods have other ways to locate me?”
“Just how great are the restrictions of the Federal Government’s laws on gods?”
Question after question appeared in Yang Fan’s mind.
The immense joy did not muddle his head; instead, it made him feel danger.

“Forget it, misfortune and fortune depend on each other. Wealth that even gods would be tempted by has been seized by me, how could it be all plain sailing!” Yang Fan thought to himself, and began to study the Wonder Penglai Island obtained from the school warehouse.
“Wonder: Penglai Island (rare Wonder, no transaction records in the Divine Shop for nearly a hundred years)”
“The legendary blessed land of immortals, spontaneously nurtured by the rules of heaven and earth, possesses an independently operating Immortal Dao system.”

“Within the island, Immortal Qi can be endlessly derived, self-generating and self-propagating, endless and unceasing without the need for external supply. It is an extremely rare’self-circulating Cultivation Holy Land’.”

“Anyone residing within it will have their Cultivation speed increased by 200% and Comprehension Ability increased by 100%, making it easier to comprehend Cultivation Techniques and spells; their mind will be clear and lucid, making it difficult for distracting thoughts to invade, which can effectively reduce the probability of Heart Demons breeding.”

“In addition, Penglai Island comes with spatial shielding and rule interference characteristics. The space of the Divine Kingdom where it is located is chaotic and its coordinates are indefinite, which can effectively shield against deductions, greatly reduce the risk of the Divine Kingdom coordinates being exposed, and possess extremely high strategic concealment value.”
“[Evaluation]: Top-tier Cultivation Holy Land, possessing both self-generating Immortal Qi and spatial concealment capabilities, belonging to a strategic core-type Wonder.”
Looking at the introduction of Penglai Island, Yang Fan had the feeling that he might just be a child of Luck.
Whatever he was just worried about, a solution immediately presented itself.

Although Yang Fan was not clear on the specific strength of its ability to interfere with the Divine Kingdom coordinates, since it could be evaluated by the Divine Shop as a strategic core-type Wonder, it was definitely extraordinary.
He was currently just a Divine Being; even if he was targeted by a god, the other party couldn’t possibly be too strong.
Yang Fan guessed that as long as he didn’t actively expose his coordinates, low-tier gods would most likely not be able to find his Divine Kingdom.
Besides this, Penglai Island could also produce Immortal Qi; wasn’t this complementing Spirit Peach Mountain perfectly?
Perfect!
Choosing Penglai Island could not be more correct!
After understanding everything, Yang Fan’s mind stirred, and his Divine Sense instantly descended upon the Divine Kingdom.
The next moment, heaven and earth shook!
The previously still spacious land of the Divine Kingdom seemed to be reshaped by an invisible giant hand.
The Void Realm split open, and an immortal island slowly descended.
Seas of clouds surged, and rosy rays of light shone brilliantly.
The entire island was wreathed in immortal mist, and without even touching the ground, it had already formed its own Realm.
“Penglai Island, form!”
Immortal Qi surged endlessly from its core, spreading in all directions like a tide.
In a split second, the aura of life throughout the entire Divine Kingdom soared abruptly!
The air became incomparably heavy.
Immediately following this, Spiritual Veins surged on Penglai Island, and a towering mountain rose abruptly from the ground.
The mountain body was crystal clear, with spiritual light flowing over it.
The vegetation in the mountain grew wildly, laden with spirit peaches, and all kinds of fruits grew together.
The dense Spiritual Qi turned into mist, flowing endlessly among the mountains.
“Spirit Peach Mountain, form!”
Another moment later, two wine springs emerged from the fissures at the foot of Peach Mountain.
The spring water was golden like amber, filled with fragrance and brimming with spirituality.
Merely the diffusion of its aura caused the Bloodlines of surrounding living beings to churn and their Divine Senses to become clear.
“Monkey Wine Spring, appear!”
At the same time, heaven and earth trembled, and a primitive, unadorned huge boulder slowly fell into Penglai Island.
The moment it landed, a circle of invisible ripples swept outward, covering a radius of a hundred miles.
“Enlightenment Stone, suppress!”
All living beings within the Divine Kingdom subconsciously looked up at the huge island in the sky at this moment, kneeling on the ground.
“Thank you for the grace of my god.” All believers shouted together.

Merely with the appearance of Penglai Island, all animals and plants within the Divine Kingdom felt an inexplicable comfort, their bodies incomparably cozy, as if they were immersed in a spiritual spring every moment.
In the Real World, Yang Fan similarly felt a tingling sensation coming from his body; this was the feedback brought about by the leap in the Divine Kingdom’s environment.

sentences.text: “Grade B building Monkey Wine Spring, worth 2 billion Faith Points (no purchase permission).”
“Depositing spirit fruits can produce Monkey Wine.”
“This wine is mild in nature and contains pure spiritual power.

Consuming it can refine the Physical Body, eliminate Impurities, and slightly improve Cultivation Aptitude; at the same time, it can greatly enhance Comprehension Ability in a short period, making it easier for the consumer to comprehend Cultivation Techniques and break through Bottlenecks.”
“With sufficient spirit fruits, the Divine Kingdom can produce 100 bottles of Monkey Wine every thirty years.”
“Monkey Wine: Selling price 1 million Faith Points. (Can be purchased in the Divine Shop).”
“Grade B Spirit Plant Pan Tao Tree, worth 1 billion Faith Points (no purchase permission).”
“It blossoms in three thousand years, bears fruit in three thousand years, and matures in three thousand years.”
“A single mature Pan Tao can extend life by a thousand years.”
“A single Pan Tao is worth 100 million Faith Points (no permission to purchase).”
“Special building Enlightenment Stone (no permission to view specific information).”
“Wonder: Spirit Peach Mountain (no permission to view specific information).”
“Wonder: Penglai Island (no permission to view specific information).”
Looking at the feedback from the Intelligent Life, Yang Fan was instantly stunned.
Given his current situation, he actually had no way to view the specific information.
As a Divine Being, it was understandable that he didn’t have purchase permissions for Grade B buildings, but he should at least be able to see the details of these buildings!
This meant he didn’t even have the qualification to learn knowledge!
“What is going on?
These things are placed right here in my Divine Kingdom, could it be that you expect me to figure them out on my own?” Yang Fan muttered complainingly.
“Beep beep beep.”
“With a Tier 3 God acting as a guarantor, Federal citizen Yang Fan’s identity permissions have been increased, and the above information can now be viewed.” The Intelligent Life sent an urgent voice.
Hearing this, Yang Fan’s expression was equally shocked.
“A Tier 3 God is acting as a guarantor for me?
Who is it?” Doubts arose in Yang Fan’s heart.
Unable to figure it out, he simply stopped thinking about it; anyway, it was a good thing for him right now.
“Grade B building Monkey Wine Spring, worth 2 billion Faith Points (available for purchase).”
“Grade B Spirit Plant Pan Tao Tree (available for purchase).”
“Special building Enlightenment Stone: A special building nurtured by heaven and earth, containing the aura of Dao rules, extremely rare.”
“Where it exists, it can form an Enlightenment Domain.
The range of the Domain is about a hundred kilometers in radius.
Living beings within it have clear thoughts, greatly enhanced Comprehension Ability, and Cultivation efficiency increased by 50%.”
“Being in this Domain for a long time not only helps in comprehending Cultivation Techniques and raising Realms, but also accelerates the mastery and deduction of various skills.”
“Worth 10 billion Faith Points (out of stock in the Divine Shop; if you wish to purchase, you can choose to place a pending order, and the Divine Shop will help match the transaction).”
“Good stuff, no Wonder even the Divine Shop is out of stock.” Yang Fan was overjoyed.
Placing this Enlightenment Stone in a gathering place of believers could not only greatly improve Cultivation efficiency, but also help them comprehend various skills.
If anyone’s Divine Kingdom had this treasure, they would definitely keep it for themselves; how could they possibly sell it?
Yang Fan was clear that these tens of billions of Faith Points were not the value of the Enlightenment Stone itself at all.
Much like the starting bid of an auction house, the actual transaction price should be much higher than this.
Yang Fan suppressed the joy in his heart and continued to search for “Wonder Spirit Peach Mountain”.
“Wonder: Spirit Peach Mountain (out of stock in the Divine Shop, transaction matching probability is extremely low, placing a pending order is not recommended as it wastes time).”
“A top-tier resource-type blessed land formed by the convergence of Spiritual Veins and Immortal Qi, its mountain body nurtures spirituality and can continuously grow various spirit fruits.”
“The Spirit Plants in the mountain are luxuriant, mainly spirit peaches alongside hundreds of other fruits.
The spirit fruits produced contain pure Spiritual Qi, and long-term consumption can nourish the physique, stabilize Cultivation, and be widely provided as Cultivation resources.”

“The yield is extremely astonishing, enough to support the daily Cultivation and survival needs of hundreds of millions of living beings, and it is an important Foundation for maintaining the operation of the Divine Kingdom.”
“However, this mountain has extremely high environmental requirements and needs a continuous supply of Immortal Qi for nourishment.
Once the Immortal Qi is insufficient, the Spirit Plants will rapidly decline, and their yield and quality will drop drastically.”
“[Evaluation]: Extra-large resource point, possessing long-term strategic supply capability.”
Yang Fan was silent, Yang Fan was shocked, Yang Fan was ecstatic.
He finally understood why that Alien Divine Kingdom had so many spirit fruit supply lines, yet so few guarding Monkey Soldiers.
This was simply because there were too many resources, piled up everywhere throughout the Divine Kingdom, without even sending believers to guard them.

With Spirit Peach Mountain around, that Alien Demigod didn’t care about these spirit fruit resources at all, and piling them up everywhere was just so that their believers could eat whenever they wanted.
Yang Fan took a deep breath, and at this moment he actually felt cold sweat breaking out on his forehead.
After understanding the value of the Wonder, Yang Fan felt that this harvest was too huge; no Wonder those gods would pay attention to him.
“Damn it, why must the exam be conducted through live streaming?
Could someone be eyeing me?”
“Aside from the Intelligent Life of the Federal Government, no one else should know the coordinates of my Divine Kingdom.
However, would the gods have other ways to locate me?”
“Just how great are the restrictions of the Federal Government’s laws on gods?”
Question after question appeared in Yang Fan’s mind.
The immense joy did not muddle his head; instead, it made him feel danger.
“Forget it, misfortune and fortune depend on each other.

Wealth that even gods would be tempted by has been seized by me, how could it be all plain sailing!” Yang Fan thought to himself, and began to study the Wonder Penglai Island obtained from the school warehouse.
“Wonder: Penglai Island (rare Wonder, no transaction records in the Divine Shop for nearly a hundred years)”
“The legendary blessed land of immortals, spontaneously nurtured by the rules of heaven and earth, possesses an independently operating Immortal Dao system.”
“Within the island, Immortal Qi can be endlessly derived, self-generating and self-propagating, endless and unceasing without the need for external supply.
It is an extremely rare’self-circulating Cultivation Holy Land’.”

“Anyone residing within it will have their Cultivation speed increased by 200% and Comprehension Ability increased by 100%, making it easier to comprehend Cultivation Techniques and spells; their mind will be clear and lucid, making it difficult for distracting thoughts to invade, which can effectively reduce the probability of Heart Demons breeding.”
“In addition, Penglai Island comes with spatial shielding and rule interference characteristics.

The space of the Divine Kingdom where it is located is chaotic and its coordinates are indefinite, which can effectively shield against deductions, greatly reduce the risk of the Divine Kingdom coordinates being exposed, and possess extremely high strategic concealment value.”
“[Evaluation]: Top-tier Cultivation Holy Land, possessing both self-generating Immortal Qi and spatial concealment capabilities, belonging to a strategic core-type Wonder.”
Looking at the introduction of Penglai Island, Yang Fan had the feeling that he might just be a child of Luck.
Whatever he was just worried about, a solution immediately presented itself.

Although Yang Fan was not clear on the specific strength of its ability to interfere with the Divine Kingdom coordinates, since it could be evaluated by the Divine Shop as a strategic core-type Wonder, it was definitely extraordinary.
He was currently just a Divine Being; even if he was targeted by a god, the other party couldn’t possibly be too strong.
Yang Fan guessed that as long as he didn’t actively expose his coordinates, low-tier gods would most likely not be able to find his Divine Kingdom.
Besides this, Penglai Island could also produce Immortal Qi; wasn’t this complementing Spirit Peach Mountain perfectly?
Perfect!
Choosing Penglai Island could not be more correct!
After understanding everything, Yang Fan’s mind stirred, and his Divine Sense instantly descended upon the Divine Kingdom.
The next moment, heaven and earth shook!
The previously still spacious land of the Divine Kingdom seemed to be reshaped by an invisible giant hand.
The Void Realm split open, and an immortal island slowly descended.
Seas of clouds surged, and rosy rays of light shone brilliantly.
The entire island was wreathed in immortal mist, and without even touching the ground, it had already formed its own Realm.
“Penglai Island, form!”
Immortal Qi surged endlessly from its core, spreading in all directions like a tide.
In a split second, the aura of life throughout the entire Divine Kingdom soared abruptly!
The air became incomparably heavy.
Immediately following this, Spiritual Veins surged on Penglai Island, and a towering mountain rose abruptly from the ground.
The mountain body was crystal clear, with spiritual light flowing over it.
The vegetation in the mountain grew wildly, laden with spirit peaches, and all kinds of fruits grew together.
The dense Spiritual Qi turned into mist, flowing endlessly among the mountains.
“Spirit Peach Mountain, form!”
Another moment later, two wine springs emerged from the fissures at the foot of Peach Mountain.
The spring water was golden like amber, filled with fragrance and brimming with spirituality.
Merely the diffusion of its aura caused the Bloodlines of surrounding living beings to churn and their Divine Senses to become clear.
“Monkey Wine Spring, appear!”

“Thank you for the grace of my god.” All believers shouted together.

chapters.title: Chapter 70: The Strong are Always Lonely
paragraphs: After finishing all this, it was already evening.
Yang Fan was just getting ready to organize the assets in his Divine Kingdom and then make a procurement run to the Divine Shop when he received a message from Luo Chengfeng.
“Little Yang, meet me in the Virtual World.”
Not daring to delay, Yang Fan immediately put on his helmet.
Inside the room, Luo Chengfeng’s expression was somewhat ugly.
“Grandfather,” Yang Fan said.

Looking at Yang Fan, Luo Chengfeng’s expression softened quite a bit: “Before this midterm examination, because you comprehended the Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array at the Great Success stage, I went to see the Family Head. He promised that as long as you could enter the top ten, he would convene an Elder meeting to strive for a First-Class Genius cultivation quota for you.”
“What is the current situation?” Looking at Luo Chengfeng’s expression, Yang Fan guessed that the result was probably not good.
“The Elder meeting just ended, and in the end, this resolution did not pass.” Luo Chengfeng sighed, his expression somewhat unwilling.

According to the final exam results, Yang Fan could be said to have overfulfilled his task, but the methods he used were too opportunistic, and compounded with being somewhat disgraceful, this became a point of attack for quite a few Elders.
Even though the Family Head intended to agree, there were too many opposing Elders, so it had to be dropped.
“It’s fine, as long as Grandfather tried your best.” Yang Fan smiled indifferently.

If it had been before, becoming a First-Class Genius of the Luo Family would definitely have been providing timely help in a snowy day for him, but now it could at most be considered adding flowers to brocade.
The biggest investment for a First-Class Genius was those strategic-level buildings, such as the Ice God Temple in Luo Bing’s Divine Kingdom.
Naturally, he wouldn’t mind having more of such buildings, but right now, Penglai Island, Spirit Peach Mountain, and the Enlightenment Stone in his Divine Kingdom were not bad either.
A person couldn’t take all the benefits for themselves; Yang Fan was already very satisfied with this harvest.
Next, as long as he gave himself time, the Divine Kingdom would usher in rapid development.
Within a year or two, Yang Fan had the confidence to become a demigod.

Luo Chengfeng seemed to have thought of something, spat, and said: “Luo Xuan and Rao Mingming, that couple, are truly annoying. When they humiliated me back then, it was one thing that I didn’t look for trouble with them, but they even dared to trip me up. Truly shameless to the extreme!”
“Who are these two?”

“Luo Mingxuan’s parents, First-Order Gods. Our relationship used to be quite good, but because of their beastly son, some unpleasantness arose. I didn’t expect it to implicate your evaluation this time,” Luo Chengfeng explained.
If these two hadn’t taken the lead to go against him, most of the other Elders should have given him some Face.
Yang Fan suddenly understood in his heart.
Apart from adding a trace of disgust toward that Luo Mingxuan, there wasn’t much emotional fluctuation inside him.
Without Luo Chengfeng, he probably wouldn’t even have had this opportunity.
Having received benefits from others, one naturally had to bear the corresponding Karma.
Thirty years in the east of the river, thirty years in the west of the river; when he graduated from school, he would just find a chance to get back at them then.

Seeing Yang Fan’s calm expression, Luo Chengfeng nodded with satisfaction and continued: “Although I failed to strive for the First-Class Genius cultivation for you, the Family Head has still decided to increase the investment in you: 2 billion Faith Points plus a B-grade building, the Flesh Sea Blood Pool.”
“The Faith Points have been transferred into your Divine Kingdom. This is the building card for the Flesh Sea Blood Pool.” Luo Chengfeng placed the card in Yang Fan’s hand.

Seeing that the other party had once again helped him secure an investment, Yang Fan asked: “Grandfather, the school rewarded me with 10 billion Faith Points. Perhaps we can help Rou’er repair her Divine Kingdom!”
Hearing this, the look Luo Chengfeng directed at Yang Fan gradually softened.

“That was something I used to deceive Rou girl back then, to give her some hope. Perhaps one day when I, as her grandfather, have saved up enough money, her Divine Kingdom will be able to recover as before. If it were truly that simple, I would have long since sold the buildings in my own Divine Kingdom to cure Rou girl.”
“Could there really be no way?” Yang Fan’s expression was ugly.
During this period of time getting along with Luo Rou, he truly acknowledged her, and the two of them now even had a child.
No matter what, Yang Fan did not want to give up.

“It’s not that there’s no way, but rather a lack of personal connections and resources. At the very least, a Fourth-Order or even Fifth-Order God must step in, and they must also excel in healing abilities. The Luo Family is just a small Family in Yang County, making it very hard to come into contact with such powerhouses.” Luo Chengfeng sighed.
Perhaps the Family Head Luo Hai could reach one, but it was impossible to ask the other party for help over a matter like this.

Seeing Yang Fan’s expression full of solemnity, Luo Chengfeng reminded him: “Develop your Divine Kingdom well and get into a good university. If you can take a powerful God as a teacher, there might be a way to solve Rou’er’s problem.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan’s eyes couldn’t help but light up.
“Having this heart is enough. Rou girl wouldn’t want you to put all your energy into this illusory matter either, especially since the two of you still have a child.”
“Yes, Grandfather.”

“Rou girl has already contacted me, saying that quite a few people want to purchase the Wonders Spirit Peach Mountain and the Enlightenment Stone in your Divine Kingdom. Remember, no matter who it is, do not sell them. Once these things are sold, you can never buy them back. You are still a student right now. Under the protection of federal law, even a God wouldn’t dare to make a move against you,” Luo Chengfeng reminded.
“I understand.”
Even if Luo Chengfeng hadn’t mentioned this matter, he wouldn’t have agreed.
Earning Faith Points was originally meant for investing in his Divine Kingdom.
To sell these rare buildings now in exchange for a large amount of Faith Points, and then buy some ordinary resources to invest back into the Divine Kingdom—wasn’t that being sick in the head?

“During this midterm exam, you really angered that girl Luo Bing quite a bit. If the Family Head hadn’t been broad-minded, you’d probably be given small shoes to wear in the future. If there’s an opportunity, remember to ease the relationship.”
“This...” Yang Fan’s expression was somewhat troubled.
Luo Bing was simply an iceberg, and coupled with the fact that he had offended her to death, he really couldn’t think of any way to ease the relationship.
He would thank the heavens if she didn’t come looking for trouble with him.

“Humans are good at wisdom rather than brute force. For our Human Race to stand tall among numerous alien civilizations, what we rely on most is the collective strength of everyone. Your harvest this time was so huge that even Gods turned red with envy, but you lost the hearts of the people. You still have to attend university after the College Entrance Examination. You both hail from Yang County, and you originally were the best candidates to support each other and progress in unity. If you can’t ease the relationship, I’m afraid you’ll be fighting alone once you go out.” Luo Chengfeng let out a long sigh, his tone revealing a hint of helplessness.
As a God, he understood the importance of friends best.
When a Divine Kingdom was attacked by alien races, the Family’s Gods would come to support.
When going out to clear wasteland, no matter how strong your believers were, warfare would still incur massive consumption, and the overall strength of the Divine Kingdom would be slowly weakened.
Having a few friends strike together to share the pressure would greatly reduce the risks of a Divine Kingdom War.
And these allies who could defend together and clear wasteland together relied on more than just interests.
Either they were in the same Family forming an offensive and defensive alliance, or they had known each other since childhood and trusted each other deeply.
After this exam, Yang Fan’s reputation stank completely; who would dare to cooperate with him in the future?
“I’ll try my best!” Yang Fan said awkwardly.
After Luo Chengfeng left, Yang Fan also felt that what he said made sense.
Then he opened the Genius Exchange Group.
“I’m sorry, how about I invite everyone to Tianxiang Renjian to apologize?”
Yang Fan clicked send.
“You have been kicked out of the group chat by Deputy Group Leader Li Tianheng, and you can no longer receive or send messages.”
A red exclamation mark and a System prompt popped up simultaneously.
Yang Fan fell into a brief silence.
“Forget it, the strong are always lonely!” Yang Fan thought to himself, only able to comfort himself this way.
It was just a pity that he had lost another source of information from now on.
