chapters.title: Chapter 71: Advanced Intelligent Life
paragraphs: Luo Family residence, Family Head’s room.
“Father, you actually called an Elder meeting for Yang Fan. Are you crazy?” Luo Bing demanded.
“I am the Luo Family head, so naturally I must provide resources for outstanding descendants.”
“Him? Outstanding? If not for your silly daughter helping out, could he have come out alive?” Luo Bing was furious, completely unable to comprehend her father’s train of thought.
Seeing his daughter talk back for the first time in so many years, Luo Hai couldn’t hold it in for a moment and directly laughed out loud.
“What are you laughing at? Is it that funny?”
“Nothing, just feeling that my daughter is truly quite pissed off. That brat is indeed detestable,” Luo Hai said, holding back his smile.
“That bastard Yang Fan played all of us for fools. It’s one thing that you aren’t helping your daughter vent her anger, but you’re even increasing investments in him. I...”
“Alright, Bing’er, I’ve watched the school’s video. Yang Fan’s actions had no problems,” Luo Hai suddenly said seriously.
“Why?”
“If a person who can’t even afford a meal suddenly sees ten million on the road, do you think they would pick it up or not?”
“It’s fine that he used the rules to steal the core assets of that Alien Demigod, but why did he have to use us afterward?”
“If he had told the truth, how would you all have reacted?” Luo Hai countered.
“This...” Luo Bing fell into silence.
Given the situation back then, most people would probably have made him hand over the assets.

“He simply made the choice most beneficial to himself. Putting myself in his shoes, I would have done the same. Therefore, I say he is not wrong; the ones truly in the wrong are yourselves. The greatest taboo in Divine Kingdom pioneering is entirely entrusting your trust to others. This exam he only utilized you all; in a real Divine Kingdom War, those so-called companions might not hesitate to stab you in the back and plunder your Divine Kingdom Foundation. For you, this can also be considered a lesson, which might not necessarily be a bad thing,” Luo Hai patiently explained.

Luo Bing took a deep breath and slowly said, “Father, you’ve also misjudged the person. If I were to make friends with someone like this, when encountering danger in the future, he would definitely be the first to run away.”

“That’s true as well. When this brat lies, he doesn’t blush or skip a beat. You should stay away from him in the future, but don’t deliberately target him either. After all, regardless of what’s said, he is still a member of my Luo Family,” Luo Hai thought for a moment and said.
“Hmph, classes are being divided soon, targeting him won’t be my turn anyway,” Luo Bing huffed and turned to leave.
At this time, the 2026 Genius Exchange Group was also in an uproar.
Even Li Tianheng, who rarely spoke, began discussing with the crowd.
“The day after tomorrow, this Yang Fan will be coming to Class 1. Old Cao should be opening a Divine Kingdom Battlefield, which of us will take him down first?”
“I’ll go.”
“Of course it’s me. I was screwed over so miserably by him, I’ll definitely slaughter all the believers he sends out.”
“Big Mouth Li, don’t steal the kill. With such a great opportunity, why not let little ol’ me show off?”
The group chat was extremely lively, basically revolving around how to deal with Yang Fan.
Looking at these messages, Li Shuhao’s legs were trembling a bit.

“Brother Yang, you’ve really poked a hornet’s nest this time. Previously it was just Luo Mingxuan, now geniuses from the entire senior grade have been offended by you. Don’t let innocent bystanders get caught in the crossfire!” Li Shuhao didn’t dare to speak at all, fearing someone might mention that he had once spoken up for Yang Fan.

“Shut up! The first time is mine. I have no other requests; from now on, as long as teachers open the Divine Kingdom Battlefield, not a single one of Yang Fan’s believers can stay alive. Whoever fails, I will challenge them in the next match! If we go to extracurricular activities, whoever dares to help Yang Fan, I will challenge them in the future too. From now on, Yang Fan is the number one person on the Must-Kill List of Yang County No. 1 Middle School, understand?” Li Tianheng sent out the message.
Yang Fan didn’t know that not only had he been kicked out of the group chat, but everyone in Class 1 was also plotting how to deal with him.
At this moment, he was researching the Flesh Sea Blood Pool given to him by Luo Hai.

“Grade B Building: Flesh Sea Blood Pool, value 5.0 billion Faith Points. Injecting flesh and blood essence can produce bloody water; believers soaking in it can significantly enhance physical strength. Evaluation: Very suitable for a Divine Kingdom on the Martial Route, but this building requires a massive amount of flesh and blood, and long-term use will consume heavy resources.”
Looking at the description, the corners of Yang Fan’s mouth involuntarily curled into a smile.

He had originally prepared to take the Fusion route of Cultivation and Martial Arts, and this building rewarded by Luo Hai was extremely practical, capable of substantially boosting believers’ combat power in the short term.
Yang Fan chose to load this Flesh Sea Blood Pool next to the Hundred Spirits Blood Pool.
Ever since loading Wonders like Penglai Island and Spirit Peach Mountain, Yang Fan, as a deity, could clearly sense that two completely different auras had now appeared within his Divine Kingdom.
The Immortal Qi evolved on Penglai Island was full of vitality, upright and peaceful, resembling a fairyland on earth.
Yet buildings like the Hundred Spirits Blood Pool and Flesh Sea Blood Pool exuded a pure aura of bloodshed.
Yang Fan could sense that Penglai Island somewhat repelled such buildings; forcing them together would likely cause the powers generated by the buildings to counteract each other.
Regarding the future development of the Divine Kingdom, Yang Fan already had a rough route in mind.
Those with Cultivation talent could go to live on Penglai Island, while believers who chose Martial Arts would remain on the ground.
Having won first place in the mid-term exam, apart from the Wonder reward of Penglai Island, the reward of 10.0 billion Faith Points had also arrived in his account.
Coupled with another 2.0 billion sent by the Luo Family, his liquidity had reached an unprecedented height.
“Faith Points: 12.4 billion.”
Besides this, there was still a massive amount of resources in Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom that needed to be handled.

In this Alien Divine Kingdom, he had captured nearly a hundred Grade C granaries, countless various spirit fruits, ten thousand fire spirit peach trees, a large number of low-level Spirit Plants, and all sorts of messy defensive buildings.
All these items were currently piled up by Yang Fan on the southwest side of the Divine Kingdom.
Various items were mixed together, and some Spirit Plants had already sustained damage.
These things weren’t high in value, but the quantity was huge.
Selling them all might still yield an income of 1.0 billion Faith Points.
Yang Fan’s Divine Sense felt those messy buildings and Spirit Plants, and a sudden headache gripped his heart.
Categorizing all these items was a massive engineering project; even though he was the deity of this place, he felt mentally exhausted.
Returning to reality, Yang Fan thought of how he had been kicked out of the group chat, and could only send a message to Luo Chengfeng to see if the other party had a solution.
The loot captured this time was too much and too messy.
If he relied on himself to categorize and list them online for sale, it might take a month or two to finish, and Yang Fan definitely didn’t want to waste his time on this.

“Advanced Intelligent Life. With your current net worth, you can afford it. You little rascal, many demigods are reluctant to spend on this thing, you really struck it rich all at once,” Luo Chengfeng sent a message, accompanied by a crying-laughing expression.
Yang Fan immediately began searching in the Divine Shop.
“Advanced Intelligent Life: Value 2.0 billion Faith Points.
Produced from a Tier-6 Mechanical Divine Kingdom, it is a special existence nurtured jointly by the deity’s will and the power of rules.
Possessing a high degree of logical capability and independent thinking ability, it serves exclusively for the operation and development of the Divine Kingdom.

Its core characteristic is absolute loyalty; its thought System is bound to the deity’s Origin, immune to external influence and erosion, capable of unconditionally executing the deity’s will and making optimal judgments for the overall interests of the Divine Kingdom.

This lifeform can perceive the internal structure and operating status of the Divine Kingdom in real-time, conduct overall analysis and planning for resource flow, believer development, and civilization processes, assist the deity in formulating development paths, and enhance overall efficiency.
At the same time, its authority covers most basic functions of the Divine Kingdom, and secondary control can be granted.

Within the authorized scope, it can allocate resources, adjust structures, and execute construction and management instructions, making it the core auxiliary hub for the operation of the Divine Kingdom.

In addition, this lifeform can interface with external Systems (such as Divine Shop transactions, stock trading, etc.) to conduct information organization, value assessment, and trading decisions, assisting the deity in achieving the maximization of resource utilization.”

chapters.title: Chapter 72: Self-Awareness Completely Letting Go
paragraphs: Looking at the introduction of the Advanced Intelligent Life, Yang Fan couldn’t help but exclaim it was awesome.
Isn’t this just a super computer with independent consciousness?
With this thing around, he could just ask it directly whenever he had any questions; why would he need to browse the chat groups and the God Forum every day?
How could human sources of information compare to the computer itself?
Yang Fan opened the chat box with Luo Chengfeng and continued to ask: “Grandpa, such a good thing only costs two billion? Isn’t it too cheap?”

“The market is all about supply and demand. With the successful research and development of high-order Intelligent Life, the Mechanical Divine Kingdom started mass production, and the price naturally dropped. Basically, all gods own their own high-order Intelligent Life. Besides, you call it cheap? Two billion is still cheap? Many demigods don’t even have this gadget. An investment of two billion Faith Points could completely turn a Divine Being’s divine kingdom upside down; who would use it to buy such an intelligent creature? Do you think everyone is born with a golden spoon in their mouth, or did they have dogshit luck like you, picking up a lottery ticket the moment they stepped outside?”
Luo Chengfeng sent a voice message, his tone rattling off like a machine gun, making Yang Fan a bit awkward.
“Why do I feel like Grandpa is a bit envious and jealous of me!” Yang Fan muttered.
Yang Fan let out a gentle sigh of relief and directly clicked to purchase.
As the high-order Intelligent Life loaded, he could feel a new consciousness appearing in his divine kingdom.
Unlike believers, the other party had no Physical Body, but was an awareness entity similar to a Soul.
“Master, please choose the external appearance, personality, and name.” A milky-white ball of light floated in front of Yang Fan.
“Random young female, capable personality, named Yang Yi.” Yang Fan said.
“Generating appearance.”
In the span of a breath, the milky-white ball of light slowly transformed into a twenty-year-old young woman wearing a business suit.
“Please grant me secondary permissions, and Yang Yi will help the master plan the overall development of the divine kingdom.” Yang Yi gave a bow and said.
“Very well.”
Yang Fan snapped his fingers and gave the permissions to the other party.
At the moment Yang Yi was born, Yang Fan understood that the other party had already bound with his own deity Origin.
She was simply another life form of believer within the divine kingdom and was completely trustworthy.
Upon receiving the permissions, Yang Yi’s body stood straight, and her eyes flashed with various data rapidly like a computer screen.
“Divine kingdom inspection complete, all information has been received.”
“First help me organize that pile of messy stuff and put them all online for sale,” Yang Fan instructed.
“Sell at market price?”
“Yes.”

“Completed. Total revenue is 1.127 billion; after deducting personal income tax and transaction tax, the net revenue is 992 million. Based on historical data, there is a 90% probability that all transactions can be completed in 1 hour and 24 minutes.” Yang Yi replied almost simultaneously.
“What?” Yang Fan was stunned.
He discovered that that pile of miscellaneous items had actually been instantly organized and directly connected to the Divine Shop to start selling.
“This... why is it so fast?” Yang Fan asked in shock.

“Judging from the master’s reaction just now, my computing power is approximately 12.42 million times yours. Even if the assets just now were 1000 times more, I could process them instantly!” Yang Yi replied calmly, without any sense of showing off, but rather as if stating a fact.
Yang Fan swallowed hard and asked: “What level of Intelligent Life do you belong to?”

“Fourth-tier Intelligent Life. According to the master’s understanding, it is equivalent to the Nascent Soul of the Cultivation Route, or the Martial Emperor of the Martial Route. However, this Intelligent Life belongs to the service type and lacks any attack and defense methods, so its value is not high.” Yang Yi responded.
“Impressive. Using you to do this kind of thing is a bit overqualified.” Yang Fan couldn’t help but sigh.
At this moment, Yang Fan once again felt the power of the Mechanical Divine Kingdom.
It was hard to imagine what those high-order Mechanical Divine Kingdoms had developed into.
“Master, please give me more resource allocation permissions. There are many problems in the divine kingdom that need to be resolved right now.”
“What problems?”

“Too many Blood Clotting Flowers are planted. According to the current market price, the annualized return rate is 363%. Although the profit is high, the divine kingdom’s area is limited and cannot accommodate massive investment. Currently, this crop occupies too much area, seriously affecting the population development of believers. It is recommended to sell them all.”

“Based on the current assets of the divine kingdom, it is recommended to mainly invest in the Monkey Wine Spring. Its annualized return rate is 60%, and because there is the Wonder Spirit Peach Mountain, it is zero cost in the long run.”

“Since the divine kingdom possesses the Wonder Penglai Island and the divine kingdom’s ecology is extremely stable, low-grade assets such as the Bodhi Precious Snake, Dark Night Vulture, Spirit Fish Baby, and water lotus are recommended to be bundled and sold.”

“Spirit Peach Mountain requires a large number of believers to carry out harvesting work. It is recommended to immediately purchase C-rank Breeding Cards. The current population capacity limit of the divine kingdom is about 40 million, and it is strongly recommended to max out the population.”

“Considering the subsequent population explosion and the meat demand of believers on the Martial Route, it is also necessary to purchase four Fully Automatic Concentrators and a large amount of Tai Sui meat.”
Yang Yi was like a precise machine, quickly stating hundreds of large and small suggestions.
“Stop. From now on, the development of the divine kingdom is entirely up to you. Exactly how much resource mobilization do you need?”

“Detecting that the master’s current identity is a high school student, the probability of the divine kingdom being invaded is extremely low. Currently, investment and cultivation of believers are the main focus. It is recommended that the master give me 90% resource mobilization authority, as well as the disposal rights for assets below B-rank, and I will make the optimal choice.”
“Very well.” Yang Fan directly gave the permissions to the other party.
If Yang Yi was at the level of a university doctor, then Yang Fan was most likely at the intelligence level of a paramecium.
The most valuable trait in a person is self-awareness.
Since he had Advanced Intelligent Life assisting him, he could completely let go.
The employee was absolutely loyal to him, and on top of that, capable.
If he, as the boss, still didn’t delegate power, wouldn’t he be a fool?
Consciousness returned to reality.
At this moment, Yang Fan could still feel the changes within his divine kingdom.
A large amount of Faith Points were being traded and circulated between the divine kingdom and the Divine Shop.
Yang Yi’s move was also ruthless; she directly spent 6 billion to buy three more Monkey Wine Springs.
The low-grade Yao Beasts such as the Bodhi Precious Snake initially purchased by Yang Fan had all been bundled and sold by her.
In just the span of a few breaths, the entire divine kingdom had undergone a drastic transformation.
“God Lord: Yang Fan
Divine Kingdom Area: One million square kilometers
Talent: F-rank Resource Talent (All resources in the divine kingdom accelerate growth by 10%)
SSS-Rank Talent: Evolution (Unique talent, can accelerate the Evolution of the divine kingdom, hidden.)
Believers: Tier 2 Beings (52), Tier 1 Beings (1,844), Mortals (1.02 million)
Dependents: little spirits (122)

Techniques: Five Elements Cultivation Technique, Vajra Indestructible Technique, Federal Body Refinement Technique, Muscle and Tendon Strengthening and Marrow Cleansing Technique, Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array (Major Achievement)...
Faith Points: 4.2 billion (providing 40.2 Faith Points daily)

Buildings: Moon Well X1000, Sun Spring X1000, Special Life Building Ancient Spirit Tree (Millennium, nurturing little spirits), Special Building Enlightenment Stone, B-rank Building Monkey Wine Spring X5, B-rank Building Flesh Sea Blood Pool X1, B-rank Building Hundred Spirits Blood Pool X1 (soaked with 10 Tai Sui, load rate 100%), Special Building Fully Automatic Concentrator X1 (cutting plant loaded with 100 Tai Sui, load rate 100%), C-rank transmission tower X5, F-rank City of Steel X5
Wonders: Penglai Island (deployed), Spirit Peach Mountain (deployed)
Assets: Pan Tao Tree (X2, B-rank Spirit Plant), Tai Sui X110, E-rank Weapons (X0.7 thousand sets), F-rank Weapons (X4 thousand sets)”
This mid-term exam not only caused heavy losses to Tier 2 and Tier 1 believers, but even the number of ordinary Mortals had dropped to 1 million.
However, under the blessing of Breeding Cards and the Evolution Talent, it is believed that the population will recover soon.

However, under the blessing of Breeding Cards and the Evolution Talent, it is believed that the population will recover soon.

chapters.title: Chapter 73: Overflowing with a Technological Vibe
paragraphs: Moreover, the environment inside his Divine Kingdom had undergone earth-shaking changes.
Nourished by the Immortal Qi of Penglai Island, the Aptitude of those believers was slowly improving.
Coupled with the blood pills from the Century Blood Pool, the body-forging methods of the Flesh Sea Blood Pool, and an endless supply of various spirit fruits.
Yang Fan believed that the strength of his believers would usher in a rapid boost.
Given the selling price of Monkey Wine, this Monkey Wine Spring had already become Yang Fan’s main source of income at present.
It only took thirty years in the Divine Kingdom for a Monkey Wine Spring to brew 100 bottles of Monkey Wine, with a total value of 100 million.
In one month in the outside world, a Monkey Wine Spring could bring him an income of 100 million, coupled with his tenfold Evolution Talent, this meant an income of 1 billion.
Five Monkey Wine Springs yielded a monthly output of 5 billion Faith Points.

Yang Yi seemed to understand Yang Fan’s emphasis on the Ancient Spirit Tree, so the Sun Spring and Moon Well were left untouched, which could similarly provide him with a fixed income of 60 million Faith Points every month.
Feeling the changes inside the Divine Kingdom, Yang Fan relaxed entirely.
As expected, the more capital a person had, the more relaxed they became.
This high-tier Intelligent Life was simply the most awesome worker.
After finishing all matters, Yang Fan opened the door and called out to Luo Rou, who was chatting with his mother in the living room.
“Rou’er, the matter has been dealt with,” Yang Fan said softly.
“Mom, I’m going upstairs first,” Luo Rou said politely to Sun Rong.
“Mm, you haven’t seen each other for a month. Don’t mess around, and watch your stomach,” Sun Rong instructed, but her gaze was fixed on Yang Fan upstairs, carrying a trace of warning in her eyes.
Luo Rou’s face flushed red.
“No way, Mom, stop talking nonsense.”
Closing the bedroom door, Luo Rou appeared somewhat constrained at the moment.
“What’s wrong?” Yang Fan asked.

Luo Rou lightly bit her lips and said, “It’s nothing? I just didn’t expect you to be so amazing, the top student of the grade. Even if my Divine Kingdom hadn’t been damaged, I’m afraid I wouldn’t be worthy of you.”

“What nonsense are you talking about? I’ll transfer 100 million Faith Points to you. You don’t need to save during this period. However much Water of Life your Divine Kingdom needs, buy it to your heart’s content.”
“This...”
“Those poisonous mists inside your Divine Kingdom—when we get to university, I will definitely find a way to help you resolve them. Trust me.”
Looking at Yang Fan’s earnest gaze, Luo Rou gently nodded.
In the past when Yang Fan said this, Luo Rou only treated it as him comforting her, but now she didn’t doubt it in the least.
In the future, Yang Fan might really have the ability to save her.
“Husband, it’s not very convenient for me. Why don’t you go to the Virtual World Tianxiang Renjian!” Luo Rou’s voice was like a mosquito’s.
“What are you thinking? Go to sleep quickly.”
Yang Fan picked her up, held her in his arms, and they drifted off to dreamland together.
Early the next morning, Yang Fan’s consciousness plunged into the Divine Kingdom.
Looking at the changes inside the Divine Kingdom, he was completely dumbfounded.
Those four former City of Steel had vanished, replaced by a massive technological metropolis spanning north and south.
The buildings gleamed with a cold luster throughout, their surfaces intertwined with runes and technological patterns, emitting a stable and powerful energy fluctuation.
The ground was no longer dirt and fenced paths; it was entirely paved with asphalt roads.
Straight and wide roads unfolded, running through the entire city like Bloodlines.
Countless light rails intersected on the ground and in mid-air, forming a vast and precise transportation system.
A screeching sound rang out—that turned out to be the nuclear-powered bus Yang Fan had once ridden in Yang County.
High above in the sky, there were even several supersonic aircraft constantly shuttling back and forth between Penglai Island and the ground.
Wonderland and technology had merged in a bizarre yet perfect way at this moment.
Furthermore, the surroundings of Spirit Peach Mountain presented an entirely different scene.
Large numbers of the Human Race gathered here, with towns built around the mountains in an orderly fashion.
Spirit fruits matured in the mountains, and Spiritual Qi permeated the air.
Countless Mortals shuttled back and forth among them, harvesting, transporting, and sorting; everything was operating with high efficiency.
Even some areas had been equipped with automatic pickers, achieving semi-automated harvesting.
Machinery and manual labor operated in coordination, continuously transporting out spirit fruits.
A portion was put into the Monkey Wine Spring, and a larger portion was placed into the warehouse.
The primitive society of the Divine Kingdom was completely gone; now it had turned into large-scale, systematic, and industrialized resource production and human civilization!
Yang Fan stood quietly high in the air, for a moment feeling somewhat unfamiliar with it.
“Is this my Divine Kingdom? What on earth happened overnight? Can someone tell me!” Yang Fan screamed wildly in his heart.
Clearly, he was walking the path of the Fusion of Cultivation and the Martial Route, so why had the technology section suddenly been maxed out now?
“Master, welcome to inspect the work.” Yang Yi’s exquisite face suddenly appeared before Yang Fan.
“This... what is going on?”

“Considering that current funds are sufficient and for long-term development, I directly purchased the City of Technology worth 500 million Faith Points in one go. Its footprint can be automatically adjusted, up to 2 million square kilometers at most. Even if Master breaks through to a deity, it can still be used,” Yang Yi replied.
“Impressive. But don’t you feel that this city doesn’t quite match the primeval forests on both sides?” Yang Fan rubbed his temples.
“This question has no value. The City of Technology possesses a comfortable living environment, efficient modes of transportation, and extremely low logistics and transshipment costs.”
“Moreover, I have shut down a large number of entertainment facilities. In this case, matching it with the Breeding Card can maximize the birth rate of believers.”

“Currently, the believer population in the Divine Kingdom is severely insufficient, which I believe is the primary consideration. The degree of environmental matching has nothing to do with the development of the Divine Kingdom and is meaningless to consider,” Yang Yi said in a calm tone.
“What about this supersonic plane?”

“Using superb negotiation skills, when purchasing the City of Technology, I got the merchant to throw in five supersonic aircraft with built-in controllable nuclear Fusion energy. They can fly uninterrupted for 100 million years 24 hours a day, which is barely enough for personnel movement between the two places for now. Once believers break through to the Qi Refining Realm, these supersonic aircraft can also be discounted and listed in the Divine Shop for sale.”
“Awesome!” Yang Fan gave a thumbs-up.
Although the combination of technology and Cultivation felt a bit weird, Yang Fan had to admit that after Yang Yi’s tossing about, the development of his believers had indeed accelerated a lot.
“Master, I apply to list two Grade B Spirit Plant Pan Tao Trees on the network for sale, and spend 500 million to buy a Grade B fresh-keeping storage warehouse,” Yang Yi continued.
“Reason.”

“The yield rate of the Pan Tao Tree is too low, and currently Master’s believers are too weak, still in the basic breeding stage. There is no need to worry about lifespan issues, so it has no value for continued Cultivation. Placed in the Divine Kingdom, the time cost of capital is too high.”

“The Grade B fresh-keeping storage warehouse follows the Spatial Law, possessing a storage area of 500,000 square kilometers, which can preserve the spirit fruits currently harvested from Spirit Peach Mountain.”
Yang Fan couldn’t help saying, “Can’t we just sell these spirit fruits directly if we can’t finish eating them?”
Spirit Peach Mountain was truly worthy of being a Wonder.
Under the supply of Immortal Qi from Penglai Island, it bore all kinds of spirit fruits every year.
Relying solely on the five Monkey Wine Springs and the believers’ consumption, not even 1% could be used up.

chapters.title: Chapter 74: Class 1 Grade 12 Study Content
paragraphs: Facing this, Yang Fan couldn’t help but marvel at the miraculous nature of these Wonders.
Even if he were to simply sell spiritual fruits, Yang Fan felt that his daily income would not be less than 100 million.
Although the quality of these spiritual fruits was not high, the quantity was simply too massive.

Yang Yi responded, “According to my Divine Kingdom planning, the Monkey Wine Spring will be one of the master’s main sources of income in the future. If we choose to purchase spiritual fruits through the market to brew Monkey Wine, the annualized profit rate will drop to 40%.”

“Based on the current output of Spirit Peach Mountain, another 100 Monkey Wine Springs can be purchased. Moreover, only when the believer population develops to 100 million will it barely reach a balance.”
“Selling these spiritual fruits now and buying them back at a high price in the future is not as good as purchasing a Class B fresh produce warehouse to solve the root problem.”
“Your consideration is very comprehensive, I agree.” Yang Fan nodded.
As expected of an Advanced Intelligent Life, using rational thinking to solve every realistic problem made its efficiency terrifyingly high.
Having witnessed Yang Yi’s ability, Yang Fan decided that he would no longer interfere with the normal development processes of the Divine Kingdom from now on.
With such an all-around believer helping out, why should he worry so much?
Yang Fan put on his helmet and came to the Virtual World to prepare for today’s classes.
Unlike other believers, regardless of whether he was in reality or the Virtual World, Yang Yi could communicate with him.
“Although I have you, I can’t completely lay flat either. Later during class, if there is anything I don’t understand, tell me in my mind.”
“No problem. Managing the development of the Divine Kingdom plus helping you answer questions takes up less than one-millionth of my computing power.”
Yang Yi’s voice came from his mind.
Clearly there was no fluctuation in tone, but Yang Fan always felt as if he had been insulted.
Arriving at the classroom, Zhang Pang did not greet him this time, but instead hid in a corner as if he had seen a ghost.
Yang Fan casually found a seat and sat down.
The classmates around him instantly fled, hiding far away.
“Damn, is there any need? Luo Bing and Li Tianheng aren’t even here!” Yang Fan muttered inwardly.

Yang Yi’s voice appeared in his mind at this moment: “Master, just now I browsed all the webpages related to Yang County No. 1 Middle School, as well as the school’s tieba and forums, and found that you are now the public enemy of the whole school?”
“What’s the situation?”

“Initiated by Li Tianheng, whoever has a good relationship with you in the whole school will be targeted by him, and there is a bounty of 10 million for your dirt. Currently, master, you are ranked first on the ‘Deserving to be Executed’ list of this scoundrel.”
“Damn, campus bullying, huh!” Yang Fan was somewhat speechless.
Just how much did this Li Tianheng hate him?
If not for the restrictions of federal law, would he have sent troops to attack his Divine Kingdom?

“According to inquiries, there is a 94.2% probability that the teacher will announce class assignments in today’s class. Based on the master’s midterm exam scores, you will definitely go to Class 1, Grade 12 to study.”

“The usual study content of Class 1, Grade 12 is divided into: 1. Applying for the public Divine Kingdom Battlefield, where believers’ physical bodies participate in battle. 2. Restricted Divine Kingdom defense battles. 3. Extracurricular practical activities, including but not limited to classmates cooperating to explore the Divine Kingdoms of dead deities.”
“Judging from public tieba forums and various messages, the probability of the master being bullied and targeted by classmates is as high as 99.99%.”
“Holy crap, aren’t we sitting in the classroom for class?” Yang Fan swallowed hard.
“Most students in Class 7, Grade 12 take the logistics direction, which leans towards theory. Class 1, Grade 12 is entirely warfare-oriented, leaning towards practice.” Yang Yi continued to explain.
“Is there danger?” Yang Fan asked in his mind.
“The Divine Kingdom Core is not in danger. If handled improperly, believers may die on a large scale, which could significantly drag down the development progress of the Divine Kingdom.”
“Is there any good method!”
“Rapidly improve the strength of believers.”
“Hurry up and help me think of a way.” Yang Fan said anxiously.
“Apply to purchase the Class B building Spirit Weapon Workshop, plus a small mineral vein.”
“Approve the application.”
“Apply for 200 million funds to purchase corpses of various alien races, and use the Flesh Sea Blood Pool to rapidly improve the Physical Body of believers and increase survivability.”
“Approve the application.”
“Apply...”
“Approve them all, stop dawdling, you handle it.”
At this moment, Yang Fan was extremely grateful that he had purchased an Advanced Intelligent Life.
Its collection, organization, and analysis of information were simply too awesome.
Without Yang Yi, he probably wouldn’t even know that danger was approaching.
Yang Fan said bitterly in his mind: “Want to bully me? When I develop, I’ll make you call me daddy.”
With the two Wonders of Penglai Island and Spirit Peach Mountain, Yang Fan felt a lot more confident.
With his Evolution Talent, plus these assets within his own Divine Kingdom, Yang Fan didn’t believe that his development speed couldn’t catch up to Luo Bing and Li Tianheng.
“Zhang Pang sent a private message: Brother Yang, I don’t dare to talk to you, don’t blame me, my little arms and legs can’t handle it.” Yang Yi continued to remind.
“Help me reply to his message and tell him to keep a distance from me during this period.” Yang Fan said.
“Yes, master.”
With an Advanced Intelligent Life, handling things was simply convenient.
With just a thought, the other party could do anything.
Just at this moment, Class 7, Grade 12 head teacher Li Qingying walked into the classroom.
At this moment, Li Qingying’s face was glowing red, and she was even humming a little tune, showing that she was in a good mood.
Li Qingying looked at Yang Fan with a full face of smiles, staring at him until his heart felt a bit creeped out.

“Classmates, the midterm exams have ended. First of all, congratulations to Yang Fan and Li Shuhao for being promoted to Class 1, Grade 12, and Wang Zhenyu for being promoted to Class 3, Grade 12. Tomorrow you will go to other classes. As for the coordinates, I will send them to your bracers later.” Li Qingying said slowly.
After saying this, she conjured a chair from who knows where and sat down.

“We won’t have class today, let’s chat. First of all, congratulations to our student Yang Fan for winning first place in this grade, everyone applause.” Li Qingying took the lead in clapping vigorously.
However, the scene was somewhat awkward at this moment.
The applause below was very sparse, and many people didn’t dare to raise their heads.
Li Qingying didn’t care about this at all, and continued to say to Yang Fan: “Teacher is very glad to have a student like you.”
Yang Fan was speechless inside: “What’s going on with Teacher Li? No class, changed to chatting instead.”
“Master, according to the midterm exam rankings, teaching teachers will receive corresponding rewards.” Yang Yi reminded in his mind.
“So I made Teacher Li get rich? No Wonder her gaze looking at me is so gentle.”

“From another perspective, the first place in exams over the years has always been a student of Class 1, Grade 12. When the master is promoted to Class 1, that head teacher will also look at you in a new light!” Yang Yi added insult to injury.
Yang Fan shivered in his heart.
He hadn’t even been assigned to his new class yet, and he had already offended his future head teacher?
Why was the after-effect of this midterm exam getting stronger and stronger?
“Since everyone has no interest, then let’s end the class. Student Yang Fan, stay behind.” Today, Li Qingying didn’t seem to want to have class either, waving her hand directly and saying.
Arriving at the office, Li Qingying took out a card and placed it on the desk.
“Work hard, this is a gift for you.”
Taking the card, before Yang Fan could look closely, Yang Yi’s voice came into his mind.
“Class D Formation Black Tortoise Life-Extinguishing Array, can be set up by up to one million believers simultaneously, skilled in defense. Selling price 100 million Faith Points.”

Li Qingying slowly said: “This is the Class D Black Tortoise Life-Extinguishing Array. With your Comprehension Ability, you should now be qualified to comprehend it. If you can get started, the remaining time of Grade 12 will be much easier to get through.”
Speaking of this, a trace of pity flashed in Li Qingying’s eyes.
“Thank you, teacher.” Yang Fan’s mouth twitched slightly.
“Go ahead. The teacher of Class 1 is named Cao Wang, and his temper is a bit irritable. Remember to stay away from him.” Li Qingying waved her hand.

No Wonder her gaze looking at me is so gentle.”
“From another perspective, the first place in exams over the years has always been a student of Class 1, Grade 12.
When the master is promoted to Class 1, that head teacher will also look at you in a new light!” Yang Yi added insult to injury.
Yang Fan shivered in his heart.
He hadn’t even been assigned to his new class yet, and he had already offended his future head teacher?
Why was the after-effect of this midterm exam getting stronger and stronger?
“Since everyone has no interest, then let’s end the class.
Student Yang Fan, stay behind.” Today, Li Qingying didn’t seem to want to have class either, waving her hand directly and saying.
Arriving at the office, Li Qingying took out a card and placed it on the desk.
“Work hard, this is a gift for you.”
Taking the card, before Yang Fan could look closely, Yang Yi’s voice came into his mind.
“Class D Formation Black Tortoise Life-Extinguishing Array, can be set up by up to one million believers simultaneously, skilled in defense.
Selling price 100 million Faith Points.”
Li Qingying slowly said: “This is the Class D Black Tortoise Life-Extinguishing Array.
With your Comprehension Ability, you should now be qualified to comprehend it.
If you can get started, the remaining time of Grade 12 will be much easier to get through.”
Speaking of this, a trace of pity flashed in Li Qingying’s eyes.
“Thank you, teacher.” Yang Fan’s mouth twitched slightly.
“Go ahead.
The teacher of Class 1 is named Cao Wang, and his temper is a bit irritable.
Remember to stay away from him.” Li Qingying waved her hand.

chapters.title: Chapter 75: Divine Kingdom True Battlefield Teaching Edition
paragraphs: Returning to reality, Yang Fan, who took off his helmet, could not help letting out a breath.
“The rest of my student life is not going to be easy.”
Just as Yang Fan was sighing, he suddenly felt a surge of power welling up in his body.
A Tier 3 creature was born within the Divine Kingdom.
Directing his consciousness into the Divine Kingdom, he indeed discovered that beside the Enlightenment Stone on Penglai Island, a believer had made a Breakthrough to Tier 3.
Under the dual blessing of Penglai Island and the Enlightenment Stone, coupled with his ten-fold Evolution Talent, his believers were growing stronger rapidly.
“Yang Yi, according to the information you investigated, where does the current strength of my believers rank in Class 1, Grade 12?” Yang Fan asked.
“There are 228 people in Class 1, Grade 12. If all believers are committed, the ranking should be around 100.”
“So low?”

“According to the midterm exam recording, the master’s advantage lies in the powerful troop supply capability. The believers’ own strength is too weak; even if they comprehend the Major Achievement Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array, there is no major advantage.”
“Then won’t I have a miserable time?”

“Tomorrow, there is a 95% probability that Class 1, Grade 12 will apply for the public Divine Kingdom Battlefield. The participating believers will number 10,000. Depending on the opponent’s strength, the master can choose to dispatch believers of different strengths to appropriately reduce losses.”
“Given a hundred years in the Divine Kingdom, I am confident in raising the comprehensive strength of the master’s believers into the top ten.”
“By then, even Luo Bing and Li Tianheng might not be willing to pay a huge price to fight to the death with the master,” Yang Yi analyzed.
Hearing this, Yang Fan’s eyes lit up.
A hundred years in the Divine Kingdom would only take him ten days.
As expected of a high-tier Intelligent Life, its words always give people peace of mind.

“With the blessing of the Enlightenment Stone, the believers are barely qualified to comprehend the Black Tortoise Life-Extinguishing Array. If they can master it to the entry level, the master can fight against many in the Divine Kingdom defense war.”
“Then what are we waiting for? Hurry up and load it, let them comprehend it.”
Unlike Yang Fan, Yang Yi, being an Intelligent Life, would not feel tired at all.
Once there was excess resources in the Divine Kingdom, it would immediately list them for sale.

Moon Radiance Road, Sun Essence, Monkey Wine, and even the weapons produced by the Spirit Weapon Workshop purchased today—once Yang Yi judged that the inventory was sufficient, it would immediately list them.
Once Faith Points were sufficient, it would purchase the Monkey Wine Spring, or make compound interest investments with the Moon Well and Sun Spring.
If Yang Fan used to compound monthly in the past, then the current Yang Yi compounded hourly.
Yang Fan could feel that every moment, his Divine Kingdom was circulating with the outside world.
Under the blessing of the ten-fold Evolution Talent, one day outside was ten years in the Divine Kingdom, making this feeling even more obvious.
The next day, Yang Fan somewhat reluctantly put on his helmet and entered the Class 1, Grade 12 classroom.
The layout of the classroom was no different, and Yang Fan saw quite a few acquaintances.

Luo Bing and Li Tianheng’s seven-member squad, Luo Mingxuan the annoying Young Master, Li Shuhao the old friend, Tie Feng from the Blacksmith Association, and old faces who had once had a group chat dinner together.
Many people shifted their gazes over, looking at Yang Fan with disgust, gloating, and more so, hostility.
Yang Fan had just found a corner seat and sat down when a figure stood in front of him.
“Yang... bro...ther, this is my seat, go to the back,” the newcomer said through gritted teeth.
Yang Fan knew this person; his name was Li Chengze, one of the original seven-member squad, who had a fiery temper but was very loyal.
At this moment, Luo Mingxuan was crossing his legs, looking like he was watching a show.
“How satisfying! So what if your talent is good? You offended so many people, let’s see how you survive in Class 1, Grade 12,” Luo Mingxuan said with a smug face.
Yang Fan did not argue with him, directly getting up and sitting in the very last corner seat.
Dignity is not given by others; in the end, it still depends on strength.
When all was said and done, he had failed them in the past, so Yang Fan didn’t want to bother with such trivial matters.
Seeing Yang Fan swallowing his anger and even acting indifferent, Li Chengze wished he could curse out loud.
But the head teacher was about to arrive shortly, so he could only suppress his anger.
A middle-aged man with a square face walked up to the podium.
“There are some new faces, so I will reintroduce myself. My name is Cao Wang, and I am your new head teacher.”

“Today, in the first class, I will only talk about one thing, which is to abandon your previous lazy habits. The students of Class 1, Grade 12 all take the path of war, so our classes are different from other classes.”
“I don’t care how you develop your Divine Kingdom in your spare time. My class only teaches one thing, and that is war.”
“I don’t talk about deceptive things like Divine Kingdom ecology here, nor do I discuss boring things like Divine Kingdom investment.”

“How to attack an Alien Divine Kingdom? How to plunder resources with maximum efficiency? How to proportion population, weapons, and provisions? How to flexibly apply various Formations? As well as taboos in war! Every single one of my classes will involve combat.” Cao Wang’s tone was cold and stern, like an iron-blooded general, and the powerful divine aura made all the students present shudder.
“Before starting the first class, I want to meet a classmate. Who is Yang Fan?” Cao Wang swept his gaze across everyone.
Yang Fan took a deep breath and raised his left hand.

Looking at Yang Fan, Cao Wang narrowed his eyes slightly and said, “I watched the midterm exam recording. Your adaptability, control of the battlefield, and courage when abandoning believers are all very good. You have great talent.”
Hearing this, a trace of doubt arose in Yang Fan’s heart.
The other party was actually praising him, which was not the situation he had imagined.
“However, next time I hope these methods are used on aliens, instead of fighting amongst your own kind!”

“I am a teacher now, but at the same time I am also a soldier on The Frontline. What I detest the most are those who shirk and play tricks in war, act cowardly when facing aliens, and are sinister and cunning when facing compatriots. Do you understand?”
With a loud boom, Yang Fan only felt as if his head was about to explode.
The powerful divine aura on Cao Wang suppressed him so much that his Soul was trembling.
Death, this was the feeling of death!
“Rest assured, Master, this is an illusion generated by the Virtual World. Your consciousness and Physical Body are very safe,” Yang Yi’s reminder came from the back of Yang Fan’s mind.
Yang Fan slowly raised his head and looked coldly at the other person.
This head teacher of Class 1, Grade 12 sure gave a heavy psychological blow right off the bat!
Seeing Yang Fan adjust so quickly, Cao Wang felt somewhat surprised in his heart.
“Not bad eyes. Let me see how your actual combat capability is!”
“Apply for the Divine Kingdom True Battlefield.” Cao Wang raised his right hand high.
In an instant, the classroom environment began to change.
The podium, desks, and ground blurred and disappeared like data, replaced one by one by battle arenas.
“Divine Kingdom True Battlefield (Teaching Edition), limited to 10,000 people, shielding Divine Kingdom coordinates...”
“Shielding complete. Current matchups can be freely combined.” The voice of Intelligent Life came from the Void Realm.

After the preparation of the Divine Kingdom Battlefield was complete, Cao Wang stood with his hands behind his back: “You cannot continuously challenge the same person within a month. Try to arrange the strongest believers to participate in the battle. If there is a Breakthrough of a Formation or large-scale slaughter during the battle, the advantageous side should immediately stop to avoid affecting the development of the opponent’s Divine Kingdom.”
“I will point out your respective problems based on your combat conditions. Real Divine Kingdom Wars can allow you to progress faster.”
“Old Li, let’s team up today.”
“Old Wang, the two of us will spar. Remember to go easy; last time my Tier 4 creature had its arm chopped off by your believers, forcing me to buy a Limb Restoration Pill in the Divine Shop.”
“Tie Feng, let’s go, go, go.”

chapters.title: Chapter 76: Preparing to Reveal Fangs
paragraphs: The students of Class 1, Grade 12 quickly found their opponents, but Yang Fan remained standing in place.
Li Tianheng walked over at this moment and said, “Yang Fan, there are only the two of us left.”
Looking at the smugness in the other person’s eyes, Yang Fan let out a light sigh inwardly.
“Yang Yi, what do you think I should do?” Yang Fan asked inwardly.
“Li Tianheng possesses the C-rank Mad Blood Talent, and Tier 5 Beings have already been born within his divine kingdom. There is no chance of winning,” Yang Yi reminded him.
Yang Fan sighed and asked, “Can I choose not to fight?”
“Generally, there is no precedent of surrendering without a fight.”
“Then what if I exchange a blow and then surrender immediately?”
“Sure, go ahead!” A cruel expression appeared on Li Tianheng’s Face.
Arriving at the battlefield, Li Tianheng summoned his believers: 10 Tier 5 Beings, 1,000 Tier 4 Beings, with the rest all being Tier 3 Beings.
Looking at the opponent’s formation, Yang Fan felt that even if he dragged out all the strongest believers in his divine kingdom, it still wouldn’t be enough for the other side to slaughter.
Yang Fan complained inwardly, “Did this guy go back and pop some pills? How is he suddenly so fierce?”
With a wave of Yang Fan’s right hand, ten thousand believers were summoned out.
“Kill them for me!” Li Tianheng shouted loudly.
Li Tianheng’s believers instantly rushed in front of Yang Fan’s army like a pack of starving wolves.
In just a few breaths, all of Yang Fan’s ten thousand believers were slaughtered.
This was a real Divine Kingdom Battlefield, where believers were summoned with their physical bodies.
At this moment, the arena, which spanned hundreds of kilometers, was completely dyed red with blood.
Severed limbs and broken arms, along with internal organs, were scattered everywhere.
A terrifying stench of blood permeated the air.
The other classmates who were fighting at the moment hurriedly ordered their believers to stop their actions.
“Brother Tianheng is so ruthless, killing them off so quickly?”
“That’s not right, is Yang Fan really this weak?”

“It’s because Brother Tianheng is strong. Have you looked at his lineup? Aside from Sister Bing, who in the class is his match? He hasn’t even activated his Mad Blood Talent yet. How satisfying!” Li Chengze smiled smugly.
During the midterm exam, Yang Fan had screwed them over too miserably.
Seeing Li Tianheng carry out such a massacre at this moment made everyone feel much more refreshed inside.
“What is going on here?” Cao Wang walked over with an ugly expression.
“Reporting to the teacher, Yang Fan’s believers are too weak. They are all Mortals, and there is no learning value whatsoever,” Li Tianheng explained.
Cao Wang turned his head to look at Yang Fan: “What do you have to say?”
“Since I can’t beat him anyway, it’s better to minimize losses,” Yang Fan said bluntly.

Seeing this, Cao Wang let out a cold snort, turned his head, and cursed loudly, “Li Tianheng, are you out of your mind? We are having a class right now. Your talent is good, but this strength should be used to deal with alien races. What are you doing right now?”
“This brat treated me like a monkey. I swear I won’t be human if I don’t get revenge for this.” Even facing a deity, Li Tianheng still held his head high and chest out, completely fearless.

“Stupid. With such a narrow mind, it will be hard for you to achieve greatness. Since you’re so tough, why don’t you skip going to university after graduation and come straight to The Frontline with me to be a soldier for a few years.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan was quite surprised inwardly.
It seemed that this teacher named Cao Wang, although targeting him, wasn’t bad by nature.
He simply abhorred alien races and was genuinely teaching every single student seriously.
“Both of you go back and reflect on yourselves. This battle was meaningless with nothing worth critiquing. Log out now.”
Receiving the order, Yang Fan felt as though he had been liberated and immediately exited the Virtual World.
The moment he took off his helmet, he received a private message.

“Yang Fan, our business is far from over. From now on, people arranged by me will challenge you every day—ten thousand a day. Even if they’re just ordinary believers, you don’t have that much population to burn, right? Dare to toy with me, and this is the price!”
Looking at Li Tianheng’s threatening message, Yang Fan smiled with contempt.
If it were anyone else, they might have actually been scared by him, but Yang Fan possessed the Evolution Talent.
He could easily absorb a loss of ten thousand ordinary population a day.

“It won’t be long before fighting me like this will make your own heart ache. Consider this period as letting you vent your anger. If you continue to target me, don’t blame me for being ungracious,” Yang Fan muttered to himself.
Over the next few days, Yang Fan suffered the same fate every day.
As if prearranged, every day after everyone else finished matching, he and one remaining person were left unable to choose anyone else.
The opponents during these few days were all ‘old friends’ from the seven-member squad.
Yang Fan gradually grew numb.
By now, the population of his divine kingdom had already surpassed 4 million.

Relying on the favorable living environment coupled with the blessing of the C-rank Breeding Card, the number of newborns was increasing more and more, completely experiencing an exponential explosion.
Until the seventh day, Yang Fan’s opponent was Luo Bing.
Looking at Yang Fan’s believers who were all Mortals, she didn’t directly make a move to wipe them out.
Instead, looking somewhat bored, she told Yang Fan to surrender directly.
There was actually such a good thing!
Yang Fan hurriedly raised his hand to surrender and happily exited the Virtual World, leaving only Li Tianheng standing in place with an ugly expression.
In the entire Class 1, Grade 12, there was only one person who could refuse to give Li Tianheng Face, and that was Luo Bing.
Another five days passed, which was fifty years inside the divine kingdom.
The believer population had already broken ten million.
Under the dual blessings of Penglai Island and the Enlightenment Stone, more and more believers entered the ranks, breaking through one million.
On the same day, the first Tier 4 Being was born in the divine kingdom, and the overall strength rose to another level.
“Divine Lord: Yang Fan”
“Divine Kingdom Area: One million square kilometers”
“Talents: F-rank Resource Talent, SSS-Rank Talent: Evolution”
“Believers: Tier 4 Beings (1), Tier 3 Beings (310), Tier 2 Beings (6,252), Tier 1 Beings (1.01 million), Mortals (9.72 million)”
“Dependents: little spirits (412)”
“Dharmic Methods: Five Elements Cultivation Technique, Vajra Indestructible Technique, Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array (Major Achievement stage), Black Tortoise Life-Extinguishing Array...”
“Faith Points: 1.24 billion (providing 260.4 Faith Points daily)”

“Buildings: Moon Well x2,000, Sun Spring x2,000, B-rank Building Monkey Wine Spring x5, Special Life Building Ancient Spirit Tree (thousand-year-old, nurturing little spirits), Special Building Enlightenment Stone, B-rank Building Flesh Sea Blood Pool x1, B-rank Building Hundred Spirits Blood Pool x1 (soaked with 10 Taisui, 100% load rate), Special Building Fully Automatic Concentrator x3 (cutting plant loaded with 300 Taisui, 100% load rate), B-rank Building Spirit Weapon Workshop (built-in small mineral vein), C-rank City of Technology x1...”
“Wonders: Penglai Island (deployed), Spirit Peach Mountain (deployed)”
“Assets: Taisui x310, small mineral vein, various spiritual fruits (), D-rank weapons (), E-rank weapons (), F-rank weapons ()”

Looking at the detailed information of his divine kingdom, Yang Fan said with satisfaction, “If I participate in a real Divine Kingdom War, with a population of ten million plus the Evolution Talent, aside from Luo Bing and Li Tianheng, I will have absolutely no rivals in Class 1, Grade 12. If it’s a ten-thousand-person Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle, relying on the Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array at the Great Success stage, I should be among the top ten combat powers in the class.”
With such strength, Yang Fan no longer needed to act cowering and timid.
He was confident that even if it were Li Tianheng, if they chose a life-and-death battle, the other party’s ten thousand elite soldiers would definitely suffer heavy losses.
Li Tianheng didn’t possess ten times the Evolution Talent like Yang Fan did.
If 30% to 40% of his forces were wiped out, the other party would definitely feel the pain much more than him.
“I need to reveal a bit of my fangs, otherwise they’ll really think I’m a soft persimmon.” A trace of Battle Intent flashed across Yang Fan’s eyes.

Over the next few days, Yang Fan suffered the same fate every day.
As if prearranged, every day after everyone else finished matching, he and one remaining person were left unable to choose anyone else.
The opponents during these few days were all ‘old friends’ from the seven-member squad.
Yang Fan gradually grew numb.
By now, the population of his divine kingdom had already surpassed 4 million.

Relying on the favorable living environment coupled with the blessing of the C-rank Breeding Card, the number of newborns was increasing more and more, completely experiencing an exponential explosion.
Until the seventh day, Yang Fan’s opponent was Luo Bing.
Looking at Yang Fan’s believers who were all Mortals, she didn’t directly make a move to wipe them out.
Instead, looking somewhat bored, she told Yang Fan to surrender directly.
There was actually such a good thing!
Yang Fan hurriedly raised his hand to surrender and happily exited the Virtual World, leaving only Li Tianheng standing in place with an ugly expression.
In the entire Class 1, Grade 12, there was only one person who could refuse to give Li Tianheng Face, and that was Luo Bing.
Another five days passed, which was fifty years inside the divine kingdom.
The believer population had already broken ten million.
Under the dual blessings of Penglai Island and the Enlightenment Stone, more and more believers entered the ranks, breaking through one million.
On the same day, the first Tier 4 Being was born in the divine kingdom, and the overall strength rose to another level.
“Divine Lord: Yang Fan”
“Divine Kingdom Area: One million square kilometers”
“Talents: F-rank Resource Talent, SSS-Rank Talent: Evolution”
“Believers: Tier 4 Beings (1), Tier 3 Beings (310), Tier 2 Beings (6,252), Tier 1 Beings (1.01 million), Mortals (9.72 million)”
“Dependents: little spirits (412)”
“Dharmic Methods: Five Elements Cultivation Technique, Vajra Indestructible Technique, Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array (Major Achievement stage), Black Tortoise Life-Extinguishing Array...”
“Faith Points: 1.24 billion (providing 260.4 Faith Points daily)”

“Buildings: Moon Well x2,000, Sun Spring x2,000, B-rank Building Monkey Wine Spring x5, Special Life Building Ancient Spirit Tree (thousand-year-old, nurturing little spirits), Special Building Enlightenment Stone, B-rank Building Flesh Sea Blood Pool x1, B-rank Building Hundred Spirits Blood Pool x1 (soaked with 10 Taisui, 100% load rate), Special Building Fully Automatic Concentrator x3 (cutting plant loaded with 300 Taisui, 100% load rate), B-rank Building Spirit Weapon Workshop (built-in small mineral vein), C-rank City of Technology x1...”
“Wonders: Penglai Island (deployed), Spirit Peach Mountain (deployed)”
“Assets: Taisui x310, small mineral vein, various spiritual fruits (), D-rank weapons (), E-rank weapons (), F-rank weapons ()”

Looking at the detailed information of his divine kingdom, Yang Fan said with satisfaction, “If I participate in a real Divine Kingdom War, with a population of ten million plus the Evolution Talent, aside from Luo Bing and Li Tianheng, I will have absolutely no rivals in Class 1, Grade 12.

If it’s a ten-thousand-person Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle, relying on the Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array at the Great Success stage, I should be among the top ten combat powers in the class.”
With such strength, Yang Fan no longer needed to act cowering and timid.
He was confident that even if it were Li Tianheng, if they chose a life-and-death battle, the other party’s ten thousand elite soldiers would definitely suffer heavy losses.
Li Tianheng didn’t possess ten times the Evolution Talent like Yang Fan did.
If 30% to 40% of his forces were wiped out, the other party would definitely feel the pain much more than him.
“I need to reveal a bit of my fangs, otherwise they’ll really think I’m a soft persimmon.” A trace of Battle Intent flashed across Yang Fan’s eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 77: Displaying Strength Revenge
paragraphs: Putting on his helmet, Yang Fan tapped the coordinates and went straight to the Divine Kingdom Battlefield opened by Cao Wang.
As usual, the others had long since formed teams, and Yang Fan’s opponent was also fully prepared.
Looking at the newcomer, a trace of surprise appeared in Yang Fan’s eyes.
It turned out to be Luo Mingxuan!
Yang Fan remembered that this person’s ranking in the Luo Family Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle was around two or three hundredth, right?
In previous classes, the believers sent out by Yang Fan were all ordinary Mortals; that was because he didn’t want excessive losses.
Did this Luo Mingxuan really think he was a soft persimmon!

On another arena, while sparring with Li Tianheng, Li Chengze said with a somewhat worried expression: “Brother Tianheng, is that trash Luo Mingxuan going to be okay? Why did you agree to let him go up?”

“Rest assured, it was this person who requested it himself. I tested his standard yesterday, and his strength is not weak. He stated that he will go all out, and even if he isn’t Yang Fan’s match, it will inevitably be a fierce battle.” Li Tianheng explained.
“It seems his parents have poured a lot of resources into him again!” Li Chengze smacked his lips.
“I can only continue challenging a month later anyway. The two of them have a feud, so regardless of winning or losing, the consumption of believers won’t be little.”
“Brother Tianheng is wise.”
“A person fights for a breath of pride. That bastard Yang Fan dared to play us like this. If we don’t teach him a lesson, how are we supposed to mix in society!”
On the arena, Luo Mingxuan summoned his own believers.
1 Tier 4 entity, 20 Tier 3 entities, 360 Tier 2 entities, 4,600 Tier 1 entities, and Mortals...
Seeing this lineup, many classmates showed expressions of surprise.
“Luo Mingxuan’s strength has improved a bit fast!”
“Now there’s something to watch. Although Yang Fan has comprehended the Major Achievement Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array, his believers’ combat power is still a notch lower.”

“Not necessarily. This guy obtained the most resources during the midterm exam. Just the 10 billion Faith Points rewarded by the school alone would allow him to push his believers’ strength up quite a bit.”
“Anyway, there’s a fight to be had. This Luo Mingxuan is petty; I think he’s one to deal ruthless blows.”
During ordinary sparring, these classmates wouldn’t focus intently on the believers’ battles, but right now, they were much more interested in the battle between Luo Mingxuan and Yang Fan.
Dealing fatal blows is much more interesting than sparring!

Luo Mingxuan floated directly above his believers, crossing his arms and saying: “Yang Fan, I finally have the opportunity to fight you with real swords and guns! Don’t surrender—no, even if you surrender, I won’t stop. This arena requires both sides to agree before it can end, hahaha.”
“Going all out in battle, your losses probably won’t be small.” Yang Fan asked curiously.
Luo Mingxuan smiled evilly and said: “It doesn’t matter, it’s just contributing a force. After all, you’ve incurred the public wrath, and everyone shares a bitter hatred of the enemy!”
“I see.”
As his voice fell, Yang Fan summoned his elite troops.
1 Tier 4 entity, 300 Tier 3 entities, 6,000 Tier 2 entities, and the rest were all Tier 1 entities.
Seeing this lineup, the scene grew much quieter.
“Damn, this punk really did hide his strength.”
“They are all tiered, and there are even Tier 4 believers. This combat power should be in the top ten of the class, right?”
“It’s a bit sinister. It hasn’t even been a month since the midterm exam passed, yet he improved so fast?”

“Bullshit, how could it be so fast? The midterm exam was so dangerous, yet he actually hid his strength. This kid is extremely sinister, watching us stand at the front like clowns. You dog thing, you dog thing!” Li Chengze cursed angrily.
Back then, there wasn’t even a Tier 3 entity among Yang Fan’s believers, and later on, the ones used to scout the path for them were all Mortal believers who didn’t even wear clothes.
Improving to this extent in such a short time?
Who is he trying to fool?
The only reasonable explanation was that Yang Fan had hidden his strength that day.
Thinking of how sincere he was at that time, Li Chengze wished he could give himself a couple of slaps.
Li Tianheng’s expression was equally ugly.
Looking at Luo Mingxuan on the arena, he wished he could immediately swap places with him.
If he didn’t slaughter this villain’s believers, his Dao Heart would become unstable.
“You...” Luo Mingxuan pointed at Yang Fan, unable to squeeze out a single sentence for a long time.
Yang Fan had comprehended the Major Achievement Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array, and now his believers’ overall strength surpassed his own.
Even in a bloody battle, how much loss could he possibly inflict on the opponent?
“I concede!” Luo Mingxuan raised his hand and said.
“Kill.” Yang Fan sneered.
“Bastard.”
As the two armies clashed, the smell of blood instantly permeated the air.
Not only was their strength greater, but after being forged by the Lingbing Workshop for one or two hundred years, the ten-thousand-strong army of Yang Fan wore a full set of D-grade weapons.
In contrast, Luo Mingxuan’s Tier 3 believers wore D-grade equipment, while all the others were F-grade.
Coupled with the Formation’s advantage, it was basically a one-sided massacre.
Watching his ten thousand elite troops being harvested like grass, Luo Mingxuan’s face was as black as charred coal.
In the end, at the cost of more than eight hundred Tier 1 believers, Yang Fan completely wiped out the opponent’s believers.
“More than eight hundred Tier 1 entities—although the battle results didn’t meet expectations, it wasn’t completely without effect.” Luo Mingxuan could only comfort himself this way in his heart.
If he were to know that the Tier 1 entities in Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom had already reached one million, he would probably be angered to the point of vomiting blood.
As the battle ended and the restrictions of the Divine Kingdom Battlefield opened, Cao Wang walked over with a dark face.
“The students of our Class 1 sure have backbone; when killing fellow countrymen, they don’t hold back at all.” Cao Wang said sarcastically.
“Others want to deal ruthless blows, so I naturally have to resist.” Yang Fan said helplessly.
“It’s always you every day. Why don’t the arena battles of other classmates have such heavy casualties?”
“I am hateful to others, there’s no help for it.”
“You know you’re hateful, yet you still strike so ruthlessly.”

“I’ve considered it for a while and feel that continuing like this isn’t a solution. From now on, whoever goes up to the arena and wants to fight me to the death, let me know in advance, and I will accompany you with all my strength.” Yang Fan turned his head to look at everyone, his voice filled with cold severity.
Once his strength was sufficient, it was time to establish his authority.
With the combat power he displayed, apart from Luo Bing and Li Tianheng, others might not have the guts to fight him to the bitter end.
“I’m leaving class first!” Yang Fan waved his hand.
He was already used to leaving right after finishing the fight these days.
“Hold on.” Cao Wang suddenly spoke up.
“Is there anything else, Teacher Cao?” Yang Fan wore a puzzled expression.

“The Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array is only an F-grade Formation with no obvious advantages and limited potential. Since your Comprehension Ability is not bad, go purchase one set each of defensive and offensive Formations, not exceeding D-grade. Formations of C-grade and above require believers at the Qi Refining or Martial Disciple Realm to preside over them before they can be deployed.”
“Thank you, Teacher Cao.” Yang Fan was somewhat flattered, not expecting the other party to actually be earnestly teaching him.

Cao Wang ignored Yang Fan, instead turning directly to curse at Luo Mingxuan: “Your Formation is simply a complete mess, and your believers’ Foundation is similarly floaty and unstable. This Tier 4 entity was forcefully elevated using some kind of Medicinal Pill to boost strength, right? It looks bluffing, but it’s completely useless. Is your head filled with shit?”
“Hurry back and reflect properly. Your talent is poor, and you’re also stupid. If you hadn’t been born into a good womb, you would be nothing at all, you trash.”
Being scolded like this by Cao Wang, Luo Mingxuan’s tears started welling up.
Seeing this scene, Yang Fan, who was in a great mood, couldn’t help but laugh out loud.
“Sorry, couldn’t help it, bye.” Not wanting to be disciplined by Cao Wang, Yang Fan hurriedly exited the Virtual World.

chapters.title: Chapter 78: All-out battle is it worth it
paragraphs: There is a reason why all the students in Class 1, Grade 12 respect Cao Wang.
Although his speech was vulgar and he was very strict with the students, his teaching ethics were truly good, treating everyone equally regardless of their talent.
A person like this would definitely be a good general on The Frontline.
Unlike the satisfying and uplifting situation for Yang Fan, Luo Mingxuan was smashing things in his villa like a madman at this moment.
“Yang Fan, Yang Fan, you wait for me, I will definitely not let you off.”
After experiencing the previous establishment of prestige, the subsequent actual combat was much more normal.
The first thing many classmates matched with Yang Fan did upon taking the stage was to state that sparring would be the main focus.
Yang Fan gladly agreed.
He did not have the hobby of slaughtering others, and ordinary sparring was enough for Cao Wang to point out problems.
Another dozen days passed.
The D-grade Black Tortoise Life-Extinguishing Array was still too profound for Yang Fan’s current believers.
He adopted Cao Wang’s suggestion, and after discussing it with Yang Yi, he chose two E-grade Formations.
One was the Locking Heaven Array, focusing mainly on containment and defense.
One was the Extinguishing God Array, focusing mainly on strangulation and breaking Formations.
With the tenfold Evolution Talent, Yang Fan did not want to spend time and effort researching the Formation himself before teaching it to his believers.
Instead, he directly placed it in the transmission tower for them to study on their own.
More than a month had passed since the end of the midterm examination.
Under such high-speed development, the Divine Kingdom had experienced a full three hundred years.
Today, his believer population was no longer growing, having reached its limit.
“Believers: Tier 4 Beings (100), Tier 3 Beings (3,310), Tier 2 Beings (40,000), Tier 1 Beings (4 million), Mortals (32 million)
Vassals: little spirits (1,718)

Techniques: Five Elements Cultivation Technique, Vajra Indestructible Technique, Locking Heaven Array (E-grade), Extinguishing God Array (E-grade), Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array (Major Achievement), Black Tortoise Life-Extinguishing Array...
Faith Points: 1.12 billion (providing 360.4 Faith Points daily)”
Nearly forty million population—this was already the limit of believers that a Divine Being’s Divine Kingdom could achieve.
With the explosive population growth, Yang Yi had already deployed 5 Fully Automatic Concentrators on the ground, maxing out their production.
That was 500 Taisuis, with 1 billion worth of Taisui meat continuously producing meat without a moment’s pause.
Because spiritual fruits were abundant, in order to make the believers’ bodies healthier, Yang Yi purchased another 20 supersonic aircraft dedicated to transporting spiritual fruits.
Even the believers on the ground could not only eat sufficient concentrated meat, but also have two or three spiritual fruits with every meal.
Their lives were getting better and better.
Now, relying solely on the believers themselves, Yang Fan could obtain 360.4 Faith Points every day, having already walked one-third of the distance toward a Breakthrough to Demigod.
With more than four months remaining until the College Entrance Examination, leveraging his Evolution Talent, his Divine Kingdom had a full thousand-plus years of development time.
Yang Fan even believed that he would have the opportunity to Breakthrough to Demigod before the College Entrance Examination.
All of this was thanks to the harvest from the midterm examination.
Penglai Island and Spirit Peach Mountain had helped him far too much.
This feeling of automatically growing stronger just by lying down was truly mesmerizing.

“Today my Physical Body feels much stronger again. A few days ago when I went to the gym, a single punch actually unleashed five tons of force. I wonder how it is now.” Feeling the terrifying power contained within his body, Yang Fan really wanted to find someone in the Real World to have a good fight.
“A wonderful day begins, let’s go to class first.”
Thinking of this, Yang Fan put on his helmet.
Today was still a two-person battle on the Divine Kingdom Battlefield.
Yang Fan had recently grown accustomed to being late.
Anyway, someone would help him find a suitable opponent, so he didn’t need to waste any effort figuring out who to match with.
As Yang Fan appeared outside the battlefield, Li Tianheng’s tiger-like gaze instantly locked onto him.
“Can you challenge me now?” Yang Fan frowned.
“It’s already the second month, you aren’t planning to send ten thousand Mortals for me to kill again, are you?” Li Tianheng said with an ugly expression.
If Yang Fan continued to act so shamelessly, he really wouldn’t be able to do much to the other party.
Li Tianheng was confident that his own strength could crush Yang Fan, but the other party wouldn’t fight him.
As for making Li Chengze and the others force it, he couldn’t bring himself to say it.
Given the strength Yang Fan displayed, even Li Chengze would probably lose quite a few high-tier believers if they fought.
With the College Entrance Examination drawing closer and closer, if the loss of believers was too great, there would be no way to explain it to the Family.
“No problem, as long as you can vent your anger,” Yang Fan said indifferently.
He had indeed been in the wrong during the midterm examination, and Yang Fan still felt somewhat guilty.
Seeing Yang Fan like this, Li Tianheng flew into a rage: “I cannot vent my Qi, you being like this makes me full of Life Qi, driving me to death.”
Watching the other party act as if his tail had been stepped on, Yang Fan was completely dumbfounded.
“Giving you ten thousand believers for you to kill, and you are still unwilling?”
“Get up on the ring! Yelling and shouting like that, what kind of demeanor is this!” Cao Wang couldn’t help rubbing his own forehead.
He thought very highly of Li Tianheng.
This Mad Blood Talent placed on the battlefield was definitely a major weapon of mass destruction.
It’s just that this guy’s brain didn’t seem to work very well; whatever he thought in his heart, he would say out loud, just like a child.
The two came to the ring, and Li Tianheng immediately summoned his believers.
11 Tier 5 Beings, 1,200 Tier 4 Beings, and the rest were all Tier 3.
Compared to a month ago, his strength had grown quite a bit stronger again.

“Yang Fan, if you are a man, let’s have an all-out battle. After today, past matters can be written off between us. From now on, you don’t know me, and I don’t know you; we will become strangers.” Li Tianheng said earnestly.
If he couldn’t make Yang Fan bleed a little, Li Tianheng truly couldn’t swallow this Qi.
But under the school’s rules, if the other party kept acting shamelessly, he didn’t have any good methods either.
Li Tianheng could only make such a declaration.
Once he exterminated Yang Fan’s high-tier believers, it could be considered giving an account to his brothers and giving an account to himself.
“Are you sure?” Yang Fan’s eyes lit up.
“That’s right.”

“Alright, after today’s battle, you and I will have no further entanglements. But I’ll state this in advance: if you yourself don’t dare to fight, don’t come looking for trouble with me later.” Yang Fan said.
“Cut the crap, hurry up and have an all-out battle with me.” Li Tianheng sneered.
What kind of joke was that?
Would he not dare to fight?
With a wave of his hand, Yang Fan summoned all of his strongest believers.
100 Tier 4 Beings, 3,000 Tier 3 Beings, and the rest were all Tier 2 Beings.
Such combat power was more than a tier stronger than when he fought against Luo Mingxuan.
Most importantly, even if Yang Fan’s believers were inferior in strength to Li Tianheng, they had after all comprehended the Great Success stage Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array.
If it truly came to a battle to the death, they might not be unable to bite off a chunk of flesh from the other party.
With the Evolution Talent, Yang Fan was not afraid of believer losses; giving himself another month would allow him to pull together an even stronger team.
However, Li Tianheng was different.
Yang Fan smiled with confidence, tossing the difficult problem over to the opposite side.
Looking at the two opposing armies on the ring, the scene was dead silent.

“Yang Fan is so strong. Although he is no match for Brother Tianheng, relying on the Formation, if they really fought to the death, he would probably lose quite a few high-tier believers.” Li Chengze swallowed saliva, looking at Li Tianheng with a flash of worry in his eyes.
Beside him, Luo Bing’s expression was equally grave.
With only four months left until the College Entrance Examination, just to vent Qi, is it really worth it?
