Techniques: Five Elements Cultivation Technique, Vajra Indestructible Technique, Locking Heaven Array (E-grade), Extinguishing God Array (E-grade), Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array (Major Achievement), Black Tortoise Life-Extinguishing Array...
Faith Points: 1.12 billion (providing 360.4 Faith Points daily)”
Nearly forty million population—this was already the limit of believers that a Divine Being’s Divine Kingdom could achieve.
With the explosive population growth, Yang Yi had already deployed 5 Fully Automatic Concentrators on the ground, maxing out their production.
That was 500 Taisuis, with 1 billion worth of Taisui meat continuously producing meat without a moment’s pause.
Because spiritual fruits were abundant, in order to make the believers’ bodies healthier, Yang Yi purchased another 20 supersonic aircraft dedicated to transporting spiritual fruits.
Even the believers on the ground could not only eat sufficient concentrated meat, but also have two or three spiritual fruits with every meal.
Their lives were getting better and better.
Now, relying solely on the believers themselves, Yang Fan could obtain 360.4 Faith Points every day, having already walked one-third of the distance toward a Breakthrough to Demigod.
With more than four months remaining until the College Entrance Examination, leveraging his Evolution Talent, his Divine Kingdom had a full thousand-plus years of development time.
Yang Fan even believed that he would have the opportunity to Breakthrough to Demigod before the College Entrance Examination.
All of this was thanks to the harvest from the midterm examination.
Penglai Island and Spirit Peach Mountain had helped him far too much.
This feeling of automatically growing stronger just by lying down was truly mesmerizing.
“Today my Physical Body feels much stronger again.
A few days ago when I went to the gym, a single punch actually unleashed five tons of force.
I wonder how it is now.” Feeling the terrifying power contained within his body, Yang Fan really wanted to find someone in the Real World to have a good fight.
“A wonderful day begins, let’s go to class first.”
Thinking of this, Yang Fan put on his helmet.
Today was still a two-person battle on the Divine Kingdom Battlefield.
Yang Fan had recently grown accustomed to being late.
Anyway, someone would help him find a suitable opponent, so he didn’t need to waste any effort figuring out who to match with.
As Yang Fan appeared outside the battlefield, Li Tianheng’s tiger-like gaze instantly locked onto him.
“Can you challenge me now?” Yang Fan frowned.
“It’s already the second month, you aren’t planning to send ten thousand Mortals for me to kill again, are you?” Li Tianheng said with an ugly expression.
If Yang Fan continued to act so shamelessly, he really wouldn’t be able to do much to the other party.
Li Tianheng was confident that his own strength could crush Yang Fan, but the other party wouldn’t fight him.
As for making Li Chengze and the others force it, he couldn’t bring himself to say it.
Given the strength Yang Fan displayed, even Li Chengze would probably lose quite a few high-tier believers if they fought.
With the College Entrance Examination drawing closer and closer, if the loss of believers was too great, there would be no way to explain it to the Family.
“No problem, as long as you can vent your anger,” Yang Fan said indifferently.
He had indeed been in the wrong during the midterm examination, and Yang Fan still felt somewhat guilty.
Seeing Yang Fan like this, Li Tianheng flew into a rage: “I cannot vent my Qi, you being like this makes me full of Life Qi, driving me to death.”
Watching the other party act as if his tail had been stepped on, Yang Fan was completely dumbfounded.
“Giving you ten thousand believers for you to kill, and you are still unwilling?”
“Get up on the ring!
Yelling and shouting like that, what kind of demeanor is this!” Cao Wang couldn’t help rubbing his own forehead.
He thought very highly of Li Tianheng.
This Mad Blood Talent placed on the battlefield was definitely a major weapon of mass destruction.
It’s just that this guy’s brain didn’t seem to work very well; whatever he thought in his heart, he would say out loud, just like a child.
The two came to the ring, and Li Tianheng immediately summoned his believers.
11 Tier 5 Beings, 1,200 Tier 4 Beings, and the rest were all Tier 3.
Compared to a month ago, his strength had grown quite a bit stronger again.
“Yang Fan, if you are a man, let’s have an all-out battle.
After today, past matters can be written off between us.
From now on, you don’t know me, and I don’t know you; we will become strangers.” Li Tianheng said earnestly.
If he couldn’t make Yang Fan bleed a little, Li Tianheng truly couldn’t swallow this Qi.
But under the school’s rules, if the other party kept acting shamelessly, he didn’t have any good methods either.
Li Tianheng could only make such a declaration.
Once he exterminated Yang Fan’s high-tier believers, it could be considered giving an account to his brothers and giving an account to himself.
“Are you sure?” Yang Fan’s eyes lit up.
“That’s right.”
“Alright, after today’s battle, you and I will have no further entanglements.
But I’ll state this in advance: if you yourself don’t dare to fight, don’t come looking for trouble with me later.” Yang Fan said.
“Cut the crap, hurry up and have an all-out battle with me.” Li Tianheng sneered.
What kind of joke was that?
Would he not dare to fight?
With a wave of his hand, Yang Fan summoned all of his strongest believers.
100 Tier 4 Beings, 3,000 Tier 3 Beings, and the rest were all Tier 2 Beings.
Such combat power was more than a tier stronger than when he fought against Luo Mingxuan.
Most importantly, even if Yang Fan’s believers were inferior in strength to Li Tianheng, they had after all comprehended the Great Success stage Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array.
If it truly came to a battle to the death, they might not be unable to bite off a chunk of flesh from the other party.
With the Evolution Talent, Yang Fan was not afraid of believer losses; giving himself another month would allow him to pull together an even stronger team.
However, Li Tianheng was different.
Yang Fan smiled with confidence, tossing the difficult problem over to the opposite side.
Looking at the two opposing armies on the ring, the scene was dead silent.
“Yang Fan is so strong.

Although he is no match for Brother Tianheng, relying on the Formation, if they really fought to the death, he would probably lose quite a few high-tier believers.” Li Chengze swallowed saliva, looking at Li Tianheng with a flash of worry in his eyes.
Beside him, Luo Bing’s expression was equally grave.
With only four months left until the College Entrance Examination, just to vent Qi, is it really worth it?

chapters.title: Chapter 79: The shameless fear the reckless
paragraphs: Luo Bing similarly did not expect that Yang Fan had actually hidden so much strength; with such combat power, his combat power should be enough to enter the top five of the Luo Family on the Deity Simulation War leaderboard.
“Father, Yang Fan’s character is no good, but his strength is truly formidable.”
Luo Bing’s gaze towards Yang Fan gradually grew serious.
As expected, this time Li Tianheng did not strike directly.
He hesitated; there was no way he could not hesitate.
The College Entrance Examination was enough to affect his future development; just to win back a breath of air, was it really worth it?
“How about we forget it? Let’s just spar and be done with it.”
Yang Fan said with a smile.
Looking at Yang Fan’s gentle smile, Li Tianheng suddenly thought of what the other party had said to him inside the Alien Divine Kingdom, as well as the scene where they acted like sworn brothers.
“Fuck your mother, I’ll fucking kill you! Mad Blood activate, my believers, kill all the enemies on the opposite side for me.”
Li Tianheng instantly activated his Evolution Talent, making the army’s Aura grow three parts stronger.
The believers were like ferocious wolves choosing people to devour, charging straight over.
“Fuck, this guy is so reckless! Playing for real?”
Yang Fan was speechless to the extreme.
He was fearless because he possessed the Evolution Talent.
This Li Tianheng was simply a hot-blooded youth who rushed in the moment his brain blanked out; did he not consider the consequences at all?
Yang Fan was equally bitter in his heart; he hadn’t wanted to truly fight.
If all these believers died, his heart would ache as well.
He originally wanted to use this opportunity to make the other party lower their head and display his own strength, turning hostility into friendship so there would be less trouble in the future.
This was going to deepen the grudge even further!!!

Yang Fan’s believers had long since arranged their Formation; the soldiers at the very front had all cultivated the Vajra Indestructible Technique, holding person-high shields to block the first wave of attack.
With a bang, a flash of blade light swept past, and several Tier 2 beings walking the Martial Route at the very front of the army were cut in half at the waist.
The D-grade weapon shields, armor, along with the believers’ Physical Bodies, were all split into two halves.
Li Tianheng led the charge with three Tier 5 believers at the forefront, advancing like a bamboo being split.
After all, it was the Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array at the Great Success stage; the positions in the Formation that had just been damaged were instantly filled by other believers.
“Kill.”
Utilizing the cover of the great Formation, a believer executed the Light Body Art, appearing like a ghost beside the enemy who had just swung his blade.
With a ripping sound, a long saber slashed across, directly severing an arm from Li Tianheng’s Tier 5 believer.
This was merely the beginning of the clash; if the battle continued, it would surely result in mutual destruction.
“All of you, stop! Li Tianheng, have you gone mad?”
Sensing the situation, Cao Wang instantly appeared outside the two people’s arena, his face filled with anxiety.
Once the Divine Kingdom Battlefield opened, unless both parties agreed or one side’s believers were all killed, it was completely impossible to end.
Even Cao Wang, this deity teacher, could not intervene in the rules of the Virtual World.
Whether it was Li Tianheng or Yang Fan, both had decent strength and were seed players for the College Entrance Examination of Yang County No.
1 Middle School, and they still had to win glory for the school later.
Right now, their believers were fighting to the death like this, and high-tier believers were heavily consumed.
If the school’s teaching committee found out, he, the head teacher of Class 1, would probably have to step down.
Cao Wang had miscalculated Yang Fan’s strength, and even more miscalculated Li Tianheng’s hot-bloodedness.
Among this group of students, not a single one gave him peace of mind.
Hearing Cao Wang’s questioning, Li Tianheng subconsciously stopped his actions.
Seeing that the other party did not continue attacking, Yang Fan similarly stopped his believers from counterattacking.
Seeing both sides stop, Cao Wang let out a sigh of relief: “Class is ending soon, and from now on, you two are not allowed to match in arena battles.”
“I refuse.”
Li Tianheng said stubbornly.
“There are four months left until the College Entrance Examination; are you sure you want to fight over a momentary breath and gamble away your entire second half of life?”
Cao Wang rubbed his temples, his tone somewhat helpless.

These children of great families had great vision, resources, and talent, but perhaps because they grew up pampered in the palm of a hand, once they set their minds on something, they were crazy enough.
Li Tianheng did not answer; at this moment, his gaze was still filled with resentment as he looked at Yang Fan.
“Don’t go crazy, absolutely don’t go crazy; in the future, when I see you, I will definitely take a detour.”
Yang Fan prayed in his heart.
The shameless fear the fierce, the fierce fear the reckless.
The current situation was that the shameless had directly run into the reckless; wouldn’t that be a double dose of fear?
Yang Fan only wanted to work hard to develop his Divine Kingdom; for this kind of work that had no returns and involved risking his life with others, he really didn’t want any part of it.
“Enough, if you insist on acting like this, I will apply for a call with your father right now and let him come talk to you.”
Cao Wang said coldly.
Li Tianheng’s gaze gradually calmed down, and he said somewhat unwillingly: “I agree to end this match.”
“I agree too.”
Yang Fan immediately chimed in, afraid that the other party would go back on his word.
The arena restrictions were lifted.
After recalling his believers, Yang Fan immediately left the Virtual World.
“Fortunately, the losses aren’t big; these youngsters really don’t consider the consequences when doing things.”
At Yangcheng Villa, Yang Fan patted his chest, feeling a sense of having survived a disaster.
If these ten thousand elite soldiers died in this battle, it would likewise slow down the development of his Divine Kingdom.
At this moment in the Virtual World, Li Chengze had already finished his match.
“Brother, you almost scared me to death. If a large number of high-tier believers died and we returned to the Family, I would have to be punished along with you.”
Li Chengze couldn’t help saying.
“Looking at that smug look of his, I just can’t help it.”
Li Tianheng spat out a mouthful.

“Forget it, when facing a scum with such inferior character, the best way is to stay away. Dealing with this kind of person, we always suffer losses. Anyway, Yang Fan’s reputation is already stinking; whether during his student days or stepping into society, presumably no one will be willing to cooperate with him. Choosing to fight alone, this person will eventually be left behind by us in the future. If Brother really feels unhappy, why don’t we wait until we achieve Breakthrough to become deities, and then make him apologize and pay compensation.”
Li Chengze comforted him.

“That’s right, Yang Fan is just an outsider Genius of the Luo Family, relying on petty tricks to temporarily get ahead of us. Without the support of a Family, once he reaches the demigod stage, he will only be left further and further behind by us.”
Another person chimed in.

“Right now, he is like someone barefoot not afraid of someone wearing shoes; we are direct descendants of the Li Family, there’s no need to recklessly fight to the death with a mud-legged bumpkin like this. We’ll talk after the College Entrance Examination.”
Quite a few geniuses of the Li Family gathered around.

Seeing this scene, Cao Wang in the distance couldn’t help shaking his head, opened the chat box, and edited a message: “Your son’s Heart-Nature is still too poor; teach him properly yourself. Attachment: ‘Divine Kingdom Battlefield Today’s Video’.”
The next day, Yang Fan clicked on the coordinates, and his consciousness was not teleported to the Divine Kingdom Battlefield, but instead into the classroom.

Seeing that everyone had arrived, Cao Wang on the podium said loudly: “The arena battles on the Divine Kingdom Battlefield are meant to Cultivate your combat capabilities. Although there are only ten thousand troops, future large-scale believer warfare will likewise be built upon this Foundation. This is also the first exam of the College Entrance Examination, worth 100 credits. Of course, if anyone among you has the ability before the College Entrance Examination to make their ranking in the Deity Simulation War enter the top ten thousand of the entire county, you can be exempt from the test and directly obtain a full score. If you have any questions in the future regarding the utilization of Formations and combat skills in the Deity Simulation War, you can also private message me.”

chapters.title: Chapter 80: The Truth
paragraphs: “Yes, teacher,” everyone said in unison.
“Luo Bing, as the class monitor, let me ask you: after graduating from university and entering society, what is the primary work of our War School’s Divine Kingdom?” Cao Wang asked.
Luo Bing stood up and said, “To throw ourselves into the front lines to fight against Alien Gods, ensuring the flame of the human race remains inextinguishable.”
“That’s what the books say, but today I want to tell you that this stuff is just to pump up children,” Cao Wang said, shaking his head with a smile.
Upon hearing this, everyone looked surprised.
They never expected Cao Wang, who was a soldier, to say something so lacking in positive energy.
Cao Wang continued to explain, “The development of a Divine Kingdom requires a massive influx of external resources, and the best way to obtain these resources is through war.”

“Fighting against Alien Gods on the front lines—to put it nicely, that is protecting the weak, safeguarding the flame of the human race, and doing everything for the sake of humanity. To put it bluntly, it is to become stronger, to plunder resources; everything is for oneself.”
“T-teacher, hearing you say that, why do I feel like the gods on the front lines aren’t so noble anymore?”

“Hahaha, a gentleman is judged by his deeds, not his intentions. If one were to judge by intentions, of course, it isn’t noble. But if we judge by deeds, I can tell you that without them, you wouldn’t have such a comfortable life right now.”
Cao Wang took a deep breath and continued, “In this world, there is only one possibility that can make everyone strive in the same direction, and that is profit.”

“Everyone is working to develop their own Divine Kingdom, which is why they take the risk to join the front lines and participate in war, but this process itself protects the continuation of the entire human civilization.”
“Do you think those alien races are truly evil by nature? In fact, they are the same.”
“Heaven and earth are ruthless, treating all things like straw dogs. If you want to control your destiny, you can only constantly make yourself stronger.”
“Obtain resources through war to strengthen yourself, and after becoming stronger, launch even larger wars—it is a never-ending cycle.”
“Humans are like this, and alien races are like this. To be precise, this is an instinct engraved in the genes of every living being.”
“This is part of the truth of the world. Since you are all following the path of the War Divine Kingdom, you are qualified to know this truth.”
Everyone listened very attentively; Cao Wang’s words today were truly a wake-up call for them.
Why don’t other classes talk about this?
Because they are mostly on the logistics path, the capillaries of the entire human race, and in the future, they will likely just be ordinary Divine Beings, the poor at the bottom of the human race.
“Don’t touch the rich people’s cake, and don’t touch the poor people’s thoughts.”
“When you climb a little higher, you will gradually understand this simple social rule.”
“Li Tianheng, let me ask you: when you invade an Alien Divine Kingdom, what are the three things you need to do most?”
Li Tianheng stood up and said, “Use powerful strength to slaughter all the followers of the opposing god.”
“And then?”
“What else is there?” Li Tianheng scratched his head.
Cao Wang’s face darkened as he said, “You had better sit down.”
“Slaughtering the opponent’s followers and breaching the core of the Divine Kingdom is only the first step.”

“The second step is learning how to protect yourself. When you choose to invade others, your own coordinates are simultaneously exposed to the other party’s view. How to protect the core of your own Divine Kingdom is a discipline in itself.”

“The third step is digesting the harvest. A god’s kingdom is extremely vast, with a minimum of hundreds of millions of square kilometers. How to collect resources and dismantle defensive structures is a great area of knowledge.”
“As hunters, after killing your prey, you must eat it clean. Bones, flesh, skin, and even hair—every bit of resource must be utilized to the extreme. This is what is called’sustenance’.”
“The College Entrance Examination is divided into two paths: the War path and the Logistics path.”
“Our War path, in accordance with what I just said, is divided into three examinations.”
“An assessment of follower strength similar to a simulated battle against a god: 100 credits.”
“How to go to an Alien Divine Kingdom to collect resources: 100 credits.”
“How to prevent being invaded by Alien Gods and conduct a defensive war within your own Divine Kingdom: 100 credits.”
“The specific methods of the College Entrance Examination change slightly every year, but the core objective is to assess these three abilities of yours.”
At this point, Cao Wang snapped his fingers lightly, and the blackboard behind him instantly disappeared, replaced by a light blue electronic board.
“2026 Class of Yang County No. 1 Middle School Divine Kingdom Resource Collection Leaderboard:”
“Luo Bing: 0 points.”
“Li Tianheng: 0 points.”
“Next, I will disclose a set of coordinates to all students in Class One. This place is the Divine Kingdom of a First-Order God of an alien race,” Cao Wang said.
As his voice fell, the entire classroom began to bustle with noise.
“An Alien God!”
“What’s going on? Why give us the coordinates of a god’s Divine Kingdom? You don’t want us to go in, do you?!”
“Again? And this time it’s a god’s Divine Kingdom.”
“We are still Divine Beings; does it have to be this exaggerated?”
Most of the students in Class One began to freak out.
The shadows of the midterm exam were still fresh in their minds; they were truly terrified.
Even Luo Bing and Li Tianheng looked quite grim.
They were confident, but that didn’t mean they were fools.
An Alien God could easily slaughter them all just by sending a high-ranking follower; this was simply a dimensionality reduction strike.

“Quiet. The core of this Divine Kingdom has been destroyed, and the god is already dead. The school will not joke with your safety.” Speaking up to this point, Cao Wang couldn’t help but glance at Yang Fan.
According to the school’s arrangement for the midterm exam, if not for Yang Fan, there wouldn’t have been such heavy casualties.
The impact of the last accident was not small, and many families withdrew their investments because of it.
Upon hearing that the god was already dead, many people breathed a sigh of relief.
The core power of a Divine Kingdom is its followers.
With the death of the god, all followers would disintegrate at the same time.
Now it seemed, wasn’t that just a resource point?
Thinking of this, many classmates looked at each other, their eyes revealing a hint of fanaticism.

Seemingly guessing the thoughts of his students, Cao Wang added, “The core assets of this Alien God have already been taken by the school, so don’t think about picking up any bargains. Besides, those assets would be a complete waste in the Divine Kingdoms of little guys like you.”

“But rest assured, since it is the Divine Kingdom of a true god, there are still plenty of resources inside, such as Spirit Plants, demonic beasts, and various buildings. As long as you can find them, they belong to you. The value of the items obtained will finally be displayed on the leaderboard in the form of points.”

“The duration of this competition is until the day before the College Entrance Examination, which is four months—or 120 years of exploration and collection time in the Divine Kingdom. This is your main learning task from now on.”

“Let me give you a piece of advice: the area of a god’s Divine Kingdom is extremely vast. With your population and 120 years of time, you cannot fully explore it. It is best to cooperate as a team and advance into the depths to search for more valuable buildings.”
“The first place in this competition will receive strategic supplies invested by the school. Work hard.”
“From now on, there is no need to come here for class. If there is a need, I will notify you.”
Leaving these words behind, Cao Wang exited the Virtual World directly.

“Luo Bing, as the class monitor, let me ask you: after graduating from university and entering society, what is the primary work of our War School’s Divine Kingdom?” Cao Wang asked.
Luo Bing stood up and said, “To throw ourselves into the front lines to fight against Alien Gods, ensuring the flame of the human race remains inextinguishable.”
“That’s what the books say, but today I want to tell you that this stuff is just to pump up children,” Cao Wang said, shaking his head with a smile.
Upon hearing this, everyone looked surprised.
They never expected Cao Wang, who was a soldier, to say something so lacking in positive energy.
Cao Wang continued to explain, “The development of a Divine Kingdom requires a massive influx of external resources, and the best way to obtain these resources is through war.”
“Fighting against Alien Gods on the front lines—to put it nicely, that is protecting the weak, safeguarding the flame of the human race, and doing everything for the sake of humanity.
To put it bluntly, it is to become stronger, to plunder resources; everything is for oneself.”
“T-teacher, hearing you say that, why do I feel like the gods on the front lines aren’t so noble anymore?”
“Hahaha, a gentleman is judged by his deeds, not his intentions.
If one were to judge by intentions, of course, it isn’t noble.
But if we judge by deeds, I can tell you that without them, you wouldn’t have such a comfortable life right now.”
Cao Wang took a deep breath and continued, “In this world, there is only one possibility that can make everyone strive in the same direction, and that is profit.”

“Everyone is working to develop their own Divine Kingdom, which is why they take the risk to join the front lines and participate in war, but this process itself protects the continuation of the entire human civilization.”
“Do you think those alien races are truly evil by nature?
In fact, they are the same.”
“Heaven and earth are ruthless, treating all things like straw dogs.
If you want to control your destiny, you can only constantly make yourself stronger.”
“Obtain resources through war to strengthen yourself, and after becoming stronger, launch even larger wars—it is a never-ending cycle.”
“Humans are like this, and alien races are like this.
To be precise, this is an instinct engraved in the genes of every living being.”
“This is part of the truth of the world.
Since you are all following the path of the War Divine Kingdom, you are qualified to know this truth.”
Everyone listened very attentively; Cao Wang’s words today were truly a wake-up call for them.
Why don’t other classes talk about this?
Because they are mostly on the logistics path, the capillaries of the entire human race, and in the future, they will likely just be ordinary Divine Beings, the poor at the bottom of the human race.
“Don’t touch the rich people’s cake, and don’t touch the poor people’s thoughts.”
“When you climb a little higher, you will gradually understand this simple social rule.”
“Li Tianheng, let me ask you: when you invade an Alien Divine Kingdom, what are the three things you need to do most?”
Li Tianheng stood up and said, “Use powerful strength to slaughter all the followers of the opposing god.”
“And then?”
“What else is there?” Li Tianheng scratched his head.
Cao Wang’s face darkened as he said, “You had better sit down.”
“Slaughtering the opponent’s followers and breaching the core of the Divine Kingdom is only the first step.”
“The second step is learning how to protect yourself.
When you choose to invade others, your own coordinates are simultaneously exposed to the other party’s view.
How to protect the core of your own Divine Kingdom is a discipline in itself.”
“The third step is digesting the harvest.
A god’s kingdom is extremely vast, with a minimum of hundreds of millions of square kilometers.
How to collect resources and dismantle defensive structures is a great area of knowledge.”
“As hunters, after killing your prey, you must eat it clean.
Bones, flesh, skin, and even hair—every bit of resource must be utilized to the extreme.
This is what is called’sustenance’.”
“The College Entrance Examination is divided into two paths: the War path and the Logistics path.”
“Our War path, in accordance with what I just said, is divided into three examinations.”
“An assessment of follower strength similar to a simulated battle against a god: 100 credits.”
“How to go to an Alien Divine Kingdom to collect resources: 100 credits.”
“How to prevent being invaded by Alien Gods and conduct a defensive war within your own Divine Kingdom: 100 credits.”
“The specific methods of the College Entrance Examination change slightly every year, but the core objective is to assess these three abilities of yours.”
At this point, Cao Wang snapped his fingers lightly, and the blackboard behind him instantly disappeared, replaced by a light blue electronic board.
“2026 Class of Yang County No.
1 Middle School Divine Kingdom Resource Collection Leaderboard:”
“Luo Bing: 0 points.”
“Li Tianheng: 0 points.”
“Next, I will disclose a set of coordinates to all students in Class One.
This place is the Divine Kingdom of a First-Order God of an alien race,” Cao Wang said.
As his voice fell, the entire classroom began to bustle with noise.
“An Alien God!”
“What’s going on?
Why give us the coordinates of a god’s Divine Kingdom?
You don’t want us to go in, do you?!”
“Again?
And this time it’s a god’s Divine Kingdom.”
“We are still Divine Beings; does it have to be this exaggerated?”
Most of the students in Class One began to freak out.
The shadows of the midterm exam were still fresh in their minds; they were truly terrified.
Even Luo Bing and Li Tianheng looked quite grim.
They were confident, but that didn’t mean they were fools.
An Alien God could easily slaughter them all just by sending a high-ranking follower; this was simply a dimensionality reduction strike.
“Quiet.
The core of this Divine Kingdom has been destroyed, and the god is already dead.
The school will not joke with your safety.” Speaking up to this point, Cao Wang couldn’t help but glance at Yang Fan.
According to the school’s arrangement for the midterm exam, if not for Yang Fan, there wouldn’t have been such heavy casualties.
The impact of the last accident was not small, and many families withdrew their investments because of it.
Upon hearing that the god was already dead, many people breathed a sigh of relief.
The core power of a Divine Kingdom is its followers.
With the death of the god, all followers would disintegrate at the same time.
Now it seemed, wasn’t that just a resource point?
Thinking of this, many classmates looked at each other, their eyes revealing a hint of fanaticism.
Seemingly guessing the thoughts of his students, Cao Wang added, “The core assets of this Alien God have already been taken by the school, so don’t think about picking up any bargains.
Besides, those assets would be a complete waste in the Divine Kingdoms of little guys like you.”
“But rest assured, since it is the Divine Kingdom of a true god, there are still plenty of resources inside, such as Spirit Plants, demonic beasts, and various buildings.
As long as you can find them, they belong to you.
The value of the items obtained will finally be displayed on the leaderboard in the form of points.”
“The duration of this competition is until the day before the College Entrance Examination, which is four months—or 120 years of exploration and collection time in the Divine Kingdom.
This is your main learning task from now on.”
“Let me give you a piece of advice: the area of a god’s Divine Kingdom is extremely vast.
With your population and 120 years of time, you cannot fully explore it.
It is best to cooperate as a team and advance into the depths to search for more valuable buildings.”
“The first place in this competition will receive strategic supplies invested by the school.
Work hard.”
“From now on, there is no need to come here for class.
If there is a need, I will notify you.”
Leaving these words behind, Cao Wang exited the Virtual World directly.

chapters.title: Chapter 81: Financial Loan
paragraphs: At the same time, all the students in Class 1 received the Divine Kingdom coordinates.
A Divine Kingdom without a God posed no danger to them at all; at most, their believers might suffer losses due to the harsh environment.
Quite a few people had already used the coordinates to enter with their consciousness and scout it out.
Feeling the rich life aura within that Divine Kingdom, they returned to the classroom with excitement filling every single one of their faces.
First High School was truly generous in cultivating its students, allowing them to acquire a substantial amount of resources through this over the course of four months.
“Brother Li, can you add one more person?”
“Sister Bing, let me join your team.”
“Brother Tie, why don’t we pull a few people together?”
Most of the classmates did not leave the Virtual World immediately, but instead seized this opportunity to form cliques with each other.
After all, the teacher had just said that it was best to explore together.
The deeper they went, the more abundant the resources obtained would be.
Even if they needed to split them equally later, that would still be much better than exploring the outer periphery.
Soon, the entire Class 1 was divided into two factions.
One faction was headed by Luo Bing, and the other was headed by Li Tianheng.
After all, only the first place could receive the school’s reward this time, so these two naturally became competitors.
Coincidentally, both the Luo Family and the Li Family had quite a few Geniuses in Class 1.
At this moment, they were evenly matched.

Besides that, there were also some small groups composed of four or five people who couldn’t measure up to Luo Bing and Li Tianheng’s teams, and decided to huddle together for warmth to fish for more resources to develop their Divine Kingdoms.
Only Yang Fan sat blankly in the last row alone.
Even though his strength was quite good, no one dared to cooperate with him.
Even as a second-tier Genius of the Luo Family, Yang Fan likewise did not receive an invitation from Luo Bing.
“Who cares!” Yang Fan complained inwardly, not wanting to stay here and lose face any longer, and immediately exited the Virtual World.
Inside the Yangcheng Villa, Yang Fan followed the coordinates, and his consciousness entered that Divine Kingdom.
“Yang Yi, do you have any good suggestions?” Yang Fan asked in his heart.
“Master, this Divine Kingdom has no obvious signs of being mined, and the amount of resources it possesses is immeasurable.
The following suggestions are now given:
Go find Luo Bing and proactively establish a contract to join her team.
With the strength displayed by Master, there is a 50% success rate, and the efficiency is about ten times that of exploring alone.
Explore alone.
With the current Divine Kingdom troops, 120 years of time can only grope around in the outermost periphery, yielding at most 10 billion Faith Points.
Purchase an exploration-type high-order Intelligent Life.
Efficiency will be increased by at least ten times, and 120 years will be enough to recover the cost.”
Returning his consciousness to reality, Yang Fan immediately opened the Divine Shop and searched for an exploration-type high-order Intelligent Life.

“Exploration-type high-order Intelligent Life: Priced at 10 billion Faith Points. A special life form nurtured by the will of the Deity, specializing in external exploration and resource acquisition, possessing a high degree of autonomous action capability and extremely strong environmental adaptability. Its core ability lies in information analysis, allowing it to quickly establish cognitive models in unfamiliar environments, conduct systematic analyses of terrain structures, energy distribution, and civilizational forms, and formulate optimal exploration plans accordingly. It is capable of identifying defense Systems, finding weak nodes, and achieving efficient intrusion and resource acquisition. This life form possesses a complete knowledge base and dynamic learning capabilities. It is recommended to grant secondary command authority, allowing it to independently dispatch believer units during external operations to execute a series of tasks such as gathering, construction, transportation, and combat, achieving the integrated operation of exploration and development. [Evaluation]: The core Intelligent Life for external exploration and resource acquisition, combining analysis, command, and strategic expansion capabilities.”
“Yang Yi, what level of Intelligent Life is it?” Yang Fan asked.
“Fourth-class Intelligent Life.”
“Why is the price so much more expensive than yours?”

“The scope of abilities is different. I focus on Divine Kingdom development, similar to a relatively weak Actuary. Meanwhile, the exploration-type high-order Intelligent Life mainly focuses on collecting resources and can also command some simple combat missions. Solely in terms of computing power, I am on par with it, but on the market, it is more in demand, hence the higher price.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan fell into silence.
Ten billion Faith Points were too expensive for him right now; even if he wanted to buy it, he couldn’t afford it.
“Could it be that I have to wait another two months?” Yang Fan felt somewhat hesitant in his heart.
This was the Divine Kingdom of an alien First-Order God, and losing sixty years of exploration time was too heavy a price to pay.
“Master, perhaps we can apply for a mortgage loan,” Yang Yi reminded him.
“A loan?”

“That’s right, Master has three strategic resources in the Divine Kingdom: the Enlightenment Stone, Spirit Peach Mountain, and Penglai Island. Quite a few loan companies would be willing to cooperate.”
“What is the specific suggestion?”

“Using the Enlightenment Stone as collateral can completely satisfy this funding gap. Please grant me the mortgage permission for the Enlightenment Stone, and I will immediately negotiate with major loan companies.”
“Good.” Yang Fan immediately agreed.
Less than two minutes later, Yang Yi’s voice appeared once more.
“We negotiated with a total of 103 loan companies, and have now screened out the two most suitable ones.”
“Jingxi Finance: Mortgage the Enlightenment Stone, loan amount of 30 billion Faith Points, monthly interest rate of 20%.”
“Elephant Loan: Mortgage the Enlightenment Stone, loan amount of 100 billion Faith Points, monthly interest rate of 10%.”
Hearing the prompt tone, Yang Fan was completely dumbfounded.
“Over a hundred companies, and you finished negotiations so quickly?” Yang Fan expressed great shock.
“Major companies have high-order Intelligent Life handling transactional work, and our efficiency is one hundred million times that of humans,” Yang Yi explained.
“Awesome.”
Looking at the conditions of these two loan companies, Yang Fan furrowed his brows slightly: “Aren’t these interest rates a bit too high?”

“Reporting to Master, mortgage loans are mainly short-term borrowings. This is already the most suitable one I could choose; among them, Particle Loan and Anxin Loan have monthly interest rates as high as 50%.”
“Why are the quotas and interest rates given by these two companies so different?”

“Jingxi Finance’s 20% monthly interest is within the normal range, while Elephant Loan gave such a high quota presumably with the intention that Master won’t be able to pay it back, allowing them to confiscate the collateral. Taking this exploration of the Divine Kingdom as the goal, 30 billion Faith Points are more than enough. It is recommended that Master choose Jingxi Finance,” Yang Yi said.
Yang Fan shook his head: “No, I grant you permission to contact Elephant Loan, sign the contract, and we will directly mortgage for 100 billion.”
With the Evolution Talent, Yang Fan didn’t worry about this 10% monthly interest at all.
Even if Elephant Loan gave 200 billion, Yang Fan would still dare to swallow it down with courage.

After spending this period of time getting along with Yang Yi, Yang Fan discovered one thing: even though the other party possessed secondary permissions and could even communicate with the outside world, it seemed to be restricted by another layer of rules, failing to perceive that the time flow rate of his Divine Kingdom was different from other people’s.
Since the other party had helped him handle so many real-world matters, it should have noticed long ago.
But Yang Yi acted as if it didn’t know the SSS-rank Talent existed at all.
Yang Yi was bound to his Deity Origin in the first place, so he wasn’t worried about the other party betraying him; Yang Fan was just somewhat curious about this.
“As expected of an SSS-rank Talent, it can actually prevent even such a powerful Intelligent Life from perceiving the slightest trace!” Yang Fan sighed inwardly in his heart.

“Contract successfully signed, 100 billion funds have arrived in the account, interest is calculated daily, and Party B can repay the principal and interest at any time. If interest is not paid for two consecutive months, the collateral will be confiscated, settling the account completely.”
“Faith Points: 101.5 billion.”

chapters.title: Chapter 82: Assets Skyrocket Who Else
paragraphs: Yang Fan did not hesitate and immediately purchased a high-tier exploration-type Intelligent Life.
As the Intelligent Life loaded into the Divine Kingdom, a green ball of light appeared before Yang Fan’s consciousness.
“Please select the appearance, gender, personality, and name.”
“Randomize everything, and name it Yang Er.”
As Yang Fan finished speaking, a little boy who looked only seven or eight years old evolved from the green light.
“Yang Er greets Master.” The little boy bowed to Yang Fan, his expression somewhat shy.
Yang Fan was somewhat surprised; he hadn’t expected that choosing random for simplicity would result in the appearance of a child.
Yang Fan didn’t mind; after all, it was an Intelligent Life, and its abilities were absolutely unquestionable.
“I am giving you secondary authority, as well as the coordinates of the target’s Divine Kingdom.” Yang Fan decided quickly.
As Yang Fan’s Intelligent Life, Yang Er’s consciousness could also enter the Divine Kingdom made public by the school.

“Detected First-Order God Divine Kingdom, rich in life aura, abundant Spirit Plants, no signs of destruction, extremely high exploration value. The exploration time for the Divine Kingdom is 120 years. Combining the current population and military status of the Divine Kingdom, I request 5,000 Tier 2 Beings, 500,000 Tier 1 Beings, and 3 million ordinary Mortal. To improve exploration efficiency, I need to purchase drones, spectrum detectors, and portable simple warehouses; I specifically request 2 billion in funds.” Yang Er quickly concluded.
“Request approved.” Yang Fan nodded, then said to Yang Yi: “Keep a portion as reserve funds, and use the rest to purchase 40 Monkey Wine Springs.”
“Master, wouldn’t this investment be too risky? In the long run, the value of an Enlightenment Stone is higher.”
Yang Yi had no human emotions; it merely analyzed calmly and stated the conclusion.

“Don’t worry, I have my own methods. From now on, every month, apart from setting aside 10 billion Faith Points to pay interest, all other income will be invested in Monkey Wine Springs. I want to purchase 100 of them in a short time.”
Since Yang Yi could not perceive the existence of the Evolution Talent, Yang Fan had to issue the order himself.
100 Monkey Wine Springs would basically occupy more than half the production capacity of Spirit Peach Mountain.
By then, his monthly income from Faith Points alone would reach as high as 100 billion.
If he had known earlier that he could take out a mortgage loan, he would have done it long ago; he wouldn’t have waited until now.
Under the effect of the Evolution Talent, even investing in low-return buildings like a Moon Well would yield a 10% profit every month.
After this incident, Yang Fan had learned of another channel to obtain funds.
In the future, after he becomes a demigod or a god, if there are better investments, he could completely use this method to borrow and rapidly expand his capital.
Returning to reality, with Yang Fan’s perception, Yang Er had already turned into a consciousness entity and appeared on the outskirts of the Alien Divine Kingdom.

He did not rashly go deep inside, but instead took out dozens of miniature drone detectors, which separated from behind him, turned into tiny streams of light, and quickly vanished into the surrounding forests and mountains.
A moment later, a large amount of data began to be transmitted back.
Terrain structure, energy fluctuations, life density...
All information was quickly constructed into a complete model in Yang Er’s consciousness.
“In the outer region of the Divine Kingdom, resources are sparsely distributed, with localized high-energy reaction points,” Yang Er muttered to himself.
The next moment, he waved his hand, and several million believers instantly arrived at this location.
“Target locked: Spirit Plant resources. Team one, harvest and store in Warehouse No. 1.”
Although the god of this Divine Kingdom was dead, the ecosystem of the Divine Kingdom was not destroyed.
Under such lush greenery, there were naturally quite a few wild beasts.
However, under Yang Er’s detection, when those wild beasts were still several kilometers away, he had already dispatched squads to hunt them down, minimizing losses to the greatest extent.
“Outer perimeter cleared, risks under control, conditions for further exploration met.”
As a god, even though his consciousness was in the real world at this moment, as long as he wished, he could clearly observe everything happening around Yang Er.
Watching Yang Er’s actions, Yang Fan felt that this didn’t look like exploration, but rather a standardized resource collection process.
“It really has to be a high-tier Intelligent Life; this efficiency is much higher than mine,” Yang Fan couldn’t help but exclaim.
Only now did Yang Fan truly understand what Cao Wang meant by “do not waste.”
Throughout Yang Er’s entire collection process, anything that could be sold in the marketplace, regardless of its value, he would send people to collect.
Low-level Spirit Plants, carcasses of ranked monsters, and even that spiritual soil—this operation was simply like bandits raiding a village, checking even the toilets.
Since the god of this place was dead, the Federation’s Intelligent Life had already covered the entire Divine Kingdom.
Every collection by all students was recorded and updated in real-time.
“Yang Fan: 20,000 points.” “Yang Fan: 50,000 points.” “Yang Fan: 120,000 points.”...
With Yang Er there, Yang Fan didn’t have to worry at all.
After realizing there was nothing else to do, he hugged Luo Rou and went to sleep.
With technology developed to this point, people must learn to enjoy themselves.
If there’s work, machines do it; if there’s nothing to do...
ahem, nothing to do, sleep well and spend more time with family; that is the right thing to do.
The resources obtained by Yang Er from exploring the Alien Divine Kingdom were brought back to the Divine Kingdom in batches via portable warehouses.

Yang Yi, on the other hand, managed the development of the Divine Kingdom, using Breeding Cards to propagate the population and provide troop reinforcements and logistical supplies for Yang Er’s exploration.
As for the resources brought back, they were also listed for sale in the marketplace in batches, and subsequently, fixed assets like Monkey Wine Springs were purchased.
As a god, Yang Fan was like a loafer during this time.
After inspecting the situation on both sides every day, he found there was nothing for him to do.
At night, he would cuddle with his wife, and during the day, he would sneak off to the Tianxiang Renjian to see his old friends.
There was no helping it; life was too good, and satiety breeds lust!
Quickly, a month flashed by.

Because the exploration of the Alien Divine Kingdom was still at the outermost stage, even with Yang Er’s efficiency, in the 30 years within the Divine Kingdom, he had only brought back resources worth 2 billion.
Regarding this, Yang Fan was quite satisfied, because his score was already far in the lead.
“Yang Fan, 2.142 billion points. Luo Bing, 896 million points. Li Tianheng, 799 million points... Li Shuhao, 22 million points...”
Looking at the rankings, Yang Fan wouldn’t be foolish enough to think that he had secured first place this time.
The reason he was more than double Luo Bing and the others was entirely because the resource density and value in this outer area were too low, and this was the area Yang Er was best at.
When they reached the depths of the Divine Kingdom, perhaps any random building encountered would be worth hundreds of millions or even billions.
The true final ranking would still depend on strength.
Even so, Yang Fan was secretly pleased.
Who told these people to look down on him?
Now he was crushing them.
Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom was also developing very well.
Apart from reserving about 15 billion as insurance funds, Yang Yi invested all the remaining Faith Points into Monkey Wine Springs; there were now 63 of them.
Under the ten-fold Evolution Talent, the monthly income Yang Fan could obtain was as high as 63 billion.
Perhaps in just over a month, the goal of 100 Monkey Wine Springs could be achieved.
Thinking of the monthly income of 100 billion Faith Points, Yang Fan really wanted to ask those classmates who looked down on him during class: “Who else?”
“Low profile, keep a low profile!” Inside the villa, Yang Fan was eating spiritual fruits from his Divine Kingdom.

Yang Fan was somewhat surprised; he hadn’t expected that choosing random for simplicity would result in the appearance of a child.
Yang Fan didn’t mind; after all, it was an Intelligent Life, and its abilities were absolutely unquestionable.
“I am giving you secondary authority, as well as the coordinates of the target’s Divine Kingdom.” Yang Fan decided quickly.
As Yang Fan’s Intelligent Life, Yang Er’s consciousness could also enter the Divine Kingdom made public by the school.
“Detected First-Order God Divine Kingdom, rich in life aura, abundant Spirit Plants, no signs of destruction, extremely high exploration value.
The exploration time for the Divine Kingdom is 120 years.
Combining the current population and military status of the Divine Kingdom, I request 5,000 Tier 2 Beings, 500,000 Tier 1 Beings, and 3 million ordinary Mortal.
To improve exploration efficiency, I need to purchase drones, spectrum detectors, and portable simple warehouses; I specifically request 2 billion in funds.” Yang Er quickly concluded.
“Request approved.” Yang Fan nodded, then said to Yang Yi: “Keep a portion as reserve funds, and use the rest to purchase 40 Monkey Wine Springs.”
“Master, wouldn’t this investment be too risky?
In the long run, the value of an Enlightenment Stone is higher.”
Yang Yi had no human emotions; it merely analyzed calmly and stated the conclusion.
“Don’t worry, I have my own methods.
From now on, every month, apart from setting aside 10 billion Faith Points to pay interest, all other income will be invested in Monkey Wine Springs.
I want to purchase 100 of them in a short time.”
Since Yang Yi could not perceive the existence of the Evolution Talent, Yang Fan had to issue the order himself.
100 Monkey Wine Springs would basically occupy more than half the production capacity of Spirit Peach Mountain.
By then, his monthly income from Faith Points alone would reach as high as 100 billion.
If he had known earlier that he could take out a mortgage loan, he would have done it long ago; he wouldn’t have waited until now.
Under the effect of the Evolution Talent, even investing in low-return buildings like a Moon Well would yield a 10% profit every month.
After this incident, Yang Fan had learned of another channel to obtain funds.
In the future, after he becomes a demigod or a god, if there are better investments, he could completely use this method to borrow and rapidly expand his capital.
Returning to reality, with Yang Fan’s perception, Yang Er had already turned into a consciousness entity and appeared on the outskirts of the Alien Divine Kingdom.

He did not rashly go deep inside, but instead took out dozens of miniature drone detectors, which separated from behind him, turned into tiny streams of light, and quickly vanished into the surrounding forests and mountains.
A moment later, a large amount of data began to be transmitted back.
Terrain structure, energy fluctuations, life density...
All information was quickly constructed into a complete model in Yang Er’s consciousness.
“In the outer region of the Divine Kingdom, resources are sparsely distributed, with localized high-energy reaction points,” Yang Er muttered to himself.
The next moment, he waved his hand, and several million believers instantly arrived at this location.
“Target locked: Spirit Plant resources.
Team one, harvest and store in Warehouse No.
Although the god of this Divine Kingdom was dead, the ecosystem of the Divine Kingdom was not destroyed.
Under such lush greenery, there were naturally quite a few wild beasts.
However, under Yang Er’s detection, when those wild beasts were still several kilometers away, he had already dispatched squads to hunt them down, minimizing losses to the greatest extent.
“Outer perimeter cleared, risks under control, conditions for further exploration met.”
As a god, even though his consciousness was in the real world at this moment, as long as he wished, he could clearly observe everything happening around Yang Er.
Watching Yang Er’s actions, Yang Fan felt that this didn’t look like exploration, but rather a standardized resource collection process.
“It really has to be a high-tier Intelligent Life; this efficiency is much higher than mine,” Yang Fan couldn’t help but exclaim.
Only now did Yang Fan truly understand what Cao Wang meant by “do not waste.”
Throughout Yang Er’s entire collection process, anything that could be sold in the marketplace, regardless of its value, he would send people to collect.
Low-level Spirit Plants, carcasses of ranked monsters, and even that spiritual soil—this operation was simply like bandits raiding a village, checking even the toilets.
Since the god of this place was dead, the Federation’s Intelligent Life had already covered the entire Divine Kingdom.
Every collection by all students was recorded and updated in real-time.
“Yang Fan: 20,000 points.” “Yang Fan: 50,000 points.” “Yang Fan: 120,000 points.”...
With Yang Er there, Yang Fan didn’t have to worry at all.
After realizing there was nothing else to do, he hugged Luo Rou and went to sleep.
With technology developed to this point, people must learn to enjoy themselves.
If there’s work, machines do it; if there’s nothing to do...
ahem, nothing to do, sleep well and spend more time with family; that is the right thing to do.
The resources obtained by Yang Er from exploring the Alien Divine Kingdom were brought back to the Divine Kingdom in batches via portable warehouses.

Yang Yi, on the other hand, managed the development of the Divine Kingdom, using Breeding Cards to propagate the population and provide troop reinforcements and logistical supplies for Yang Er’s exploration.
As for the resources brought back, they were also listed for sale in the marketplace in batches, and subsequently, fixed assets like Monkey Wine Springs were purchased.
As a god, Yang Fan was like a loafer during this time.
After inspecting the situation on both sides every day, he found there was nothing for him to do.
At night, he would cuddle with his wife, and during the day, he would sneak off to the Tianxiang Renjian to see his old friends.
There was no helping it; life was too good, and satiety breeds lust!
Quickly, a month flashed by.

Because the exploration of the Alien Divine Kingdom was still at the outermost stage, even with Yang Er’s efficiency, in the 30 years within the Divine Kingdom, he had only brought back resources worth 2 billion.
Regarding this, Yang Fan was quite satisfied, because his score was already far in the lead.
“Yang Fan, 2.142 billion points.
Luo Bing, 896 million points.
Li Tianheng, 799 million points...
Li Shuhao, 22 million points...”
Looking at the rankings, Yang Fan wouldn’t be foolish enough to think that he had secured first place this time.
The reason he was more than double Luo Bing and the others was entirely because the resource density and value in this outer area were too low, and this was the area Yang Er was best at.
When they reached the depths of the Divine Kingdom, perhaps any random building encountered would be worth hundreds of millions or even billions.
The true final ranking would still depend on strength.
Even so, Yang Fan was secretly pleased.
Who told these people to look down on him?
Now he was crushing them.
Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom was also developing very well.
Apart from reserving about 15 billion as insurance funds, Yang Yi invested all the remaining Faith Points into Monkey Wine Springs; there were now 63 of them.
Under the ten-fold Evolution Talent, the monthly income Yang Fan could obtain was as high as 63 billion.
Perhaps in just over a month, the goal of 100 Monkey Wine Springs could be achieved.
Thinking of the monthly income of 100 billion Faith Points, Yang Fan really wanted to ask those classmates who looked down on him during class: “Who else?”
“Low profile, keep a low profile!” Inside the villa, Yang Fan was eating spiritual fruits from his Divine Kingdom.

chapters.title: Chapter 83: Nonsense Literature
paragraphs: On the other side, Li Tianheng’s team was commanding their followers to slaughter the 3,000 low-level demonic beasts before them.
Opening the leaderboard and looking at Yang Fan’s points, Li Tianheng’s eyelids twitched uncontrollably.
He couldn’t understand why, after he and his brothers had been exploring non-stop, day and night, for this entire period, they had been left so far behind by the other party.
“How did that bastard manage this?” Li Tianheng said through gritted teeth.
Li Chengze didn’t understand it either.
After all, they were a ten-person team.
Even though the resources they obtained had to be split, the distance they could penetrate into the Divine Kingdom was not something a lone wolf like Yang Fan could compare to.
With only his own forces, Yang Fan was likely still exploring the outer perimeter.
“Brother Tianheng, rumor has it that Yang Fan was a top student in Class 7. Could it be that he really has some insight into resource gathering?” Li Chengze asked skeptically.
“Really? Is there actually a trick to gathering resources?” Li Tianheng was equally confused.
If it were just a small difference, it might be fine; perhaps one could say it was luck, or that Yang Fan had some gathering techniques.
But the gap was too large—anyone who didn’t know better would think he was collecting resources deep within the Divine Kingdom.
“There’s someone named Li Shuhao who seems to be his classmate. I’ll have someone ask around.”
“No need. The real deciding factor is deep within the Divine Kingdom. I will take first place based on my own strength,” Li Tianheng refused directly.
Seeing this, Li Chengze couldn’t help but sigh in his heart.
“Big Brother is too stubborn. I’ll make arrangements secretly. If there really is a good method, everyone will be able to harvest a lot more during this time.” Li Chengze secretly made a decision.
As much as he disliked Yang Fan, no one would turn their back on Faith Points.
Yang City villa.

“Husband, can you continue to accompany me shopping today? The First Department Store has some new arrivals. I heard those clothes are from a Tier 2 Cultivation Divine Kingdom and are engraved with dust-repelling and waterproof arrays. I want to go take a look.” Luo Rou held Yang Fan’s hand and acted coquettishly.
Upon hearing this, Yang Fan forced a wry smile.
One day, he was genuinely bored, so he accompanied Luo Rou for a shopping trip.
It was pure torture.
She tried on twenty or thirty items in one store.
Yang Fan went from standing to sitting, and finally to lying down.
Yang Fan truly couldn’t understand how anyone could enjoy such a boring activity.
Now that they weren’t short on money, they could just shop online for even the most high-end clothing, and it could be materialized into reality in minutes.
He simply couldn’t understand how those physical shops in reality managed to survive.
Just as Yang Fan was pondering how to refuse, a message came through on his watch.

“My good friend has something important to discuss with me. Definitely next time.” Yang Fan opened Li Shuhao’s invitation to show her, and then put on his virtual helmet as if he were fleeing for his life.
Arriving at the private room in Tianxiang Renjian, before the other party could even start talking about business, Yang Fan sent a message and called his old friend, Liu Ruyan, over.
“Brother Yang, why haven’t you seen me in so long?”
Yang Fan opened his arms, and she sat on his lap naturally.
The movement was fluid and perfectly in sync.
Seeing this scene, Li Shuhao was stunned and couldn’t help but say, “Brother Yang, you’re quite practiced at this.”
“Do it enough times, and you get used to it. Practice makes perfect!” Yang Fan said shamelessly.
Li Shuhao coughed.
“Well, Brother Yang, your points are firmly in first place. I thought you were busy exploring the Divine Kingdom the whole time; I didn’t expect to actually be able to book an appointment with you.”

“Let’s meet often when we have time. Although exploring the Divine Kingdom consumes energy, one must occasionally come here to relax. Staying in a high-pressure state all the time will actually reduce the efficiency of gathering resources. We must learn to balance work and rest.” Yang Fan spoke nonsense with a straight face.
During this time, Li Shuhao had been acting like a mouse seeing a cat whenever he saw him, and he hadn’t even sent any messages to explain privately.
Now that they were meeting suddenly, it wasn’t hard to guess that someone had put him up to it.
Naturally, Yang Fan wouldn’t treat him with sincerity.
“Brother Yang, your efficiency is ridiculously high. Do you have any tips to guide a brother?” Li Shuhao rubbed his hands together, looking slightly embarrassed.
“Small matter. Let me recommend a few books to you.”
“I’d appreciate your guidance, Brother Yang.”
“Guide to Resource Gathering in the Divine Kingdom, On the Dynamic Distribution of Spirit Plants, and Appreciation of the Alien Divine Kingdom Compendium,” Yang Fan said.
Li Shuhao frowned, his eyes filled with confusion.
“Um... Brother Yang, aren’t these the compulsory education textbooks for fifth grade of elementary school?”
“That’s right!”
“Can these be useful?”

“That’s where you don’t understand. Do you know that all theorems are derived from axioms? Similarly, all profound knowledge evolves from these basic contents. As long as you thoroughly understand these few books, you’ll grasp the fundamental principles behind everything.”
“Right now in the Alien Divine Kingdom, by following the knowledge I learned from the books, I can easily find the Spirit Plant gardens and clusters of demonic beasts.”

“One only regrets having read too little when the time comes to use it. Only now do I realize how much I missed in elementary school. During this time, I’ve spent my days exploring the Divine Kingdom and my nights studying elementary school textbooks. It wasn’t easy to carve out time to see you.” Yang Fan took a sip of the red wine in front of him, his eyes revealing a hint of profundity.
“Really?”
“Truer than real gold!”
“Brother Yang, are you messing with me?”

“How could that be? With my character, I would never scam my own brother. Remember to settle the bill. I’m going to the room next door.” After saying that, Yang Fan took Liu Ruyan’s hand and walked out.
Watching Yang Fan’s back, Li Shuhao sat there, falling into deep self-doubt.
“This is the chat video, Brother Chengze. I’ve sent the message to the group chat.” Li Shuhao sent the message.
“Damn, that dog Yang Fan is actually talking about character? Hasn’t he scammed enough brothers? I told you not to ask, but you insisted on going. @Li Chengze.”
“Brother, you finished watching it so fast? @Li Tianheng”
In another room, just as Yang Fan was about to get to the main point, his wrist suddenly beeped with a notification.
Seeing the identity of the sender, he was a bit conflicted about whether to go or not.
“Sister Ruyan, I have something to take care of. I’ll transfer 10,000 as a tip. Let’s meet again when we have time.”
Yang Fan got dressed, tapped the coordinates, and left Tianxiang Renjian.
“Sister Bing, I wonder why you are looking for me?” Yang Fan said politely.
Although he had scammed Luo Bing, she had much more class than Li Tianheng, and she hadn’t taken revenge on him even now.
“Why is your resource gathering so fast?” Luo Bing went straight to the point.
“This...”
“If it’s inconvenient, forget it. Goodbye.”
As soon as she finished speaking, the other party vanished instantly.
Seeing this, Yang Fan was left completely stunned.
What was that?
Is this person sick?
Not only did she interrupt his good time, but she also left so quickly.
Are you messing with me?
And it’s not like I said I wouldn’t tell you!
After leaving, Luo Bing arrived at a conference room.
“Sister Bing, this is the video leaked from the boys’ group. They said Li Shuhao has already found out Yang Fan’s secret, so we don’t need to ask that scumbag.”
“Good, project it now. Let’s study it together.” Luo Bing nodded seriously.
A dozen or so geniuses from the Luo Family sat upright in the conference room, watching the conversation between Yang Fan and Li Shuhao with serious expressions, afraid of missing a single detail.
A full quarter of an hour passed before the video ended, and the entire conference room was abnormally quiet.
“Um... Sister Bing, my younger sister seems to be in the fifth grade. Should I borrow a book from her to take a look?” One of them hesitated, unsure whether what Yang Fan said was true or false.
This sentence seemed to make some sense, but it also felt like nonsense literature!

chapters.title: Chapter 84: Birth of a Tier 5 Being
paragraphs: Yang County No.
1 Middle School Academic Affairs Office.
Cao Wang was holding a stack of documents and looking for Yang Wanli to approve a requisition slip.
“Director Yang, the College Entrance Examination is coming up soon. We can’t skimp on the site rental fees for these Virtual World realms. Please sign off on it quickly!” Cao Wang said anxiously.

“Money is needed everywhere, and we’ve had a lot less investment recently. The school has to tighten its belt to get by. Old Cao, you can’t be as reckless with money as you used to be.” Yang Wanli complained while signing.

“The students this batch have great Aptitude. Once the College Entrance Examination is over, the funding from the Federal Government will definitely be substantial.” Cao Wang patted his chest and guaranteed.
“I trust your teaching ability, and the school will definitely not default on the special buildings promised to you.”
“Then many thanks, Director Yang.”
“Right, isn’t Class 1, Grade 12 currently conducting Divine Kingdom resource collection training? How are their results?”
“They’re still in the outer periphery. I haven’t paid attention either, let me check.”
Cao Wang opened the current leaderboard.
The two of them stared intently at the leaderboard, gazing at it for three seconds without moving an inch.

“Yang Fan? No, why is his score leading by so much? Did he go straight to the inner periphery? The Divine Kingdom has only been established for 30 years. Without believers above the Qi Refining Stage, how could that be possible?” Yang Wanli looked at Cao Wang with a face full of doubt.
Cao Wang also shook his head, indicating that he didn’t know.
“You’re his homeroom teacher, hurry up and apply for a real-time recording from the Intelligent Life.”
“Alright.”
As the two looked at the situation of Yang Fan’s believers within the Alien Divine Kingdom, their expressions gradually became colorful.

Cao Wang’s facial muscles twitched, and his breathing grew a bit heavier: “Shirking work and playing tricks, is this brat pulling that stunt again? He actually purchased an exploration-type Advanced Intelligent Life, this...”

“Hahaha, this guy is really interesting. I remember the school rewarded him with 10 billion during the mid-term exam, right? Did he dump all of it in here?” Yang Wanli’s expression was somewhat shocked.
The main consumers of such Advanced Intelligent Life were true deities.
From another perspective, only after becoming a deity would your Divine Kingdom find it necessary to be equipped with such Intelligent Life.
Just a mere Divine Being, having an Advanced Intelligent Life help manage the Divine Kingdom and gather resources—wasn’t this a blatant waste of resources?
Who knew how many Advanced buildings 10 billion Faith Points could buy; it would be enough to multiply the Divine Kingdom’s ecosystem several times over.
Yang Wanli couldn’t understand Yang Fan’s actions, but he felt deeply shocked.
“Does this brat want to earn those 10 billion back through this resource collection?” Yang Wanli speculated.

“Fool! The core of a Divine Kingdom’s development lies in the strength of the believers themselves. No matter how well these basic jobs are done, without the support of powerful strength, they won’t even reach the inner periphery of the Divine Kingdom. Utterly foolish!” Cao Wang was almost laughed to anger, wishing he could immediately apply for a call and scold Yang Fan awake.

“Alright, he has already bought it, and the College Entrance Examination doesn’t ban Intelligent Life. At the very least, his score for the second exam might be better.” Yang Wanli shook his head and sighed, having already concluded in his heart that the principal had misjudged the person.
Giving Penglai Island to such a student was somewhat wasteful.
Yang Fan had no idea that because of him, not only the students of Class 1, Grade 12, but even the teachers and the Director of Guidance were paying attention.
At this moment, he was lying on the bed, his body tense, a look of pain showing on his face.
Following the birth of a Tier 5 Being within the Divine Kingdom, his body ushered in another enhancement.
Terrifying power surged from his bone marrow, to his bones, to his flesh and blood, then to his fascia, and finally transmitted to his skin.
“Ahhh.” Yang Fan let out a low roar.
This was the first time the Divine Kingdom’s feedback had been so intense.
A full quarter of an hour passed before that sensation gradually vanished.
Yang Fan slowly got up and discovered that a layer of pale black filth had emerged on his skin.
Through the Divine Kingdom’s feedback, his Physical Body in the real world had actually undergone a marrow-cleansing session.
After taking a bath, Yang Fan sat on the bed, his consciousness plunging into the Divine Kingdom.
“Divine Master: Yang Fan
Divine Kingdom Area: One million square kilometers
Talents: F-rank Resource Talent, SSS-Rank Talent: Evolution (Hidden)
Believers: Tier 5 Being (1), Tier 4 Beings (1,030), Tier 3 Beings (23,310), Tier 2 Beings (490,000), Tier 1 Beings (14.2 million), Mortals (22 million)
Dependents: little spirits (4,718)

Techniques: Five Elements Cultivation Technique, Vajra Indestructible Technique, Locking Heaven Array (E-rank, Beginner), Extinguishing God Array (E-rank, Beginner), Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array (Major Achievement), Black Tortoise Life-Extinguishing Array...
Faith Points: 15.5 billion (Daily Faith Points provided: 553.1)

Buildings: Moon Well X5000, Sun Spring X5000, B-rank Building Monkey Wine Spring X64, Special Life Building Ancient Spirit Tree (Millennial, nurturing little spirits), Special Building Enlightenment Stone, B-rank Building Flesh Sea Blood Pool X1, B-rank Building Hundred Spirits Blood Pool X1 (Soaking 10 Taisuis, load rate 100%), Special Building Fully Automatic Concentrator X6 (Cutting plant loaded with 600 Taisuis, load rate 100%), B-rank Fresh Food Warehouse, B-rank Building Spirit Weapon Workshop (Built-in small mineral vein), C-rank transmission tower X5, C-rank City of Technology X1
Wonders: Penglai Island (Deployed), Spirit Peach Mountain (Deployed)
Assets: Taisui X610, small mineral vein, various spiritual fruits (), D-rank weapons (), E-rank weapons (), F-rank weapons ()”

Regarding the revenue generated within the Divine Kingdom during this period of time, aside from using those funds to purchase Monkey Wine Springs and Moon Wells, Yang Yi used all the idle funds to purchase a large quantity of Marrow Cleansing Pills, grinding them into powder to feed to newborn infants.

Coupled with buildings like the Wonder Penglai Island, Flesh Sea Blood Pool, and Hundred Spirits Blood Pool, the Aptitude of Yang Fan’s believers was soaring at a speed visible to the naked eye every year.

In order to select superior genes, Yang Yi even gave an order that any believers who had not broken through to a Tier 1 Being before the age of twenty must go on a long journey to clear wasteland—meaning they had to go under Yang Er’s command to gather resources.
As they went deeper into the Divine Kingdom, the resources they could gather became more and more numerous, but the accompanying risks also surged drastically.
Five years ago in the Divine Kingdom, Yang Er had once reported encountering a pack of 50,000 wolves, 20,000 of which were even ranked demon wolves.
Even though Yang Er immediately mobilized troops for reinforcement, 60,000 ordinary believers still died.
Under the Evolution Talent, this bit of loss was nothing to Yang Fan.
Those Mortal believers with poor Aptitude could just die; the Divine Kingdom could replenish them at any time.
Compared to the believer population that could reproduce in large quantities, Yang Fan valued the resources themselves much more.
As his strength skyrocketed, Yang Fan also harbored ambitions regarding the rewards for this Divine Kingdom resource collection.
He was indeed exploring alone, but the replenishment of troop sources within his own Divine Kingdom was also ten times that of others.
Nowadays, across the entire third year of high school, the only ones Yang Fan cared about were Luo Bing and Li Tianheng.
Although their strength was formidable, if they really fought it out, at most it would only equal two or three of himself.
Right now, Yang Fan was equivalent to ten of himself, so he might as well give it a try.
After all, all the points he obtained belonged to himself alone and did not need to be distributed.
More importantly, there were still three months left until the deadline.
For him, the Divine Kingdom could still develop for a full 900 years.
Over the span of 900 years, supplied with massive amounts of resources, to what extent it could develop was something even Yang Fan himself didn’t know.
Strategic resources were extremely rare; Wonders like Penglai Island were simply impossible to obtain through Divine Shop transactions.
The opportunity was right before his eyes, how could Yang Fan easily miss it?

Luo Bing: 5.9 billion points
Li Tianheng: 5.5 billion points.
