1 Middle School Academic Affairs Office.
Cao Wang was holding a stack of documents and looking for Yang Wanli to approve a requisition slip.
“Director Yang, the College Entrance Examination is coming up soon.
We can’t skimp on the site rental fees for these Virtual World realms.
Please sign off on it quickly!” Cao Wang said anxiously.
“Money is needed everywhere, and we’ve had a lot less investment recently.
The school has to tighten its belt to get by.
Old Cao, you can’t be as reckless with money as you used to be.” Yang Wanli complained while signing.
“The students this batch have great Aptitude.
Once the College Entrance Examination is over, the funding from the Federal Government will definitely be substantial.” Cao Wang patted his chest and guaranteed.
“I trust your teaching ability, and the school will definitely not default on the special buildings promised to you.”
“Then many thanks, Director Yang.”
“Right, isn’t Class 1, Grade 12 currently conducting Divine Kingdom resource collection training?
How are their results?”
“They’re still in the outer periphery.
I haven’t paid attention either, let me check.”
Cao Wang opened the current leaderboard.
The two of them stared intently at the leaderboard, gazing at it for three seconds without moving an inch.
“Yang Fan?
No, why is his score leading by so much?
Did he go straight to the inner periphery?
The Divine Kingdom has only been established for 30 years.
Without believers above the Qi Refining Stage, how could that be possible?” Yang Wanli looked at Cao Wang with a face full of doubt.
Cao Wang also shook his head, indicating that he didn’t know.
“You’re his homeroom teacher, hurry up and apply for a real-time recording from the Intelligent Life.”
“Alright.”
As the two looked at the situation of Yang Fan’s believers within the Alien Divine Kingdom, their expressions gradually became colorful.
Cao Wang’s facial muscles twitched, and his breathing grew a bit heavier: “Shirking work and playing tricks, is this brat pulling that stunt again?
He actually purchased an exploration-type Advanced Intelligent Life, this...”
“Hahaha, this guy is really interesting.
I remember the school rewarded him with 10 billion during the mid-term exam, right?
Did he dump all of it in here?” Yang Wanli’s expression was somewhat shocked.
The main consumers of such Advanced Intelligent Life were true deities.
From another perspective, only after becoming a deity would your Divine Kingdom find it necessary to be equipped with such Intelligent Life.
Just a mere Divine Being, having an Advanced Intelligent Life help manage the Divine Kingdom and gather resources—wasn’t this a blatant waste of resources?
Who knew how many Advanced buildings 10 billion Faith Points could buy; it would be enough to multiply the Divine Kingdom’s ecosystem several times over.
Yang Wanli couldn’t understand Yang Fan’s actions, but he felt deeply shocked.
“Does this brat want to earn those 10 billion back through this resource collection?” Yang Wanli speculated.
“Fool!
The core of a Divine Kingdom’s development lies in the strength of the believers themselves.
No matter how well these basic jobs are done, without the support of powerful strength, they won’t even reach the inner periphery of the Divine Kingdom.
Utterly foolish!” Cao Wang was almost laughed to anger, wishing he could immediately apply for a call and scold Yang Fan awake.
“Alright, he has already bought it, and the College Entrance Examination doesn’t ban Intelligent Life.
At the very least, his score for the second exam might be better.” Yang Wanli shook his head and sighed, having already concluded in his heart that the principal had misjudged the person.
Giving Penglai Island to such a student was somewhat wasteful.
Yang Fan had no idea that because of him, not only the students of Class 1, Grade 12, but even the teachers and the Director of Guidance were paying attention.
At this moment, he was lying on the bed, his body tense, a look of pain showing on his face.
Following the birth of a Tier 5 Being within the Divine Kingdom, his body ushered in another enhancement.
Terrifying power surged from his bone marrow, to his bones, to his flesh and blood, then to his fascia, and finally transmitted to his skin.
“Ahhh.” Yang Fan let out a low roar.
This was the first time the Divine Kingdom’s feedback had been so intense.
A full quarter of an hour passed before that sensation gradually vanished.
Yang Fan slowly got up and discovered that a layer of pale black filth had emerged on his skin.
Through the Divine Kingdom’s feedback, his Physical Body in the real world had actually undergone a marrow-cleansing session.
After taking a bath, Yang Fan sat on the bed, his consciousness plunging into the Divine Kingdom.

Divine Kingdom Area: One million square kilometers
Talents: F-rank Resource Talent, SSS-Rank Talent: Evolution (Hidden)
Believers: Tier 5 Being (1), Tier 4 Beings (1,030), Tier 3 Beings (23,310), Tier 2 Beings (490,000), Tier 1 Beings (14.2 million), Mortals (22 million)
Dependents: little spirits (4,718)

Techniques: Five Elements Cultivation Technique, Vajra Indestructible Technique, Locking Heaven Array (E-rank, Beginner), Extinguishing God Array (E-rank, Beginner), Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array (Major Achievement), Black Tortoise Life-Extinguishing Array...
Faith Points: 15.5 billion (Daily Faith Points provided: 553.1)

Buildings: Moon Well X5000, Sun Spring X5000, B-rank Building Monkey Wine Spring X64, Special Life Building Ancient Spirit Tree (Millennial, nurturing little spirits), Special Building Enlightenment Stone, B-rank Building Flesh Sea Blood Pool X1, B-rank Building Hundred Spirits Blood Pool X1 (Soaking 10 Taisuis, load rate 100%), Special Building Fully Automatic Concentrator X6 (Cutting plant loaded with 600 Taisuis, load rate 100%), B-rank Fresh Food Warehouse, B-rank Building Spirit Weapon Workshop (Built-in small mineral vein), C-rank transmission tower X5, C-rank City of Technology X1
Wonders: Penglai Island (Deployed), Spirit Peach Mountain (Deployed)
Assets: Taisui X610, small mineral vein, various spiritual fruits (), D-rank weapons (), E-rank weapons (), F-rank weapons ()”

In order to select superior genes, Yang Yi even gave an order that any believers who had not broken through to a Tier 1 Being before the age of twenty must go on a long journey to clear wasteland—meaning they had to go under Yang Er’s command to gather resources.
As they went deeper into the Divine Kingdom, the resources they could gather became more and more numerous, but the accompanying risks also surged drastically.
Five years ago in the Divine Kingdom, Yang Er had once reported encountering a pack of 50,000 wolves, 20,000 of which were even ranked demon wolves.
Even though Yang Er immediately mobilized troops for reinforcement, 60,000 ordinary believers still died.
Under the Evolution Talent, this bit of loss was nothing to Yang Fan.
Those Mortal believers with poor Aptitude could just die; the Divine Kingdom could replenish them at any time.

chapters.title: Chapter 85: B-Rank Technique Everlasting Spring Technique
paragraphs: Although Yang Fan was currently ranked first, the gap between him, Luo Bing, and the others was narrowing.
It was only a matter of time before his points were surpassed.
He was not surprised by this.

During this period, following Yang Fan’s instructions, Yang Yi had primarily used resources for the development of the Divine Kingdom, while the support given to Yang Er mostly consisted of Mortal without talent who served as expendable materials.
Even if Yang Er possessed powerful exploration capabilities, the progress remained slow if the believers lacked sufficient strength.
Only when the believers were strong enough would Yang Fan finally have the qualifications to explore the depths of the Divine Kingdom.
Relying on the support of Intelligent Life, he was already very satisfied with having achieved these gains on the outskirts of the Divine Kingdom.
Bringing his consciousness into the Divine Kingdom, Yang Yi and Yang Er immediately appeared before Yang Fan.
“Master.” The two spoke in unison.

“Yang Er, I will allocate another ten thousand Tier 3 Beings and two hundred thousand Tier 2 Beings to you. In the time remaining, there is no need to continue sweeping for resources; do your best to head towards the core of the Divine Kingdom,” Yang Fan instructed.

“Reporting to Master, there are already many Tier 1 demonic beasts where the army is currently located, numbering between thirty thousand and fifty thousand. If we continue to advance, the losses will likely be too great. Given the current population of the Divine Kingdom, we cannot replenish our troops, and it would be counterproductive,” Yang Er reminded him.
“It doesn’t matter, just do as I say.”

Due to special rule restrictions, even with such significant changes in the Divine Kingdom, Intelligent Life forms like Yang Yi and Yang Er still had not noticed the anomaly in the Divine Kingdom’s time flow.
Therefore, Yang Fan had to take the initiative and give the order.
Exploration time was limited; if they continued to collect resources on the outskirts, he feared he would truly miss out on first place this time.
“Yang Yi, based on the current development speed, within 300 years of the Divine Kingdom’s time, what is the most likely range for the number of high-tier believers?” Yang Fan asked.
Since the other party could not comprehend the existence of his Evolution Talent, Yang Fan could only estimate the future development of the Divine Kingdom in this way.
As a high-level Intelligent Life, Yang Yi possessed immense computing power and might be able to provide him with a relatively accurate judgment.

“Assuming the Divine Kingdom’s environment is maintained, resource investment is maintained... Big data simulation calculates the believer aptitude change curve, the curve acceleration decreases year by year based on the large model, designing random variable x...”

“According to Master’s request, the following conclusion is reached: In 300 years of the Divine Kingdom, the range for Tier 5 believers is 5 to 20; the range for Tier 4 believers is ten thousand to forty thousand; the range for Tier 3 believers is three hundred thousand to six hundred thousand.”
Hearing this answer, Yang Fan did not continue to issue orders and returned his consciousness to reality.
“Once the number of Monkey Wine Springs reaches one hundred, I will start investing all resources into the believers themselves. There is still enough time,” Yang Fan muttered to himself.
On the eve of the College Entrance Examination, for others, it would certainly be a race against time to pour resources into their believers and increase their strength as much as possible.
But Yang Fan was different.
His Divine Kingdom’s development time was ten times that of others, so he had no need to worry about whether his believers would have time to absorb the resources.
Five days later, Yang Fan was pushed down on the resource collection leaderboard by both Luo Bing and Li Tianheng.
Over the past twenty days, both their points had exceeded 20 billion, while Yang Fan’s name had dropped past the top ten.

“Brother Tianheng, you were right. That guy Yang Fan just had good luck in the early stages. I actually sent people to gather intelligence on him; I was so stupid,” Li Chengze said, his face full of shame.

“No need to blame yourself; you did it for the sake of the whole team. There is no need to pay attention to Yang Fan in the future; our main opponent is still Luo Bing. I am determined to win first place in this resource collection,” Li Tianheng said, his eyes filled with fighting spirit.
“Defeat the Luo Family and help Brother Tianheng take first place.”
“Take first place.”
“Let’s go!”
Everyone shouted, all cheering and boosting morale.
Li Tianheng’s group consisted entirely of direct descendants of the Li Family.
In this exploration of the resource points provided by the school, collecting resources was secondary; the core goal was to help Li Tianheng secure first place.
Compared to the strategic-level resource buildings provided by the school, the ordinary materials within the Alien Divine Kingdom were not as important.

“Brother Tianheng, this Alien Divine Kingdom is monitored by the school’s Intelligent Life. Resources must be collected by your own believers to count as points. Therefore, the efficiency in this area is too low; we must go deeper,” Li Chengze said.

“That’s right. Although the core buildings of this Alien Divine Kingdom have already been taken away by the school, there might still be high-value resource buildings left behind. We must reach the core area before Luo Bing.”
Li Tianheng nodded: “In that case, from now on, we will focus on marching. There is no need to send believers to collect Spirit Plant resources with a value below one hundred thousand.”
Another month passed, and the foot of Spirit Peach Mountain in the Divine Kingdom was already filled with Monkey Wine Springs.
Under Yang Yi’s arrangement, there was a resource house every kilometer across the entire Spirit Peach Mountain.
Semi-automated harvesting machines filled the mountains and forests.
The believers only patrolled the mountains, firstly to check if the machines were damaging the Spirit Plants, and secondly to perform secondary collection of the spiritual fruits.
The resource houses and the Monkey Wine Springs were connected by fully automated conveyor belts, with spiritual fruits being automatically deposited.
80% of the work in the entire process had been replaced by machinery, saving a massive amount of manpower.
On this day, the number of Monkey Wine Springs finally reached one hundred.
Yang Fan brought his consciousness into the Divine Kingdom.
Looking at the Monkey Wine Springs operating at full capacity, the corners of his mouth unconsciously curled up.
With an income of one hundred billion per month, it was now time to vigorously develop his believers.
“Believers: Tier 5 Beings (10), Tier 4 Beings (23,034), Tier 3 Beings (420,000), Tier 2 Beings (5.4 million), Tier 1 Beings (18.2 million), Mortal (26.7 million).”
Feeling the current strength and population structure of the believers in the Divine Kingdom, Yang Fan became increasingly confident.
If he were to participate in the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle now, his results would definitely not be weaker than Luo Bing’s.

“Master, the core investment buildings, the Monkey Wine Springs, have all been set up. The current Divine Kingdom has 12.3 billion Faith Points, of which 10 billion is needed to repay this month’s interest for Elephant Loan. Should the Divine Kingdom’s resource output be primarily used to repay the loan principal from now on?” Yang Yi asked respectfully.
Yang Fan shook his head: “Not for now. From now on, apart from reserving funds for interest, all other income from the Divine Kingdom will be invested in the believers.”
There was less than two months until the College Entrance Examination, and Yang Fan had to improve the strength of his believers as quickly as possible.
This time, Yang Fan’s goal was the two top universities of the Federal Government—Tai Chu Academy and Xingqiong Academy.
“Yes, please grant me the purchase permission for the B-Rank technique, Everlasting Spring Technique, which costs 100 million Faith Points,” Yang Yi said.
“Buy a technique?”
Yang Fan’s expression was somewhat puzzled.
There were quite a few techniques and martial skills in the transmission tower now; they should be enough for the believers to learn.

“Reporting to Master, there are currently 10 Tier 5 Beings in the Divine Kingdom, and they are all following the Cultivation path. Above Tier 5 Beings is the transition from Mortal to the Dao, becoming believers in the Qi Refining Realm. This process requires the assistance of high-level techniques. After searching, the Everlasting Spring Technique is more suitable for the current needs of the believers. As for the believers on the Martial Arts path, their strongest strength is currently only Tier 3, so we will not invest in high-level techniques for them for the time being,” Yang Yi explained.
“I see. Yang Yi, can you calculate how much longer it will take for the Divine Kingdom to produce believers in the Qi Refining Realm?”

“The current number of Tier 5 Beings in the Divine Kingdom is extremely low, the believers’ aptitude is mediocre to low, and the Divine Kingdom’s environment is average. The overall evaluation of the Divine Kingdom does not meet the standard. The conditions for calculation are not met, and it is temporarily impossible to estimate a specific time.”
“What? The Divine Kingdom has been developing for such a long time, and my evaluation is not up to standard?” Yang Fan was incredulous.
“That is correct.” Yang Yi nodded seriously.
“According to a comprehensive evaluation of the current Divine Kingdom operation data, your development level is in the median range of Divine Beings at the same stage.”
He paused slightly, as if retrieving a larger-scale data model.

chapters.title: Chapter 86: B-rank Herb Garden hundred herb spirit pivot academy
paragraphs: “Comparing the 312.7 billion divine individual Divine Kingdom samples exposed over the last millennium, the average proportion of elite believers (reaching Tier 3 or higher) is 9.6%, while the Divine Kingdom is currently at 1.07%. Reason: Resource allocation is biased toward basic expansion, with insufficient investment in individual strengthening.”

“Although Penglai Island possesses a self-circulating immortal energy system, it is currently only used for environmental bonuses. A multi-level cultivation model has not been constructed, and its potential amplification utilization rate is less than forty percent.”
Yang Er’s tone remained calm, as if he were stating an established fact.

“Furthermore, according to historical data, high-potential Divine Kingdoms at this stage have usually established at least one’strategic advantage system,’ such as extreme military units, complete social rules for believers, or a powerful resource chain.”

“However, the current Divine Kingdom, despite possessing high-quality strategic resources such as Spirit Peach Mountain, the Enlightenment Stone, and Penglai Island, has not yet completed system integration and is merely in a state of resource accumulation.”

“The emergence of believers at the Qi Refining or Martial Disciple realm within the Divine Kingdom is a necessary and sufficient condition for becoming a Demigod. Given the current resource investment and the pace of the Divine Kingdom’s development, it is impossible to calculate a specific time.”
Yang Fan swallowed hard.
At this moment, he suddenly felt that he had thought of breaking through to a Demigod too simply.
“Yang Yi, according to what you said, I have no chance of breaking through to a Demigod before the College Entrance Examination?”

“Reporting to Master, according to data from previous years, students who break through to a Demigod before the College Entrance Examination account for 0.001% of the total number, and they basically all come from major metropolises like Taichu City and Xinghai City. Yang County, where Master is located, belongs to a county-level city on a remote planet. In the database, I have not yet found anyone who has broken through to a Demigod before the College Entrance Examination on this planet.”
“It seems I thought about it too simply.” A look of embarrassment appeared on Yang Fan’s face.

“Master need not be discouraged. Demigod powerhouses only account for less than 5% of the total population, and true Gods account for even less than 1%. To break through, time for Divine Kingdom development, massive resources, and even luck are all indispensable. With Master’s potential, and having the investment and platform of a university, the Divine Kingdom’s development will be much faster, and there is a high probability of becoming a Demigod powerhouse within the four years of university.”

Yang Fan sighed in relief and said, “Alright, the purchasing authority for the Everlasting Spring Technique has already been given to you. The development of the Divine Kingdom will continue to be entirely your responsibility.”
In the era of Divine Kingdoms, the population of the human race’s Gods is so vast that it is difficult to conduct a census, and among them, there are so many prodigies.

Relying on his SSS-rank Talent, Yang Fan might be able to stay one step ahead of his peers in a small place like Yang County, but when placed within the entire human race, it is still unknown where he would rank.
In Yang County, a young person with a B-rank Talent, or even a C-rank Talent, can be focused on and cultivated by a family.
But in big cities, how many geniuses with A-rank or even S-rank Talents are there?
Besides their own innate talents, these people have families or companies that are a hundred or a thousand times stronger than the Luo Family supporting them from behind.
Even so, the prodigies who can break through to a Demigod before the College Entrance Examination are still very few.
At this moment, Yang Fan suddenly felt that his previous thoughts were naively ridiculous.
The road ahead is long.
Although the difficulty of breaking through to a Demigod far exceeded his expectations, Yang Fan was not discouraged.
Keep his feet on the ground and look up at the sky.
In life, one should not be swayed by material things or personal gains and losses; focusing on the present and taking it one step at a time is the right way.

“Yang Yi, in addition to fully improving the strength of the believers, from now on, use half of the Divine Kingdom’s forces to support Yang Er. I want to compete for first place this time,” Yang Fan said seriously.
According to Yang Er’s report, after marching at full speed in the Alien Divine Kingdom for nearly forty years, his position is now approaching the core area of the Divine Kingdom.
During this process, even though Yang Er had avoided a large number of monster hordes and traps in advance, the loss of troops along the way still reached one million.
Fortunately, with the Evolution Talent, under ten times the rate of reproduction, the supply of troops was sufficient, and the military strength within the Alien Divine Kingdom was not affected.
However, as they approached the core of the Divine Kingdom, they were already encountering a large number of Tier 3 and Tier 4 monsters.
No matter how strong Yang Er’s leadership ability was, if the believers’ strength was insufficient, even a clever housewife could not cook a meal without rice.
Nowadays, Yang Er simply does not dare to explore on a large scale.
If he encounters a large monster horde, the resources obtained would likely not be enough to compensate for the loss of the believer population.
At present, Yang Fan’s believers are likely closer to the core of the Alien Divine Kingdom than Luo Bing and Li Tianheng.
There is less than two months left until this competition, and only fifty years of Divine Kingdom time remains.
It is time for Yang Fan to show his stuff.
“Yes, Master,” Yang Yi said.
Returning to reality, Yang Fan went back to his daily life.
Apart from his fixed daily visits to the Tianxiang Renjian to relieve stress, he would also look at the admissions brochures of various universities when he had time.
Ten days later, Yang Fan suddenly received a message from Yang Er.
Lying on the bed, Yang Fan’s consciousness instantly arrived in the Alien Divine Kingdom.
The air was filled with a thick smell of blood, mixed with the lingering aura of life that had not yet dissipated.
The ground bore traces of battle; broken weapons and undried bloodstains were intertwined, clearly indicating that a fierce slaughter had just taken place.
In the distance, the figures of the believers were scattered, their auras chaotic, yet they were still on alert.
And in the center of this chaos, there was actually an herb garden, where spiritual light flowed and various Spirit Plants grew densely.

“Master, a big harvest! Originally, a concealment array was set up here, but the array was missing a corner, causing a large amount of life aura to dissipate, which I happened to discover,” Yang Er said, his face full of excitement.
“This is?”
“A B-rank herb garden, the hundred herb spirit pivot academy. Here is the specific information.”
Yang Er’s eyes emitted a blue light, projecting the specific information into mid-air.

“hundred herb spirit pivot academy: B-rank herb garden-type building, worth approximately 20 billion Faith Points. It possesses a complete Spirit Plant cultivation system and can carry out large-scale Planting of various medicinal herbs and Spirit Plants. The spiritual energy within the academy is stable, and the growth environment is highly optimized, which can significantly increase the growth rate and survival rate of Spirit Plants. It can perform refined management according to the characteristics of different Spirit Plants to achieve efficient output. It is suitable for long-term resource accumulation and medicinal material supply, and is of great help to the basic development of the Divine Kingdom and the refining of medicinal pills.”
“20 billion!” Yang Fan was extremely shocked.
He also did not expect that Yang Er would suddenly obtain such a huge harvest.
As expected of a location close to the core of the Divine Kingdom, this harvest was greater than all previous ones combined.
“Master, I request 1 billion Faith Points to purchase a large spatial bracelet. The garden-type building is too bulky and must be transported by relying on auxiliary spatial treasures.”
“Granted.” Yang Fan nodded and agreed.
The God of this place had passed away, so Yang Fan naturally could not use the rules to collect it directly into his Divine Kingdom as he did during the midterm exam.
As an exploration-type high-level Intelligent Life, the solution Yang Er provided was naturally the most effective strategy at the moment.
Yang Fan had no interest in learning about the effects of this spatial bracelet; compared to the harvest obtained, this expenditure of 1 billion Faith Points was a trivial matter.
Returning to reality, Yang Fan soon received a notification message from the school.
“Obtained hundred herb spirit pivot academy, points + 20 billion.”
“Obtained various Spirit Plants, points + 3 billion.”
Yang Fan opened the leaderboard:
“Yang Fan: Points 38.924 billion.
Luo Bing: Points 30.712 billion.
Li Tianheng: Points 29.834 billion.
With one harvest, Yang Fan’s ranking jumped to first place.
“As expected, one must explore in the core area of the Divine Kingdom. One stroke of good luck is worth decades of harvests in the Divine Kingdom,” Yang Fan said excitedly.

Reason: Resource allocation is biased toward basic expansion, with insufficient investment in individual strengthening.”
“Although Penglai Island possesses a self-circulating immortal energy system, it is currently only used for environmental bonuses.
A multi-level cultivation model has not been constructed, and its potential amplification utilization rate is less than forty percent.”
Yang Er’s tone remained calm, as if he were stating an established fact.

“Furthermore, according to historical data, high-potential Divine Kingdoms at this stage have usually established at least one’strategic advantage system,’ such as extreme military units, complete social rules for believers, or a powerful resource chain.”

“However, the current Divine Kingdom, despite possessing high-quality strategic resources such as Spirit Peach Mountain, the Enlightenment Stone, and Penglai Island, has not yet completed system integration and is merely in a state of resource accumulation.”
“The emergence of believers at the Qi Refining or Martial Disciple realm within the Divine Kingdom is a necessary and sufficient condition for becoming a Demigod.
Given the current resource investment and the pace of the Divine Kingdom’s development, it is impossible to calculate a specific time.”

In the database, I have not yet found anyone who has broken through to a Demigod before the College Entrance Examination on this planet.”

“Master need not be discouraged.
Demigod powerhouses only account for less than 5% of the total population, and true Gods account for even less than 1%.

chapters.title: Chapter 87: What a Truly Good Person!
paragraphs: Yang Fan was unaware that as his ranking climbed back to first place, the Genius Exchange Group had already exploded with activity.
“What is going on? What kind of building did that bastard Yang Fan find? Why did his points increase so much?”
“He is alone, shouldn’t he be exploring the outer perimeter?”
“Could it be that the outer perimeter of the Alien Divine Kingdom also contains high-value core buildings?”
“Nonsense. If you were an alien god, would you leave core buildings on the outer perimeter waiting for others to snatch them?”
“I’m afraid Yang Fan has already explored the core area of the Alien Divine Kingdom.”

“Your guess makes a lot of sense, but let me ask you this: without teaming up with anyone, without sufficient troop reinforcements or powerful strength, how could he possibly walk into the core area?”
“I want to ask that question too! How on earth did this guy manage it?”
“This class ranking won’t let this scumbag get first place again, will it? @Luo Bing @Li Tianheng.”
Virtual World, Li family residence conference room.
“Brother Tianheng, should I send Li Shuhao to investigate again? This guy is really a bit freakish!” Li Chengze’s expression was somewhat unpleasant.
They had noticed Yang Fan’s points skyrocketing a while ago, but because there was still a gap between him and Li Tianheng, they only gave it a little more attention.
But today, his points surged by over 20 billion, putting him back in the first-place position in the class, and everyone had to start taking him seriously.
With only a little over a month left until the Alien Divine Kingdom resource collection ranking, Yang Fan’s sudden massive gain meant he must have entered the core area.
In this kind of resource collection competition, besides strength, luck is also important.
Originally, the first-place position should have been contested between Luo Bing and Li Tianheng, but as things stand, this dark horse, Yang Fan, also has a chance.

“Brother Chengze, I think it’s a good idea, at least to find out if he is actually in the core area of the Alien Divine Kingdom. According to estimates, it will probably take us another ten years to reach the core area.”
“Yang Fan is extremely cunning; I’m afraid Li Shuhao won’t be able to get the truth out of him.”

“That’s right. I watched that video from last time several times and even fed it to an elementary Intelligent Life for analysis. Guess what the result was? There’s an 80% chance Yang Fan was spouting nonsense; his words are completely untrustworthy,” one of them couldn’t help but complain.
Li Tianheng, sitting in the main seat, had a similarly grave expression.
His face flickered between pale and flushed, as if a battle was raging inside him.
After a moment, Li Tianheng took a deep breath and said, “Transfer 100 million Faith Points to Li Shuhao.”
“There’s no need for that. He’s my underling now; a simple order is enough,” Li Chengze waved his hand confidently.
“I’m not asking him to go gather information,” Li Tianheng shook his head.
“Then why?”

“Tell him to go to Tianxiang Renjian, book a presidential suite for a month, and hire dozens of’service staff’ with good reputations, high attractiveness, and good conversational skills. Book them for the month to serve Yang Fan well.”
Li Tianheng’s voice grew quieter and quieter; he didn’t even dare to look up at his brothers.
The group was stunned.
After realizing what he meant, many of the Li family geniuses slammed the table and gave him a thumbs up.

“Brother Tianheng, this is a brilliant move! Judging from that last video, Yang Fan is just a lecher. We spend a little money to give him top-tier service and let the kid indulge in the gentle trap; how could he possibly have the energy to explore the Alien Divine Kingdom resources anymore!”
“Exactly! Why didn’t I think of this? To deal with this kind of person, you have to use these kinds of underhanded tactics.”
“Ahem!” Li Chengze coughed sharply, stopping the person who had just spoken.
Everyone fell silent, seemingly realizing something, their expressions showing surprise.
This tactic wasn’t much, but was this something their eldest brother, Li Tianheng, would actually say?
Their eldest brother used to be the person who hated using such petty tricks the most.
Did he have a change of heart?

“Do as I said. From now on, we will implement a shift system, in groups of three, to ensure that resource exploration continues twenty-four hours a day. It’s not just about Yang Fan; we also need to defeat Luo Bing,” Li Tianheng said with a serious expression.
“Yes, Big Brother,” everyone said in unison.
Early the next morning, Yang Fan received an invitation from Li Shuhao.
“Brother Li, we meet again. Every time my results improve, you invite me to meet up. Are you here to congratulate me?” Yang Fan said with a smile.
Hearing this, Li Shuhao’s expression stiffened slightly, and a trace of embarrassment flashed in his eyes.
“Ahem, well, Brother Yang, some things are not what I wish for.”
“It’s fine. What kind of relationship do we have? If there’s an issue, just say it directly; I will tell you everything I know,” Yang Fan said.
Upon hearing this, Li Shuhao couldn’t help but roll his eyes.
Tell everything he knows?
Who is he trying to fool?
He had figured out the matter from last time; there was a high probability that Yang Fan was just messing with him.
Li Shuhao had no complaints about this; after all, he was originally ordered to gather information.
Since his own motives were impure, what right did he have to demand that others treat him with sincerity?

“Brother Yang, I’ve booked a presidential suite for you. You can use it until the College Entrance Examination. It even includes ‘Big Circle’ service staff, you know what I mean!” Li Shuhao coughed and said.
“How generous. I didn’t expect Brother Li to be so extravagant,” Yang Fan looked surprised.
The presidential suites at Tianxiang Renjian were not cheap, and as for those service staff, they were also classified into tiers.
Someone like Liu Ruyan could only be considered’Small Circle,’ costing 10,000 Faith Points for the night, while ‘Big Circle’ started at 100,000.

“It’s not funded by me. Brother Yang, if you have free time, you can come here to enjoy it. However, the College Entrance Examination is imminent, and the rewards for ranking first in the Alien Divine Kingdom resource collection this time are huge, so I assume you don’t have much time,” Li Shuhao said slowly, his tone carrying a hint of a reminder.
Although Li Shuhao was from the Li family, he and Yang Fan could be considered ordinary friends.
There were some things he had to do, but deep down, he didn’t want to do them either.
Yang Fan said, “Then I will thank your friend behind this for the treat.”
“Farewell. After the College Entrance Examination ends, if Brother Yang still recognizes me as a brother, we can meet again. At that time, I will treat you to the presidential suite.”
As his voice fell, Li Shuhao vanished directly from the private room.
The presidential suite booked by Li Shuhao was located in the deepest part of the first floor of Tianxiang Renjian.
Yang Fan pushed the door open and entered.
What came into view was a vast open space, furnished with exquisite wine sets and crystal glasses.
On one side was a semi-open lounge area, with light gauze curtains hanging down, and the air was filled with a faint fragrance that made one involuntarily relax their mind.
On the other side was a ten-meter large bed and an ultra-large bathtub.
The room was equipped with a holographic electronic panel, where the profiles and styles of the’service staff’ were clearly written, with one-click summoning and instant response.
Low-key, luxurious, and carrying an indescribable hint of ambiguity.
“Whoever you are, I thank you from the bottom of my heart!” Yang Fan swallowed his saliva.
With Yang Er there, Yang Fan had no need to personally oversee the believers exploring the Alien Divine Kingdom.
Now, besides enjoying himself in the entertainment district of the Virtual World, he didn’t even know how to kill time.
Yang Fan naturally understood that the other party had ulterior motives, but he didn’t care.
Others pay, he enjoys—that’s the result.
What a truly good person!

chapters.title: Chapter 88: Divine Kingdom Defense War
paragraphs: With only one month left until the College Entrance Examination, Yang Fan was currently soaking in a bathtub with a dozen service staff members when he suddenly received a message from Cao Wang about a class gathering.
Yang Fan did not dare to delay; after getting dressed, he immediately teleported to the Class 1, Grade 12 classroom.
As Yang Fan entered, he immediately attracted the gazes of many people.
Nowadays, the gazes directed at Yang Fan were no longer hostile; instead, they held a hint of admiration and curiosity.
In this world, strength is ultimately supreme.
Even if most people felt disdain for Yang Fan’s behavior during the midterm exam, it did not hinder them from admiring his capabilities.
Not only were his believers powerful, but he had also explored deep into the Alien Divine Kingdom by his own strength.
During this period, Yang Fan remained firmly in first place, and the gap between him and Luo Bing and Li Tianheng was widening.
Everyone was very curious about how he managed to do it.
Could it be that the strength of Yang Fan’s believers far exceeded that of Luo Bing and Li Tianheng?
Everyone just felt this speculation was ridiculous.
Or perhaps, did Yang Fan really have some secret for collecting resources?
But what kind of secret could allow one person to rival an entire team?
Everyone was confused, puzzled, and curious.
But everyone also understood that Yang Fan had no obligation to tell them, so they could only bury these thoughts deep in their hearts.
Li Tianheng, sitting in the front row, checked the rankings again.
“Yang Fan: 45.7 billion points. Li Tianheng: 36.94 billion points. Luo Bing: 34.92 billion points.”
Li Tianheng asked with an ugly expression, “Chengze, are you sure the consumption records are correct?”

“Brother, this is the fourth time you’ve asked today. I paid the money, so how could I not know the specific situation? That guy Yang Fan basically stays in the presidential suite during the day for five or six hours at a time; there can’t be any mistake,” Li Chengze said in a low voice.
“Do his believers not need command? Or does he really have some means to find high-value resources?” Li Tianheng felt his head spinning.
Wasting so much time on women’s bellies every day, yet his points can still exceed mine?
You have to know, during this period, Li Tianheng’s rest time had been compressed to two hours.
He could not understand, and even less could he accept it.
On what grounds?
Could this kid be cheating!
Cao Wang walked into the classroom, his gaze also pausing on Yang Fan for a few seconds.
During this time, Cao Wang had watched quite a few recordings of Yang Fan in the Alien Divine Kingdom.
He both sighed at Yang Fan’s good luck in obtaining a high-value building like the hundred herb spirit pivot academy and was shocked by the strength of Yang Fan’s believers.
Unlike other students, Cao Wang, as the homeroom teacher, could directly connect to Intelligent Life and watch the performance of every student.
Yang Fan being able to obtain so many points, besides having an exploration-type high-level Intelligent Life, was more importantly due to the powerful strength of his believers.
Now, the importance of Yang Fan in Cao Wang’s heart was enough to stand shoulder to shoulder with Luo Bing and Li Tianheng.
Yang Fan was definitely a star pupil of Yang County No.
1 Middle School, and his strength was not even weaker than anyone in Class 1, Grade 12.
“This kid really hides deep!” Cao Wang couldn’t help but sigh in his heart.

On that day in the Divine Kingdom battlefield opened in the Virtual World, Yang Fan was not just capable of tearing a piece of flesh off Li Tianheng; if he pulled out all the high-level believers in his Divine Kingdom, the two would definitely be in a fierce struggle.
Having taught students for so many years, Cao Wang stated that this was the first time he had seen a student who hid his strength to such a degree.
Regarding this, Cao Wang felt speechless.
He hadn’t even graduated from high school and was protected by federal laws, so why act like a pig to eat the tiger?
If he had revealed his strength earlier, he might have been able to obtain more resource allocation.
‘A student who likes to act like a pig to eat the tiger and is also sinister and cunning!’ This was Cao Wang’s evaluation of Yang Fan.

Such a student could bring quite a lot of investment to Yang County No.
1 Middle School!

Cao Wang took a deep breath and said, “There is one month left until the College Entrance Examination. Five days later, we will hold the last class activity, and the content is the Divine Kingdom Defense War.”

“It will be supervised by the Federal Government high-level Intelligent Life, and all students’ Divine Kingdom coordinates will be protected by virtual coordinates. By then, all of you can go to any classmate’s Divine Kingdom to conduct an offensive and defensive battle.”

“The restrictions are as follows: 1. Tier 3 and above believers cannot enter. 2. The troops invested by each person cannot exceed 200,000. 3. It is forbidden to infiltrate the core position of the opponent’s Divine Kingdom.”

“This exam has no rewards; it is mainly to let you adapt to how to respond if alien believers come to your own Divine Kingdom in the future, or what resistance you will encounter when attacking an Alien Divine Kingdom. This is also part of the College Entrance Examination, but the specific content will only be clear on the day of the exam.”
After saying this, Cao Wang directly exited the Virtual World.
“Divine Kingdom Defense War? No rewards!” Yang Fan felt bored in his heart.

These gazes contained curiosity, impulse, eagerness to try, and even a hint of aggression.
“Damn, these people aren’t going to form a group to come to my Divine Kingdom for a stroll, are they!” Yang Fan couldn’t help but shiver in his heart.
Although there were restrictions, each person could only invest 200,000 troops, and the highest level was only a Tier 2 being.
But if all the students in Class 1, Grade 12 entered his Divine Kingdom together, things would get serious.
You have to know that there are hundreds of students in Class 1, Grade 12; if they all entered together, wouldn’t that be tens of millions?
Although the school requires that they cannot enter the core area, he has quite a lot of assets in the periphery of his Divine Kingdom, especially around the Ancient Spirit Tree.
Thinking of this, Yang Fan suddenly felt that this Divine Kingdom Defense War class activity might not go smoothly.
Returning to reality, Yang Fan’s consciousness immediately entered the Divine Kingdom.
“Yang Yi, what do you think of this Divine Kingdom Defense War?”
As his Intelligent Life, Yang Yi was clear about everything that happened in the classroom.

“Reporting to Master, the Divine Kingdom Defense War is held every year by Class 1, Grade 12. It is a friendly match, and there have been no cases of serious damage to the Divine Kingdom. However, considering Master’s special reputation, there is a 93.2% probability of being targeted by classmates, so it is recommended to take protective measures.”
“What measures?”
“Purchase defensive buildings.”
Yang Fan nodded.
After the midterm exam and the current ongoing exploration of the Divine Kingdom, Yang Fan also understood the importance of defensive buildings.

If it weren’t for the fact that he was still a Divine Being and his Divine Kingdom was protected by federal law, Yang Fan, who prioritized safety, would have already purchased a large number of defensive buildings.
With a thought from Yang Fan, the current Divine Kingdom information appeared before his eyes.
“Divine Lord: Yang Fan.
Divine Kingdom Area: 1 million square kilometers.
Talents: Omitted.
Believers: Tier 5 beings (36), Tier 4 beings (43,274), Tier 3 beings (1.25 million), Tier 2 beings (8.3 million), Tier 1 Beings (22.7 million), Mortal (10.7 million).
Dependents: little spirits (12,718).

Techniques: Everlasting Spring Technique, Locking Heaven Array (E-Grade, Minor Success), Extinguishing God Array (E-Grade, Minor Success), Black Tortoise Life-Extinguishing Array (D-Grade, Beginner)...
Faith Points: 47.9 billion (provides 755.4 Faith Points daily).

Buildings: Moon Well X5000, Sun Spring X5000, B-Grade Building Monkey Wine Spring X100, B-Grade hundred herb spirit pivot academy, special life building Ancient Spirit Tree (Millennium, gestating little spirits), special building Enlightenment Stone, B-Grade Building Flesh Sea Blood Pool X1, B-Grade Building Spirit Weapon Workshop (built-in small mineral vein)...
Wonders: Penglai Island (deployed), Spirit Peach Mountain (deployed).
Assets: Tai Sui X610, small mineral veins, various spiritual fruits (), various medicinal herbs and Spirit Plants (), D-Grade weapons (), E-Grade weapons (), F-Grade weapons ()”

chapters.title: Chapter 89: Income Comparable to a Deity
paragraphs: After this period of development, the overall strength of Yang Fan’s believers had undergone a qualitative leap.
With 36 Tier 5 creatures, not even Luo Bing or Li Tianheng possessed such a foundation.

Furthermore, with both the Locking Heaven Array and the Extinguishing God Array comprehended to the Minor Achievement stage, if he were to participate in the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle again, he would definitely soar to the skies.

The D-Grade Black Tortoise Life-Extinguishing Array had also been mastered to the entry level; this was a defensive array capable of concentrating the power of a million believers, though it wasn’t needed for the time being.
As for the cash flow of over 40 billion, it wasn’t that Yang Yi was unwilling to spend it, but rather that the believers themselves lacked the strength to digest such vast resources.
Over these hundreds of years of Divine Kingdom development, every newborn baby was able to enjoy Marrow Cleansing Pills ground into powder.

Yang Yi had even spent billions purchasing the bodies of alien believers, throwing them into the Hundred Spirits Blood Pool and the Flesh Sea Blood Pool, ensuring that every talented believer could receive their rations as much as possible.
But even so, the revenue generated by the Divine Kingdom’s investments simply couldn’t be spent in full.

If not for Yang Fan requiring the remaining funds to be used for cultivating believers, Yang Yi would have long since purchased large quantities of Moon Wells and Sun Springs for compound interest investments.
During this time, Yang Fan himself had been soaking in the Tianxiang Renjian and hadn’t even noticed that he had accumulated so much cash flow.
“A beauty is the grave of a hero! Brother Li has led me astray!” Yang Fan sighed inwardly.
Yang Fan himself hadn’t expected that his believers would be unable to digest the revenue produced by these 100 Monkey Wine Springs.
He had originally thought that with his Evolution Talent, he would earn much but also spend quickly, but he hadn’t expected that, in reality, his believers’ consumption couldn’t keep up.
If outsiders were to learn of Yang Fan’s distress, they would likely be so angry they’d vomit blood.
Which Divine Being could set up so many B-Grade Buildings within their Divine Kingdom?
It was too overpowered!
Without even any Qi Refining Realm believers, the believers naturally couldn’t digest the revenue generated by so many B-Grade Buildings.
“Yang Yi, has the resource investment for the believers really reached its limit?” Yang Fan couldn’t help but ask.

“The improvement of believer aptitude still requires generation-after-generation evolution. Pills like the Marrow Cleansing Pill cannot be taken repeatedly. With their current physical bodies, the believers cannot withstand high-level pills; forcing them to take them would instead cause them to explode and die. In terms of weapons, due to the purchase of the Spirit Weapon Workshop, there is actually too much surplus given the current troop situation. In terms of food, there is the Spirit Peach Mountain and a large amount of concentrated taisui meat, also with a large surplus. The purchase costs for cultivation techniques, martial skills, and arrays are one-time expenses, and the current Divine Kingdom no longer needs to configure more.”

“Taking 30 years of the Divine Kingdom as a unit, 100 Monkey Wine Springs can produce 10 billion worth of Monkey Wine; the Moon Wells and Sun Springs can produce 30 million in revenue; I have purchased enough herbs and Spirit Plant seeds, and the hundred herb spirit pivot academy can produce about 1 billion in income; the excess weapons produced by the Spirit Weapon Workshop and the concentrated taisui meat that cannot be stored in the warehouse of the Fully Automatic Concentrator add up to about 200 million in income.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan finally realized that he was actually this wealthy.
Yang Yi was unable to perceive the existence of the SSS-rank Talent; the income he had just mentioned had to be multiplied by ten.
“Reporting to Master, the working capital is very sufficient. I suggest prioritizing negotiations with Elephant Loan to repay the debt and reduce interest expenses.”

Even though Yang Yi had experienced the development of the Divine Kingdom, because he could not perceive the existence of the SSS-rank Talent, he subconsciously only believed that the Divine Kingdom’s funds were sufficient.
Under the circumstances where the resources needed by the believers had reached saturation, Yang Yi’s suggestion was naturally the best choice.
“No need to negotiate. Once the funds are sufficient, pay it off in one lump sum ahead of schedule,” Yang Fan said indifferently.
“But Master, with the current Divine Kingdom income, it will take at least half a year to gather the remaining funds. The interest for Elephant Loan...”
“Just do as I say.”
Yang Fan rubbed his temples, feeling a bit of a headache.
Even his own Intelligent Life couldn’t detect the existence of the SSS-rank Talent, which was indeed safe enough, but it would also affect judgment.
For Yang Fan, a mere hundred billion in funds wouldn’t take half a year; one month would be enough.
“Yang Yi, how does the passive income of my Divine Kingdom compare to a Demigod now?”
“According to the data, the median monthly income of a Demigod is 50 million Faith Points.”
“So low?” Yang Fan was somewhat incredulous.

“With the development of the Divine Kingdom, the resource investment deities make in their believers increases exponentially. Many Demigods have a gross monthly income as high as several hundred million Faith Points, but 60% to 70% of that capital is invested into the believers, and the remaining 30% is used for reinvestment in the Divine Kingdom to maintain a balance of payments. With the current net income of Master’s Divine Kingdom, it is comparable to an ordinary low-rank deity.”
“Does it have to be this exaggerated? I’m just a Divine Being,” Yang Fan said, shocked.
His net income was comparable to a deity; if not for Yang Yi’s reminder, Yang Fan wouldn’t have even dared to think about it.

“There is still a gap in the asset return ratio of the Divine Kingdom compared to a deity, but the expenses are too low. Currently, the total consumption of the Divine Kingdom adds up to less than 5% of the revenue,” Yang Yi explained patiently.
Yang Fan himself followed the path of a War Divine Kingdom, but his current Divine Kingdom investment ratio was much higher than those classmates who followed the logistics path.
The reason for this was that the harvest from the midterm exam was too great, and combined with the existence of the Evolution Talent, it caused a serious imbalance in his income and expenditure.
But fortunately, his income was far greater than his expenditure.
Now, Yang Fan was like a three-year-old child possessing a multi-billion fortune.
However, this fortune was kept in the safest bank in the world, and others could not know about it.

“Master need not worry. The more assets the Divine Kingdom has, the better. After Master enters university or breaks through to a Demigod, there will be many places that need Faith Points. The more funds, the faster the Divine Kingdom can develop.”
Having many Divine Kingdom resources was a good thing.
After the shock passed, Yang Fan brought the topic back.
“For the defense of this Divine Kingdom Defense War, what suggestions do you have?”
“Given the current area of the Divine Kingdom and the distribution of resources, it only requires 1 billion Faith Points to purchase defensive buildings.”

Yang Yi had just calculated the extreme situation; even if all the students in Class 1 attacked together, with these funds to purchase defensive buildings, plus the Divine Kingdom’s believers setting up the Black Tortoise Life-Extinguishing Array, they could easily block it.
“I will give you 10 billion. Spend it all for me,” Yang Fan said.
“Master, defensive buildings have no investment attributes. Isn’t that too wasteful?”

“I am a big tycoon now; how can my home’s security measures be poor? In the future, I want the Divine Kingdom to be like a hedgehog. Whoever wants to attack me will first be pricked until they are covered in blood. Buy the most expensive defensive buildings for me; they must be usable even after I break through to a Demigod,” Yang Fan said heroically.
Although the risk of the Divine Kingdom being invaded was currently extremely low, who made Yang Fan have such sufficient funds?
The stronger the defensive buildings, the better; just consider it buying peace of mind for himself.
“Yes, Master.”
Genius Exchange Group.
“Isn’t it not very good to go to Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom together?”
“There’s nothing wrong with it; we aren’t violating school rules.”
“I’m mainly curious about what stage his Divine Kingdom has developed to!”
“Let’s go together and sweep his outer resources clean.”
“Brother, you’re a bit bad, but I like it. Hahaha.”

chapters.title: Chapter 90: Patrol Robots
paragraphs: With Yang Yi around, Yang Fan didn’t have to worry at all about purchasing or arranging defensive buildings, and his life remained relaxed and uneventful.
Soon, it was time for the Divine Kingdom Defense War to begin.
Just in case, Yang Fan specifically paused his Evolution Talent before class.

“This is just a normal class activity, so do not maliciously destroy the ecology within the Divine Kingdom. Likewise, the defenders’ believers should not launch large-scale attacks. The purpose of this class activity is to let you understand how to build a Divine Kingdom defense system.”
“Focus on defensive buildings, neutral creatures cultivated in the Divine Kingdom, and special environments.”
Before the activity began, Cao Wang urged them once more.
At this moment, he specifically glanced at Yang Fan; after all, since the latter joined Class 1, Grade 12, he had caused quite a few headaches for him.
“Yes, teacher,” everyone said in unison.
Cao Wang nodded and immediately issued instructions to the federal Intelligent Life.
Soon, a new message appeared in Yang Fan’s inbox.
“Class 1, Grade 12 student Divine Kingdom virtual coordinates: Luo Bing: 122-4649-7966 (one-time virtual coordinate) Li Tianheng: 468-7946-7976 (one-time virtual coordinate) Yang Fan:...”
On the other side, in the First High School academic affairs office, Cao Wang was sitting with Yang Wanli, observing this class activity.
Yang Wanli glanced at Cao Wang and asked, “Is Yang Fan really as strong as you say?”
“This kid hides his strength very well. Through this activity, it’s the perfect chance for you to see the strength of our Class 1, Grade 12 star student.”
“Isn’t the Divine Kingdom Defense War a friendly match? How can it test his strength?” Yang Wanli asked, somewhat puzzled.
Cao Wang shook his head, signaling for the other to keep watching.

Under normal circumstances, the Divine Kingdom Defense War is just students visiting each other’s Divine Kingdoms to conduct offense and defense battles, observing others’ Divine Kingdom development, and understanding their own shortcomings.
But Yang Fan was different.
Looking at his students’ eyes, Cao Wang understood that the number of students choosing to enter Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom for this class activity would definitely not be small.
Under the rules, even though Luo Bing and Li Tianheng could not commit much combat power, Class 1, Grade 12 had nearly two hundred students.
Even if only half of the classmates chose to enter Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom, that would still be twenty million troops.
As for the safety of Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom, Cao Wang was even less worried.
Under the monitoring of the federal Intelligent Life, the attackers’ believers could not enter the core area at all, and at most, they could only cause damage on the periphery.
“Don’t you like to hide? I want to see if you can keep hiding this time!” Cao Wang watched the projection, feeling quite smug.
Yang Fan’s consciousness had already entered his own Divine Kingdom, and Yang Yi was also standing beside him.
“The Divine Kingdom Defense War is about to start. Are you ready?” Yang Fan asked.

“Rest assured, Master. With the current defensive power of the Divine Kingdom, even if Divine Beings commit more troops, it is absolutely impossible for them to break through the defense system I have set up,” Yang Yi said confidently.
“Then I shall wait and see!” Yang Fan looked curious.
As a god, Yang Fan naturally knew that a large number of defensive buildings had been purchased within his Divine Kingdom, but he was still unclear about the effects of these buildings.
It was the perfect opportunity to let his good classmates help test the waters.
Soon, Yang Fan felt spatial fluctuations in his Divine Kingdom, and two armies appeared almost simultaneously at the very edge of his Divine Kingdom.
A full four hundred thousand troops, all of whom were second-tier creatures.
In addition to the believer armies, the gods’ consciousnesses were also floating directly above.
The first to arrive were Luo Bing and Li Tianheng.
The two exchanged a glance without saying a word, simultaneously turning their gazes toward the giant island in the sky.
“What is this?” Li Tianheng was full of shock.
“It should be a Wonder-type building,” Luo Bing said with a grave expression.
She had thought that Yang Fan had only obtained the Wonder Spirit Peach Mountain from the midterm exam; she hadn’t expected him to have another Wonder within his Divine Kingdom.
The rich vitality emitted by Penglai Island could be clearly felt even from where they were at the very edge of the Divine Kingdom.
This building was definitely no ordinary item!
“Did your Luo Family invest in this?” Li Tianheng couldn’t help but ask.
Luo Bing shook her head: “No.”
As Luo Hai’s daughter, she how could she not know what the family had invested in for Yang Fan?
“Could it be the school?” Luo Bing couldn’t help but guess in her heart.
Just then, more and more people arrived in Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom.
“Wow, no Wonder his believers are so strong. The environment of this Divine Kingdom is dozens of times better than mine.”
“Such rich life energy.”
“Why is there such a huge island in the sky? Are we really students of the same grade?”
“Awesome, a hidden big shot!”
The scene instantly became lively, with those students in the sky chatting with each other.
In the blink of an eye, the very edge of the Divine Kingdom was already filled with believers, nearly thirty million of them.
Looking at it, the believers were like ants.
Yang Fan’s actions during the midterm exam had angered the masses, and now he was firmly in first place on the Divine Kingdom resource collection leaderboard.
Naturally, everyone wanted to come and see how far his Divine Kingdom had developed.
In the school’s academic affairs office, Yang Wanli’s mouth was wide enough to fit an entire egg.
“Two-thirds of the entire Class 1, Grade 12 have come. Is this kid that hated by others?” Yang Wanli complained.
“Although they are all low-tier believers, many ants can bite an elephant to death. The pressure should be enough to make him reveal his strength!” Cao Wang laughed.
Inside the Divine Kingdom, some people couldn’t help but start sending troops to explore.
They hadn’t walked far when the ground began to squirm.
Only the screams of the believers could be heard as a full ten thousand people were directly swallowed by the surface, followed by a thick cloud of toxic smoke.
“Damn, this is a C-grade defensive building, the Thousand Poison Swamp!”
“The Thousand Poison Swamp is a building worth 2 million! Why did he put it on the periphery? I wasn’t prepared!”
The Thousand Poison Swamp was triggered, and toxic smoke continued to escape, causing the surrounding believers to start fainting in large numbers.
Seeing this, everyone hurriedly ordered their believers to disperse.
Being at the edge, no one had raised their guard yet, and they hadn’t expected to suffer such a big loss right at the start.
“There’s one here too, also a Thousand Poison Swamp!”
“Same here.”
“We haven’t even started, and I’ve already lost 10% of my troops. What is going on?”
Although these believers were not the core combat power of the Divine Kingdom, their value was not low.
If they were all lost here, many people would likely feel the heartache.
“Brother Tianheng, this guy’s Divine Kingdom is a bit eerie. Why are there so many defensive buildings placed on the periphery?” Li Chengze couldn’t help but ask.

Li Tianheng sneered: “What are you afraid of? As long as he isn’t an idiot, he would know that many people would visit his Divine Kingdom for this Divine Kingdom Defense War. Investing a large amount of defensive resources on the periphery is likely to scare us off!”
“That’s right, Big Brother is insightful. This guy is even playing tactics!” Li Chengze slapped his head, suddenly realizing.
“I brought a small treasure pouch today; I must harvest more Spirit Plants from his Divine Kingdom to take back.”
“Hahaha, a kindred spirit.”
“Me too.”
Luo Bing was also deeply interested in the development of Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom.
Together with the others, the army of over thirty million humans marched mightily toward the depths of the Divine Kingdom.
“What is this?” someone suddenly exclaimed in shock.
Looking toward the sound, 1,000 robots walked out from the dense forest.
These humanoid robots had bodies of silvery-white metal, and each held a submachine gun in their hands.
Their movements were uniform, and they aimed their guns at the soldiers in front of them.

Seeing this scene, Li Tianheng hurriedly said: “These are patrol robots produced by the Mechanical Divine Kingdom, constructed entirely of regenerative metal. Each one is worth 100,000 Faith Points. Quickly use shields to defend!”
Just as his words fell, dense gunfire simultaneously erupted in the forest.
Bang, bang, bang, bang.
Bullets fell like a light rain, striking the armor and making metallic clanging sounds.

chapters.title: Chapter 91: You're Fucking Sick!
paragraphs: In the blink of an eye, fresh blood stained the entire land red.
Each robot’s weapon was equipped with 1,000 rounds of ammunition, all of which were fired within a few breaths, killing hundreds of thousands of human believers on the spot.
“Catch up to them; it only takes a quarter of an hour for these robots to reload their ammunition,” Li Tianheng called out.
As a first-class genius of the Li Family, Li Tianheng’s knowledge naturally far exceeded others.
He had once bought a robot out of curiosity to patrol his own Divine Kingdom, which was why he understood this.
Upon hearing this, many classmates arranged for their believers to give chase.
Li Chengze swallowed his saliva and asked, “Big Brother, why did Yang Fan buy so many robots?”
The group of robots that had just appeared was worth 100 million Faith Points.
Wouldn’t it have been better to use those funds to cultivate his own believers?
Rich, he’s fucking rich.
“We might as well take this opportunity to rob him of everything,” Li Tianheng sneered.
Just at this moment, gunfire rang out again from the distance.

Li Chengze seemed to sense something, his face darkening as he said, “It’s my believers. There is a thousand-man robot squad lying in ambush in the distance; the believers I sent out have all been killed in action.”
Li Tianheng turned his head, his eyes filled with shock.
Yang Fan is this rich?
“Damn, there’s a squad here too. They’re using this forest to wage guerrilla warfare.”
“Yang Fan isn’t acting like a human. He has so many resources and doesn’t use them to cultivate his own believers, but instead uses them to defend against us!”
“March at full speed to the open area!” someone shouted.
Their soldiers were at most second-order creatures, and in terms of speed alone, it was difficult to catch up with these patrol robots.
At this moment, a strange phenomenon was occurring in the forest.
Despite being a massive army of ten million, they were essentially sitting ducks.
When the enemy is tired, we strike; when the enemy chases, we flee.
As soon as the ammunition was reloaded, those robots would fire a volley at the crowd.
Only a few days had passed in the Divine Kingdom, yet the main force had already been reduced by four or five million people.
As a god, even though Yang Fan was at the core of his Divine Kingdom, he was well aware of everything happening outside.
“Well done. These robots are quite a lethal weapon against low-order creatures.”

“Thank you for the praise, Master. Apart from combat, the greatest function of these patrol robots is to issue warnings. I have obtained their visual access. Once the environment of the Divine Kingdom deteriorates, or if there is an external invasion, I will be able to know immediately. That is why I spent one billion Faith Points to purchase them. Even if Master breaks through to become a demigod in the future, these patrol robots can still be used.”
On the other side, Li Tianheng and the others had already walked out of the mountain range.
Upon arriving at the open plain, they would immediately spot the patrol robots if they appeared.
Even if they couldn’t catch them, they could have their shield bearers set up a defensive posture, significantly reducing losses.
Seeming to realize that their effectiveness was limited, the robots no longer appeared.
What came into view was a prairie with incredibly lush vegetation that had already grown to the height of a Half-man.
There were also large quantities of red and black flowers, with butterflies, birds, and bees flying in the air.
It felt peaceful and serene.

“Sister Bing, something isn’t right, is it? With such a good environment, why are there no demonic beasts? There aren’t even any unranked beasts like antelopes or yaks.” A genius from the Luo Family couldn’t help but ask.
It wasn’t just the plain they were currently in; the mountain forest they had just passed through was the same.
The land was fertile and the vegetation lush; it was truly strange that such a good natural environment wasn’t being used to raise demonic beasts.
With so many regenerative resources in the Divine Kingdom, was Yang Fan not utilizing them at all?
Hearing this, everyone revealed a thoughtful expression.
“There are beehives here. Could it be that Yang Fan’s main income comes from raising bees and selling honey?”
Huge beehives were placed in the open area, with dense swarms of bees constantly flying in and out.
A classmate commanded his believers to approach, preparing to collect them into his treasure pouch.
Just at that moment, the beehives shook, and a large number of bees swarmed out instantly.
They had just been ordinary wasps collecting nectar, but what appeared now were black-green bee soldiers the size of a palm.

Seeing this scene, Luo Bing’s expression changed drastically: “Quickly command the believers to run! Find the nearest river. This is a B-Grade Building, the Poison Bee Queen. Once a believer is stung, they will undoubtedly die.”
Hearing this, everyone quickly issued a Divine Decree.
Although they hadn’t heard of this building, they didn’t dare to doubt Luo Bing’s words.
Because there were too many believers and no unified command, this evacuation instead caused many stampede accidents.
The bee soldiers were dense, a dark, overwhelming swarm that stung anyone they saw.
Those poisoned believers didn’t die immediately; instead, they dragged their injured bodies along as they fled with the main force.
“Luo Bing, what is the effect of this B-Grade Building, the Poison Bee Queen?” Li Tianheng asked.
“Worker bees will collect poisonous plants and concentrate various toxins within the beehives. Those bee soldiers will then carry the corresponding toxicity,” Luo Bing explained.
Li Tianheng looked at those believers who had been stung by the bee soldiers and were still running with the group, and couldn’t help but say, “The effect isn’t that strong, is it? This is B-Grade?”
Luo Bing shook her head: “The Poison Bee Queen is a growth-oriented B-Grade Building. It needs to cultivate various poisonous flowers and plants; the longer the time, the stronger the toxicity.”

“So that’s how it is. It seems Yang Fan only purchased this building recently. Truly stupid, actually spending a large sum of money to buy a B-Grade Building.” A look of disdain appeared on the corner of Li Tianheng’s mouth.
In the development of a Divine Kingdom, every expense must be calculated carefully.
Even a descendant of a major family like Li Tianheng wouldn’t be willing to buy a C-Grade Building, let alone a B-Grade one.
In his eyes, this action by Yang Fan was simply a waste of resources.
Luo Bing nodded, but the red and black flowers she had just seen suddenly flashed through her mind, and a sliver of an ominous premonition grew in her heart.
Upon arriving at a rushing river, before the believers could jump in, the bee soldiers had already turned back.
Seeing this, everyone breathed a sigh of relief.
“It’s good they stopped chasing. Such a large piece of land, and Yang Fan actually uses it specifically to raise this Poison Bee Queen; what a waste.”

“Defensive buildings basically have no resource production capacity. Once bought, they’re essentially dead weight. Why did Yang Fan set up so many of them in his Divine Kingdom? Just to defend against us?”
“This person is definitely sick. Under the rules, we can’t enter the core area anyway. How many Spirit Plants could we possibly pick? Is it necessary?”
Everyone was speechless; it was mainly because the resistance they had encountered along the way was too much.
They had to remember that they were still on the periphery.
Just at this moment, a commotion suddenly broke out among the believers below.
“What’s the situation? My believers have suddenly lost contact with me!”
“Me too.”
“It seems to be those people who were stung by the bee soldiers.”
“Are they dead? How are these people still moving?”
There is only one situation where a god cannot perceive their believers: the believer has already died.
But at this moment, a bizarre scene occurred.

The expressions of those soldiers who had been stung by the bee soldiers began to twist, their limbs bent at strange angles, their bones made hissing sounds, their eyes opened extremely wide, and blood flowed from their eye sockets.

“This is... Fuck your mother, it’s fucking zombie virus! Those bees carry a zombie virus. Yang Fan, is it necessary? You’re fucking sick!” Li Tianheng seemed to have realized something and couldn’t help but curse loudly.
Those poisoned believers started crazily biting their companions, one spreading to ten, ten spreading to a hundred.
The believers who hadn’t received instructions from their own gods were all dumbfounded.
Why did my brother start attacking me?
Should I fight back?
