Fuck your mother, it’s fucking zombie virus!
Those bees carry a zombie virus.
Yang Fan, is it necessary?
You’re fucking sick!” Li Tianheng seemed to have realized something and couldn’t help but curse loudly.
Those poisoned believers started crazily biting their companions, one spreading to ten, ten spreading to a hundred.
The believers who hadn’t received instructions from their own gods were all dumbfounded.
Why did my brother start attacking me?
Should I fight back?

chapters.title: Chapter 92: I'm Done Playing
paragraphs: The scene instantly became chaotic, with screams and sounds of tearing echoing one after another.
“Brother Tianheng, are you sure this is the zombie virus?” Li Chengze shuddered.
At this moment, he looked at the believers he had brought with him with a hint of disgust in his eyes, as if he didn’t want to take them home.
For a Divine Being, the zombie virus is a catastrophe.
If one accidentally becomes infected, all believers in the Divine Kingdom face the risk of extinction.
Who in their right mind would dare let their Divine Kingdom be contaminated by the zombie virus?
“Lunatic! I’m done playing. You guys can keep commanding these believers; I don’t want them anymore. Goodbye.”
“From now on, I’m definitely walking the other way if I see Yang Fan. This guy is a total madman.”
“These believers are already dead. Don’t get entangled with them; make the believers jump into the river,” another person suggested.
As some believers entered the river, another scream rang out.
The faces of the believers soaking in the water suddenly turned ferocious, and their skin rotted away at a speed visible to the naked eye.
“This river water is also poisonous! Don’t enter the river, run into the mountains!”
“Even the Divine Kingdoms of alien gods aren’t as disgusting as this place. This guy Yang Fan is literally toxic.”
“He really does like poison. Why are all these defensive buildings related to poison? He even brought out the zombie virus. Is this something a normal person would touch?”

“I’ve only seen it in textbooks. Rumor has it that this zombie virus is a weapon of mass destruction against Mortal. Only believers who have broken through the Qi Refining or Martial Apprentice realm can be completely immune, and it can quickly wipe out low-end populations.”
“Yang Fan is a real pervert.”
First High School Academic Affairs Office.
Yang Wanli and Cao Wang were equally dumbfounded.
“That’s a Corpse Flower, right! He’s actually cultivating Corpse Flowers around the Poison Bee Queen? This kid...” Cao Wang swallowed his saliva, his eyes filled with shock as well.

“A Divine Being daring to cultivate Corpse Flowers—I’ve lived for so long, and this is truly the first time I’ve seen it. The principal’s eye for talent is indeed unique,” Yang Wanli couldn’t help but say.
In the core of the Divine Kingdom, Yang Fan watched as the tens of millions of people turned into walking corpses in just a few hours, and he also felt a tingling sensation on his scalp.
“Yang Yi, this zombie virus?”

“Master, according to the rules of this Divine Kingdom Defense War, the enemy’s strength will not be too high. The zombie virus is perfect for eliminating them in large areas at once,” Yang Yi replied.
“That’s not important. What I mean is, won’t my believers get poisoned one day!”

“Master, rest assured. I have already isolated that area. Once this Divine Kingdom Defense War ends, I will sell the Corpse Flowers and will not continue to increase the intensity of the zombie virus. As the believers grow stronger, that bit of virus will no longer pose a threat,” Yang Yi explained.
Hearing this, Yang Fan finally breathed a sigh of relief.
There really was a bit too much poison in his Divine Kingdom!
After this crisis, the believers brought by his classmates were now less than ten million, but most of those who remained were Tiered believers, and their strength was not weak.
Before everyone could catch their breath, a gunshot rang out again behind them.
“Is it ever going to end? A class activity, making it look like a professional tournament!” Li Chengze cursed under his breath.
His believers had finally managed to reach the forest to catch their breath, but these patrol robots appeared again.
Luo Bing turned her head to look into the depths of the forest, her tone calm as she said, “The life energy in this direction is the strongest. Let’s go this way.”
“Sister Bing, what about these robots?”
“The believers we brought are too weak to catch up. Focus on defense; there’s no need to pursue,” Luo Bing said.
“Let’s do that. With so many defensive buildings set up, I want to see what good things Yang Fan actually has,” Li Tianheng nodded in agreement.
Continuing to advance, Luo Bing and the others encountered defensive buildings every so often.
They had long since become numb to this.
After the zombie virus incident, no one planned to take this batch of believers back; if they died, they died.
Since that was the case, they might as well use this opportunity to probe Yang Fan’s true strength.
After walking for a full ten thousand kilometers, their forces had dropped to four million along the way.
Feeling the rich vitality emanating from the forest in front of them, the expressions of Luo Bing and the others were filled with shock.
“What kind of building is set up inside? The life energy is almost tangible,” Li Tianheng couldn’t help but say.
“The aura seems to be from a Moon Well and a Sun Spring,” Luo Bing said, feeling somewhat skeptical.

“Sister Bing, I reckon it’s a B-Grade Building with the same effect. With life energy this rich, how many Moon Wells would you need to set up? No one would be stupid enough to make such a low-return investment,” one of the Luo Family members retorted.
“We’ll know when we take a look,” Li Tianheng said nonchalantly, ordering his believers to be the first to step into the forest.
As they went deeper, the life energy became even richer, and even the expressions of those exhausted believers improved quite a bit.
“It really is a Moon Well and a Sun Spring. He bought so many!” someone exclaimed.
Looking ahead, dense rows of buildings were arranged in an interlocking manner, and there was simply no end in sight.
Just the Moon Wells and Sun Springs in front of them were likely worth no less than one hundred million.
“What on earth is he doing? Why would he buy such a large amount of these low-yield resource buildings?” Luo Bing was full of confusion.
“I’ll take these things first; the classmates who are still here can split them after we get out,” Li Chengze smiled triumphantly.
He had suffered quite a few losses at the hands of Yang Fan, so now that he had finally seen valuable buildings, he naturally didn’t want to let them go.
Just as the believers were approaching the Moon Well, an arrow suddenly shot out from the distance, landing a foot in front of the believers.
“Humans from the outside world, stay away from this place, or don’t blame us for being impolite,” a voice came from the forest.
In the blink of an eye, little spirits clad in green appeared on the towering ancient trees, drawing their bows and nocking arrows in an offensive stance.
“The Elf Race! He’s doing this to cultivate an Ancient Spirit Tree!” Luo Bing said in surprise.
At this moment, Luo Bing’s eyes were filled with admiration.
Cultivating an Ancient Spirit Tree requires a massive amount of time; there is no way to see results in the short term.
The maximum lifespan of a Divine Being is only 500 years.
Even with the most generous calculation, they can at most cultivate an Ancient Spirit Tree that is 100,000 years old.
These Elf Race members can only be considered dependents of the Divine Kingdom and cannot bring intuitive benefits like believers.

Starting to invest huge sums of money to cultivate an Ancient Spirit Tree from the Divine Being stage—regardless of whether this investment was correct or not, Luo Bing greatly admired Yang Fan’s far-sighted vision and courage.
If it were her, she would never dare to spend such a huge price to cultivate an Ancient Spirit Tree sapling.
Watching the tens of thousands of little spirits standing on the towering ancient trees, Li Tianheng and the others were not panicked in the slightest.
Newly born little spirits are all Mortal.
Even if they are Tiered creatures, so what?
The gap in strength between the two sides was too vast.
The Elf Race before them didn’t even put as much pressure on them as those robots.
“Do it. Once we grab these buildings, we leave immediately. The environment here is not conducive to combat,” Li Tianheng commanded.
Li Chengze nodded.
Just as he was about to make a move, a thick vine suddenly swung over from the distance.
Bang!
The huge vine slammed into the shield, and the terrifying force sent nearly a thousand people flying.
“This is a C-Grade defensive building, a Tree Demon. I don’t know how many there are; this is going to be troublesome!” Li Chengze frowned slightly.
“Stupid humans, since you don’t want to leave, then stay! Become nutrients for the forest!” The Elf Race released their grip simultaneously.
Arrows leaped down, accurately and unerringly shooting into the unprotected eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 93: Comparable to the Foundation Establishment Realm
paragraphs: The Elf Race are all master archers; every arrow strikes the enemy’s weakest point, and not a single arrow is wasted.
“Shields up, group of five, charge for me!” Li Chengze began to issue a Divine Decree to direct the battle.
Before the believers could even get close to the Moon Well, the mountains here began to tremble.
Countless tree roots burst out from the ground, wrapping directly around the soldiers’ ankles and dragging them into the soil.
Woo-woo~ Deep in the forest, the earth shook and the mountains swayed as an ancient tree, the size of a small hill, slowly moved outward.
After Li Tianheng saw clearly the source of the commotion, he instantly activated his Mad Blood talent.

“Mad Blood buff activated, run away immediately! Save as many as you can! This is a B-rank defensive structure, the Treant King. Even believers at the Foundation Establishment realm might not be its match. Relying on numerical superiority is meaningless!” Li Tianheng shouted to explain.
Upon hearing this, everyone immediately sent down Divine Decrees to command their believers to flee.
“Where do you think you’re running, invaders! Die!” The Treant King actually spoke in a human voice, and countless tree roots and vines converged from all directions.
“Help me!”
“My God, save me.”
“So painful!”
The believers below screamed in agony.
The strength of those vines was immense, crushing their armor and bones completely.
After one battle, fewer than a million believers remained.
When the battle ended, the Elf Race deep in the forest bowed to the Treant King: “Many thanks for your assistance, Lord Treant.”
“I like it here. Let us protect our home together.” As the Treant King finished speaking, its massive body began to move slowly back into the depths of the forest.
Outside the forest, the expressions on everyone’s faces were equally dramatic, even bordering on disbelief.
“Brother Tianheng, this Treant King... how much is it worth?” Li Chengze looked at his own broken troops and asked with curiosity.
Such a powerful defensive structure was essentially a dimensional strike against them right now; that was strength comparable to the Foundation Establishment realm.
“Five billion Faith Points.” Li Tianheng took a deep breath.
Upon hearing this, the students present were, aside from admiring Yang Fan’s financial resources, mostly speechless.
As a Divine Being and still a high school student, it is basically impossible to encounter a situation where you are invaded.
Why on earth would you set up such a defensive building in your Divine Kingdom?
Five billion Faith Points could buy so many resources to improve the strength of one’s believers, or be used for long-term investments to increase passive income.
The least logical thing to do is to buy defensive structures.
Someone who didn’t know better would think you were fighting a Divine Kingdom War!
Li Tianheng turned his head to look at Luo Bing and asked: “What are your thoughts?”

“I have no interest in plundering a classmate’s Divine Kingdom assets. Right now, I’m just curious about how far his Divine Kingdom has developed.” Luo Bing looked toward the core of Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom, feeling eager to try.
“With the Treant King there, we can’t get past.” Li Tianheng shook his head.
“We can just go around it.” Luo Bing pointed to the grass at the edge of the forest.
“The journey would be at least three or four times longer, and the defensive structures along the way...”
“So what if the believers all die? They’re just Tier 2 creatures; do you still care about such things?” Luo Bing said in a cold tone.
Hearing this, quite a few people nodded.

“Sister Bing is right. After that incident with the poison bees, I wasn’t planning on bringing these believers back to my own Divine Kingdom anyway. It’s better to let them expend their remaining value.”
“I’m also curious about just how far Yang Fan has pulled ahead of me.”
“I used to think Yang Fan was just a bottom-tier, unscrupulous scumbag. I didn’t expect his strength to be this formidable. It really was a case of being blinded by a leaf.”
After witnessing the danger level of Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom, everyone’s assessment of him rose to a new level.
As expected, as long as one is strong enough, there will naturally be great scholars to argue on one’s behalf.
Even the negative opinions everyone held about him from the midterm exams faded quite a bit.
“Let’s go, let’s go see together.” Li Tianheng was full of fighting spirit.
At the core of the Divine Kingdom, Yang Fan couldn’t help but ask: “Can the Treant King go out and fight for me like the believers?”

“No. Although the Treant King is classified as a defensive structure, it is actually a neutral creature. If placed in a suitable environment, it can automatically guard the Divine Kingdom. However, it has no allegiance; even one’s own believers will be attacked if they enter that forest.”
“No wonder it only cost five billion Faith Points despite being so strong.” Yang Fan sighed.
The power just displayed by the Treant King, if it appeared inside the City of Technology, would likely be enough to sweep through all his believers.

“Reporting to Master, given the current situation of the Divine Kingdom, there is actually no need to purchase too many defensive structures. Since the funds provided by Master were so generous, I could only plan from a long-term perspective and purchase more expensive structures.”
“Understood. Next up is this final big guy.” Yang Fan said, looking at the massive cannon newly installed on the city wall.
“B-rank City-Destroying Cannon, from a Tier 2 Mechanical Divine Kingdom. It cannot be moved, requires one month to charge, and one shot is enough to destroy a city. Value: 2 billion Faith Points.”
Sensing that Li Tianheng and the others were still carefully probing and moving forward, Yang Fan directly removed the defensive structures along the way to speed up their progress.
Along the way, because they were no longer threatened by defensive structures, Li Tianheng and his group marched much faster.
In less than a month, they had bypassed the Elf Forest, and the City of Technology was directly within their line of sight.
The massive City of Technology spanned from north to south; it was impossible to see the end of it with the naked eye.
Ten thousand meters in the air, Penglai Island was wreathed in ethereal mist, resembling an earthly paradise.
And directly below it was the City of Technology, emitting a silver-white glow with flowing, shimmering light.
Li Tianheng turned to look at the deep, quiet forest behind him, and then looked at the modern-style metropolis in front of him; a sense of incongruity arose in his heart as well.
“Sister Bing, Brother Tianheng, what path is Yang Fan taking? Is he preparing to go in the mechanical direction?” A voice came from the crowd.
Gods who take the mechanical path are extremely rare, and most of them come from big cities because this path burns through too many resources.
Not to mention ordinary people, even a great family like the Luo Family might not dare to support their family’s prodigies in taking this path.

Luo Bing explained: “It’s just a city. The cities produced by the Mechanical Divine Kingdom have excellent living environments. Letting believers live in them can significantly increase the birth rate.”
As a prodigy of the Luo Family, Luo Bing naturally had a more rational view.
She also had a City of Technology in her Divine Kingdom, but it was much smaller than this one of Yang Fan’s.

Even though she was a First-Class Genius of the Luo Family, with a monthly family subsidy and additional funding from her father, what she had seen and heard during this time made Luo Bing feel that Yang Fan seemed to be much wealthier than she was.
“Where on earth did this guy get so many funds?” Luo Bing was filled with curiosity.
In the Academic Affairs Office of the First High School, Cao Wang finally perked up a bit.

“Director Yang, they are finally going to engage in battle. It’s just a pity that Li Tianheng and his group’s forces have been depleted too much. Even with the Mad Blood talent buff, it won’t be enough.”
“They won’t be able to put much pressure on Yang Fan!” Cao Wang said regretfully.
Yang Wanli laughed: “This kid is a bit mysterious. I want to see just how strong his believers are overall!”

Letting believers live in them can significantly increase the birth rate.”
As a prodigy of the Luo Family, Luo Bing naturally had a more rational view.
She also had a City of Technology in her Divine Kingdom, but it was much smaller than this one of Yang Fan’s.

Even though she was a First-Class Genius of the Luo Family, with a monthly family subsidy and additional funding from her father, what she had seen and heard during this time made Luo Bing feel that Yang Fan seemed to be much wealthier than she was.
“Where on earth did this guy get so many funds?” Luo Bing was filled with curiosity.
In the Academic Affairs Office of the First High School, Cao Wang finally perked up a bit.
“Director Yang, they are finally going to engage in battle.
It’s just a pity that Li Tianheng and his group’s forces have been depleted too much.
Even with the Mad Blood talent buff, it won’t be enough.”
“They won’t be able to put much pressure on Yang Fan!” Cao Wang said regretfully.
Yang Wanli laughed: “This kid is a bit mysterious.
I want to see just how strong his believers are overall!”

chapters.title: Chapter 94: People Are Just That Realistic
paragraphs: Yang Fan also noticed the situation outside the city within his Divine Kingdom.
“Begin. Let me see the power of this City-Annihilating Cannon.” Yang Fan ordered.
Under Yang Fan’s command, the massive turret began to turn.
“What is this? Is Yang Fan not planning to fight us?” Li Tianheng looked at the massive City-Annihilating Cannon, a look of confusion on his face.
Luo Bing sighed softly and said, “Let’s go. There’s no point anymore.”
“What do you mean?”
There was no answer; Luo Bing’s consciousness had already left this place.
Countless energy patterns converged at the core of the cannon—the City-Annihilating Cannon activated.
The next instant, a blinding pillar of light tore through the sky!
It headed straight for the location of everyone’s believers.
All the believers were annihilated instantly in the extreme high energy before they could even scream.
A million people, all evaporated in the blink of an eye.
The light dissipated, and the ground was no longer as it had been.
The original ground had been forcibly blasted into a huge deep pit, its edges molten, still radiating residual heat.
The entire world, after that one shot, fell into a deathly silence.
Seeing this, Li Tianheng and the others had their mouths slightly agape, wanting to say something but stopping.
Was that necessary?
Who was this show of force for?
“Yang Fan, you’re good!” Li Tianheng snorted coldly, and his consciousness immediately left the place.
Everyone looked at the massive island in the sky, the boundless City of Technology, and that terrifying City-Annihilating Cannon.
The envy on their faces could not be hidden.
Looking at the spot where their believers had just disappeared, some also felt a pang of pain.
Every year’s Divine Kingdom Defense War was just a formality; everyone would just fight tentatively and call it a day.
Unlike this time, which ended in total annihilation.
Inside the Academic Affairs Office of Yang County No.
1 Middle School, Yang Wanli said with a wry smile, “This is what you wanted me to see? The pressure is indeed great, but the target was wrong.”

Cao Wang’s face darkened when he heard this: “Who knew this kid would be so well-prepared? These defensive buildings combined are probably worth nearly ten billion; ordinary demigods aren’t even as extravagant as him.”
“Interesting, truly interesting. A student who can attract the principal’s attention is indeed extraordinary.” Yang Wanli changed his opinion.
The Divine Kingdom Defense War class activity ended.
Upon returning to reality, Yang Fan suddenly found he had received a message.
“Group owner Luo Bing invites you to join the Genius Exchange Group.”
Yang Fan was a bit surprised.
Wasn’t he kicked out by Li Tianheng?
Clicking agree, Yang Fan returned to the group chat.
“Welcome, Brother Yang.”
“Brother Yang is amazing. That was a City-Annihilating Cannon, right? I looked it up, the market value is 2 billion. You’re really willing to spend!”
“Are you preparing to cultivate the Ancient Spirit Tree? Isn’t the investment cycle a bit too long? @Yang Fan.”
“Let the past unhappiness be in the past. Let’s laugh off our grudges. Remember not to bring zombie viruses when visiting in the future! I’m really scared. @Yang Fan.”
As soon as Yang Fan agreed to join, he saw a flurry of messages.
Now, he had suddenly jumped from being a rat that everyone wanted to beat, to being Brother Yang in everyone’s mouths.
This rapid shift in status made Yang Fan a bit uncomfortable.
People are just that realistic.
Offend a strong person, and a bunch of lackeys want to come up and kick you a few times.
Now that he had become the strong one, these same people started actively trying to build a relationship.
Just a rabble.
After casually agreeing with a few things in the group, Yang Fan clicked on message mute and continued his presidential suite life at the Tianxiang Renjian.
On the eve of the College Entrance Examination, the resource collection ranking was finally determined.
“Yang Fan: 85.7 billion points.
Luo Bing: 67.92 billion points;
Li Tianheng: 66.94 billion points.
As the assessment ended, Yang Fan’s believers were forced to leave the Alien Divine Kingdom.
And he got his wish and won first place.
“I Wonder what building the school will reward me with this time?” Yang Fan felt some anticipation.
The Penglai Island rewarded by the school had caused a heaven-turning, earth-shattering change in his Divine Kingdom.
Yang Fan’s consciousness entered the Divine Kingdom, and the specific information appeared before his eyes.
“Divine Lord: Yang Fan
Divine Kingdom area: 1 million square kilometers
Talent: omitted
Believers: Tier 5 Beings (46), Tier 4 Beings (53,274), Tier 3 Beings (2.25 million), Tier 2 Beings (10.3 million), Tier 1 Beings (25.7 million), Mortal (11.7 million)
Kin: little spirits (22,718)
Techniques: Everlasting Spring Technique...
Locking Heaven Array (E-Grade, Great Success stage), Extinguishing God Array (E-Grade, Great Success stage), Black Tortoise Life-Extinguishing Array (D-Grade, beginner)...
Faith Points: 37.9 billion (providing 795.8 Faith Points daily)

Buildings: Moon Well X20,000, Sun Spring X20,000, B-Grade Building Monkey Wine Spring X100, B-Grade hundred herb spirit pivot academy, Special Life Building Ancient Spirit Tree (Millennium, currently gestating little spirits), Special Building Enlightenment Stone...

B-Grade Defensive Building Poison Bee Queen, B-Grade Defensive Building Tree Demon King, B-Grade Defensive Building City-Annihilating Cannon, C-Grade Thousand Poison Swamp X50, Patrol Robot X10,000...
Wonder: Penglai Island (already placed), Spirit Peach Mountain (already placed)
Assets: Taisui X610, small mineral veins, various spiritual fruits (), various medicinal herbs and Spirit Plants (), D-Grade weapons (), E-Grade weapons (), F-Grade weapons ()”
The explosive growth phase of believer strength had ended.
Under the tenfold Evolution Talent, in the past four to five hundred years, even the faces of the Tier 5 beings had all been replaced.
Without transforming into a mortal and entering the Dao to break through to Qi Refining, even a Tier 5 being’s lifespan was no more than four hundred years.

Now, the high-tier believers in Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom were in a state of dynamic change, either dying from exhausted lifespans or from illness, but at the same time, new believers were breaking through in strength to fill the vacancies.
The overall strength of the believers was in a slow growth process.
Yang Fan was not in a hurry.
Divine Kingdom development required resources and opportunities, but more importantly, time itself.
During this period, apart from the Divine Kingdom’s own earnings, the resources collected by Yang Er in the Alien Divine Kingdom had also long since been sold.
About seven days ago, the loans from Elephant Loan had all been repaid.
With Yang Fan’s current income, he was not short of funds at all and had no urgent need to look for high-yield Divine Kingdom investments.
Because he had the intention to cultivate the Elf Race, under Yang Yi’s suggestion, he had purchased quite a few more Moon Wells and Sun Springs.

Yang Fan could feel that as the aura of life within the Divine Kingdom became richer, the growth speed of the Ancient Spirit Tree had increased quite a bit; reaching maturity might not even take one hundred thousand years.
Following the improvement in believer aptitude, as Yang Fan expected, both the E-Grade Extinguishing God Array and Locking Heaven Array had been comprehended to the Great Success stage.
Yang Fan had been waiting for this moment for a long time.
Before the College Entrance Examination, he still had to participate in one Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle.
First, for the Luo Family’s benefits; it would be a waste not to take the over 10 billion Faith Points.
Second, he wanted to sprint for the top 10,000 in the Yang County Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle.
After studying the recruitment prospectuses of various universities during this time, Yang Fan discovered that the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle was a major bonus point.
There were even records of a high school student from Yang County No.
1 Middle School breaking into the top 10,000 in the simulation battle and eventually joining Xingqiong Academy through a special admission route.
Compared to the Luo Family’s Faith Point subsidy, Yang Fan valued its added value more.
University is a stepping stone; since there is an opportunity, he naturally wants to strive for the best.
For this College Entrance Examination, Yang Fan’s goal was originally the two strongest universities in the Federation.
“Better to be the head of a chicken than the tail of a phoenix.” This saying is chicken soup fed to you by those poor schools for the sake of recruitment.
The real situation is that a mountain chicken can only ever look up and envy the phoenix’s tail.

chapters.title: Chapter 95: Purchasing B-Grade Weapons Climbing the Rankings
paragraphs: “What are the chances of me entering the top ten thousand in Yang County if I participate in the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle with my current strength?” Yang Fan asked tentatively.

“Reporting to Master, information regarding the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle is top-secret information of the Federal Government; it is impossible to use information leaked online for big data reference,” Yang Yi said.

“It is rare even in big cities for a high school student to comprehend an E-grade formation to the Great Success stage. Since Yang County is located in a remote area, Master has a considerable chance with his current strength,” Yang Er provided his judgment from a different perspective.
Yang Fan nodded and arranged, “Help me select the strongest ten thousand elite soldiers.”
“Judging by the current overall situation, I suggest Master purchase ten thousand sets of B-grade weapons. The army’s overall combat power will increase by about sixty percent,” Yang Er added.
Yang Fan’s eyes couldn’t help but light up.
Since he was now wealthy, if his believers’ own strength was insufficient, he might as well rely on external forces.
B-grade weapons—those were war supplies for gods.
Currently, the strongest beings in his Divine Kingdom were only fifth-order creatures.
If they were equipped with ten thousand sets of B-grade weapons, it would definitely be overpowered.
“What is the price?”
“Ten thousand sets of B-grade weapons have a current market value of 20 billion.”
Returning to reality, Yang Fan immediately put on his virtual helmet and entered the Luo Family base.
Having added Luo Tietie’s contact information last time, Yang Fan had just sent a message, and the other party immediately provided the coordinates.
“Oh my, the great genius Yang has been making quite a name for himself lately, winning first place in the senior year twice in a row. His future achievements will be limitless.”
Luo Tietie was burly and stout, but his movements were extremely agile.
He spun three hundred and sixty degrees on the spot and came over to pull him into a hug.
“Cough, cough.” Yang Fan coughed violently a few times.
The other party was too enthusiastic, making it somewhat difficult for him to accept.
During this period, Yang Fan had been enjoying the softness of beauties in the Tianxiang Renjian, so being suddenly hugged by a three or four hundred-pound fat man made him shudder involuntarily.
“I... I want to purchase weapons,” Yang Fan said, inadvertently pushing the other party away.
“The College Entrance Examination is coming up soon, and many of the younger generation of the Luo Family have been asking me to order weapons, but I have been keeping a portion for you privately.”
“Come, sit down and let’s talk. I have some excellent Longjing tea here!” Luo Tietie’s face was filled with smiles.
“Little Brother Yang, I wonder what grade of weapons you need, and how many sets?” Luo Tietie took a sip of tea.
Yang Fan said, “Ten thousand sets of B-grade weapons!”
“Pfft!”
The tea in Luo Tietie’s mouth sprayed out directly.
He looked up at Yang Fan as if he had misheard, and asked, “That, what grade?”
“B-grade.”
“N-no, have you broken through to a Demigod?” As soon as Luo Tietie finished speaking, he wished he could slap himself.
What kind of stupid question was that to ask?
The other party was a high school student; at most, he had only awakened his Divine Kingdom for one year.
Breaking through to a Demigod in one year?
Dream on!
“No,” Yang Fan shook his head.
“Don’t mind me. Your brother here is just confused. You don’t even have any believers in the Qi Refining Realm, so why are you equipping so many B-grade weapons?”
“To participate in the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle,” Yang Fan answered truthfully.
“You know the market price of B-grade weapons, right?”
“Of course, ten thousand sets are about 20 billion.”
“These are war consumables. Are you sure you want to spend so much capital on purchasing weapons?” Luo Tietie couldn’t help but remind him again.
Yang Fan nodded earnestly.
To others, this was a misallocation of resources, but since Yang Fan was earning enough now, why not?
20 billion Faith Points was nothing; it was just one week’s income for Yang Fan.
“Cough, cough.” Luo Tietie coughed and continued, “I have the things you want in stock, but unlike those low-grade weapons, I can only give you a five percent discount at most.”

Before Yang Fan could answer, Luo Tietie continued to explain, “It’s not that I’m being stingy, brother. The cost of weapons above B-grade is very high. Even when the gods within the clan purchase from me, I mostly just give them a five percent discount as a gesture.”

“On the market, there are forging buildings produced by the Mechanical Divine Kingdom, such as the Spirit Weapon Workshop, Heavenly Weapon Pavilion, etc. With these buildings, C-grade weapons and below can basically be mass-produced. But B-grade weapons are different; not only do they require smelting high-grade ore, but simple magic arrays must also be engraved inside the weapons. Weapons of B-grade and above all need to be personally forged by a master blacksmith. My Divine Kingdom has cultivated fewer than ten thousand blacksmiths, and all the people in the Luo Family who do forging business added together are not enough to meet the consumption of their own gods. This stuff is never hard to sell.”
Yang Fan expressed his understanding and directly transferred 19 billion Faith Points into Luo Tietie’s Divine Kingdom.
“So generous. Among the younger generation of the Luo Family, I’m afraid only you and Miss Luo Bing would dare to spend like this,” Luo Tietie exclaimed.
“Did Luo Bing also purchase B-grade weapons?”

“Same idea as you, wanting to push for a ranking in the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle. However, if you want to challenge the number one spot in the Luo Family, I’m afraid you will be disappointed. Luo Bing already has over 8,000 points.”
Luo Tietie took out the card loaded with the supplies and handed it to Yang Fan.
Yang Fan thanked him and left the Luo Family base.

“In the future, when participating in real Divine Kingdom wars, the consumption of weapons will surely be an astronomical figure. Once I become a Demigod and have believers in the Qi Refining Realm, I must also cultivate my own blacksmiths,” Yang Fan decided in his heart.
To engrave magic arrays into weapons, one needs at least believers in the Qi Refining Realm; no wonder weapons above B-grade are so expensive.
With a thought, Yang Fan opened the Luo Family’s Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle leaderboard:
“1st Place, Luo Bing, First-Class Genius, 8761 points, win rate 53.2%.
2nd Place, Luo Hen, First-Class Genius, 8110 points, win rate 54.5%.
...72nd Place, Yang Fan, Second-Class Genius, 1244 points, win rate 92.5%.
...109th Place, Luo Mingxuan, Second-Class Genius, 1122 points, win rate 50.2%.”
On the eve of the College Entrance Examination, all the geniuses were pushing for points, and Yang Fan’s ranking had also dropped to 72nd.
After loading the B-grade weapons into his Divine Kingdom, Yang Fan immediately started the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle.
46 fifth-order creatures, 9954 fourth-order creatures, and all equipped with full sets of B-grade weapons.
This was Yang Fan’s strongest army at the moment.
“Identity: Divine Being, number of believers: ten thousand, meets the requirements of the simulation battle. Do you wish to start matching?”
“Start.”
“Matching started, matching successful. Random battle scene: Volcano. Battle begins.”
As the Intelligent Life’s prompt sound faded, Yang Fan saw his opponent’s believers immediately.
There were only a few dozen third-order believers.
Facing such a lineup, Yang Fan couldn’t even summon the slightest bit of interest.
In just a few breaths, relying on overwhelming combat power, he instantly slaughtered the opponent.
In a distant star region, inside a commercial apartment, a man took off his virtual helmet.
“Every time I win a few games in a row, it matches me with such monsters, breaking my winning streak. Disgusting!”

In the real world, Yang Fan had only not participated in the simulation battle for a few months, but for him, with the Evolution Talent, thousands of years had already passed within his Divine Kingdom.
With his current points and Yang Fan’s strength, it was basically a state of suppression, sweeping all the way through.
2000 points, 3000 points, 5000 points, 7000 points.
Yang Fan had won 300 games in a row.
The points had gone from +10 per game at the beginning to +100 now.
“All believers dead, battle over. Federal citizen Yang Fan, points +104, current points 7542, win rate 98.8%. Do you wish to continue the simulation battle?”
“Continue.”
“Generating scene—Grassland. Battle begins.”
The environment changed again.
Yang Fan’s consciousness hovered directly above his believers, looking at the enemy army, his eyes finally showing some seriousness.
40 fifth-order creatures, the rest were all fourth-order, and like Yang Fan, the opponent was fully equipped with B-grade weapons.

With these buildings, C-grade weapons and below can basically be mass-produced.
But B-grade weapons are different; not only do they require smelting high-grade ore, but simple magic arrays must also be engraved inside the weapons.
Weapons of B-grade and above all need to be personally forged by a master blacksmith.

My Divine Kingdom has cultivated fewer than ten thousand blacksmiths, and all the people in the Luo Family who do forging business added together are not enough to meet the consumption of their own gods.
This stuff is never hard to sell.”
Yang Fan expressed his understanding and directly transferred 19 billion Faith Points into Luo Tietie’s Divine Kingdom.
“So generous.
Among the younger generation of the Luo Family, I’m afraid only you and Miss Luo Bing would dare to spend like this,” Luo Tietie exclaimed.
“Did Luo Bing also purchase B-grade weapons?”
“Same idea as you, wanting to push for a ranking in the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle.
However, if you want to challenge the number one spot in the Luo Family, I’m afraid you will be disappointed.
Luo Bing already has over 8,000 points.”
Luo Tietie took out the card loaded with the supplies and handed it to Yang Fan.
Yang Fan thanked him and left the Luo Family base.
“In the future, when participating in real Divine Kingdom wars, the consumption of weapons will surely be an astronomical figure.
Once I become a Demigod and have believers in the Qi Refining Realm, I must also cultivate my own blacksmiths,” Yang Fan decided in his heart.
To engrave magic arrays into weapons, one needs at least believers in the Qi Refining Realm; no wonder weapons above B-grade are so expensive.
With a thought, Yang Fan opened the Luo Family’s Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle leaderboard:
“1st Place, Luo Bing, First-Class Genius, 8761 points, win rate 53.2%.
2nd Place, Luo Hen, First-Class Genius, 8110 points, win rate 54.5%.
...72nd Place, Yang Fan, Second-Class Genius, 1244 points, win rate 92.5%.
...109th Place, Luo Mingxuan, Second-Class Genius, 1122 points, win rate 50.2%.”
On the eve of the College Entrance Examination, all the geniuses were pushing for points, and Yang Fan’s ranking had also dropped to 72nd.
After loading the B-grade weapons into his Divine Kingdom, Yang Fan immediately started the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle.
46 fifth-order creatures, 9954 fourth-order creatures, and all equipped with full sets of B-grade weapons.
This was Yang Fan’s strongest army at the moment.
“Identity: Divine Being, number of believers: ten thousand, meets the requirements of the simulation battle.
Do you wish to start matching?”
“Start.”
“Matching started, matching successful.
Random battle scene: Volcano.
Battle begins.”
As the Intelligent Life’s prompt sound faded, Yang Fan saw his opponent’s believers immediately.
There were only a few dozen third-order believers.
Facing such a lineup, Yang Fan couldn’t even summon the slightest bit of interest.
In just a few breaths, relying on overwhelming combat power, he instantly slaughtered the opponent.
In a distant star region, inside a commercial apartment, a man took off his virtual helmet.
“Every time I win a few games in a row, it matches me with such monsters, breaking my winning streak.
Disgusting!”

In the real world, Yang Fan had only not participated in the simulation battle for a few months, but for him, with the Evolution Talent, thousands of years had already passed within his Divine Kingdom.
With his current points and Yang Fan’s strength, it was basically a state of suppression, sweeping all the way through.
2000 points, 3000 points, 5000 points, 7000 points.
Yang Fan had won 300 games in a row.
The points had gone from +10 per game at the beginning to +100 now.
“All believers dead, battle over.
Federal citizen Yang Fan, points +104, current points 7542, win rate 98.8%.
Do you wish to continue the simulation battle?”
“Continue.”
“Generating scene—Grassland.
Battle begins.”
The environment changed again.
Yang Fan’s consciousness hovered directly above his believers, looking at the enemy army, his eyes finally showing some seriousness.
40 fifth-order creatures, the rest were all fourth-order, and like Yang Fan, the opponent was fully equipped with B-grade weapons.

chapters.title: Chapter 96: Mechanical God
paragraphs: After so many battles, Yang Fan finally understood the ranking mechanism of this Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle.
When he had been on a winning streak for a while, opponents whose strength far exceeded his current points would appear.
If he could win, the point rewards for subsequent battles would increase significantly each time.
This matchmaking system was practically designed for people like them who were grinding for points; otherwise, adding points one by one would be too inefficient.
Setting up the Locking Heaven Array, all his believers stood ready.
As the two armies clashed, Yang Fan’s army instantly suppressed the opponent.

“The strength is sufficient, and the equipment is good, but the comprehension of the array is lacking. They must be a high school student like me; I just don’t know where this genius is from,” Yang Fan evaluated inwardly.
The Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle had no age limit.

Having gone through so many battles, Yang Fan had encountered opponents who had comprehended E-grade arrays to the Great Success stage, but they had lost to him due to their own insufficient strength and weaponry.
By 7000+ points, many opponents had comprehended arrays to the Great Success stage.
A situation like this opponent’s clearly indicated they were a high school student who hadn’t awakened their Divine Kingdom for long.
Aside from the aptitude of the believers, the most important factor in array comprehension was time.
If not for Yang Fan possessing the Evolution Talent, even the most basic Myriad Spirits Return to Origin Array might not have reached the Great Success stage by now.
Soon, the opponent’s grand array was broken, and their ten thousand believers were slaughtered.
“Battle ended. Points +201. Current points: 7746. Win rate: 98.9%. Continue matchmaking?”
“Continue.”
In the outside world, the various family groups of the Luo Family were already in an uproar.
Yang Fan, a genius with an outside surname, had now broken into the family’s top ten.
“His ranking hadn’t moved for so long that I’d almost forgotten about him. I didn’t expect him to be holding back such a big surprise.”
“For any genius who can make the top ten each year, as long as they don’t fall in the future, becoming a god is basically a certainty.”
“Luo Chengfeng is lucky; he really did recruit a hero for our Luo Family.”
“Don’t hide at home giggling, come out and talk. @Luo Chengfeng.”
At this moment, Luo Chengfeng was in his Virtual World office, looking at the Luo Family leaderboard projected on the wall.
Sitting beside him was Luo Rou, who was already showing signs of pregnancy.
“Good! With my grandson-in-law’s strength, I’d like to see what you, Luo Xuan and your wife, can say now?” Luo Chengfeng said triumphantly.
“Grandfather, is my husband really that amazing?”
Looking at Yang Fan’s eighth-place result, Luo Rou was a bit dazed.
She had once thought Yang Fan was a bastard who was sponging off her family; now it seemed she was the one who had married above her station.
“Xiao Fan is already on a 300-match winning streak. At this rate, if he wins a few more, that girl Luo Bing will likely be outdone.” Luo Chengfeng laughed heartily.
Luo Rou said pleasantly surprised, “Then does my husband have a chance to enter the top 10,000 in Yang County?”
Upon hearing this, Luo Chengfeng’s expression became somewhat serious.

“That will likely be difficult. After 10,000 points, the opponents encountered are basically old fogies who have lived for three or four hundred years. Xiao Fan has good talent, but it’s only been a year since he awakened his Divine Kingdom; the gap is too large.”

“It’s been over a decade since a high school student broke into the top 10,000. When Luo Bing awakened her Ice Spirit Root, she also made bold claims, setting this as her goal, but looking at it now, the gap is vast.”

“Just keep a calm mind. With Xiao Fan’s current results, obtaining the Luo Family’s First-Class Genius investment is a certainty. Once he reaches university, I fear that in the future, even your grandfather will be unable to catch up to him.”
Luo Chengfeng was very happy.
His children had all died in battle for the family, and his only granddaughter had also suffered damage to her Divine Kingdom and did not have long to live.
He hadn’t expected the grandson-in-law he recruited to have such talent.
Yang Fan’s points continued to skyrocket: 8000, 8300, 8500.
Due to his continuous victories, his points soon reached 9341.
“1st place: Yang Fan, Second-Class Genius, 9341 points, 99% win rate.
2nd place: Luo Bing, First-Class Genius, 8761 points, 53.2% win rate.
3rd place: Luo Hen, First-Class Genius, 8110 points, 54.5% win rate.
Luo Bing looked at the current leaderboard, and her cold, arrogant expression finally changed.
“Why is he so strong?” Luo Bing bit her lip slightly, her expression showing some unwillingness.
Having awakened the B-grade Ice Spirit Root, the former Luo Bing had an ambition higher than the sky.

She hadn’t looked down on anyone in the younger generation of Yang County, and even boasted that she would enter the top 10,000 of the Yang County Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle during high school, aiming to enter Xingqiong Academy.
The ideal was plump, but the reality was skinny.
Only as graduation approached did Luo Bing truly understand the difficulty of it.
Even though she was a First-Class Genius of the Luo Family and had the support of her father, the Tier 3 God Luo Hai, her resources far exceeded her peers.
However, the development time of her Divine Kingdom was too short; in terms of array comprehension, she was still no match for the older generation.
After her points reached over 8000, it became hard to advance even an inch.
But what was Luo Bing seeing right now?
Yang Fan actually had a chance to reach her goal.
The further the points went, the exponentially higher the strength of the opponents became, yet Yang Fan’s current win rate was as high as 99%.
What did this mean?
He had been winning continuously from the start; his true strength was far beyond this.
“Perhaps you have a chance to enter the top 10,000,” Luo Bing murmured as she watched the points constantly jumping on the leaderboard.
Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle space.
“Battle ended. Points +307. Current points: 9832. Win rate: 99.1%. Continue matchmaking?”
Hearing the prompt, Yang Fan let out a sigh of relief.
In this battle, he had lost as much as 60% of his soldiers.
If not for following Yang Er’s suggestion to purchase B-grade weaponry, his winning streak would likely have ended here.
“Continue.”
As the space evolved, the environment Yang Fan was in changed into a mountain range.
After seeing the enemy clearly, Yang Fan was stunned.
The opponent’s believers were not strong in terms of cultivation realm; the ten thousand believers were all Third-Order beings, but their equipment was extremely strange.

All the believers were covered from head to toe in silver-white armor, with uniform thrusters equipped behind the armor, and the weapons they held were laser longswords, not the common iron weapons seen on the market.
Even though their cultivation realm was so weak, they could be matched against him.
Yang Fan did not dare to be careless and ordered his believers to set up the Locking Heaven Array and enter a defensive state.
Since he didn’t understand the depth of the opponent, the best method was to use defense to replace offense.
Just then, the opponent’s believers held their swords in their right hands, and with a unified motion, took out metal barrel-like objects from their chests with their left hands.
“What the hell?”
As Yang Fan was wondering, countless bullets shot directly out from the metal barrels.
“Fuck! This guy is a god who follows the Mechanical path.” Yang Fan’s face was filled with shock.
The number of gods following the Mechanical path was too scarce.
There were two thousand people in the third year of high school in Yang County, but not a single one followed the Mechanical path.
This was the first time Yang Fan had encountered a Mechanical God.
Countless bullets smashed toward Yang Fan’s army formation like raindrops.
Bang, bang, bang, bang.
The believers in front had already raised their shields, blocking 90% of the bullets.
One had to know that the shield soldiers in front were all believers who practiced the Vajra Indestructible Technique and had powerful physical bodies.
Even so, those bullets that grazed past the shields and landed on them pierced straight through them.
The bullets seemed endless, dense and packed, wave after wave, giving them absolutely no chance to catch their breath.
“This is too shameless! Shield soldiers, provide cover! Entire army, charge!” Yang Fan commanded.

chapters.title: Chapter 97: Human Prodigy
paragraphs: Unlike the patrol robots in his own Divine Kingdom, the weapons in his opponent’s hands were clearly of a higher grade.
In just this short amount of time, he had already lost hundreds of men; if he stayed where he was, he would only be a lamb waiting to be slaughtered.
Advancing to within about a hundred meters, the opponent retracted their gun barrels and charged forward, wielding laser swords.
“Extinguishing God Array, engage the enemy.”
Switching formations, he used offense as defense.
As the two armies clashed, Yang Fan found the scene unfolding before him almost unbelievable.
Every time the opponent’s weapons touched his soldiers, they released a powerful electric current, causing even Fifth-Order creatures to pause for a moment.
What was most terrifying was that no matter how his soldiers attacked, they could not land a hit on the enemy.
In such a complex environment of two armies clashing, the enemy soldiers made no superfluous movements, and their speed was simply not what a Third-Order creature should possess.
This was completely a one-sided massacre; even though his followers were stronger, the opponent had wiped them all out without suffering a single casualty throughout the entire battle.
“Battle ended. Points -1. Current points: 9340. Win rate: 98.5%. Do you wish to continue matching?”
Yang Fan’s followers had already been resurrected, but he did not rush to start, asking instead in his mind.
“Yang Yi, what is going on with their weapons?”

“Reporting to Master, this is non-mass-produced fully automatic equipment from the Mechanical Divine Kingdom. It possesses intelligent chips and can dodge, defend, and attack on its own. Just now, Master was actually fighting the equipment.”
“This is too unfair, can they really do that?”
Yang Fan was utterly speechless.
That battle had been a literal dimensionality-reduction strike.
Even though his soldiers had comprehended the Extinguishing God Array at the Great Success stage, they were still fish on the chopping block, easily slaughtered by others.

“The Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle only restricts identity and the number of soldiers; weapons of any grade will be synchronized and projected into the simulation space. Moreover, the core advantage of the Mechanical Divine Kingdom is its weapons and intelligent control. The opponent is not in violation,” Yang Yi explained.
“Then can I buy these weapons?”
“You can, but each set costs 100 million Faith Points, and your current funds are severely insufficient. Furthermore, without a Mechanical Heart, the combat power would be significantly reduced.”
Upon hearing this, Yang Fan’s eyelids twitched violently.
The total value of the opponent’s weapons was as high as one trillion.
No Wonder he had lost so miserably; he had essentially been crushed by money.
“Forget it. With this matching mechanism, it’s impossible for me to win forever; I have to keep going,” Yang Fan thought to himself.
Nine thousand-plus points were not Yang Fan’s limit, and it was impossible for him to encounter such monsters every time.
Yang Fan’s goal this time was to enter the top 10,000 in Yang County.
The simulation battle matching continued.
Watching his points fluctuate constantly, Yang Fan felt a bit nervous as well.
Currently, the points for the 10,000th place in the Yang County Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle were 10,240.
As long as he could surpass that, he would achieve his goal.
Ten consecutive wins, one loss; points broke through ten thousand, win rate dropped to 94.2%.
Eight consecutive wins, one loss; points reached 10,124, win rate dropped to 89.1%.
Five consecutive wins, one loss; points 10,200, win rate 83.1%.
Three wins one loss, four wins one loss, two wins one loss...
Even though his opponents were Divine Beings from the entire human race, it seemed as if Heaven was playing a joke on Yang Fan; his points were just barely approaching the 10,000th mark.
He hadn’t managed to break through for over a dozen consecutive attempts.
“Continue. Even if it’s by luck, I have to squeeze in,” Yang Fan took a deep breath.
If he entered the top 10,000 in Yang County, he would have a chance to be recommended for admission.
No matter what, Yang Fan had to strive for it with all his might.
Points +1, points +2, points -1...
“Battle ended. Points +2. Current points: 10,241. Win rate: 63.2%.”
Hearing this sound, Yang Fan let out a long sigh of relief.
The enemies he encountered now were ridiculously strong, and every battle was extremely perilous.
But fortunately, he had finally squeezed into the top 10,000.
“Federal citizen Yang Fan, as a high school student, has squeezed into the top 10,000 of the local Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle leaderboard. Record saved.”
“Congratulations, citizen Yang Fan. Status upgraded, listed as a Human Prodigy.”
“Congratulations, citizen Yang Fan. Mall permissions increased, information permissions increased, security permissions increased.”

“Based on existing information and the judgment of the Federal Government’s highest Intelligent Life, you are specially awarded an A-grade resource building—Spirit Vein. This building is of immense value and has been treated with confidentiality.”

“According to the comprehensive evaluation by Intelligent Life, citizen Yang Fan has met the conditions for exemption from the College Entrance Examination. Tai Chu Academy extends an invitation to you. Staff from Tai Chu Academy will arrive in one day; please prepare to leave for your studies.”
A series of notification sounds rang in Yang Fan’s mind, and he was completely stunned.
Outside, in the real world, the school’s upper management and even government agencies were in an uproar, with Intelligent Life systems all flashing red alerts.
“High school senior Yang Fan, Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle points 10,241, listed as a Human Prodigy.”
“Listed as a Human Prodigy!”
“Citizen Yang Fan, listed as a Human Prodigy. Tai Chu Academy personnel will arrive in one day. According to Federal law, the local government must fully cooperate.”
The news spread rapidly among the upper echelons of Yang County like a hurricane.
“Principal Hong, what is going on? Such a genius appeared in No. 1 High School, and I, as the county magistrate, only found out because of a reminder from the Federal Government’s Intelligent Life!”
In the Virtual World, a man was wearing a suit, his hair combed meticulously, but at this moment, his gaze held some resentment.
This person was none other than the magistrate of Yang County, a Tier 3 God who rarely showed his face—Wang Yun.
“Old Wang, don’t blame me. I only just found out as well. This guy rushed from over a thousand points to over ten thousand; who could have predicted that?” Hong Bing was equally speechless.
“You didn’t cultivate such a genius in advance?” Wang Yun was somewhat suspicious.
“I had my eye on him after the midterm exams and invested a Wonder building in him, but I didn’t pay much attention after that. We’ve known each other for so many years; would I lie to you?”
“Then tell me, what should we do now? Tai Chu Academy is already snatching him up. If the higher-ups ask, how do we explain this?” Wang Yun couldn’t help but rub his temples.
Yang County belonged to the sphere of influence of Tiannan City, and that mayor was a graduate of Xingqiong Academy.
According to normal logic, if a prodigy appeared, they should have been recommended by them to Xingqiong Academy.
After all, a figure at the prodigy level was a treasure fought over by everyone at the top.
As a result, Yang Fan had suddenly barged into the top 10,000, directly alarming the Federal Government’s highest Intelligent Life, and the Federation had even allocated the spot to Tai Chu Academy.
Although they both belonged to the human race, Tai Chu Academy and Xingqiong Academy were in a competitive relationship.

Originally, by recommending a Human Prodigy, they could have received a reward, but now that he had been snatched away by others, let alone the reward, it was uncertain whether they would even face punishment from above.
“Tell the truth,” Hong Bing sighed.
“You are also the deputy county magistrate, and you have the most responsibility, so you’ll be the one at the forefront when the time comes.”
In the Luo Family’s base in the Virtual World, the place was in an uproar as well.

Yang Fan’s goal this time was to enter the top 10,000 in Yang County.
The simulation battle matching continued.
Watching his points fluctuate constantly, Yang Fan felt a bit nervous as well.
Currently, the points for the 10,000th place in the Yang County Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle were 10,240.
As long as he could surpass that, he would achieve his goal.
Ten consecutive wins, one loss; points broke through ten thousand, win rate dropped to 94.2%.
Eight consecutive wins, one loss; points reached 10,124, win rate dropped to 89.1%.
Five consecutive wins, one loss; points 10,200, win rate 83.1%.
Three wins one loss, four wins one loss, two wins one loss...
Even though his opponents were Divine Beings from the entire human race, it seemed as if Heaven was playing a joke on Yang Fan; his points were just barely approaching the 10,000th mark.
He hadn’t managed to break through for over a dozen consecutive attempts.
“Continue.
Even if it’s by luck, I have to squeeze in,” Yang Fan took a deep breath.
If he entered the top 10,000 in Yang County, he would have a chance to be recommended for admission.
No matter what, Yang Fan had to strive for it with all his might.
Points +1, points +2, points -1...
“Battle ended.
Points +2.
Current points: 10,241.
Win rate: 63.2%.”
Hearing this sound, Yang Fan let out a long sigh of relief.
The enemies he encountered now were ridiculously strong, and every battle was extremely perilous.
But fortunately, he had finally squeezed into the top 10,000.
“Federal citizen Yang Fan, as a high school student, has squeezed into the top 10,000 of the local Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle leaderboard.
Record saved.”
“Congratulations, citizen Yang Fan.
Status upgraded, listed as a Human Prodigy.”
“Congratulations, citizen Yang Fan.
Mall permissions increased, information permissions increased, security permissions increased.”
“Based on existing information and the judgment of the Federal Government’s highest Intelligent Life, you are specially awarded an A-grade resource building—Spirit Vein.
This building is of immense value and has been treated with confidentiality.”
“According to the comprehensive evaluation by Intelligent Life, citizen Yang Fan has met the conditions for exemption from the College Entrance Examination.
Tai Chu Academy extends an invitation to you.
Staff from Tai Chu Academy will arrive in one day; please prepare to leave for your studies.”
A series of notification sounds rang in Yang Fan’s mind, and he was completely stunned.
Outside, in the real world, the school’s upper management and even government agencies were in an uproar, with Intelligent Life systems all flashing red alerts.
“High school senior Yang Fan, Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle points 10,241, listed as a Human Prodigy.”
“Listed as a Human Prodigy!”
“Citizen Yang Fan, listed as a Human Prodigy.
Tai Chu Academy personnel will arrive in one day.
According to Federal law, the local government must fully cooperate.”
The news spread rapidly among the upper echelons of Yang County like a hurricane.
“Principal Hong, what is going on?
Such a genius appeared in No.
1 High School, and I, as the county magistrate, only found out because of a reminder from the Federal Government’s Intelligent Life!”
In the Virtual World, a man was wearing a suit, his hair combed meticulously, but at this moment, his gaze held some resentment.
This person was none other than the magistrate of Yang County, a Tier 3 God who rarely showed his face—Wang Yun.
“Old Wang, don’t blame me.
I only just found out as well.
This guy rushed from over a thousand points to over ten thousand; who could have predicted that?” Hong Bing was equally speechless.
“You didn’t cultivate such a genius in advance?” Wang Yun was somewhat suspicious.
“I had my eye on him after the midterm exams and invested a Wonder building in him, but I didn’t pay much attention after that.
We’ve known each other for so many years; would I lie to you?”
“Then tell me, what should we do now?
Tai Chu Academy is already snatching him up.
If the higher-ups ask, how do we explain this?” Wang Yun couldn’t help but rub his temples.
Yang County belonged to the sphere of influence of Tiannan City, and that mayor was a graduate of Xingqiong Academy.
According to normal logic, if a prodigy appeared, they should have been recommended by them to Xingqiong Academy.
After all, a figure at the prodigy level was a treasure fought over by everyone at the top.
As a result, Yang Fan had suddenly barged into the top 10,000, directly alarming the Federal Government’s highest Intelligent Life, and the Federation had even allocated the spot to Tai Chu Academy.
Although they both belonged to the human race, Tai Chu Academy and Xingqiong Academy were in a competitive relationship.

Originally, by recommending a Human Prodigy, they could have received a reward, but now that he had been snatched away by others, let alone the reward, it was uncertain whether they would even face punishment from above.
“Tell the truth,” Hong Bing sighed.
“You are also the deputy county magistrate, and you have the most responsibility, so you’ll be the one at the forefront when the time comes.”
In the Luo Family’s base in the Virtual World, the place was in an uproar as well.

chapters.title: Chapter 98: The Luo Family's Response
paragraphs: Luo Chengfeng stood up and pointed at Luo Xuan’s nose, cursing, “Luo Xuan, do you have no shame? A conflict between the younger generation has actually been escalated to a Family meeting. For the sake of that useless son of yours, you’re not even following the rules anymore, are you!”
“A First-Class Genius requires a massive amount of resources. If his surname were Luo, I naturally wouldn’t have any objections, but after all, his surname is Yang.”
“Then your wife, Rao Mingming, shouldn’t speak at Family meetings in the future either; her surname isn’t Luo either.”
“Those are two different things!”
Luo Hai slammed the table with rare force.

With a loud bang, Luo Hai stood up and said, “What kind of behavior is this bickering? If the Family wants to develop and flourish forever, it doesn’t rely on internal schemes, but on fair, just, and open Family rules.”
“Yes, Clan Head,” the Elders responded.

“To be able to break into the top ten thousand of the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle within less than a year of Awakening shows that Yang Fan’s Divine Kingdom has infinite potential. For such a Genius, our Luo Family should naturally put our full effort into nurturing him.”
At this point, Luo Hai looked around and said loudly, “I announce that from now on, Yang Fan will be a First-Class...”
Luo Hai’s words suddenly stopped, the expression on his Face shifting repeatedly, until finally, he sat back down in his chair.
“Clan Head, what is it?” Luo Chengfeng showed a look of confusion.
“There’s no need anymore. Elder Chengfeng, return to the real world in a moment and bring Yang Fan to the Luo Family grounds.”
“Huh?”

“Yang Fan has been admitted to Primordial Academy. Tomorrow, he will be picked up by a specialist and taken to Taichu City. This is the news Principal Hong just gave me; there can be no mistake,” Luo Hai explained.
The scene instantly fell silent, and the dozen or so gods present all wore looks of disbelief.
Early admission, and Primordial Academy sending a specialist to escort him to Taichu City—the implications of this were far too great.
Eleven years ago, No.
1 Middle School also had a Genius who broke into the top ten thousand of the simulation battle, but that person only barely obtained a recommendation for admission to Xingqiong Academy.
Let alone early admission, they even had to undergo a series of rigorous tests before entering the school.
Primordial Academy couldn’t be fools; their Intelligent Life must have discovered something unusual.
Otherwise, it would be impossible for them to place such importance on him, rushing from Taichu City to Yang County in a single day.
To travel in such a hurry, how many space wormholes would they have to cross?
The travel costs and resources spent would be an astronomical figure for gods from a small place like theirs.

“Clan Head, while Yang Fan hasn’t been officially admitted to Primordial Academy yet, we should immediately sign a Family contract with him. This person might be a springboard for our Luo Family,” one Elder said with a Face full of excitement.
“That’s right. This boy’s Divine Kingdom most likely has a hidden talent, we...”

“Enough. The Federal Government’s protection of Prodigies is extremely strict; don’t try these petty tricks. No matter what, Yang Fan came from our Luo Family. With this bit of connection, when he becomes a High-Order God in the future, even the scraps that fall from his fingernails will be enough to sustain us,” Luo Hai said with a stern expression.
“Yes, Clan Head.”
“Elder Chengfeng, hurry to the Yang City villa and bring him and your granddaughter to the Luo Family grounds in the real world.”
“Yes,” Luo Chengfeng replied and immediately disappeared from the meeting room.

After he left, Luo Hai stood up and announced, “Next, I have three things to announce: First, the B-Grade Building, Alchemy Tower, in the storehouse will be gifted to Yang Fan for free. Second, withdraw ten thousand Divinity Points from the Family account to support his living expenses at Primordial Academy.”
Hearing this, the Elders all showed expressions of pain, but none of them argued.
Given Yang Fan’s current situation, he was indeed worth the Family’s full investment.

“Second, from now on, Luo Chengfeng’s granddaughter Luo Rou’s status is upgraded to a Family First-Class Genius. The Grand Elder will take my command token to Tiannan City to find Great Master Gu He and ask for his help in resolving the issue of Luo Rou’s damaged Divine Kingdom. ”
“In the future, when Luo Rou and Yang Fan’s child is born, regardless of their talent, they will also enjoy the treatment of a First-Class Genius,” Luo Hai continued.
“Yes, I will go shortly.”
“Third.” Luo Hai turned to look at Luo Xuan, his body radiating the pressure of a Tier 3 God: “Your son is named Luo Mingxuan, right?”
“Clan Head, I will certainly discipline that brat well when I get back. I won’t let him appear in front of Yang Fan ever again,” Luo Xuan said with a trembling voice.
“Not enough. For your sake, Luo Mingxuan will be expelled from the Luo Family. Find a quiet place to raise him yourself,” Luo Hai said, settling the matter with finality.
“I obey the Clan Head’s command.” Luo Xuan sighed in his heart, yet he was helpless.

“Brother Luo Xuan, don’t be so sad, you two. That boy Luo Mingxuan was useless anyway; just have another one. We have achieved Breakthroughs to become gods and have long Lifespans; how can we be trapped by these personal feelings?” a nearby Luo Family Elder consoled.
“That’s right. Compared to the Family’s interests, you must know which is more important. Don’t be foolish.”
Many Elders began to remind him.
Luo Xuan’s Face looked a bit ugly, but he didn’t know how to argue back.
“Alright, the Family meeting ends here. You may all leave,” Luo Hai said.
After everyone left, Luo Hai edited a message and sent it to his daughter.
In less than fifteen minutes, Luo Bing appeared in the meeting room.
At this moment, Luo Bing kept her head down, her Face filled with an irrepressible sense of defeat.
“Defeated by someone of the same age, are you not convinced?” Luo Hai asked.
“I’m just a bit unwilling,” Luo Bing responded.

Luo Hai looked at his daughter gently, “Once you get to university and see more people, the pride in your heart will naturally be worn down. Don’t think your talent is that great; it’s only a B-Grade Talent. In Tiannan City, you might not even make the list.”
“Ultimately, Yang County is too small. I should have arranged for you and Luo Hen to go to Tiannan City to study together back then.”
“Father, I still need to study Formations. Why did you call me here?”
“It’s confirmed that Yang Fan has been admitted to Primordial Academy. He will leave Yang County tomorrow,” Luo Hai said.
Hearing this, Luo Bing pursed her lips slightly, “He really has good luck. I will definitely work hard to catch up to him.”

Seeing that his daughter didn’t realize the gravity of the situation, Luo Hai continued to explain, “In the last hundred years, three people from Yang County have squeezed into the top ten thousand of the Divine Kingdom Simulation Battle as high school students. One of them even ranked over nine thousand.”
“Guess where they all went to university?”
Luo Bing shook her head, indicating she didn’t know.
Although this news wasn’t top secret, she didn’t have time to research it.

Moreover, she heard that as long as one entered the top ten thousand of the simulation battle, they would automatically get a hundred points on the first part of the College Entrance Examination, and even have the chance to be recommended to an excellent university.
“Of the three, only one entered Xingqiong Academy. The other two didn’t even receive an invitation.”
Luo Bing looked at her father in confusion.
If that were the case, Yang Fan’s ranking was only at the very end of the top ten thousand, so why would he receive an invitation?
“The Genius who entered Xingqiong Academy was rated as a Grade C Genius by the Federal Government. Guess what Yang Fan’s evaluation was?”
“Prodigy! He was rated as a Human Race Prodigy by the Federal Government’s Intelligent Life!”
Luo Hai stared into Luo Bing’s eyes, his expression gradually becoming solemn.
Looking at her father’s expression, Luo Bing finally realized the gravity of the situation.
Yang Fan’s potential seemed to far exceed her imagination.

chapters.title: Chapter 99: Father
paragraphs: Luo Bing did not know what it meant to be a Prodigy of the Human Race, but looking at her father’s eyes, she knew it was not simple.
“Father, but he clearly has an F-Grade resource talent, why?”
“Hidden talent.”
“This is?”
“I am only a Tier 3 God, so I do not know much. However, for Primordial Academy to be so anxious to snatch him up, Yang Fan’s hidden talent must be extraordinary.”

Luo Hai took a deep breath, his expression suddenly turning serious: “The Family has decided to fully invest in Yang Fan, but I feel there is still a missing link between the Luo Family and Yang Fan.”
“Bing’er, I intend to betroth you to Yang Fan. Are you willing?”
“Father, what kind of joke is this? I...” Before Luo Bing could finish her sentence, her consciousness suddenly felt a pressure like the roaring of mountains and seas.
Luo Hai looked at Luo Bing with calm eyes, the aura of a Tier 3 God undisguised.
At this moment, Luo Hai was no longer Luo Bing’s kind father, but the Family Head of the Luo Family, a Tier 3 God who had long held a high position.
“Bing’er, kneel.” Luo Hai said coldly.
Under the immense pressure, Luo Bing could no longer hold on and knelt by the table on both knees.

“When you were young, I took you to the City Government to see the world. You ate a piece of Ten-Thousand Fire Spirit Fish and came back to tell me you wanted more. It was the Family that helped you buy it. Do you know that was a B-Grade Spirit Beast?”
“Before the Awakening of the Divine Kingdom, the Family had already helped you identify your Ice Spirit Root talent and spent a fortune to purchase the Ice God Temple. Do you still remember?”
“Your monthly allowance, the assistance of the Family Actuary, the provision of various rare resources, and the personal guidance of Gods.”
“From the moment you were born, you were the apple of the Luo Family’s eye, enjoying luxury and being sought after by others.”
“Having received so many benefits, now that the Family needs you, you refuse. Do you think this is right?”
Luo Hai’s tone was calm, but his voice struck Luo Bing’s back like a ten-thousand-pound weight.
“Fa... Father, I will become very strong in the future, I will...”

“You only have B-Grade talent. With the cultivation of the Luo Family, reaching my level in the future is your limit. And now, a massive Opportunity for the Luo Family is right before us. You are not even willing to make this small sacrifice?” Luo Hai continued to press.
“But what about Cousin Luo Rou?”
“It does not matter. The strong naturally possess more rights in choosing their partners. Don’t forget, your mother was my 28th wife.”
“I understand, Family Head.” Luo Bing said slowly.
As her words fell, the pressure on her body from Luo Hai vanished instantly.
Luo Bing lowered her head and slowly stood up.
“After leaving the Virtual World, go directly to the villa in Yang City. Get it done for me tonight.”
“Yes, Family Head.”
After Luo Bing finished speaking, she disappeared into the virtual space.
Looking at the spot where Luo Bing had just stood, Luo Hai felt a bit dazed: “Little Bing, you are still young. My choice is not just for the Family; it is also for you!”
On the other side, Yang Fan, who had exited the Virtual World, was called out by Luo Chengfeng before he could enter his Divine Kingdom to check his gains.
“Grandfather, what is this?”
Seeing Luo Chengfeng hurriedly pulling him and Luo Rou into the car, Yang Fan was stunned.
What was going on?
Why did it look like they were running away?
“We are going to the Luo Family grounds.” Luo Chengfeng explained.
“The Virtual World would have sufficed. What is this?”
“The Family Head wants to see you in the real world.”
“Ah?” Yang Fan was a bit shocked.
One had to know that the Luo Family Head, Luo Hai, was a Tier 3 God.
“My good grandson-in-law, no matter what happens in the future, you must take good care of Little Rou. She is carrying your child.” Luo Chengfeng, who was driving, couldn’t help but urge him.
Hearing this, Luo Rou became nervous: “Grandfather, has your Divine Kingdom been attacked?”
“Go, go, go, you silly girl, are you cursing your grandfather?” Luo Chengfeng rolled his eyes.
“Then why did Grandfather say that, as if you were entrusting an orphan?” Luo Rou placed her hand on her stomach, her little mouth pouting involuntarily.
Luo Chengfeng drove to the Luo Family and then led the two of them into the reception room of the Family Head, Luo Hai.
This was Yang Fan’s first time seeing Luo Hai.
The other party did not have the slightest airs of a God; his aura was gentle, like a warm spring breeze, making people feel close to him.
“Greetings, Family Head.” Yang Fan said politely.
“Come, sit down quickly. You are heading to Taichu City tomorrow, so I was a bit anxious. Don’t mind it.” Luo Hai explained.
Yang Fan thought to himself that it was as expected.
As expected of the Luo Family, one of the two major families in Yang County, they received the news so quickly.
Since he had been admitted to Primordial Academy, it seemed this Luo Family Head wanted to strengthen their relationship before he left.
Yang Fan was not surprised by this.
He had no blood relation to the Luo Family, and as he displayed more and more value, the Luo Family naturally had to invest more.
Yang Fan was equally grateful to the Luo Family; if not for their help, he would never have achieved his current results.
“Little Fan, I can call you that, right!” Luo Hai looked at Yang Fan.
“Of course, you are too kind, Family Head.” Yang Fan felt a bit flattered.
“This is fine wine I brought back from Tiannan City. It has great benefits for the Physical Body of a Divine Being. You can have a taste.”
“Thank you.” Yang Fan picked up the wine glass and drank it in one gulp.
Facing a Tier 3 God, Yang Fan did not take precautions.
After all, with the other party’s strength, if they really wanted to do something to him, he couldn’t defend against it anyway, so it was better to accept the benefit openly.

Seeing Yang Fan drink the wine in one gulp, the corner of Luo Hai’s mouth curled into a smile as he continued: “Since you have been admitted to Primordial Academy in advance, the Luo Family has decided to increase our investment in you. This is the B-Grade Building, the Pill Tower. It is considered the most core strategic resource in the Luo Family’s treasury. When you break through to Demigod in the future, you will understand the value of this building.”
“Thank you, Family Head.” Looking at the card in his hand, Yang Fan was a bit surprised.
A strategic resource, and the other party just gave it away?
Without asking for anything in return?

“Besides that, the Family has also decided to reward you with 10,000 Divinity Points unconditionally. Consumption in Taichu City is high; consider this living expenses. If you have any needs in the future, you can tell me directly. The funds will be transferred to your Divine Kingdom tonight.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan looked up at the other party, his eyes full of disbelief.
Yang Fan suspected he had misheard!
That was 10,000 Divinity Points.
Converted to Faith Points, that was one trillion.
The Luo Family’s investment in him was a bit ridiculously large!
Yang Fan swallowed his saliva, “Family Head, I do not know how I should repay you?”

“You are the Genius of my Luo Family, why talk about repayment? Just work hard at Primordial Academy in the future. Once you break through to a High-Order God, it will be enough for the Luo Family to bask in some glory.” Luo Hai said with a smile on his face.
Luo Rou, who did not know the situation on the side, was also staring at her Family Head, looking incredulous.
As a direct descendant of the Luo Family, she naturally had heard of the Pill Tower; it was a treasure that even Gods needed.
And 10,000 Divinity Points—Luo Rou indicated that she had never seen so much money in her life.
“Come, have another drink. I will have the driver take you back later. Get a good rest tonight.”
As he spoke, Luo Hai filled Yang Fan’s glass again.
