“Bing’er, kneel.” Luo Hai said coldly.
Under the immense pressure, Luo Bing could no longer hold on and knelt by the table on both knees.
“When you were young, I took you to the City Government to see the world.
You ate a piece of Ten-Thousand Fire Spirit Fish and came back to tell me you wanted more.
It was the Family that helped you buy it.
Do you know that was a B-Grade Spirit Beast?”
“Before the Awakening of the Divine Kingdom, the Family had already helped you identify your Ice Spirit Root talent and spent a fortune to purchase the Ice God Temple.
Do you still remember?”
“Your monthly allowance, the assistance of the Family Actuary, the provision of various rare resources, and the personal guidance of Gods.”
“From the moment you were born, you were the apple of the Luo Family’s eye, enjoying luxury and being sought after by others.”
“Having received so many benefits, now that the Family needs you, you refuse.
Do you think this is right?”
Luo Hai’s tone was calm, but his voice struck Luo Bing’s back like a ten-thousand-pound weight.
Father, I will become very strong in the future, I will...”
“You only have B-Grade talent.
With the cultivation of the Luo Family, reaching my level in the future is your limit.
And now, a massive Opportunity for the Luo Family is right before us.
You are not even willing to make this small sacrifice?” Luo Hai continued to press.
“But what about Cousin Luo Rou?”
“It does not matter.
The strong naturally possess more rights in choosing their partners.
Don’t forget, your mother was my 28th wife.”
“I understand, Family Head.” Luo Bing said slowly.
As her words fell, the pressure on her body from Luo Hai vanished instantly.
Luo Bing lowered her head and slowly stood up.
“After leaving the Virtual World, go directly to the villa in Yang City.
Get it done for me tonight.”
“Yes, Family Head.”
After Luo Bing finished speaking, she disappeared into the virtual space.
Looking at the spot where Luo Bing had just stood, Luo Hai felt a bit dazed: “Little Bing, you are still young.
My choice is not just for the Family; it is also for you!”
On the other side, Yang Fan, who had exited the Virtual World, was called out by Luo Chengfeng before he could enter his Divine Kingdom to check his gains.
“Grandfather, what is this?”
Seeing Luo Chengfeng hurriedly pulling him and Luo Rou into the car, Yang Fan was stunned.
What was going on?
Why did it look like they were running away?
“We are going to the Luo Family grounds.” Luo Chengfeng explained.
“The Virtual World would have sufficed.
What is this?”
“The Family Head wants to see you in the real world.”
“Ah?” Yang Fan was a bit shocked.
One had to know that the Luo Family Head, Luo Hai, was a Tier 3 God.
“My good grandson-in-law, no matter what happens in the future, you must take good care of Little Rou.
She is carrying your child.” Luo Chengfeng, who was driving, couldn’t help but urge him.
Hearing this, Luo Rou became nervous: “Grandfather, has your Divine Kingdom been attacked?”
“Go, go, go, you silly girl, are you cursing your grandfather?” Luo Chengfeng rolled his eyes.
“Then why did Grandfather say that, as if you were entrusting an orphan?” Luo Rou placed her hand on her stomach, her little mouth pouting involuntarily.
Luo Chengfeng drove to the Luo Family and then led the two of them into the reception room of the Family Head, Luo Hai.
This was Yang Fan’s first time seeing Luo Hai.
The other party did not have the slightest airs of a God; his aura was gentle, like a warm spring breeze, making people feel close to him.
“Greetings, Family Head.” Yang Fan said politely.
“Come, sit down quickly.
You are heading to Taichu City tomorrow, so I was a bit anxious.
Don’t mind it.” Luo Hai explained.
Yang Fan thought to himself that it was as expected.
As expected of the Luo Family, one of the two major families in Yang County, they received the news so quickly.
Since he had been admitted to Primordial Academy, it seemed this Luo Family Head wanted to strengthen their relationship before he left.
Yang Fan was not surprised by this.
He had no blood relation to the Luo Family, and as he displayed more and more value, the Luo Family naturally had to invest more.
Yang Fan was equally grateful to the Luo Family; if not for their help, he would never have achieved his current results.
“Little Fan, I can call you that, right!” Luo Hai looked at Yang Fan.
“Of course, you are too kind, Family Head.” Yang Fan felt a bit flattered.
“This is fine wine I brought back from Tiannan City.
It has great benefits for the Physical Body of a Divine Being.
You can have a taste.”
“Thank you.” Yang Fan picked up the wine glass and drank it in one gulp.
Facing a Tier 3 God, Yang Fan did not take precautions.
After all, with the other party’s strength, if they really wanted to do something to him, he couldn’t defend against it anyway, so it was better to accept the benefit openly.

Seeing Yang Fan drink the wine in one gulp, the corner of Luo Hai’s mouth curled into a smile as he continued: “Since you have been admitted to Primordial Academy in advance, the Luo Family has decided to increase our investment in you.
This is the B-Grade Building, the Pill Tower.
It is considered the most core strategic resource in the Luo Family’s treasury.
When you break through to Demigod in the future, you will understand the value of this building.”
“Thank you, Family Head.” Looking at the card in his hand, Yang Fan was a bit surprised.
A strategic resource, and the other party just gave it away?
Without asking for anything in return?
“Besides that, the Family has also decided to reward you with 10,000 Divinity Points unconditionally.
Consumption in Taichu City is high; consider this living expenses.
If you have any needs in the future, you can tell me directly.
The funds will be transferred to your Divine Kingdom tonight.”
Hearing this, Yang Fan looked up at the other party, his eyes full of disbelief.
Yang Fan suspected he had misheard!
That was 10,000 Divinity Points.
Converted to Faith Points, that was one trillion.
The Luo Family’s investment in him was a bit ridiculously large!
Yang Fan swallowed his saliva, “Family Head, I do not know how I should repay you?”
“You are the Genius of my Luo Family, why talk about repayment?
Just work hard at Primordial Academy in the future.
Once you break through to a High-Order God, it will be enough for the Luo Family to bask in some glory.” Luo Hai said with a smile on his face.
Luo Rou, who did not know the situation on the side, was also staring at her Family Head, looking incredulous.
As a direct descendant of the Luo Family, she naturally had heard of the Pill Tower; it was a treasure that even Gods needed.
And 10,000 Divinity Points—Luo Rou indicated that she had never seen so much money in her life.
“Come, have another drink.
I will have the driver take you back later.
Get a good rest tonight.”
As he spoke, Luo Hai filled Yang Fan’s glass again.

chapters.title: Chapter 100: Wanting to Relive the Moment
paragraphs: Luo Hai’s wine was truly potent.
With his current strength, after just two glasses, Yang Fan felt his head grow heavy and began sweating all over.
“Um... Family Head, I think I...?” Yang Fan felt something was off with his body.
“Drunk, right? I’ll have the driver take you back immediately.”
Luo Hai acted swiftly, arranging for a man in a black overcoat who quickly came up to support Yang Fan and take him downstairs.
Watching this scene, Luo Chengfeng glanced at the wine glass from earlier and couldn’t help asking, “Family Head, you...”

“Little Rou’s talent is too poor. Even with the Family’s full support, it will be difficult for her to achieve a God Breakthrough in the future. Everything is for the sake of the Family. You understand.” Luo Hai said meaningfully.
Luo Chengfeng sighed softly but did not refute.
“Grandpa, what are you talking about?” Luo Rou asked, puzzled.
“Little Rou, I’ve already sent the Grand Elder to Tiannan City to find Great Master Gu He. He will help you resolve the issue with your damaged divine kingdom.” Luo Hai changed the subject.
“Really?!” Luo Rou’s face lit up with excitement.
Ever since Yang Fan revealed his talent, her life had been getting better and better.
Her biggest worry now was the problem with her divine kingdom, fearing she wouldn’t have time to watch her child grow up.
Now, hearing that the issue with her damaged divine kingdom could be resolved, Luo Rou was overjoyed beyond words.

Luo Hai continued, “Once your divine kingdom is restored, the Family will grant you the treatment of a First-Class Genius and have you return to university. As for your child, from birth, they will also be a First-Class Genius of our Luo Family.”
Hearing this, Luo Rou felt excitement, but a trace of confusion also flickered in her eyes.
The cultivation of a First-Class Genius requires a vast amount of Family resources.
For the Family Head to grant two spots at once finally made Luo Rou sense that something was amiss.
“Your husband’s divine kingdom has limitless potential. In the future, he might even lead the entire Luo Family to a higher level.” Luo Hai explained.
Luo Chengfeng walked over and patted Luo Rou on the shoulder.
“Girl, you’re pregnant. Don’t stand for too long. Go rest for a while in the guest room downstairs.”
Luo Rou nodded obediently and left the room.
After she left, Luo Chengfeng inquired, “I wonder which one Family Head has arranged?”
“My daughter, Luo Bing.”
“The Family Head’s methods are impressive.”

“Not at all. Everything is for the Family. Moreover, Bing and Xiao Rou used to have a good relationship. After Xiao Fan becomes a God, the two of them might still need to help each other.” Luo Hai said calmly.
After understanding the reasoning behind it, Luo Chengfeng’s expression gradually relaxed.
“Family Head, since they’re both marrying Yang Fan, wouldn’t the seniority get a bit messy? I’m the grandfather, you’re the father. In the future, between the two of us...”
“Get lost. I’m probably a few thousand years older than you. Don’t try to get the better of me.” Luo Hai rolled his eyes, looking exasperated.
“Just joking. You’re the Family Head. You’ve always gotten the better of us when allocating resources before. How would I dare?” Luo Chengfeng chuckled.
In the car, Yang Fan only felt his head growing heavier and his whole body so hot he just wanted to take off his clothes.
He didn’t even know how he got back to the room, only feeling a body emitting a cool aura catch him.
“What’s wrong with you?”
“Not so fast... I’m not ready yet...”
“You... are you crazy?”
“Is this poison? Bastard!”
“Luo Hai, am I really your daughter?”
Waking up in bed the next day, Yang Fan felt utterly refreshed, as if he had boundless energy.
Feeling the soft body in his arms, Yang Fan directly lowered his head and kissed it.
“Rou’er, last night felt amazing. Did you give me a cold bath? You worked hard...”
Both of them opened their eyes simultaneously, their lips still touching!
Silence.
You could hear a pin drop in the room!
With a thud, Yang Fan felt a kick to his abdomen, almost making him vomit bile.
“You... Luo Bing, what are you doing here?” Yang Fan clutched his stomach, sweating profusely from the pain.
Luo Bing was not only the top figure in Class 1, Grade 12 but also Luo Hai’s daughter.
A Tier 3 God’s daughter was lying in his bed, and he had just instinctively kissed her.
Wait?
Last night was...?
Yang Fan suddenly understood, looking at her with an expression of utter disbelief.
“Sister Bing, last night, you and I, we...? What happened?” Yang Fan pointed at Luo Bing, then at himself, his finger trembling.
Luo Bing just sat on the bed motionless, her gaze calm as she looked at Yang Fan.
“Um... should we say something?”
“Last night, I...?” Yang Fan ventured cautiously.
Luo Bing took a deep breath.
“You have quite the repertoire. Seems you learned a lot at the Tianxiang Renjian!”
Luo Bing wrapped the towel around herself, then stood up, walking somewhat awkwardly into the bathroom.
Seeing this, Yang Fan fully understood what had happened.
“The Luo Family Head drugged me, and I slept with his daughter? How did this plot...?” Yang Fan’s face twitched.
Ever since his divine kingdom’s Awakening, his Physique had grown stronger and stronger.
How could he possibly get drunk?
Now it seemed the wine Luo Hai gave him was definitely problematic.
But was it necessary?
If you all agreed yourselves, as a man, could I even refuse?
It must be said, Luo Bing’s aura was one that could inspire a desire to conquer.
Even Yang Fan had fantasized about it before.
As long as Luo Bing nodded herself, Yang Fan felt that not rising to the occasion would be a disrespect to manhood.
“Such a wonderful night, yet I was in a poisoned state. What a pity.” Yang Fan shamelessly thought to himself.
“Wait, how does Luo Bing know I went to the Tianxiang Renjian? Which bastard exposed this and ruined my image?” Yang Fan suddenly froze.
At that moment, Li Chengze and Li Shuhao, both at their own homes, sneezed simultaneously.
“Who’s talking bad about me?” they both wondered.
After finishing her bath and getting dressed, Luo Bing sat down beside Yang Fan.
“It wasn’t your fault. My father drugged you, and I agreed to it.” Luo Bing said suddenly.
“Why?” Yang Fan was somewhat puzzled.
“The Family needs to win you over. I am the tool.” Luo Bing said with an extremely serious expression.
“Yang Fan, one day, I will rely on my own efforts to catch up to you. I am not your appendage.”
“This is the marriage certificate. You need to sign it.”

“Our marital relationship has no restrictions. Our divine kingdom assets are managed separately. If you have physical needs, you can find me in the Virtual World. If you want offspring, I’ll send you the address after I graduate from high school.”
“I probably won’t get into Primordial Academy. When the time comes, you come find me. I can get pregnant, but it must not affect the development of my divine kingdom.”
“The child can also take your surname. As for the cost of raising them, we’ll split it fifty-fifty.”
After saying this, Luo Bing didn’t wait for Yang Fan’s reply and got up to leave.
“Wait a moment.” Yang Fan suddenly called out.
“What is it?”
“Add me as a friend. If you have any troubles in the future, you can find me. Although my strength isn’t much, I’m fairly wealthy and can help you develop your divine kingdom.”
“Not necessary.”
With a bang, the room door closed.
Yang Fan’s expression was a mix of amusement and exasperation.
“It’s just that her personality is too cold. I was unconscious yesterday. I’d like to relive the moment.”
